This role calls for a proactive self\-starter who can turn insight into action,** **operate independently, and lead engagements, experiments, and learning efforts with** **minimal oversight. Mortgage industry experience is preferred; candidates without it** **should be prepared to ramp up on the domain quickly.** **Key Responsibilities** ** Lead client engagements to scope, prototype, and deliver GenAI\-powered** **workflows.** ** Translate business and operational pain points into LLM\-based solutions.** ** Run discovery sessions, use case sprints, and prompt engineering labs with** **stakeholders.** ** Stand up fast\-cycle experiments and proofs of concept using tools such as** **ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or open\-source models.** ** Package successful experiments into ** Capture real\-world insights to inform product, content, and go\-to\-market** **strategies.** **Minimum Qualifications** ** 3–8 years of experience in consulting, product enablement, innovation, or applied** **business strategy.** ** Demonstrated ability to work independently, make decisions, and lead client work** **without constant oversight.** ** Hands\-on experience using generative AI for real work, including building** **prompts, workflows, and proofs of concept.** ** Excellent facilitation and storytelling skills, with the ability to bridge business,** **compliance, and technical stakeholders.** ** Ability to think and act quickly in fluid environments, with strong executional** **follow\-through.** ** Self\-directed learner with high curiosity and a bias toward jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: New York City · Full\-time **Help build the backend that makes better healthcare possible.** ----------------------------------------------------------------- At Nolla Health, we’re building AI\-powered healthcare that connects understanding a patient’s needs with actually delivering care. That takes more than a capable model: it takes software that brings together patient information, clinical decisions, and the systems needed to act on them. We’re looking for an experienced engineer to build and own that foundation. You’ll develop the services behind our patient apps and clinical workflows, connect healthcare systems, and build the infrastructure that lets AI agents work securely and reliably alongside clinicians. This is a hands\-on role with room to shape the architecture, engineering practices, and team as we grow. We welcome senior and staff engineers, early startup engineers, and former founders who want broad ownership and close involvement in the product. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build the APIs and backend services powering our patient apps and clinical workflows. * Develop the systems that connect AI agents to patient information, clinical tools, and actions involved in delivering care. * Build tools that help clinicians review cases and care for patients. * Integrate with electronic medical records and other healthcare systems. * Own cloud infrastructure, deployments, monitoring, and production reliability. * Design secure systems for sensitive patient data, including access controls and audit trails. * Work with product, clinical, and AI teammates to take features from an idea through launch and ongoing operation. * Improve how we build software through automation, thoughtful tooling, and effective use of AI coding tools. * Help hire and mentor engineers as the team grows. **What you bring** ------------------ * Substantial experience building and operating production backend systems, typically six or more years. * Experience building at an early\-stage startup, shipping with a small team and owning multiple parts of the stack. * Strong judgment about APIs, data models, databases, background jobs, and integrations. * The ability to own cloud infrastructure and operate the services you build. * A practical understanding of security, reliability, and handling sensitive data. * Product judgment: you can work through an ambiguous problem, understand what users need, and choose an approach that gets useful software into their hands. * Effective use of AI coding tools, with the judgment to review, test, and maintain what they produce. * A desire to stay hands\-on while taking responsibility for technical decisions and outcomes. We care about what you’ve built, how you think, and the responsibility you’ve taken on. You should bring strong engineering practices and know how to apply them in a small team. **Bonus points** ---------------- * Backend systems for consumer or mobile products. * AI agents, tool integrations, or AI\-powered features in production. * Healthcare software, clinical workflows, EMR integrations, or HIPAA requirements. * Hiring or mentoring engineers. Healthcare experience is welcome, but it isn’t required. An interest in making healthcare better is. Your work will support both patients seeking care and the clinicians providing it. You’ll help decide how AI becomes part of a working healthcare service, from the information an agent can access to how a clinical workflow moves forward. You’ll have a direct say in how Nolla’s backend is built and how the engineering team works. As we grow, there’s room to take on technical leadership and help build the team while staying close to the code. This role is based in New York City. We’re open to candidates willing to relocate. **Compensation** ---------------- Salary: $180,000–$220,000\+, based on experience. Compensation Range: $180K \- $220K

jobs.title: Construction Scheduling & Project Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Construction Scheduling \& Project Controls Engineer** ======================================================== **A challenge for builders of plans** ------------------------------------- Imagine a utility conflict is discovered on a roadway reconstruction job. The milestone is at risk. You open Primavera P6, craft a fragnet, run a Time Impact Analysis, and model recovery options. You brief the Project Manager on critical path movement, float erosion, and the sequence that gets the team back on track—backed by quantities, production rates, and a revised look‑ahead. If that sounds like your kind of challenge, you’ll thrive here. **Role mission** ---------------- Turn contracts and drawings into dependable CPM schedules for heavy civil work—underground utilities, streets and roadways, and bridges—then keep those schedules current, insightful, and actionable. **Core responsibilities** ------------------------- * Build baseline CPM schedules in P6 in coordination with Project Managers, Estimating, and Operations leadership. * Translate plans, specifications, bids, contracts, and scheduling clauses into robust schedule structure and field‑realistic sequencing. * Develop calendars, WBS, activities, logic ties, durations, milestones, constraints, and coding standards in Primavera P6\. * Fold in contractual milestones; procurement, submittals, utility coordination, traffic control, testing, and closeout requirements. * Continuously update schedules to reflect progress, resequencing, change orders, and impacts; issue revisions and recovery paths. * Run what‑if scenarios to assess alternatives and recommend time‑recovery strategies. * Detect and communicate changes to critical path, float, activity sequences, and milestone dates to stakeholders. * Integrate estimating data—budgets, quantities, production rates—into baselines and short‑interval plans to track plan vs. actual. * Identify early slippage, constraints, and schedule risks; supply timely information for decision‑making. * Prepare TIAs, fragnets, and schedule exhibits for delays, changes, differing site conditions, utility conflicts, and change orders. * Advance standardized scheduling practices, templates, reporting, and project controls processes across Core Operations. * Present findings, risk trends, and recommendations to PMs, the Division Manager, and Leadership; maintain complete schedule records. * Undertake other related duties as assigned. **Experience \& qualifications** -------------------------------- * High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related field strongly preferred. * 3–5 years in construction scheduling or project controls, preferably on heavy civil, roadway, utility, bridge, or infrastructure projects. * Advanced Primavera P6 user who can independently create complete CPM baselines from project documentation. * Strong grasp of heavy civil means, methods, and sequencing—particularly utilities, streets/roadways, and bridges. * Proficient reading and interpreting plans, specifications, contracts, bids, project budgets, and contractual scheduling requirements. * Microsoft Office proficiency; Microsoft Project and other project controls or construction‑management platforms preferred. **Working conditions** ---------------------- Expect extended seated computer work along with periods of standing and walking; occasional lifting up to 25 lbs. You’ll frequently use office equipment requiring fine motor skills. The role includes outdoor site visits and stakeholder interaction; sufficient mobility and stamina are required to attend meetings and navigate construction environments. **Benefits you can count on** ----------------------------- * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision * Company‑paid basic dental, life, and short‑/long‑term disability * Optional life, accident, critical illness, and pet insurance * 401(k) retirement plan * Quarterly bonus program * PTO, paid holidays, and a paid winter company break (eligible roles) * EAP and wellness resources * Tuition reimbursement and continuing education support * Dependent scholarship program (eligible employees) * Company events, community involvement, and quarterly State of the Company meetings **Equal Opportunity \& E‑Verify** --------------------------------- E\-Z Bel Construction, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. E\-Z Bel Construction, LLC participates in E\-Verify, a federal system that allows enrolled employers to confirm the employment eligibility of newly hired employees

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our Data \& Analytics team, responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and data models on our Databricks lakehouse on Azure, governed through Unity Catalog. You will work in an AI\-first team where agentic AI is part of how we design, build, test and operate our data platform every day. As part of the team, you’ll contribute to technical design and help shape our engineering standards. **YOUR CHALLENGE:** * Design and develop data pipelines in Python (PySpark) on Databricks, applying engineering best practices for performance, reliability and maintainability. * Ingest and integrate diverse data sources into the lakehouse in batch, following our bronze, silver and gold layering and ensuring data quality and accuracy. * Help introduce event streaming and real\-time ingestion to the platform: design, build and operate streaming pipelines on Databricks from sources such as Kafka, handling late, duplicate and out\-of\-order events reliably. * Maintain data models and the data estate codebase, with data governed, secured and documented in Unity Catalog. * Write automated tests for every change: unit tests for pipeline logic, integration tests against real data, and data quality checks that catch issues before they reach users. * Follow and contribute to the team’s engineering standards: clean, modular code, peer code review, CI/CD, infrastructure as code (Databricks Asset Bundles) and clear documentation. * Use agentic AI tools (such as Claude Code) daily to build, test, review and troubleshoot, and help design and improve the AI agents and skills that automate our data workflows, with human review built in. * Monitor and operate our cloud data platform (Databricks on Azure) day to day: track pipelines and jobs, troubleshoot issues and support daily data operations. * Collaborate with engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders; support ad hoc data analysis requests. * Drive continuous improvement through training and self\-development. Any other ad hoc tasks that may be required by the business from time to time. * **TO DO IT, YOU WILL NEED:** * A Degree in IT, Computer Science, or related fields. * Proven experience as a Data Engineer, building and maintaining scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for data lakes or lakehouses, with exposure to both batch and real\-time data. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks on Azure, including Unity Catalog (catalogs, schemas, permissions and lineage). * Hands\-on experience with event streaming and real\-time ingestion: Spark Structured Streaming and event platforms such as Kafka. * Strong SQL skills; experience with relational databases and complex queries. * Experience orchestrating pipelines with Databricks Workflows (Jobs) and deploying them with Databricks Asset Bundles; Azure Data Factory experience is an asset. * Coding proficiency in PySpark and Python. * A strong testing mindset: experience writing unit and integration tests (e.g. pytest) and data quality checks, and writing code that is designed to be tested. * Solid software engineering practices: Git, pull requests and code review, CI/CD (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or equivalent) and documentation. * Hands\-on experience working with agentic AI: using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code) in daily engineering work, and designing, building or integrating LLM\-powered agents that orchestrate data workflows. * Comfortable delivering in a fast\-paced, agile environment. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and team collaboration. * Self\-motivated with a drive for continuous learning. Want to help build the future of Catena Media? Apply now for the opportunity to join our collaborative team!

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About the job** **This is a 1099 contract position with the opportunity to transition to full\-time W2 employment. Please provide resume when applying.** ***The Strawhecker Group*** The Strawhecker Group (TSG) is a fast\-growing analytics and consulting firm focused on the electronic payments industry. The company serves the entire payments ecosystem, from fintech startups to Fortune 500 companies. The firm provides its clients with advisory services, research, and analytics to help them plan and execute their strategic initiatives. Based in Omaha, Nebraska, a recognized payments industry hub, TSG is an established leader in this high\-growth, ever\-evolving space. ***Job description: Data Engineer*** The Strawhecker Group (TSG) is in search of a Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain the data pipelines and infrastructure that power our payment analytics, reporting, and business intelligence products. In this role, you will primarily work in Python and SQL, building pipelines into BigQuery on Google Cloud Platform. As a Data Engineer, on any given day you might be building a new ETL pipeline, optimizing a warehouse model, or partnering with analytics and product teams on a new dataset. The ideal candidate has strong experience building OLAP\-friendly data models and analytics pipelines using Python, SQL, and BigQuery. Experience supporting predictive analytics and machine learning use cases is preferred. ***Essential Duties and Responsibilities*** * Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and deliver data from internal systems and third\-party payment sources. * Build and optimize data models and warehouse structures in BigQuery to support analytics, reporting, and product needs. * Develop and maintain data pipeline orchestration using tools such as Cloud Composer (Airflow) or Dataflow. * Ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency across pipelines through validation, testing, and monitoring. * Help migrate rules\-driven transformation logic from Excel spreadsheets into versioned SQL tables, enabling historical reloads and reproducible processing based on the rules in effect at a given point in time. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary team of Data Engineers, Back\-End Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Data Scientists. * Implement data security and access controls appropriate for sensitive payment and merchant data, aligned with PCI DSS and internal governance standards. * Work with the product and analytics teams to understand requirements and translate them into reliable, well\-documented datasets. * Optimize pipeline performance and cost efficiency across Google Cloud Platform data services. * Dive into difficult problems and successfully deliver results on schedule. * Respond to ad hoc business requests by translating ambiguous questions into reliable datasets, analyses, and data products. Continuously optimize ingestion and transformation pipelines for speed, scalability, and cost efficiency. ***Job Qualifications*** * 3\+ years of recent hands\-on experience in data engineering or a related backend engineering role. * Bachelor's degree or more in Computer Science or a related field. * Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling for analytics workloads. * Proficiency in Python for data pipeline development. * Strong hands\-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, especially BigQuery and related data services. * Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Cloud Composer, Apache Airflow, or Dataflow. * Strong understanding of OLAP, data warehousing, and analytics\-oriented modeling concepts, including partitioning, clustering, and performance tuning. * Experience working with structured and semi\-structured data (JSON, CSV, Parquet). * A track record of projects completed on time, you are a flawless executor, not a procrastinator. * Experience with all phases of the software development life cycle, best practices, and Agile Software Development. * Experience with dbt, Looker Studio, or Tableau is a plus. * Experience supporting predictive analytics and machine learning workflows built on top of production data pipelines is a plus. ***Position Type and Location*** This role begins as a 1099 independent contractor engagement, with the opportunity to transition to full\-time W2 employment based on performance and business need. Specific terms of the contract engagement, including scope, duration, and payment terms, will be defined in a separate Independent Contractor Agreement. During the 1099 contract phase, this position can be performed remotely from anywhere in the United States. Upon transition to W2 employment, this position will be based onsite in Omaha, NE. ***Compensation and Benefits*** 1099 Contract Phase: Compensation is structured as a contract rate, as agreed upon in the Independent Contractor Agreement. TSG provides the equipment needed to perform the work. As an independent contractor, you are responsible for your own tax withholding and insurance. This phase does not include TSG's employee benefits package. W2 Employment Phase: Upon transition to full\-time W2 employment, TSG offers competitive compensation and an excellent benefits package, including: * Free Fridays (1 Friday a month to be taken as PTO) * Unlimited PTO * Casual work environment * Health Insurance and Dental Insurance * Simple IRA Match * Life Insurance premiums 100% paid for by TSG ***Background Checks, Access, and Security Controls*** All contract to hire employees, whether in the 1099 contract phase or the W2 employment phase, are held to the same background check, access control, and security control requirements. This includes background checks required for employment and compliance with TSG's PCI DSS and data security policies. There is no difference in vetting or security standards between the two phases. ***Working Conditions:*** During the 1099 contract phase, work location and schedule are agreed upon between the contractor and TSG in the Independent Contractor Agreement. Upon transition to W2 employment, the role follows a standard office environment, Monday through Friday, with some flexibility in scheduling, business casual attire, and off\-street free parking in Omaha. The above is intended to describe the essential job functions and the essential job requirements for the performance of this job. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive statement of all supplemental duties, responsibilities, or non\-essential requirements.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: **Trellis builds and deploys self\-improving agents to get patients access to life\-saving medicine.** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ **Our AI agents process billions of dollars worth of therapies annually with patients in all fifty states.** We do this by automating document intake, prior authorizations, and appeals at scale to streamline operations and accelerate care. We classify medical referrals, understand chart notes, and automate contract and reimbursement search to provide patients with accurate coverage determinations and cost responsibility. Think of us as the the infrastructure behind how the patients get the medications. Trellis is a spinout from Stanford AI Lab and is backed by leading investors including YC, General Catalyst, Telesoft Partners, and executives at Google and Salesforce. **About You** ------------- You're highly structured, detail\-oriented, and thrive in complex deployment environments. You enjoy being on the front lines with customers, translating technical capabilities into real\-world implementations that drive measurable impact. You are comfortable operating in ambiguity and taking ownership of mission\-critical deployments. You work well cross\-functionally, aligning internal engineering teams with customer IT and operational stakeholders. jobs.description: **About MECO** For more than a century, The Manufacturers Equipment Company (MECO) has served the brick and construction aggregates industries with equipment, engineering expertise, and custom solutions for material handling and processing applications. Based in Middletown, Ohio, MECO works with customers and leading equipment manufacturers throughout North America to solve real\-world challenges in industrial facilities. Our projects bring together structural engineering, material handling equipment, fabrication, and field installation—giving our engineers the opportunity to see their work move from an initial concept to a completed project. **The Opportunity** MECO is looking for an Engineering Manager / Structural Engineer to lead structural engineering efforts and help deliver custom solutions for our customers. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving problems that don't always come with a standard answer. One project may involve designing a new conveyor support structure or equipment platform, while the next may require figuring out how to install new equipment within an existing plant that has been operating for decades. You'll perform structural analysis and design for steel structures, equipment supports, connections, and foundations while working closely with our designers, customers, equipment manufacturers, fabricators, and installers. You'll also provide technical direction to the drafting and design team and have the opportunity to help shape the tools, standards, and processes used by MECO's engineering group. **What You'll Work On** Your projects will include a variety of structural and industrial applications, such as equipment support structures, access platforms, conveyor structures, foundations, structural modifications, and equipment retrofits. You'll develop structural models and calculations, determine appropriate design loads, design structural steel members and connections, and work with reinforced concrete foundations. You'll review drawings and coordinate the structural design with equipment and project requirements. Because many MECO projects involve existing industrial facilities, you'll also spend time in the field documenting existing conditions, taking measurements, evaluating structures, and developing practical solutions when the existing conditions don't quite match the drawings—or when drawings don't exist at all. Beyond individual projects, you'll provide technical guidance to the drafting and design team and contribute to the continued development of MECO's engineering standards, calculation tools, software workflows, and design practices. **What We're Looking For** We're looking for an engineer who is comfortable taking ownership of a design, working through incomplete or evolving project information, and communicating effectively with both technical and nontechnical project partners. You'll need: · A bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. · Professional Engineer (PE) licensure in Ohio, or the ability to obtain Ohio PE licensure within 90 days of employment. · Professional experience in structural or civil engineering with a strong foundation in structural steel design. · Experience using structural analysis and design software. · Working knowledge of applicable structural design codes and standards. · The ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with designers, customers, vendors, and other project stakeholders. · The ability to perform field measurements and occasionally travel overnight. Experience with industrial facilities, bulk material handling, aggregates, brick, mining, or similar applications is a plus. Experience with reinforced concrete foundations, existing structure modifications, steel fabrication, or construction coordination is also valuable. Familiarity with RISA structural analysis software, AutoCAD, Revit, and/or Advance Steel is preferred but not required. **What MECO Offers** MECO offers the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of engineering projects and work directly with the people who design, supply, fabricate, install, and operate the systems you engineer. You'll work across a variety of projects rather than being limited to one type of structure or one phase of the design process. Benefits include: · Vacation and paid holidays · Health, dental, and vision insurance · Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance · AD\&D and life insurance · Additional voluntary insurance options · 401(k) with a 3% company safe\-harbor contribution · Discretionary profit sharing · Part\-time remote work · Professional development opportunities If you enjoy structural engineering, industrial environments, and the challenge of turning real\-world constraints into practical designs, MECO offers an opportunity to make a direct impact on projects from concept through installation. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * AD\&D insurance * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Relocation assistance * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Do you have any experience in bulk material handling applications? License/Certification: * PE License in OH or capable of earning one within 90 days (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Middletown, OH 45044

We hire people who teach themselves new things, make good calls without much direction, and care about getting it right for the attorneys who depend on us. We work hard at a sustainable pace, without crunch culture or arbitrary deadlines. **The role** ============ Today our founder runs the AI stack personally. He holds a Columbia PhD in AI and built Amazon's first customer\-facing RLHF pipeline. You'll take the stack over, all of it: agentic workflows, retrieval and evaluation, inference optimization, fine\-tuning, and post\-training. For your first \~90 days you'll work side by side with him. After that, you set our AI direction and grow the team around it. At a larger company, this would be three separate roles. Here, it's one. This is likely the single highest\-impact role at the company, and we need someone who can do the engineering and the science. **Rough split** =============== * **\~40% agentic systems:** orchestration, tool use, and reliability * **\~20% inference:** serving and optimization, including small models on constrained on\-prem hardware * **\~40% longer\-horizon research:** model adaptation, post\-training, and RL **Problems you'll own** ======================= * High\-recall retrieval and synthesis across billion\-token document collections * Agents that are reliable, testable, and deployable, not just impressive in a demo * Getting strong performance from small open\-source models in air\-gapped environments * Evals that capture what "correct" means to a litigator * RL that trades off tool use against compute **Our stack** ============= * **Models:** open\-weight models we fine\-tune, adapt, and post\-train for legal reasoning, then serve as our own versions * **Serving:** vLLM on our own H100 and H200 GPUs * **Deployment:** the same models run in private cloud and fully air\-gapped customer environments * **Language:** Python * **Around it:** PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes (K3s), Vue **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've trained or post\-trained real models (fine\-tuning, RLHF, or RL). Experience calling APIs is not enough. * You've also shipped LLM or agentic systems to production that real users depend on. * You have strong evaluation instincts and know how to tell real gains from noise. * You have hands\-on inference and serving experience. * **When you apply, please include a link to a repo, paper, write\-up, or system you built.** We're hiring for this role across levels, from strong AI engineer to AI lead. Compensation reflects the level we hire at. **Nice to have** ================ * Experience on a big tech AI team or at an AI startup * A PhD or MS in ML * Research publications or open\-source work in LLMs, agents, RL, or evaluation * Distributed training or large\-scale GPU experimentation **Our process** =============== * A call with our founder * A screen with our Head of Engineering * A deep dive on a real problem **Why Discernis** ================= * Research problems with a direct path to production and paying customers * A founder who speaks your language * Meaningful equity with a 4\-year vest and 1\-year cliff * Health insurance * Unlimited PTO plus standard US holidays If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, email us at admin@discernis.ai. Compensation Range: $170K \- $250K

jobs.description: ### **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. ### **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will build web applications end to end, from the interface a user sees to the data layer behind it. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. ### **Your first project** Your first project will likely have you building full\-stack features in PHP and Laravel, with Python alongside. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build features end to end: Laravel on the back end, React or Vue on the front, and REST application programming interfaces (APIs) into third\-party systems. These applications carry heavy concurrent traffic, and you write unit and integration tests for what you ship. * Deploy and run it on Amazon Web Services (AWS). You write the Python automation behind it and the caching that keeps it fast as traffic grows. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of professional full\-stack development experience with PHP/Laravel and Python * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field * Expert\-level PHP and Laravel: MVC architecture and Eloquent ORM * HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+), with at least one front\-end framework (React or Vue.js) * Python for scripting, automation, and web development (Django or Flask) * Relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and query optimization for web applications * AWS deployment experience: EC2, RDS, S3, CloudFront, and Route 53 * Git\-based version control and modern tooling (Composer, npm/yarn) * HTTP, web security principles, API design, and responsive design * Clear writing and speaking for both technical and non\-technical readers: documenting decisions, writing for client stakeholders, presenting your own work ### **Preferred** * Large language model (LLM) API integration (OpenAI, Anthropic) and prompt engineering * Blockchain and smart\-contract integration (Web3\) * A portfolio of shipped full\-stack projects * Federal information technology experience * Familiarity with AI\-assisted developer tooling ### **Who you are** You build the whole feature, not just your half, and you care whether it holds up under real traffic. When something breaks, you can trace it across the interface, the data, and the deployment, and fix it wherever it actually lives. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. ### **What you bring** * Production PHP and Laravel, with the architectural judgment to keep an application responsive as concurrent users grow. * Modern HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with React or Vue, to build responsive interfaces. * Relational data models and query optimization for web applications, in MySQL or PostgreSQL. * Python for the data processing and automation that support the application. * Practical delivery on AWS using EC2, RDS, S3, and CloudFront, including the caching and loading strategies that keep a growing application fast. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. ### **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a live Python coding exercise. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $100,000 to $150,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. ### **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. ### **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

maintain drawing logs, job files, and digital repositories. * Support preconstruction turnover, procurement roadmaps, and contract analysis. * Source and level vendor/subcontractor quotations; organize scopes and pricing. * Quantify and measure: track production, cost codes, and performance in **HCSS/HeavyJob** and Excel. * Prepare monthly pay estimates; jobs.title: Junior Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Junior Network Engineer – Boca Raton, FL / Nationwide (Remote or Hybrid)** ============================================================================ **FLAGLER TECHNOLOGIES MSP Team** United States ### **Who Are We?** We’re more than just an IT support provider—we’re a team committed to delivering exceptional service while fostering growth and development within our ranks. Our mission is to empower the next generation of IT professionals by creating opportunities for leadership and career advancement. As our Managed Services practice continues to grow, we’re looking for a **Junior Network Engineer** who has a strong networking foundation and is ready to continue building their skills across a variety of technologies, vendors, and client environments. This role is designed to provide a development path toward becoming a **Senior Network Engineer** as your technical skills, ownership, and experience continue to grow. ### **What Does a Typical Day Look Like in This Role?** As a **Junior Network Engineer**, you will help support and maintain network infrastructure across our managed client environments. You’ll troubleshoot network issues, monitor performance, assist with changes and upgrades, and work with senior engineers as you continue developing your networking skills. Your responsibilities will include: * Troubleshooting switching, routing, wireless, firewall, VPN, and connectivity issues. * Monitoring network health, performance, and availability. * Assisting with network changes, firmware upgrades, and scheduled maintenance. * Maintaining accurate technical documentation. * Collaborating with senior engineers, clients, and vendors. **Schedule:** This is primarily a daytime position, with regularly scheduled **evening, overnight, and/or weekend maintenance** as needed. ### **What Qualifications or Experience Do I Need?** For this role, you should have hands\-on experience in **network engineering, network administration, or a similar networking\-focused position**. You should have a strong understanding of networking fundamentals and be comfortable troubleshooting real\-world network issues. We’re looking for someone who can demonstrate experience or working knowledge in areas including: * Switching and routing fundamentals. * VLANs, STP, IPsec, HSRP/VRRP, BGP, OSPF, 802\.11 wireless, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, and QoS. * OSI and TCP/IP models. * Enterprise switches, routers, wireless infrastructure, and firewalls. * Network troubleshooting involving connectivity, routing, switching, performance, and infrastructure issues. * Network monitoring, diagnostic, configuration management, and traffic analysis tools. * Network firmware and software upgrades. * Production network changes and maintenance activities. * Developing and following implementation, testing, validation, and rollback procedures. * Maintaining configuration backups and recovery procedures. * Creating and maintaining technical documentation, procedures, and network diagrams. Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills are important, but communication is equally important. You’ll need to clearly document your work, communicate with clients and other engineers, manage multiple priorities, and know when an issue should be escalated. You must also be comfortable working in an MSP environment where you may support **multiple clients, network architectures, vendors, and management platforms** rather than focusing on a single network environment. ### **What Will Help You Stand Out?** A **Cisco CCNA or equivalent practical networking experience** is strongly desired. A **CCNP or equivalent advanced networking experience** is a plus. Additional experience that will help you stand out includes: * Cisco Catalyst switching. * Cisco Meraki. * Aruba networking technologies. * SolarWinds. * Aruba Central. * Cisco Catalyst Center. * MSP or multi\-client networking environments. * Enterprise, hospitality, or multi\-site networks. * Large\-scale firmware or network infrastructure upgrade projects. * Formal incident, problem, configuration, and change management processes. Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who is **humble, hungry, and people smart**. You should be comfortable asking questions, learning from more senior engineers, sharing what you learn with others, and progressively taking ownership as your skills develop. ### **Training \& Career Development** This position is specifically intended for an engineer who wants to continue developing their networking career. You’ll have opportunities to train and cross\-train across multiple networking technologies and vendor platforms, participate in knowledge transfer with Senior Network Engineers, and gain exposure to increasingly complex network environments. We expect our engineers to document and share newly acquired knowledge, pursue relevant technical training and certifications, and continually expand their capabilities rather than becoming dependent on a single vendor or technology. As you demonstrate technical competency, reliability, ownership, strong client communication, and the ability to independently manage increasingly complex environments, the goal is to provide a defined path toward a **Senior Network Engineer** position. ### **Schedule \& After\-Hours Expectations** This is primarily a **daytime position**, with normal troubleshooting, monitoring, planning, testing, documentation, and engineering responsibilities performed during regular business hours. Because network maintenance and production changes frequently need to occur outside normal business hours, you will also be expected to **regularly participate in scheduled evening, overnight, and/or weekend maintenance activities**. After\-hours maintenance will generally be scheduled in advance, and engineers are expected to appropriately plan their workload around these activities. Critical vulnerabilities, zero\-day remediation, or emergency network conditions may occasionally require work outside of normally scheduled maintenance windows. ### **What Else Should You Know About Us?** * **3 Weeks of Paid Time Off** (vacation and sick time accrued, subject to manager approval). * **Healthcare Options** with 75% of your premium covered. * **Dental \& Vision Services**. * **Group Life Insurance**. * **401k with up to 4% matching and immediate vesting.** * **Access to industry training and certification reimbursement** to support your continued growth. Devices that access company resources will need to be managed by us while being used for work purposes. A company computer and peripherals will be provided. You'll need a personal cell phone for multi\-factor authentication and a reliable internet connection—we even provide a stipend for this. Thanks for considering a position with us! If you’re ready to build on your networking experience, work with a wide range of technologies, and grow toward a Senior Network Engineer role while helping us deliver exceptional service to our clients, **apply today and let’s start a conversation.** ### **Application Review Process Notice (Please Read)** We will reach out if your qualifications match the role. **Please do not call or email for application updates** so our team can stay focused on supporting our clients.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff — Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Nuance Labs** --------------------- Nuance Labs is building photorealistic, real\-time AI avatars with emotional intelligence: a full\-duplex audiovisual system that can listen, speak, react, interrupt, and respond like a real person. We're a research company, with PhDs from MIT, UW, Oxford, CMU, and Johns Hopkins, and industry experience from Apple, Meta, Amazon AGI, and more. Backed by Accel, Lightspeed, South Park Commons, and NVIDIA, we combine frontier research with ruthless engineering needed for consumer\-grade, real\-time systems. The team is small, the work is real, and the problems are unsolved. **How Nuance Differentiates** ----------------------------- Most conversational AI avatars today are hacks — a face slapped on a speech\-to\-speech pipeline, stuck in the uncanny valley: emotionless, mechanical, one\-turn\-at\-a\-time. Current systems take 2–5 seconds to respond; natural conversation requires sub\-500ms. That's a 10x improvement, and it demands rethinking the entire stack. That rethinking starts with full\-duplex: an AI that listens and speaks simultaneously, perceives emotion in real time, and responds with a face that actually reflects it. It's an extremely hard problem, and we're developing foundation models designed for it from the ground up. **About the Role** ------------------ A great model is only part of the product. The rest is everything a person touches before, during, and after a conversation with our avatar, along with the tools our researchers rely on to make the next model better. We’re looking for a Product Engineer who can own that surface end to end, from user\-facing features and our developer platform to the internal tooling behind our research. You might spend one week on a feature for a launch and the next pairing with a researcher on tooling for an upcoming study. There’s very little top\-down direction here. Engineers find what needs doing, align with the people it affects, and get it done. You care about how something feels to use, and you know where polish matters and where a quick version will answer the question. * Comfort with production systems: load, rollouts, monitoring, and what to do when something breaks. * **Self\-drive.** Given a problem rather than a spec, you figure out what needs doing and follow through without daily direction. * **Range.** You’re happy moving between product, platform, and research tooling, and you get up to speed quickly on whatever the next problem needs. * **Startup instincts.** You thrive in small, fast\-moving teams and enjoy owning outcomes rather than tickets. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience with conversational AI. * Experience with audio/video capture or real\-time media. * Mobile and/or desktop app development. * Experience building developer\-facing products such as APIs, SDKs, or documentation. * Experience building tools for researchers or working closely with ML teams. **Compensation** ---------------- $250,000 – $300,000 base salary, plus meaningful equity. We think long\-term ownership matters and structure equity accordingly. **Logistics** ------------- * **Location:** In\-person in Seattle, five days a week — we believe in the compounding value of working shoulder\-to\-shoulder. * **Visa sponsorship:** We sponsor visas (O\-1, H\-1B, green card, etc.) from day one. * **AI\-native tooling:** Do your best work with the best tools, including unlimited tokens. **Benefits \& perks** --------------------- * **Health:** We offer a variety of plans that meet your needs, including an HDHP with \~$2,000 in annual HSA contributions by the company (roughly 2x what most big tech companies put in). * **Wellness:** $2,000/yr to spend on gym memberships, fitness equipment, training/coaching, classes, and more. * **Work setup:** One\-time $500 to spend on any tech or accessories that you might need to optimize your workflow. * **Time off:** 15 days of PTO, 10 public holidays, and we close the office for a full week at year\-end. * **Food:** Lunch, drinks, and snacks on us every workday. We observe boba tea Tuesdays and Thursdays. * **Commuter benefits:** Utilize pre\-tax money (up to $340/month) for parking and transportation. * **401(k):** 4% match (100% of 1st 3% \+ 50% of next 2% contributions). *Nuance Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better AI.*

jobs.title: Network Engineer (AI & Infrastructure Automation)
jobs.description: **FLEX** is a growing technology company that serves the core processing needs of over 250 credit unions in 46 states, including Alaska, Hawaii, and the West Indies. **FLEX** proudly stands alone as the industry's largest and oldest core system provider that has not changed ownership. We are looking for a highly motivated, energetic, and professional individual to join our team. **FLEX** is looking for local talent, in office, in Sandy, Utah. You need not apply if you are looking for remote work. FLEX offers competitive salaries, paid holidays, PTO, medical, dental, and a matching 401 (k) retirement plan. We are seeking a forward\-thinking Network Engineer to maintain, scale, and modernize our enterprise network and data center infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for traditional network architecture, data center operations, and proactive monitoring. Crucially, we are looking for someone who leverages cutting\-edge AI tools to accelerate documentation, automate routine operations, troubleshoot complex network events, and continually optimize network architecture. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **1\. AI\-Driven Automation \& Infrastructure Optimization** ------------------------------------------------------------ * Utilize AI LLMs to draft network documentation, write automation scripts, analyze complex log data, and generate standard operating procedures (SOPs). * Continuously evaluate existing network infrastructure and implement modernization strategies to enhance performance, security, and redundancy. * Bridge traditional network engineering with modern AI workflows to streamline incident response and change management. **2\. Monitoring \& Performance Management** -------------------------------------------- * Administer and expand our monitoring environment, maintaining customized triggers, templates, and dashboards for network devices, servers, and data center assets. * Monitor bandwidth utilization, latency, packet loss, and device health metrics to maintain high availability and proactively address potential bottlenecks. * Establish baseline network metrics and automated alerting pipelines for rapid fault isolation. **3\. Network \& Data Center Operations** ----------------------------------------- * Manage, configure, and maintain core network hardware, including switches, routers, firewalls, and load balancers across data center and office environments. * Support data center physical and logical operations: rack layout planning, cabling infrastructure, power distribution management, and hardware maintenance. * Implement and enforce security protocols, VPNs, routing policies, and segmentation rules. FLEX is committed to excellence and life\-long relationships. We are looking for team members who will share in that same commitment, both of our staff and our clients. We encourage the integration of AI tools directly into daily workflows to increase productivity and eliminate repetitive busywork. jobs.title: Performance Data Engineer
jobs.description: Headquartered in Houston, Texas, Panthera Grid Partners is a portfolio company of Brookfield, one of the world’s largest owners and operators of renewable power and sustainable solutions. Panthera Grid Partners delivers reliable, utility\-scale solar, wind and energy storage infrastructure to meet America’s growing demand for domestic energy. With a portfolio exceeding 10 gigawatts, Panthera Grid Partners operates in U.S. power markets where load growth, grid reliability and capital investment are most critical. The company develops, acquires, builds, and operates renewable energy assets with a disciplined, precision\-driven focus on execution, performance, and operational integrity. Through responsible land stewardship and strong local partnerships, Panthera Grid Partners delivers energy projects with respect for land, agriculture, and local priorities, working with landowners and communities to support long\-term land value and strengthen regional economies. **Job Summary** The Performance Data Engineer owns the data architecture, pipelines, performance calculation layer, and reporting processes for Panthera Grid’s operating utility\-scale solar and battery energy storage portfolio. The role builds and maintains the governed platform used by performance and reliability engineers and serves as the trusted source for reporting delivered to stakeholders at all levels. This position ingests and standardizes SCADA, meteorological, inverter, tracker, revenue meter, and PPA settlement data; implements fleet KPI definitions as versioned and tested code; and delivers fleet\-wide reporting through Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. The Performance Data Engineer holds decision rights on data tooling and architecture for the team and partners closely with, Reliability Engineering, Asset Management, Operations \& Maintenance, Commercial Operations, and IT/OT to ensure that data supporting performance decisions is complete, consistent, transparent, and trusted. **Responsibilities** **Data Platform and Architecture** ---------------------------------- * Own the team’s data platform architecture, including the Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse and Warehouse, and hold decision rights on data tooling. * Design and maintain the asset hierarchy, tag mapping, and reporting\-oriented time\-series storage model for the operating fleet. * Integrate SCADA platforms, meteorological feeds, inverter and tracker data, revenue meters, and settlement data through APIs and automated pipelines while supporting existing AWS integrations. * Own the asset onboarding pipeline so that adding a new site is a repeatable configuration process rather than a custom project. * Lead the digitization of existing tools, workbooks, and manual workflows into standardized, governed solutions that can scale across the portfolio and various asset platforms. **Performance Calculation and Analytics** ----------------------------------------- * Implement standard fleet KPIs—including availability, performance ratio, weather\-adjusted expected energy, degradation, and loss attribution—as versioned, tested code. * Build reusable analytical frameworks for degradation analysis, long\-term performance projections, and production\-loss attribution for interpretation by performance engineers. * Validate expected energy production through statistical analysis and comparison with performance models in partnership with Performance Engineering. * Supply validated data, tooling, and analysis for root cause investigations, incident reviews, performance guarantee evaluations, and contractual testing. **Reporting and Business Intelligence** --------------------------------------- * Own the reporting architecture, including Power BI semantic models, KPI definitions, refresh schedules, access, and distribution. * Deliver daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting against budget, P50 forecasts, and contractual guarantees from a single governed source. * Develop and maintain dashboards, executive summaries, technical reports, and analytical tools for internal and external stakeholders. * Partner with Asset Management and Commercial Operations to quantify operational risks, production impacts, and revenue implications. * Support M\&A activities by providing the operating data, cost actuals, and analytical tooling used by Asset Management and Finance to build operating expense (OpEx) models, scenario analyses, and portfolio valuations for acquisitions and due diligence. * Integrate and maintain day\-ahead/real\-time (DA/RT) market, settlement, and curtailment data, and provide the data models and reporting that enable Commercial Operations and Asset Management to analyze price, basis, congestion, and settlement exposure. **Data Quality, Governance, and Operations** -------------------------------------------- * Define and enforce data quality rules, lineage, monitoring, and reconciliation against revenue meter and settlement data. * Maintain clear documentation of data flows, calculation logic, KPI definitions, platform architecture, and operating procedures. * Automate recurring workflows using Python, SQL, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, APIs, and related technologies. * Monitor platform reliability, troubleshoot data failures, and coordinate resolution with IT/OT, vendors, O\&M providers, and internal teams. * Stay current with data engineering practices and renewable\-energy technologies affecting solar PV, BESS, trackers, inverters, and energy analytics. * Identify opportunities to scale reusable data products, diagnostic workflows, and self\-service reporting across the portfolio to improve reporting speed, troubleshooting efficiency, consistency, and program scalability. **Requirements*** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data engineering, electrical engineering, statistics, physics, meteorology, or another quantitative field, or equivalent relevant experience. * At least five years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a related technical role; renewable\-energy or utility experience is strongly preferred. * Advanced proficiency with SQL and Python and demonstrated experience building production\-grade, maintainable data pipelines and analytical workflows. * Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, lakehouse or warehouse architecture, Power BI semantic models, and data orchestration tools. * Experience integrating APIs, SCADA or other operational technology data, time\-series datasets, and enterprise business systems. * Strong knowledge of data modeling, testing, source control, documentation, lineage, observability, and data\-quality practices. * Ability to translate business and engineering requirements into scalable data products and explain complex technical concepts to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Professional verbal and written communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work independently across multiple priorities. * Demonstrated experience modernizing spreadsheet\- or script\-based processes into scalable, governed data products that improve reporting and operational troubleshooting. Location: Hybrid in Houston, Texas (4 days in office, Fridays remote). **Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. Visa sponsorship or transfer visas, including H\-1B or L\-2, are not available for this position.** **Preferred** * Experience with utility\-scale solar PV, battery energy storage systems, renewable asset management, or energy markets. * Familiarity with plant performance metrics such as availability, performance ratio, expected energy, degradation, curtailment, and production\-loss attribution. * Experience with platforms such as AlsoEnergy, Power Factors, OEM monitoring systems, revenue meters, settlements data, or similar sources. * Experience with cloud architecture, CI/CD, infrastructure governance, machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced data science. * Experience working with IT/OT security, NERC or utility compliance requirements, and third\-party technology providers. Experience supporting renewable\-energy M\&A, technical due diligence, or portfolio valuation through operating expense modeling, cost benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and scenario development. **Benefits** Panthera Grid Partners offers an exciting benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, health savings account, flexible spending account, company\-paid life insurance and short\-term disability, voluntary life, and long\-term disability, paid paternal leave, and a retirement plan with matching contributions. Full\-time position with competitive compensation package, including bonus.

jobs.title: Press Tooling Development Engineer (Stamping)
jobs.description: **Build the tools that build what matters** ------------------------------------------- At Genesee, manufacturing excellence starts at the tool. Your mission: conceive, build, and refine stamping dies and fixtures that deliver quality parts at speed and at cost. ### **Your mandate** * Architect stamping dies, tooling, and check fixtures with CAD (SolidWorks, Logopress, AutoCAD) that meet safety, ergonomic, and performance criteria. * Lead the tool build lifecycle with internal and external shops; own timelines and quality gates. * Run tooling trials and validations; troubleshoot form, fit, and function to steady‑state production. * Engineer process gains: optimize material strip layouts, cycle times, tonnage, and press line flow. * Coordinate across Engineering, Tool \& Die, Quality, and Production to launch and sustain tools. * Publish and maintain complete design documentation: models, drawings, specifications, and standards. * Continuously propose improvements that elevate efficiency and minimize waste. ### **How you'll win** * Education/experience: High School Diploma/GED and an engineering degree or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years in tooling design/development or manufacturing engineering, with a progressive die focus. * Proficiency in SolidWorks (Logopress preferred) and familiarity with 2D design. * GD\&T mastery and expert print interpretation. * Practical grounding in tool and die build, debug, machining, and setup/repair. * Root‑cause analysis skills to resolve part failures quickly. * Exposure to transfer/progressive dies, coil‑fed presses, and in‑die tapping/assembly. ### **Preferred profile** * Certified Toolmaker or 5\+ years in Tool \& Die; apprenticeship completion a plus. * APQP/PPAP execution experience; working knowledge of ISO standards. * Lean/CI mindset with measurable improvements delivered. * Clear communicator, meticulous documenter, and creative problem solver. ### **Imagine this scenario** You inherit a transfer die that is splitting a flange on station 3\. You review the strip layout, confirm press tonnage, add relief to a form steel, tune feed progression, validate with GD\&T on the check fixture, and document updates in SolidWorks. Scrap drops, cycle time tightens, and the line hits rate—repeatable and at quality. ### **Growth, benefits, and flexibility** * Hybrid rhythm: on site Monday–Thursday, remote Friday. * Bonus eligibility based on personal performance and overall plant profitability. * Career growth pathways and high‑impact projects. * Competitive salary and benefits package. * A culture that encourages innovation and empowers engineers to drive change. ### **Capabilities \& proficiencies** * GD\&T; Troubleshooting; CAD/CAM; Mechanical Design \& Engineering. * Metal Stamping \& Forming (Progressive Die). * Tool/Die/Mold setup and repair familiarity; PPAP process expertise. * Excellent communication skills. * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. ### **Technology \& equipment context** * CAD platforms: AutoCAD, SolidWorks (Logopress), Solid Edge. * Press environment: coil‑fed lines; progressive and transfer dies; in‑die tapping/assembly.

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer
jobs.description: What if you could join a rapidly growing company and play a critical role in bringing new medicines to patients by helping scale the programmable infrastructure behind a new human cellular biology platform? ### **About Vesalius** Vesalius Therapeutics is pioneering a new platform to generate breakthrough treatments for common diseases. Our platform combines large\-scale human genetics, genomics, stem cell studies, high\-dimensional cellular phenotyping, and artificial intelligence to uncover causal biology and identify optimal intervention points for new therapies. Vesalius was founded in 2019 by Flagship Pioneering. ### **Role Overview** We are seeking a Principal Data Engineer to lead the architecture and evolution of the data platform underpinning our human genetics, multi\-omics, and high\-content imaging programs. This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role with broad technical authority. As the architectural lead for data engineering, you will set the direction for our AWS environment and the pipelines, catalog, and access layers built on it, defining the technical roadmap and the standards others build against. The scope spans core cloud data engineering (orchestration, warehousing, infrastructure as code, cost governance) and the distinctive challenges of scientific data: connecting each microscopy image to its cell line, donor, and study of origin, and enabling scientists to answer genotype questions directly, without specialist intervention. You will join a focused, high\-impact team supporting a research organization whose data generation and analytical ambitions are expanding rapidly. Our platform is established and productive, and is now entering a deliberate modernization phase. You will lead that transition, with significant influence over the platform's next\-generation architecture. At Flagship, we accept impossible missions to enable bigger leaps. Our core values guide us through uncertainty and toward lasting impact. ### **Role Responsabilities** * Serve as technical owner and architect of our AWS environment, including account structure, IAM, networking, compute, and storage. * Lead and extend cost governance, including budgets, alerting, tagging enforcement, rightsizing, and storage lifecycle and tiering. * Define and own developer operations for the data platform, including infrastructure as code, CI/CD, container builds, and secrets and environment management. * Upgrade our data lake, managed orchestration, metadata and data ingestion workflows to scale with future data production and enhance the infrastructure that transfers data from the lab to the cloud. * Partner with ML and computational biology leaders to define the interface between platform and modelling. ### **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years building and operating production data infrastructure, with a track record of architecting and owning platforms end to end. * Deep AWS expertise: S3, IAM, EC2, Batch, Lambda, and Spark (EMR or equivalent). Experience as technical owner of production cloud environments, including multi\-account architecture and cross\-account access. * Strong Python and SQL, with a background in production\-grade pipeline development. * Production experience with workflow orchestration (Nextflow, Airflow, Temporal, Step Functions, Redun, or similar) and the judgement to evaluate and select among them. * Infrastructure as code (CloudFormation/CDK), CI/CD, containers, and observability. DevOps is a core competency for this role. * Data modelling and warehouse or lakehouse design, including metadata management, lineage, and data quality practice. * Cost governance at scale, including budgets, tagging, rightsizing, and storage lifecycle across hundreds of terabytes. * Fluency with scientific data semantics (studies, samples, donors, cell lines, assays) and the ability to partner directly with scientists to translate their questions into data models. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with genetics and genomics data. * Microscopy or high\-content screening data, including large binary object stores, transfer optimization, and image streaming for model training. * Databricks, OpenMetadata, or a comparable catalog in production. * Snowflake, particularly governed access patterns over cloud object storage. * ML infrastructure: SageMaker or Databricks ML, MLflow or Weights \& Biases, feature stores. * Serving data to LLM or agent clients (MCP servers, tool APIs). * Experience leading data platform architecture as a senior or principal individual contributor, ideally in biotech, pharma R\&D, or a research institute. ### **We are an equal opportunity employer**. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We recognize that great candidates often bring unique strengths **without fulfilling every qualification**. If you have some of the experience listed above but not all, please apply anyway. We are dedicated to building diverse and inclusive teams and look forward to learning more about your background **and interest in Flagship.** ***Recruitment \& Staffing Agencies****: Flagship Pioneering and its affiliated Flagship Lab companies (collectively, "FSP") do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to FSP or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Flagship Pioneering's internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.* The salary range for this role is $179,000 \- $236,000\. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including a candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience. Vesalius Therapeutics currently offers healthcare coverage, annual incentive program, retirement benefits and a broad range of other benefits. Compensation and benefits information is based on Vesalius Therapeutics's good faith estimate as of the date of publication and may be modified in the future.

jobs.title: QA and Test Engineer Role
jobs.description: **About OPEN Data Jobs** OPEN Data Jobs (ODJ) is built to craft data careers. We connect high\-potential data, AI, and software professionals with meaningful work on the cutting edge of the federal sector, and our aim reaches beyond any single opening: to help you understand your strengths, find the right role, and grow throughout your career. ODJ is organized around Roles and Openings. A Role is a durable career type, such as Data Engineer or AI Engineer: it describes the work, the skills that count, and where the path can lead. An Opening is a specific position hiring right now, with a level, a location, and an application. Roles help you see where you fit; from there, there is more than one way to move. Today, you can apply to any Opening that fits you through our secure application system. You can also register for a Role to express interest in that broader category of work. A Role registration is not an application to every future Opening. **The work** QA and Test Engineers produce the evidence that tells a team whether software is ready to trust. They turn requirements, user stories, and risks into tests, run those tests by hand and through automation, and report what they find in terms a developer can act on and a decision\-maker can rely on. The work runs through the full stack, from the user interface through APIs, services, integrations, and databases to the environments they run in, and follows real user journeys end to end across all of them. It covers user interface (UI) and user experience (UX) testing, including usability testing with representative users; functional, regression, integration, end\-to\-end, and user acceptance testing; and performance and load testing. Accessibility testing checks conformance with Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), and testers work with security specialists on the checks built into the delivery pipeline. QA and Test Engineers plan test strategies and schedules, build and maintain test environments and test data, write and maintain automated test suites, track defects to resolution, and define release criteria and report whether the evidence meets them. Testing starts early and continues throughout delivery, whether testers sit inside the delivery team or provide an independent assessment. QA and Test Engineers work with product owners, business analysts, developers, and DevSecOps engineers so that quality is designed in, measured continuously, and documented well enough to stand up to an audit or an independent review. **What you'll build** * Test strategies, test plans, test cases, and scenarios traced to requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Automated test suites at the unit, API, and UI levels, wired into CI/CD pipelines, including end\-to\-end tests that follow a user journey through the front end, APIs, services, and databases. * Usability, performance, load, compatibility, and accessibility results that show how a system behaves under the conditions tested, and where it falls short. * Defect reports, root\-cause evidence, and retest records that carry a problem through to a verified fix. * Traceability matrices, test evidence, and release\-readiness reports that support go\-live decisions, authorization reviews, and audits. **Who you are** You are skeptical in a useful way. You read a requirement and see the case that would break it, and when something looks wrong, you keep exploring after the script ends. in MLOps, ML platform engineering, backend engineering, full\-stack engineering, or related production engineering roles. * Experience owning machine\-learning systems in production, including training, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and incident response. * Strong Python and SQL skills, including APIs, backend services, asynchronous workflows, testing, CI/CD, and observability. * rollback. * Working knowledge of Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure. * Strong communication and judgment when balancing customer urgency, usability, reliability, and long\-term maintainability. * jobs.title: Principal Architect
jobs.description: **Powering the world’s payments ecosystem** ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. You'll mentor architects and senior engineers across the organization and help align the broader architecture community around ACI's unified enterprise direction as cloud\-native and AI\-enabled practices become the default. **What You'll Own** =================== * Provide architecture leadership across multiple products or platforms — not just a single domain — resolving the toughest technical assignments where there's no obvious solution * Perform significant mentoring and coaching of architects and senior engineers across the organization, communicating with broader architecture and engineering audiences to raise the collective bar * Provide architectural and big\-picture oversight for new or enhanced products and services, and create or shape Architecture Roadmaps that span product lines * Drive compliance with and evolution of ACI's architectural standards across customer and product initiatives org\-wide * Support development and product leadership with high\-level analysis, design reviews, performance/scalability guidance, and deep subject\-matter expertise * Plan and direct cross\-product initiatives: review scope, plan resource use, and partner with project managers to ensure critical programs land * Research and evaluate emerging technologies, design patterns, and products at a strategic level, determining what's worth incorporating across ACI's portfolio * Maintain and actively leverage cross\-product architectural knowledge, driving reuse of techniques and technologies across teams where it creates real value * Set the standard for how AI/ML and cloud\-native architecture are used across multiple product lines, not just within a single team * Define how ACI’s platforms authenticate and authorize non\-human payment initiators, positioning ACI’s architecture relative to emerging agent\-initiated payment standards and agent identity/consent frameworks * Define how AI coding and development agents are used safely across the SDLC — what can be delegated, what requires human review, and how architectural governance (ADRs, fitness functions) adapts as agents generate and modify production code * Work directly with customers on innovative ideas and projects, translating customer needs into long\-term technical strategy * May select staff and provide input to performance reviews; contribute to resource planning and capital budget decisions for the architecture function * Align the broader architecture community around critical directional issues, assisting Chief Architects in setting unified enterprise direction **Our Tech Stack** ================== *Deep expertise in this exact stack isn’t a hard requirement – strong architects from adjacent stacks are welcome to apply.* * Architecture modeling \& governance — recognized expertise producing and reviewing ADRs, architecture models, and fitness\-function frameworks across multiple teams * Domain\-driven design — deep, applied expertise using DDD to resolve real\-time cross\-system boundary problems at scale * Cloud \& data architecture — deep, cross\-product expertise in multi\-cloud design and data platform architecture (data lakes, warehouses,
