payment protocols — working knowledge of the agent\-initiated payment landscape (agent identity, consent/mandate verification, agent\-scoped tokenization) and a point of view on how ACI’s platforms should interoperate with it * Payments \& financial systems — deep expertise in payment processing standards and flows (ISO 8583, ISO 20022, card networks, real\-time payment rails) * Security \& compliance architecture — recognized expertise in IAM, zero\-trust design, and regulatory architecture (PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, GDPR, regional payment regulations) across products * Fraud, risk \& tokenization architecture — deep expertise in real\-time fraud/risk engines, tokenization strategy, and network\-level risk scoring across payment flows **What You Bring** ================== *You there's no obvious solution, and you're comfortable being the final word when trade\-offs are genuinely hard * Systems thinking that spans multiple products — you see where complexity and risk will Own the success metrics in partnership with FP\&A to ensure tight alignment on business levers to drive growth and deployment of capital. **You Have** * \~10 years in product management, technical program or portfolio management, strategy, business operations, or a role with genuine operational ownership — not coordination. * A record of holding multiple parallel workstreams, competing stakeholders, and ambiguous ownership, and keeping all of it moving. * Experience building or running a PMO or program portfolio. Keep them healthy with Wishbone insurance and / or our Total Pet vet service and telehealth discount plan. * Employee Assistance Program: Free access to confidential personal support. * Dependent Care FSA: You will have access to a Dependent Care FSA, which allows you to set aside pre\-tax funds for childcare expenses The recruiter assigned to this role can share more information about the specific compensation and benefit details associated with this role during the hiring process. ### **Our Values** Our values are the core beliefs that shape who we are, what we stand for, and how we behave.They form the foundation of Altana's culture and integrity and guide how we hire, design, build, and connect with each other and our customers. * **Trust:** Our customers and partners entrust us with missions of the highest importance. We rely on each other to deliver, to speak openly, and to hold ourselves accountable. * **Resilience:** In a world of uncertainty and complexity, our work must withstand challenges, evolve with conditions, and ensure reliability over time. Resilience is both how we operate and what we deliver. It's how we respond when things don't go to plan –– we adapt, we support each other, and we keep moving forward. * **Stewardship:** We are stewards of every mission we touch. Because our work impacts lives and futures, we hold ourselves accountable to delivering mission impact and never compromising. Our responsibility extends beyond individual projects to the broader system of global trade. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: **About Ande** We're a Series A startup building an AI\-native platform that connects Enterprises and Hospitality across the entire booking experience, backed by top\-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Redpoint Ventures, Sierra Ventures, and Bain Capital, and led by a serial entrepreneur with offices in NYC and SF. We help companies turn every dinner, event, and offsite into something effortless to plan and a breeze to manage, plugging right into the tools they already use. **About the Role** You will own the intelligence behind the Ande Agent. That's the concierge and its team of subagents that take a request from one sentence ("dinner for 12 with the Acme team next Thursday, somewhere private") to a confirmed, paid, on\-policy booking. Along the way they source venues, compare options, email the venue and negotiate terms, and handle every change after that. This is not a chatbot or a demo. The agent acts on real money, on behalf of real executives, with real venues on the other end of the thread. It runs in production today for reservations and private dining. Our strategy depends on carrying more of the work with every request: more kinds of entertainment, more cities, more of the workflow, without growing headcount to match. You will set how we get there. **What You'll Do** * Own the agent system. Ande runs on a root concierge agent with specialist subagents for sourcing, comparison, and venue coordination, on a self\-hosted agent harness behind queued turn workers. You’ll own its architecture, model choices, and upgrade path, and make sure it holds up under latency budgets, provider failover, and real\-world load. * Build tools the agent can trust. The agent has about 75 typed capabilities that let it search, hold, book, pay, and message. Each one runs as the acting user and respects who they’re acting for, such as an assistant booking on behalf of an executive. Consequential actions become proposals that the booker confirms. You’ll decide what the agent is allowed to do, and how to make it safe. * Make evals the gate for every change. You’ll build scenario suites, graders, and LLM judges calibrated against human labels. They replay from recorded runs on every PR and run in full nightly. Your goal is evals trustworthy enough that a model upgrade or prompt change can ship on the strength of the number alone, and cheap enough to run all the time. * Power venue correspondence. Our agent negotiates with venues over email. It reads replies, pulls out offers, minimums, deadlines, and payment requests, and knows when to push, when to wait, and when to hand off to a person. You’ll make sure all of it is resistant to anything a third party writes into a thread. * Build memory and the supply learning loop. You’ll shape what the agent remembers about a company, its people, and its venues, with clear rules on what’s shared and what stays private. You’ll also build the loop that turns every venue conversation into structured supply data, like which room actually fits 14 or what a venue will do on a Tuesday, so each recommendation is better than the last. * Ship fast, reliable judgments. You’ll build typed classifiers for consent, triage, ranking, and urgency. Each has labeled thresholds, a timeout, and a fallback, and each rolls out from shadow mode to live. * Set the bar for building with AI. You’ll define how Ande builds with AI: agent behavior as versioned config, product teammates proposing changes through evals, and AI coding agents as the default way the team ships. You’ll mentor engineers and partner closely with our AI product manager. **What We’re Looking For** * Education and experience: a degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. You have 5\+ years building production software, including 2\+ years shipping LLM agents to real customers (tool use, multi\-step planning, structured outputs, long\-running conversations). * Production evals: you’ve owned evals in production, from writing them to finding failure modes in real traffic and improving quality turn by turn. * Systems engineering: strong TypeScript and backend skills, including queues, concurrency, idempotency, and how distributed systems fail. * Sound judgment: you know where a model belongs and where deterministic code does, and you have the discipline to make agent actions safe, auditable, and reversible. * AI\-native workflow: you use AI coding agents every day. Our codebase is built to be worked on by them, and we expect you to raise that bar. * Clear communication: you can explain agent behavior and trade\-offs to product, operations, and customers. **Bonus Points** * You've been a founding or early engineer and know how to balance craft, ownership and speed. * You've built agent harnesses, orchestration layers or tool brokers, not just prompts. * Experience with search, ranking or recommendation systems. * Experience with marketplaces, booking or payments, where a wrong action costs money. * Experience defending agents against prompt injection from untrusted content. **Why This Role Matters** The Ande Agent is how we scale. Every request it handles end to end is work we don’t have to hire for, so how far it can take us depends on the person who owns its intelligence. The stakes are real. The agent moves real money for executives and negotiates directly with venues, so a mistake costs customers money and costs us venue relationships. Every venue conversation also makes the agent smarter. That learning loop is an advantage competitors can’t easily copy. This isn’t an AI feature bolted onto a product. The agent is the product, and you’ll own how it thinks. **This is an in\-office position (4 days/week) in New York City** **Equal Employment Opportunity** *Ande is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and will consider all applicants for employment without regard to any legally protected status* Compensation Range: $210K \- $280K

jobs.title: Motion Controls & Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Give hope. Give health. Make your mark in the fight against cancer.** At Accuray, we make a direct and powerful impact on the lives of cancer patients every day — helping them live longer, better lives. But our commitment to innovation offers a truly unique opportunity: the chance to change the fight against cancer — helping to develop, introduce and support new treatment delivery systems and software that will give new hope and new health to cancer patients and cancer survivors around the world. Accuray develops, manufactures and sells radiotherapy systems for alternative cancer treatments. Our radiation therapy for cancer makes treatment shorter, safer, personalized and more effective, ultimately enabling patients to live longer, better lives. **Job Description** The Motion Controls \& Robotics Software Engineer contributes to the research, planning, design, implementation, and verification of software that controls critical electro\-mechanical and robotic motion mechanisms contributing to the function and performance of Accuray’s radiation therapy products. This is a software\-forward motion control role for early\-career candidates with foundational experience or strong demonstrated capability developing software that interfaces with physical hardware. The role supports high\-level architecture, detailed implementation, integration, and verification of these motion devices while building cross\-functional experience across Software, Mechanical, Electrical, and Systems Engineering to solve complex engineering problems. **Essential duties and responsibilities:** PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT * Object\-oriented software development and hands\-on hardware integration for Accuray’s control systems, including robotic manipulators, precision positioning systems, thermal and pneumatic control systems. Detailed analysis reports (design reviews, control system models, DFMEA, etc.), debugging, reliability cycling, system integration, and formal software/hardware testing are key components of the development activities. * Researches, analyzes, plans, and implements the control system design in accordance with product requirements as established from various sources including marketing, manufacturing, reliability, and customer specification documents. Supports the distillation of system\-level requirements into sub\-system and component\-level requirements. * Develops and executes comprehensive test plans, including manual, automated, unit, integration, and system\-level tests, to rigorously verify developed software and hardware against defined requirements and specifications. * Hands\-on, data driven problem solving – commonly working directly with motion hardware to move development efforts forward. Assists with hardware prototype builds and troubleshooting as needed. * Documents, implements and tests applicable design requirements for production. This includes supporting the transfer of relevant design output documents, recommended assembly and test instructions, and service troubleshooting support. * Collaborates closely and frequently with Embedded Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, and test teams throughout the software development and product development lifecycle. * Provides subject matter expert input and guidance for field service escalations into engineering. * Supports the Mechanical Systems Manager in establishing or updating project and departmental deliverables. COLLABORATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT * Works collaboratively within project teams and Product Development, seeking input from senior engineers and cross\-functional partners as appropriate. * Communicates technical progress, risks, and roadblocks clearly, and incorporates feedback into design, implementation, and verification of work. * Follows applicable quality processes on projects and within the Mechanical Systems group. * Contributes to process improvement activities as experience grows. SAFETY AND QUALITY * Supports the effective implementation of safety and quality considerations and requirements in product design. * Supports timely investigation, communication, and resolution of safety and quality issues raised by customers or staff. * Supports Accuray’s Quality System and Safety and Health Program by following applicable procedures and documentation practices. **Qualifications** Required * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics Engineering, Mechatronics, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field, with coursework or experience in software development for physical systems. * **Software experience:** Professional software development experience is preferred, but strong candidates with substantial internship, co\-op, academic project, research, or personal project experience developing software for physical systems will be considered. Relevant experience should demonstrate hands\-on software developm nd/or Python, including class design, interfaces/abstractions, modular code structure, debugging, and unit/integration testing. * **Software development practices:** Experience using professional software development practices such as version control, code review, issue tracking, build/release workflows, and automated testing. * **Product development exposure:** Exposure to software development, testing, or release activities for products, prototypes, lab systems, or hardware\-integrated software. * **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Able to effectively present technical concepts to individuals that are not subject matter experts and assist as needed. Preferred or Desired * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics, Engineering Physics, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related technical field. * Internship, co\-op, research, academic project, or early professional experience in a regulated, safety\-critical, medical device, robotics, automation, or high\-reliability engineering environment. * Demonstrated ability to test and verify developed hardware and software against requirements. * Ability to develop system\-level requirements for motion control systems and effectively integrate both individual components into a system and sub\-systems into a larger system. * Experience or strong academic/project exposure working with automated or robotic systems and their components (motor controllers, drive electronics, sensors, etc.), including low\-level firmware, mid\-level software interfaces/device drivers, APIs, and robot controls middleware. * Experience developing robotics, motion control, or embedded software in regulated, safety\-critical, or high\-reliability environments. * Experience programming digital motion controllers, including configuration and utilization of digital I/O for motion control applications. * Self\-starter who can make progress independently while seeking guidance appropriately, collaborating with peers and management as needed. * Demonstrated experience developing, building, debugging, or deploying software in Linux\-based environments. * Exposure to 3D CAD modeling software (SolidWorks preferred) and virtualization tools for robotics applications. * Exposure to Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) and parallel computing concepts. * Proficiency with linear algebra, rigid transformations, coordinate frames, and/or robotics software for serial\-link manipulators. * Proficiency in working with databases, including querying, data manipulation, and schema design. * Strong foundational knowledge in control theory combined with hands\-on experience developing data\-driven control strategies. * Comfortable using AI\-assisted tools to enhance productivity, accelerate problem solving, and strengthen software development workflows while maintaining engineering judgment, verification discipline, and ownership of the final work product. * Understands fundamental machine learning and reinforcement learning concepts and their potential utility in advancing robotic capabilities. * Formal product reliability qualification and testing background. \#LI\-BB1 **To qualify for this position, candidates must be able to furnish proof that they are authorized to work in the country they are applying on a permanent basis without sponsorship.** **EEO Statement** At Accuray, our commitment to patient\-first outcomes drives an inclusive and collaborative work environment where the best ideas rise to the top — and everyone works to push them further. We value diversity in both the professional and personal backgrounds of our employees, as this variety adds rich energy to every team, every project and every work day. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or national origin – including individuals with disabilities and veterans.

jobs.title: Platform Engineering and Operations Lead (Palantir)
jobs.description: The Platform Engineer \& Operations Lead is the hands\-on internal technical owner of Acosta Group’s enterprise Palantir Foundry and Artificial Intelligence Platform (AIP) ecosystem within the AI Center of Excellence. This role engineers and operates a secure, reliable, governed, reusable, and cost\-effective platform while supporting product, program, and project teams from solution design and build through deployment, go\-live, stabilization, and ongoing production support. The role owns platform administration, DevSecOps, identity and access management, observability, enterprise integration, ontology governance, and FinOps. It provides technical direction to vendor engineers, sets engineering standards and priorities, reviews deliverables, manages escalations, and retains critical platform knowledge and decision\-making within the enterprise. * **Platform engineering:** Own Foundry and AIP administration, configuration, environment strategy, releases, upgrades, capacity, and operational health. Engineer shared services, automation, and reusable patterns for AIP applications, agents, workflows, and model/tool integration. * **Solution delivery:** Partner with delivery teams on architecture, hands\-on build, integration, testing, deployment, go\-live readiness, and stabilization. Coordinate environments, access, release windows, cutover, and post\-production support ownership. * **Production reliability:** Establish monitoring, alerting, service levels, runbooks, incident response, problem management, and escalation paths. Lead complex incidents, root\-cause analysis, service restoration, and continuous improvement; define and test recovery and continuity practices. * **DevSecOps:** Establish repeatable development, testing, promotion, and deployment practices for code, configuration, data products, ontology changes, and AIP capabilities. Implement quality gates, traceability, segregation of duties, rollback plans, and production\-readiness controls. * **Security and access:** Own identity and access management (IAM) and role\-based access control (RBAC), including least privilege, privileged access, approvals, periodic reviews, and auditable permissions. Partner with Cyber and enterprise teams on vulnerability management, policy compliance, and control remediation. * **Ontology governance:** Define design standards, stewardship, lifecycle management, documentation, and controlled change for shared objects, relationships, actions, interfaces, and business concepts. Promote reuse and assess downstream impacts, lineage, data quality, security, testing, and versioning. * **Enterprise integration:** Establish secure, resilient, observable integrations across enterprise applications, APIs, data platforms, identity services, analytics tools, and cloud services. Partner with data engineering on pipeline reliability, orchestration, performance, and cross\-platform issue resolution. * **FinOps:** Establish consumption and cost visibility, allocation, forecasting, budgeting inputs, and optimization reviews where data is available. Translate cost drivers into architecture, processing, scheduling, retention, and configuration improvements; support vendor/SOW and renewal decisions. * **Vendor technical leadership:** Set vendor engineering priorities, capacity, service expectations, quality standards, and escalation procedures. Review designs, code, configuration, operational changes, and incident analysis; ensure knowledge transfer, documentation, coverage, and internal technical ownership. * **Enablement and partnership:** Create onboarding guidance, reference implementations, templates, and engineering playbooks. Partner with Palantir, product teams, Cyber, Infrastructure, Data Governance, Finance, and business stakeholders to balance delivery speed, reliability, reuse, governance, and cost. * 10\+ years of progressive experience in software, data, platform, or cloud engineering; DevSecOps; site reliability engineering (SRE); enterprise integration; or related technical domains. * 5\+ years building or operating enterprise data, analytics, AI, developer, or cloud platforms in production. * Demonstrated hands\-on Foundry platform engineering or administration and AIP solution delivery or operations experience, including production support—not solely application development, architecture advisory, or vendor contract management. * Experience supporting multiple delivery teams through build, deployment, go\-live, stabilization, and ongoing operations in environments requiring security, reliability, governance, auditability, and cost management. * Experience technically leading vendor engineers, managed\-service teams, consultants, or distributed engineering resources. * Deep technical capability in Foundry administration, AIP enablement, ontology design and governance, data pipelines, applications, actions, and integrations. * Proficiency in DevSecOps, CI/CD, release controls, environment promotion, IAM/RBAC, least\-privilege design, and enterprise security practices. * Strong troubleshooting and production engineering skills, including observability, SLAs/SLOs, incident response, resilience, disaster recovery, and operational readiness. * Understanding of APIs, enterprise integration, data movement, cloud services, and cross\-platform ownership and support. * Ability to connect platform consumption and solution design to allocation, forecasting, optimization, and cost\-to\-serve. * Hands\-on technical leadership, sound prioritization, and the ability to direct vendor teams while balancing delivery, reliability, security, governance, and cost. * Strong stakeholder partnership and written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate technical risks and investment needs into business decisions, clear documentation, and executive\-ready updates. * Adaptability in an evolving, multi\-team environment. Experience with shared enterprise Palantir environments, Palantir partner organizations, major cloud/identity/data integrations, and reusable platform services is advantageous. Acosta Group is a collective uniting the most trusted retail, marketing, and foodservice agencies—Acosta, ActionLink, CORE Foodservice, CROSSMARK, Mosaic, Premium Retail Services, and Product Connections. Together, we connect consumers with the brands they love through omnichannel selling, merchandising, brand advocacy, and integrated marketing. We recognize our associates are the foundation of our success. That’s why we prioritize your growth, development, and well\-being to help you reach your full potential. With programs designed to support a fulfilling work\-life balance, we offer opportunities that fit your lifestyle and ambitions—whether you’re looking for part\-time flexibility or full\-time career advancement. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: The Opportunity Adobe Workfront is the work management platform that enterprises rely on to plan, run, and measure work across thousands of people, projects, and approvals. Behind it are engineering teams who understand both the platform and the complex, often regulated environments where customers use it. The Forward Deployed Engineer role sits at the intersection of software engineering, solution architecture, and technical consulting. You will be embedded with Workfront's most strategic customers, working directly with their teams to solve hard platform challenges, design scalable integrations, and build what is needed to unblock adoption and expansion. **You will work in a cross\-functional Customer Pod:** a small, autonomous team with end\-to\-end ownership. As a senior engineer, you set technical direction for your accounts, mentor other builders, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers. What You'll Do Partner with strategic customers to understand their workflows, systems, security requirements, and business goals. Turn complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes. Build and ship custom integrations and extensions across Workfront Workflow, Workfront Planning, Workfront Fusion, APIs, and adjacent Adobe and third\-party systems. Investigate and resolve production issues, from data and permissions models to automation, reporting, and performance. Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep dives that earn customer trust. Prototype and iterate quickly, using AI\-assisted tools as a standard part of how you work. Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts from discovery through go\-live and expansion. What Success Looks Like We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. You explain complex ideas to technical and executive audiences in workshops, architecture reviews, and briefings. Business acumen. You understand the use case before choosing the technology. Software craft. You write code, build prototypes, and ship working software. Your designs reflect implementation reality. Data and integration judgment. You weigh trade\-offs in data models, API design, and system integration. Growth mindset and AI fluency. You use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) to design, prototype, and deliver, and you build toward agentic capabilities. **Typical background:** 8 to 12 years in software engineering, solution architecture, technical consulting, or customer\-facing engineering. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Company Overview** AIS, a division of 1HMX, is a global leader in Human Machine eXperience (HMX) solutions, delivering innovative, high\-performance products that power the future of human interaction with technology. Our portfolio includes electro\-mechanical assemblies and immersive technologies, such as augmented/virtual reality systems, wearable electronics, telerobotic controls, night\-vision equipment, EV and marine interfaces, infection control solutions, medical and industrial display/control panels, and touchscreen products. **Position Summary** The Manufacturing Engineering Manager leads the people, processes, and technical systems that connect product design to reliable, efficient production. This role is responsible for the Manufacturing Engineering team and provides leadership oversight for Bench Technicians and Electro\-Mechanical Assemblers. The manager aligns process engineering, production test and equipment support, and hands\-on assembly resources to support new product introduction (NPI), sustaining production, and continuous improvement. As a hands\-on leader, this individual sets priorities, develops team capability, and ensures that products move from prototype and pilot builds into production with appropriate processes, documentation, tooling, test systems, and training. The manager partners closely with Design Engineering, Operations, Quality, Program Management, and other 1HMX teams to improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost. **Key Responsibilities** **Team Leadership \& Resource Management** * Lead, coach, and develop Manufacturing Engineers, Bench Technicians, and Electro\-Mechanical Assemblers; establish clear expectations, accountability, and development goals appropriate to each function. * Oversee day\-to\-day priorities and resource allocation across NPI, sustaining engineering, production troubleshooting, test\-system support, assembly needs, and continuous improvement projects. * Conduct regular one\-on\-ones, performance reviews, and career\-development conversations; provide timely feedback and identify training or staffing needs. * Build a collaborative, customer\-focused team culture that emphasizes safe work practices, quality, technical ownership, problem\-solving, and continuous learning. * Coordinate workload and escalation paths so production issues receive timely technical support while longer\-term engineering and process\-development work continues to progress. * Support hiring, onboarding, cross\-training, and succession planning for the teams under this role. **Manufacturing Engineering \& New Product Introduction (NPI)** * Lead Manufacturing Engineering activities for NPI, ensuring products enter production with mature and validated processes, complete documentation, appropriate tooling, and demonstrated readiness. * Partner with Design Engineering early in development to improve design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM/DFA), testability, reliability, and production scalability. * Oversee development and maintenance of manufacturing processes, assembly procedures, work instructions, routings, tooling requirements, and other production documentation. * Coordinate prototype builds, pilot runs, process validation, operator training, and handoff to full\-rate production. * Ensure Manufacturing Engineering resources support both new programs and released products, including production changes, troubleshooting, Continuous Improvement, and process optimization. * Review and approve critical process documentation, including PFMEAs, control plans, validation reports, and tooling or fixture specifications, as appropriate. **Bench Technician, Test \& Equipment Support** * Oversee Bench Technician support for production test systems, fixtures, tooling, and equipment, including triage, troubleshooting, repair, upgrades, and preventative maintenance. * Ensure production test systems and fixtures are built, deployed, calibrated, maintained, and validated using applicable schematics, drawings, procedures, and technical requirements. * Coordinate technical support for product performance testing, design verification testing (DVT), and related test planning, procedures, reporting, and data analysis. * Ensure production teams have a clear escalation path for equipment, fixture, test\-system, and product issues; coordinate with engineering teams when issues require additional expertise. * Support improvement of test methods, automation, fixtures, and production support equipment, including appropriate use of tools such as LabVIEW or related test software where applicable. **Electro\-Mechanical Assembly Oversight** * Provide leadership and operational coordination for the Electro\-Mechanical Assembly team to support production priorities, quality requirements, and program schedules. * Ensure assemblers have current work instructions, appropriate tools and fixtures, required training, and access to timely technical support. * Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and rations and Supply Chain to address material, tooling, capacity, and equipment constraints that affect production. **Cross\-Functional \& Organizational Leadership** * Represent Manufacturing Engineering and its supporting production technical teams in site leadership discussions, program reviews, and planning activities. * Partner with Design Engineering, Quality, Operations, Program Management, and Supply Chain to resolve issues and align priorities. * Support customer and third\-party technical audits and communicate manufacturing\-process capabilities, risks, and corrective actions clearly. * Coordinate with 1HMX global engineering teams to share best practices, transfer processes, and align standards across sites. **Qualifications** **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Manufacturing Engineering, or a closely related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. * 8\+ years of progressive manufacturing engineering or related manufacturing technical experience, including at least 2–3 years in a formal people\-management role. * Demonstrated experience leading teams or coordinating work across engineering, technical support, and production functions. * Experience supporting NPI, CI, and production readiness in a precision, high\-mix manufacturing environment. * Experience in electromechanical, pneumatics, electronics, HMI, or related product manufacturing strongly preferred. **Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities** * Broad understanding of manufacturing processes relevant to HMX products, including electromechanical assembly, PCBA processing and rework, Screen printing, Laser cutting/marking, wiring and harness fabrication, and production test. * Ability to lead technical troubleshooting across electrical, mechanical, electronic, and mechatronic systems, including production fixtures and test equipment. * Knowledge of DFM/DFA, Lean manufacturing, Six Sigma concepts, PFMEA, SPC, GD\&T, root\-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methods. * Familiarity with CAD tools such as SolidWorks and with eCAD tools; experience specifying or qualifying automated manufacturing and test equipment is beneficial. * Familiarity with test instruments and systems, electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and test software such as LabVIEW, programming language such as Python, or similar platforms. * Familiarity with ERP/MES systems in a production environment; Syteline experience is a plus. * Strong organizational, communication, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage concurrent programs and translate technical issues for non\-technical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to develop employees, set expectations, manage performance, and lead cross\-functional teams. **Preferred** * Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification, or equivalent continuous\-improvement experience. * Exposure to AS9100, ISO 13485, or other sector\-specific quality management systems. * Experience with robotics, motion control, haptics, wearables, AR/VR, or display integration technologies. * Experience with automated test, pneumatics, production automation, or test platforms such as LabVIEW. * Experience supporting multi\-site or global manufacturing engineering initiatives. **Working Conditions** * Combination of office and production\-floor work. * Frequent interaction with production teams and equipment in a manufacturing environment; adherence to applicable ESD and safety protocols is required. * May require occasional extended hours to support critical program deadlines or production needs. **Equal Opportunity** 1HMX / AIS is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Data Foundations
jobs.description: **This is Adyen** Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for global customers like Meta, Uber, H\&M, and Microsoft, making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. We create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by a culture that encourages ownership and provides the support to truly own your career. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team, delivering innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. **Data Foundations** Adyen is building a top\-tier data team across San Francisco and Amsterdam. The goal is to accelerate data as our most differentiating and least replicable asset across our company. We are focusing on the foundations: the things that make data work as one thing. We decide how it fits together, what it means, and how anyone, human or AI, can trust and use it. The team is new and sits at the heart of our engineering organization. You will join as one of its technical leaders. You will architect data and work on complex challenges across the company, multiplying your impact through the teams and people you work with. You win them over with good design, working prototypes and trust. By driving decisions through ambiguity, you will shape the next generation of Ayden's data. You will be based in San Francisco and work closely with the Data Foundations lead in Amsterdam. You will have a lot of room to run your own week. ### **What you will do** * **Build greenfield.** The mandate, the architecture and the standards are being written now. You help write them. * **Design the foundation.** Set the target architecture for shared data models, data contracts and the semantic layer that every domain builds on. * **Give every metric one clear meaning.** Work with domain teams so each core metric is defined once and owned by the domain that creates it. Variants get their own names. * **Make data contracts the norm.** Agree contracts between producers and consumers, with owners, versions and automatic checks. Consumers are never surprised. * **Build lineage in from the start.** Anyone can trace a figure to its source without asking the engineer who built the pipeline. * **Help teams ship data products.** Guide domain teams to publish datasets with a clear owner, schema and service level. They own the product. You own the standard. * **Stay hands\-on.** Build prototypes, review designs and solve hard problems in the data stack. * **Partner across Adyen.** Product, Finance, Compliance, Platform Engineering and domain leads. Win the argument with data and a working prototype. * **Grow other engineers.** Mentor engineers in Data Foundations and in the domains. Help them solve problems with their own ideas, and raise the bar in design reviews. ### **Who you are** * You have 10\+ years in data engineering or data architecture, and you have worked at Staff scope. You have set direction for more than one team, and you are still hands on. * You pick your own problems. You see what needs to change and drive it to done without being told. * You have designed shared data models, data contracts or semantic layers that many teams build on, and you can defend the trade\-offs. * You have changed what other teams built without any authority over them. You did it with data, prototypes and trust. * You explain hard ideas in plain words to engineers, finance people and executives. You write clearly. * You work well with Engineering, Product, Finance, Compliance and other stakeholders, across time zones. This role's annual base salary range is $258–$367k, plus RSUs. To *learn more about our compensation philosophy, please click* *here**.* **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Adyen** We actively seek different perspectives to sharpen our ideas. Our unique culture is a product of our diverse backgrounds and experiences. No matter who you are or where you're from, you're welcome to be your true self at Adyen. *If you need accommodations or support during the recruitment process to perform at your best, you'll have the opportunity to let our team know in your application. We encourage people from all backgrounds and abilities to apply.* **What's next?** Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don't be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. Adyen is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. ### **San Francisco** Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. This role is based out of our San Francisco office. We are an office\-first company and value in\-person collaboration; we do not offer remote\-only roles.

jobs.title: Head of Network Quality
jobs.description: **About Aeris Communications Inc.** Aeris is the secure connectivity platform for Physical AI and intelligent IoT devices. It caters to connected cars, drones, autonomous mobility, robotics, utilities, energy, fleet management, logistics, medical devices, and manufacturing. Aeris serves over 7,000 enterprise customers and connects more than 115 million devices worldwide, including 41 million connected vehicles, supported by an ecosystem of 30\+ mobile network operators. Enterprises rely on Aeris for the borderless connectivity, embedded security, observability, and proven scale that mission critical Physical AI programs demand. ### **Role Overview** Aeris is hiring a Head of Network Quality to build and own a new function responsible for network quality governance, test lab operations, and automated validation across our IP/Cellular network supporting more than 100M devices worldwide. This leader will establish standardized quality frameworks, embed quality controls into engineering and change processes, and leverage AI\-driven automation to reduce outages and protect SLAs. This is an opportunity to shape how quality is engineered into a global cellular network from the ground up. You’ll define the systems, standards, and automation capabilities that improve network stability and release confidence while partnering across Engineering, Operations, Architecture, and Quality teams. Based in Chicago or Bucharest, this role reports to Claudio Taglienti and offers direct visibility into senior engineering leadership. ### **Key Responsibilities** ###### ***Network Quality Governance*** * Own and drive Network Quality governance, standards, and measurable quality outcomes across network changes and releases. * Establish quality metrics and reporting to measure validation effectiveness, compliance, automation coverage, and customer\-impacting issues. * Embed quality controls into engineering and change management processes across the organization. ***Test Lab \& Validation Frameworks*** * Build and lead a managed Network Test Lab supporting consistent pre\-production validation. * Develop validation workflows and scalable regression testing capabilities across the Aeris network environment. * Create structured, repeatable approaches to validating network designs and changes before production deployment. ***Automation \& AI Enablement*** * Develop automated validation and regression testing capabilities that reduce reliance on manual testing. * Leverage AI and agentic automation approaches to improve regression testing and engineer compliance validation. * Identify opportunities to automate operational quality processes with measurable business impact. ***Cross\-Functional Leadership*** * Partner across Network Engineering, Operations, Architecture, and Quality teams to improve network reliability and operational consistency. * Guide technical decision\-making around network quality standards, feasibility, and implementation priorities. * Lead and grow a small technical quality team while helping establish the long\-term roadmap for the function. ### **Qualifications** * Deep telecom networking knowledge including 4G/5G, IP routing, security (firewall/VPN/NAT), and cellular network architecture. * Demonstrated ability to write or build code to solve problems, including use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code. * Hands\-on experience with agentic AI and automation, including building automation solutions with clear operational rationale. * Technical leadership capability with the ability to guide engineering decisions and define technical feasibility. * Strong cross\-functional communication skills with the ability to work across multiple business units and stakeholder groups. Aeris is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Observability)
jobs.description: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200\+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80\+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we're moving to wide events, with one context\-rich event per request, improving the signal\-to\-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We're also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI\-assisted code is well instrumented by default. We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You'll spend most of your time hands\-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross\-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams. **What You'll Do** * You will own the architecture of Affirm's telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200\+ TB/day. * You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents. * You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships. * You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year\-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business\-impacting projects. * You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design \& analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade\-offs are well understood and managed. * You will act as a force\-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes. * You take ownership of your team's operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support "keep the lights on" \& on\-call efforts. * You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks. * You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example. **What We Look For** * You have 8\+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin. * You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes. * You have built or operated high\-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform. * You have a well\-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs. * You have driven adoption of a jobs.description: Lead or contribute to cross\-functional teams to develop and operationalize AI solutions that help solve our most challenging problems. \- Apply modern engineering techniques to design, develop, deploy and maintain end\-to\-end AI workflows spanning model training, inference and performance monitoring. \- Adapt and integrate diverse AI model architectures, including computer vision systems, natural language processors, audio processors, large language models (LLMs) and multi\-modal frameworks to address complex mission\-critical challenges. \- Monitor and maintain AI products through systematic identification of performance degradation and computational inefficiency and address these challenges through regular fine\-tuning to ensure continued alignment with evolving mission needs and organizational goals. \- Maintain knowledge of current AI research and adapt emerging techniques to intelligence applications. \- Test and evaluate AI solutions against mission requirements and produce actionable recommendations. AI/ML solutions, ensuring models and supporting systems are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and appropriate for VA mission requirements. • Collect, clean, transform, analyze, and prepare structured and unstructured data for AI/ML model development, training, testing, and evaluation. • Evaluate potential AI technologies, models, tools, frameworks, and architectures and recommend solutions appropriate for complex Federal Government and cybersecurity use cases. • Apply AI and machine learning techniques to solve real\-world business, cybersecurity, engineering, analytics, and operational problems across a large enterprise environment. • Develop and support Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions, including model configuration, system prompts, classifiers, fine\-tuning, content moderation, safety filters, and other model controls. • Evaluate AI\-generated outputs for accuracy, factuality, grounding, reliability, bias, helpfulness, honesty, and overall model performance before outputs are incorporated into VA efforts. • Design and execute AI/ML model evaluation and validation methodologies, including benchmark testing and comparative evaluation of model outputs. • Perform and support AI red\-team testing to identify weaknesses, unintended model behaviors, bias, security vulnerabilities, and other risks associated with AI\-generated outputs. • Implement mechanisms and controls to improve the factuality and grounding of AI/LLM outputs, including system\-level instructions, source attribution, content controls, and appropriate response behavior when information is incomplete, contradictory, or uncertain. • Produce technical documentation, analysis, recommendations, briefings, and other materials that clearly communicate AI architecture, model performance, risks, controls, and recommended courses of action to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. • Deliver Government\-owned AI\-related technical artifacts developed under the program, including applicable models, model weights, algorithms, configurations, documentation, data models, source code, and supporting technical components. • Other responsibilities as assigned Minimum qualifications • Minimum of 5 years of experience in relevant fields including IT security, data science, or software engineering, design, development, or deployment of AI or machine learning systems in enterprise or Government environments • Experience working on data science, machine learning, or AI projects, either through internships, research projects, or professional roles. • Experience building, training, and deploying machine learning models and AI systems in a production environment. • Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams, including data scientists, software developers, and domain experts. • Experience in data collection, cleaning, and analysis techniques to prepare datasets for AI modeling. jobs.title: IT Infrastructure Manager
jobs.description: **Overview:** The IT Infrastructure Manager is responsible for leading a high\-performing team of IT professionals in charge of cloud infrastructure, physical and virtual servers, data storage, and backup and recovery systems. Key responsibilities include developing and executing strategies for optimizing the compute, cloud, and storage environment, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, overseeing the maintenance and performance of all server and storage components, managing vendor relationships, driving initiatives to enhance cybersecurity, and staying current with industry trends. The IT Infrastructure Manager must provide infrastructure that is robust, secure, cost\-effective, and future\-proofed. **Responsibilities:** 1\) Develop and execute strategies for optimizing the cloud, server, storage, and backup environment to meet business goals, including scalability, security, and cost\-effectiveness. 2\) Owns the design, build, and lifecycle management of the Azure cloud environment and on\-premises virtual and physical server infrastructure, including capacity planning and cloud cost management. 3\) Oversees enterprise data storage and backup systems, ensuring data is protected, recoverable, and retained in accordance with business and compliance requirements. 4\) Develops, implements, and regularly tests disaster recovery and business continuity plans for all systems and data. 5\) Serves as a member of the IT security council and ensures server, cloud, and storage design and implementation comply with all security requirements, including patching, hardening, and vulnerability remediation. 6\) Regularly conducts and participates in meetings with Directors and Managers within the IT organization to ensure that infrastructure designs and capabilities will support active and future initiatives. 7\) Partners closely with the Network Manager to ensure cloud, data center, and network designs are aligned and integrated. 8\) Responds with the appropriate sense of urgency to changes in infrastructure needs. Understands the priorities of all active and pending projects and plans infrastructure changes accordingly. 9\) Anticipates changes in infrastructure needs due to organizational growth or organizational changes, develops design changes, and prepares recommendations based on the anticipated changes. 10\) Manages and grows a team of infrastructure engineers, providing coaching and mentoring, and identifies and recommends training for team members. 11\) Develops and maintains documentation on standards for the infrastructure team. 12\) Engages 3rd party resources when necessary to support projects / initiatives. Responsible for vetting potential vendors / partners and presenting the Director with vendor recommendations (including costs). 13\) Develops and maintains project plans following IT project management standards for all work / tasks completed by the infrastructure team, and consistently communicates project status as well as problems / issues to Senior IT management and all impacted teams. 14\) Serves as a member of the ITSM standards committee. Works closely with the Service Desk to ensure superior service and communication throughout both IT and the business organizations. 15\) Serves as a member of the Change Advisory Board. Responsible for communicating all infrastructure activities as well as identifying potential conflicts and/or impact to operations. **Qualifications:** Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience in IT field. A minimum of 10 years of experience in IT infrastructure, including leadership of server, cloud, or storage teams. Expertise in cloud computing (Microsoft Azure preferred), virtualization, Windows/Linux server environments, enterprise storage, and backup/recovery technologies. Strong knowledge of cybersecurity best practices. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Superior customer service orientation. Robust decision making and problem\-solving skills. Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Azure, VMware, ITIL) are a plus. \#LI\-JE1

jobs.title: IT Network Manager
jobs.description: **Overview:** The IT Network Manager is responsible for leading a high\-performing team of IT professionals in charge of the enterprise network, including WAN, LAN, wireless, network security, and telephony. Key responsibilities include developing and executing strategies for optimizing network and voice services, collaborating with cross\-functional teams, overseeing the maintenance and performance of all network components across warehouses, offices, and retail stores, managing carrier and vendor relationships, driving initiatives to enhance cybersecurity, and staying current with industry trends. The IT Network Manager must provide a network that is robust, secure, cost\-effective, and future\-proofed. **Responsibilities:** 1\) Develop and execute strategies for optimizing the enterprise network and telephony environment to meet business goals, including scalability, security, availability, and cost\-effectiveness. 2\) Owns the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of the WAN, LAN, and SD\-WAN connecting all warehouses, corporate offices, and retail stores, including routing, switching, and circuit management. 3\) Oversees the enterprise wireless network, ensuring reliable coverage and performance for store, warehouse, and office operations. 4\) Oversees cloud and self\-managed telephony and voice systems, including contact center and store voice services. 5\) Serves as a member of the IT security council and ensures network design and implementation comply with all security requirements, including firewalls, segmentation, remote access, and PCI store openings and remodels. 8\) Partners closely with the Infrastructure Manager to ensure network, cloud, and data center designs are aligned and integrated, and supports disaster recovery and Responsible for vetting potential vendors / partners and presenting the Director with vendor recommendations (including costs). 13\) Develops and maintains project plans following IT project management standards for all work / tasks completed by the network team and consistently communicates project status as well as problems / issues to Senior IT management and all impacted teams. 14\) Serves as a member of the ITSM standards committee. Works closely with the Service Desk to ensure superior service and communication throughout both IT and the business organizations. 15\) Serves as a member of the Change Advisory Board. Responsible for communicating all network activities as well as identifying potential conflicts and/or impact to operations. **Qualifications:** Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience in IT field. A minimum of 10 years of experience in enterprise networking, including leadership of network or telecom teams. Expertise in WAN/LAN/SD\-WAN, routing and switching, enterprise wireless, firewalls, and VoIP/cloud telephony; experience supporting multi\-site retail or distribution environments preferred. Strong knowledge of network security and cybersecurity best practices, including PCI DSS. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Superior customer service orientation. Robust decision making and problem\-solving skills. Relevant certifications (e.g., CCNP, CWNA, Palo Alto/Fortinet, ITIL) are a plus. \#LI\-JE1

jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- We are seeking a talented Data Engineer to join our EC2 \+ EBS \+ Networking Product BI team. Today, the team uses automated alarms for real\-time monitoring and AI\-powered agents that self\-heal failures and triage tasks — you will maintain and extend this system using Redshift, orchestration frameworks, and AWS data services. * Report Delivery \& Business Reviews: Own and operate Weekly/Daily Business Review (WBR/DBR) reporting for EC2 services, ensuring accurate, timely delivery to CEO/S\-Team and VP\-level stakeholders. Today, report generation, validation, and delivery are automated via LLMs — you will operate and improve these workflows. * Callout Generation: Generate callouts on service performance — identifying week\-over\-week trends, anomalies, and key drivers to surface in executive reviews. Today, dashboards serve 100\+ Product Managers across 11 engagement areas — you will own dashboards for your service areas and improve self\-serve capabilities. * Stakeholder Partnership: Work closely with Product Managers, service finance teams, and cross\-functional partners to translate business questions into data products and present findings to senior leaders. Today, the team partners across EC2, Networking, and Compute product families — you will be the primary analytics point of contact for your assigned service areas. We serve as the data and analytics partner for Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2\), Networking Services, and adjacent Compute product families — supporting 100\+ Product Managers across 11 engagement areas. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Trainium Systems
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Have you ever wondered what it takes to build the software systems that turn a rack of AI accelerators from inert silicon into a system a customer can run workloads on? Do you want deep ownership of a service that every one of those systems depends on to boot, run, and stay healthy? Who are we? Annapurna Labs is the part of Amazon that designs the custom silicon behind the cloud, including Trainium for AI training, Graviton CPUs, and the AWS Nitro system. Nearly every server in AWS runs hardware we designed. We build the chips, the systems, and the software that power some of the largest AI training and inference workloads in the world. What do we do? We build the software that provisions, operates, updates, and monitors the servers behind AWS's largest AI training workloads, built on Trainium, Graviton, and the AWS Nitro system. We give the people who run this hardware a complete way to stand it up, watch its health, deliver new software to it, and diagnose it, all through open, standard interfaces. We own that software from design through the running system. Why it's high\-impact? The hardware is just silicon until our software makes it provisionable, observable, and serviceable. Every system runs through what we build. The service you own is on the path for all of them, and the people who run this hardware depend on it every day. What's the challenge? There are many ambiguous and difficult challenges in our fast\-moving space. Our services require deep system and software expertise. You need to have the ability to work within a fast moving and startup\-like environment in a large company. You will identify solutions, trying ideas, given space to fail and iterate to produce products that your customers love. What you will do? You own a service in the management plane, in provisioning, monitoring, telemetry, software delivery, or diagnostics, depending on where the team needs you. You take it from design to production, you work backward from what the operator needs, and you build on the interfaces the hardware teams expose. Who would succeed in this role? An engineer who likes building and operating a service in production and takes it the whole way. You read logs and reason across process and system boundaries, you ship in small verifiable steps, and you turn requirements into a service other people rely on. jobs.title: Data Center Chief Engineer
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join our dynamic Data Center Engineering Operations Team and become a critical architect of the infrastructure that powers global cloud computing. You'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of Amazon Web Services' physical infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that support millions of customers worldwide. The Data Center Chief Engineer (CE) is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating at peak efficiency. This involves both planned preventative maintenance of equipment, daily corrective work, and emergency response to emergent issues. The CE serves as an expert technical resource reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager, interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT) and any third\-party vendors. They are expected to be a singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center and to support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission\-critical servers must maintain better than 99\.999% uptime. Chief Engineer will be responsible for managing small\-to\-medium large impact projects from conception to completion. These projects can involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. The CE will be tasked with creating and delivering milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities. The Chief Engineer directs, trains and supports EOT’s in their role of providing hands\-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. Implementation and execution of site/equipment\-specific training exercises is also expected. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand\-by diesel generators, switchgear, UPS’s, PDU’s, AHU’s, chillers, cooling towers, chemical treatment systems, pumps, motors, VFD’s, and building automation systems. AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Citizens. (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States) Key job responsibilities * Oversee the day\-to\-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in a data center. * Operate independently with limited direct management * Act as an escalation point for all facilities\-related issues within the data center, escalating to the Data Center Facility Manager as needed * Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures * Troubleshoot and report of facility and data sever\-level events within internal SLA * Create and deploy new standard practices for Engineering Operations Technicians, Chief Engineers, and vendor support teams * Provide training and guidance to Engineering Operations Technicians * Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff * Ensure all security procedures are adhered to by vendor and Amazon staff * Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows * Communicate complex technical information to a non\-technical audience * Using Microsoft Office suite (Outlook, Excel, PPT, Word) and other computer programs such as PDF, QUIP, and other dashboards and scheduling tooling. * Instruct others on scheduling, ticketing, and providing mentorship in developing solutions. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational. Essential Requirements: * Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed * Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational * Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings * 4\+ years of administrative experience including Microsoft Office products * Experience leading technical teams through daily operations, maintenance evolutions, and complex troubleshooting * 4\+ years of data center experience including industrial electrical and mechanical systems **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Associates or higher in engineering field or mechanical or electrical trades * PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent certifications * Training\-lead informal training * Must be able to work in an environment that involves walking, stooping, bending, and climbing to access equipment.
