jobs.description: **Company:** Ambilabs LLC **Location:** Warren, Rhode Island **Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site **Experience:** 7\+ Years **About Ambilabs** Ambilabs LLC is a growing environmental technology company specializing in advanced ambient air quality monitoring instrumentation, custom monitoring systems, and innovative environmental measurement solutions. We serve government agencies, research institutions, and industrial customers throughout North America and internationally. Our Research \& Development team focuses on designing and developing the next generation of environmental monitoring technologies, with an emphasis on measurement accuracy, reliability, and practical real\-world applications. **Position Overview** Ambilabs is seeking an experienced, highly motivated Senior Research \& Development Scientist / Engineer to join our team in Warren, Rhode Island. This position will play a critical role in the research, design, development, and commercialization of new environmental monitoring instruments, with a particular emphasis on optical measurement technologies, light scattering, and absorption. The ideal candidate possesses a strong theoretical understanding of optics and advanced mathematics, physics, combined with the hands\-on engineering experience necessary to design, build, test, and troubleshoot complex instrumentation. Experience with nephelometry, aerosol measurement, or optical particle detection is a significant advantage. We welcome experienced professionals from a range of engineering and scientific disciplines, including optical engineering, electrical engineering, physics, applied sciences, and related technical fields. This is an opportunity for an experienced technical professional who enjoys solving challenging engineering problems, developing innovative technologies, and transforming scientific concepts into commercially viable products. **Key Responsibilities** **Research \& Product Development** * Research and development activities for new environmental monitoring instruments and measurement technologies. * Design, develop, and optimize optical measurement systems, particularly those utilizing light scattering, and absorption principles. * Evaluate new technologies, measurement techniques, and components for potential integration into commercial products. * Drive product development from initial concept and feasibility studies through prototyping, validation, and production readiness. * Identify and implement improvements to existing instrument designs, measurement accuracy, reliability, and performance. **Optical Systems \& Analytical Engineering** * Apply advanced optical principles, light scattering theory, light absorption theory, and mathematical modeling to instrument design and development. * Develop and solve complex mathematical equations related to optical measurements, signal processing, and instrument performance. * Design and evaluate optical configurations, light sources, detectors, and associated measurement electronics. * Develop calibration methods, measurement algorithms, and performance verification procedures. * Analyze experimental data to identify measurement limitations, sources of error, and opportunities for improvement. **Hands\-On Engineering \& Prototyping** * Independently design, assemble, modify, and troubleshoot electronic and optical prototypes. * Work directly with electronic circuits, sensors, optical components, and laboratory instrumentation. * Utilize hand tools, electronic test equipment, and specialized laboratory equipment to build and evaluate experimental systems. * Diagnose complex mechanical, electrical, and optical problems and develop effective solutions. * Conduct laboratory testing, validation experiments, and instrument performance evaluations. **Technical Leadership \& Collaboration** * Provide technical direction and expertise throughout the product development process. * Collaborate with engineering, technical service, and other departments to ensure successful product development and commercialization. * Establish testing procedures, technical specifications, and performance requirements. * Prepare detailed technical documentation, research findings, design records, and test reports. * Mentor and provide technical guidance to less experienced team members as needed. * Independently manage technical priorities and development milestones while maintaining project schedules. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of professional experience in research and development, instrumentation engineering, optical systems, or related technical product development. * Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, applied sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent demonstrated professional experience. * Strong understanding of optics, including light scattering principles and their applications in measurement technologies. * Advanced mathematical and analytical capabilities, including the ability to derive, manipulate, and solve complex equations. * Demonstrated experience designing, developing, testing, or improving scientific or industrial instrumentation. * Extensive hands\-on experience working with electronics, electronic components, and laboratory test equipment. * Proficiency using hand tools to assemble, modify, troubleshoot, and repair electronic and mechanical systems. * Ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex technical and engineering challenges. * Experience with experimental design, data analysis, measurement uncertainty, and instrument performance evaluation. * Demonstrated ability to take technical concepts from initial design through functional prototype development. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document and explain complex technical concepts. **Preferred Qualifications** The following qualifications are highly desirable but are not required: * Experience with nephelometry, including the design, development, calibration, or operation of nephelometric measurement systems. * Knowledge of aerosol science, atmospheric optics, or particulate matter measurement technologies. * Experience with Mie scattering, Rayleigh scattering, or related optical measurement principles. * Experience designing optical detection systems utilizing LEDs, lasers, photodiodes, or photomultiplier tubes. * Experience with analog and digital electronics, signal conditioning, and low\-noise measurement circuits. * Familiarity with embedded systems, microcontrollers, and instrument control technologies. * Experience with scientific programming, numerical analysis, or mathematical modeling using tools such as Python, MATLAB, or similar software. * Experience with optical simulation, mechanical design, or CAD software. * Knowledge of environmental monitoring instrumentation, air quality measurement methods, or analytical instruments. * Experience developing commercial products, including design verification, validation, and transition to manufacturing. * Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a relevant technical or scientific field. **Ideal Candidate** The successful candidate will be someone who: * Enjoys combining advanced scientific theory with practical, hands\-on engineering. * Can understand the physics and mathematics behind a measurement technique and translate that knowledge into a functional instrument. * Is comfortable working at a laboratory bench, assembling electronics, using tools, and troubleshooting prototypes. * Approaches complex problems analytically and develops practical, innovative solutions. * Takes ownership of technical challenges and works independently to achieve results. * Is creative, detail\-oriented, and motivated by developing new technologies. * Thrives in a collaborative environment where ideas can move quickly from concept to prototype and commercial product. **Compensation \& Benefits** Ambilabs offers a competitive compensation and benefits package, including: * 3 weeks of paid time off (PTO) * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Medical insurance * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * Life insurance * Free gym membership * Opportunities for professional growth and technical leadership * Direct involvement in innovative environmental monitoring product development * Collaborative, hands\-on research and engineering environment **Work Location** This is a full\-time, on\-site position at Ambilabs LLC in Warren, Rhode Island. The position requires regular laboratory work, hands\-on prototype development, instrument testing, and direct collaboration with our engineering and technical teams. **Ambilabs LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering (Robotics, Controls, Hardware)
jobs.description: **Arculus adapts yesterday's pipelines to transport tomorrow's energy.** Our SputteredPipe™ technology is an ultra\-thin Al/Al₂O₃ multilayer coating, developed at MIT, applied to the internal surface of oil and gas pipelines. It lowers friction (lower OpEx, higher throughput), prevents corrosion, and makes pipe suitable for CO₂ transport and hydrogen blending. We apply it two ways: we coat new 40\-ft pipe joints ourselves, in\-house, and the autonomous SputterPig™ coats existing pipelines in place, with no excavation. We are a small team in Alexandria, Virginia. We need an engineer who has built hardware that works outside the lab and wants to own the engineering of the company. **The role** You will lead the design, build, test and field deployment of the machines that apply our coating: an autonomous robot that travels inside live pipelines, and a coating system for new pipe. You will own the technical roadmap, set the architecture, and build the engineering team around you. This is the senior engineering seat of the company, and it can grow into Chief Technology Officer as we grow. You will: * Decide the mechanical, electrical, controls and software architecture of our machines, and build the first working versions yourself. * Take prototypes from the bench to pilot runs in the field, and fix what breaks. * Work with pipeline operators, research partners and testing labs, and represent the engineering side in technical meetings. * Hire and lead the next engineers. **You must have** * At least 5 years of hands\-on engineering: you have built electromechanical or robotic systems yourself, and at least one of them ran outside a lab. * Depth in at least two of: mechatronics, controls and estimation, embedded systems, mechanical design for harsh environments, vacuum or thin\-film process equipment. * Experience taking a prototype to a deployed product or a field trial. * Willingness to travel for work, often at short notice, including to field sites and test facilities (about 30 to 40% of the time). * Willingness to work long, irregular hours when a test campaign or deployment demands it. This is a startup, and the schedule follows the work. We say so up front. * Work onsite in Alexandria, Virginia, with travel. **Strong plus** * Pipeline, in\-line inspection (pigging), or confined\-space robotics. * Sputtering, PVD, or other vacuum coating hardware. * Experience leading a small technical team. * Safety\-critical or hazardous\-area (explosive atmosphere) design experience. **What we offer** * A real technical leadership role with direct access to the CEO and the science behind the technology. * Base salary of $120,000 to $150,000, depending on experience, plus equity of 0\.3% to 0\.5% of the fully diluted company, vesting over four years. * Visa sponsorship is available. * The chance to build the machines that retrofit the pipeline network for CO₂ and hydrogen. **How to apply** Email careers@arculus\-solutions.com with your CV and a short note (a few lines) describing the hardest machine you have built and what broke first. Subject: "Head of Engineering application \- your name". We reply within 3 business days. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Paid time off Education: * Master's (Required) Ability to Relocate: * Alexandria, VA 22314: Relocate before starting work (Required) Willingness to travel: * 75% (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job ID** 2026\-19766 **Date posted** Oct. 26, 2026 **Location** Seattle, Washington **Category** Software Engineering Arm is building the foundational platform software for the next generation of Physical AI systems on Arm: software that lets AI applications and agents perceive, reason and act through real devices, reliably and on\-device, across robotics, industrial automation and the smart home. The work sits at the intersection of distributed systems, edge computing and AI infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to join a new team in Seattle and build new products and reference implementations that enable developers to put the latest Arm technology to work in their solutions. **Job Overview:** ----------------- Building intelligent systems that interact with the physical world requires bringing together AI models, diverse hardware, and software frameworks across the cloud and edge. Developers need simpler ways to connect these technologies, orchestrate complex workflows, and build reliable applications that can operate across different devices and environments. Our team is building the open\-source foundations and developer tools to make Physical AI more accessible, scalable, and reliable. We are working to simplify how AI agents interact with physical devices, coordinate tasks, and operate across heterogeneous hardware environments. By bringing together AI, hardware, and developer ecosystems, we aim to make building and deploying real\-world agentic applications as seamless as building software today. As a **Staff AI Engineer**, you will develop the tools and technologies that bring this vision to life. You will design and build SDKs, frameworks, and reference applications that enable AI agents to interact with physical devices, orchestrate complex workflows, and operate across cloud and edge environments. You will integrate modern AI models, inference runtimes, and agent frameworks to create end\-to\-end applications, while developing evaluation methodologies to measure their reliability, performance, and effectiveness in real\-world scenarios. You will work hands\-on with real physical hardware, and edge computing platforms, collaborating with engineers, product teams, and industry partners to shape the future of Physical AI on Arm. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Design and implement features in our SDKs and reference services, on both the device side and the agent side * Build reference applications and demos that connect agents to real devices across edge and cloud, using PyTorch\-ecosystem inference runtimes and popular agent frameworks * Develop evaluation harnesses that measure the reliability, latency and correctness of agent\-to\-device interactions, and use the results to improve the product * Bring up and maintain a fleet of development hardware (single\-board computers, cameras, sensors, robot platforms, edge servers) used for development, testing and demonstrations * Contribute to the security and operational posture of the platform: identity, authorization, observability and safe failure behavior * Write clear documentation, samples and learning material for external developers, and support the open\-source community through issues, reviews and contributions * Collaborate with architects, product managers and partner engineers on requirements, API design and release quality **Required Skills and Experience:** ----------------------------------- * Professional software engineering experience building distributed systems, with strong Python and working proficiency in at least one of C\+\+, Rust or Go * Experience building and shipping AI\-powered applications, including LLM tool use or agent frameworks, and integrating them with real systems * Practical experience deploying ML models for inference, on servers or on edge devices, with PyTorch or a comparable framework * Solid grounding in messaging, RPC, concurrency, failure handling and testing of networked software * Comfortable with Linux, embedded single\-board computers, containers and CI/CD workflows * Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across hardware, systems and ML disciplines * Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field **"Nice to Have" Skills and Experience:** ----------------------------------------- * Experience with publish/subscribe messaging systems or IoT protocols * Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol or similar agent\-tool interfaces * Robotics or physical\-AI background: ROS 2, robot arms, perception pipelines, or control loops * On\-device inference experience with ExecuTorch, ONNX Runtime or vendor NPU toolchains, and LLM serving with vLLM or similar * Experience designing evaluations or benchmarks for AI agents * Contributions to open\-source projects and experience supporting an external developer community * Security fundamentals for connected devices **In Return:** -------------- You will take on imp thoughtful engineering, collaboration and continuous learning, and you will have a direct say in what the product becomes. **Additional Information:** --------------------------- Please note that no relocation package is available for this role. \#LI\-KC1 **Salary Range:** ----------------- $170,900\-$231,200 per year We value people as individuals and our dedication is to reward people competitively and equitably for the work they do and the skills and experience they bring to Arm. Salary is only one component of Arm's offering. The total reward package will be shared with candidates during the recruitment and selection process. **Our 10x Mindset** ------------------- At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https://careers.arm.com/10x\-mindset (opens in new window) **Use of AI in Your Application** --------------------------------- At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI\-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm.com so we can support you. **Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations** ---------------------------------------------- At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com. To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. **Hybrid Working** ------------------ Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. **Equal Opportunities** ----------------------- Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Solutions Engineer, Data - Evinova
jobs.description: **Location** Durham, North Carolina, United States **Job ID** R\-262981 **Date posted** 27/10/2026 **About the Role:** As a Senior Clinical Solutions Engineer, Data, you’ll be the customer\-facing clinical data expert on our SaaS Delivery team and a trusted advisor on data requirements, data standards, and technical solutions for connecting with Evinova’s SaaS solutions. You’ll work across clinical trial operational, study design, cost and rate, and feasibility data, leading customer conversations about data requirements and then building and guiding the work that gets customer data into our platform, from source data through validated loads. You’ll also be a domain expert across the product suite, supporting post\-implementation technical inquiries and contributing to pre\-sales discussions. You’ll work directly with customers’ clinical operations, data, and IT teams, and with our Product and Engineering teams, to turn customer needs into working solutions. You’ll stay close to products in development and translate their requirements into delivery approaches. Our product space is new, so this role suits someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, is energized by emerging technology, and is happy to roll up their sleeves to deliver digital health solutions at scale. **What You’ll Do** **Lead customer data conversations** * Lead discovery with customers on data requirements, identifying the right datasets, data owners, and multi\-functional partners for each data type. * Advise customers on data standards and on how their data maps to Evinova’s out\-of\-the\-box offerings. * Develop deep expertise in Evinova’s data landscape and in customer data architectures, providing technical guidance during implementation and configuration. * Present clearly and confidently to technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior customer collaborators. **Technical implementation** * Guide customers through collecting source data specifications, preparing datasets, and mapping and transforming data to Evinova standards where needed. * Support customer onboarding to ingest sponsor\-specific data sources. * Build and prepare data work hands\-on where needed, and load them into customer environments. * Review customer\-provided data for quality and completeness, and resolve issues before load. * Validate loaded data in customer environments and reconcile it against source. * Manage defects and issues through to resolution in partnership with Product and Engineering, and lead root\-cause analysis and remediation. * Navigate formal change control and environment promotion, coordinating approvals, dependencies, and timelines. * Champion change initiatives using change\-management guidelines, aligning delivery with strategic goals, product releases, and multi\-functional needs during complex transitions. * Track and communicate implementation progress across customers and internal partners, working independently across multiple engagements and proactively identifying and mitigating risks. **Integrations** * Lead all aspects of end\-to\-end customer data integration, including collecting requirements, configuring, testing, and maintaining integrations, and fix connectivity issues. * Manage configuration as code and coordinate reviews and approvals with Platform and Security partners. * Support system\-upgrade impact assessments and update integrations after implementation. * Ensure data exchange meets applicable data privacy and regulatory requirements **Be the product SME** * Answer post\-implementation technical and data questions and serve as a customer concern point for data\-related issues. * Support pre\-sales with technical and data questions, such as feasibility and prioritization. * Act as a key liaison between customers, internal teams, vendors, and our Product and Engineering teams, and work with Product to build solutions and feed customer insights back into the roadmap. * Establish and document guidelines for data exchange, including monitoring and to fix, and develop and optimize delivery playbooks, templates, and checklists that make use of Evinova’s automated tools. * Train internal teams and customers on data exchange procedures and standards. * Keep a commercial approach, making sure integration and delivery work brings value for customers and for Evinova. **Essential Qualifications** * 8\+ years of experience * Bachelor's Degree * Demonstrated experience in clinical operations, clinical data management, clinical trial planning, or a related technical field where data informs study decisions. * Strong working knowledge of clinical trial data structures, terminologies, and standards, including USDM and CDISC. * Hands\-on familiarity with clinical trial operational, study design, cost and rate, and feasibility data, ideally including both clinical operational data and cost or finance data. * Good background in the technical implementation of customer\-facing data integrations across organizations, ideally for enterprise SaaS customers. * Strong working skills with structured data formats and secure file transfer. * Comfort with configuration in version control, command\-line tools, and basic cloud concepts (for example, AWS). * Experience with work\-tracking and documentation tools such as Jira and Confluence. * Demonstrated ability to analyze data flows, identify discrepancies, and solve complex data issues. * Ability to manage high\-visibility, technical customer engagements, work independently across multiple engagements, and own problems end to end. * Executive presence and good communication, with the ability to translate technical topics for non\-technical audiences and collaborate across diverse teams. * Highly organized and passionate about finding effective approaches. Shows resilience and adaptability in a fast\-paced, newly emerging product space. Has a passion for improving healthcare through technology. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting or implementing healthcare technology, digital health solutions, or data\-heavy SaaS platforms. * Knowledge of data privacy and compliance requirements and standards for clinical data. * Experience working within formal change management in a regulated environment. * Experience supporting pre\-sales or solution scoping. * Familiarity with integration monitoring tools, automation, and customer delivery playbooks. * Practical experience applying AI\-driven tools or frameworks to accelerate data integration and validation (for example, reducing manual mapping). When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to encourage life\-changing medicines. In\-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. **That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office.** But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. **Why Evinova (AstraZeneca)?** ------------------------------ Evinova draws on AstraZeneca’s deep experience developing novel therapeutics, informed by insights from thousands of patients and clinical researchers. Together, we accelerate the delivery of life\-changing medicines, improve the design and delivery of clinical trials for better patient experiences and outcomes, and think more holistically about patient care before, during, and after treatment. Evinova represents an outstanding opportunity to deliver meaningful outcomes with digital and AI to serve the wider healthcare community and create new standards for the sector. We work a minimum of three days per week from the office to maintain the pace, connection, and creative friction that builds great products, while respecting individual flexibility. Join us on our journey of building a new kind of health tech business to reset expectations of what a biopharmaceutical company can be. This means opening new ways to work, pioneering ground breaking methods, and bringing unexpected teams together. Interested? Come and join our journey. **Date Posted** 28\-Oct\-2026 **Closing Date** 10\-Nov\-2026 Our mission is to build an inclusive environment where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. In furtherance of that mission, we welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of their protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please complete the corresponding section in the application form.

jobs.title: Test Solutions Software Section Lead
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Test Solutions Software Section Lead (Player/Coach)** In Precision Strike \& Sensing Solutions, we design, develop, and manufacture state‑of‑the‑art systems that enable our customers to execute their missions. Our manufacturing lines support critical programs where **build, test, and diagnostic software** are foundational to production throughput, yield, and quality. We’re creating a dedicated **Test Solutions Software Section** to bring technical harmony to how we develop, deploy, and sustain test software across programs—reducing downtime, accelerating change, and developing the next generation of factory\-focused engineers. **Your Impact** * **Technical Stewardship at Scale:** Serve as the subject‑matter authority for the **software powering manufacturing and automated test equipment**. Establish a common, reusable architecture that keeps high‑volume production seamless and efficient across multiple programs/sites. * **Production Problem Solving:** Lead rapid diagnosis and resolution of factory floor software issues. When the line stops, you own the recovery—coordinating across Test Engineering, Manufacturing, Hardware, and Quality to restore flow. * **Player/Coach Leadership:** Split your time between **hands‑on contributions** (architecture, code reviews, integration, troubleshooting) and **front‑line leadership** (hiring, performance management, coaching, career development, roadmap stewardship). **The Challenge** You will stand up and lead a cross‑program team of software engineers responsible for the **full lifecycle** of manufacturing test solutions—requirements, architecture, coding, integration on hardware, verification, deployment, and sustainment. Today, engineers are distributed under different leaders and embedded within program teams. You will: * Consolidate and **realign reporting** for test‑focused engineers into a single section. * Define and execute a **technical roadmap** that standardizes platforms, patterns, and processes across programs. * Build **cross‑training** plans to increase bench strength and eliminate single‑points‑of‑failure. * Partner with Program Engineering Managers and factory leadership to meet schedule/cost objectives **without sacrificing reliability**. **Roles \& Responsibilities** **Leadership \& People** * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of test solutions software engineers; establish growth plans, skill matrices, and cross‑training rotations. * Perform staff management including performance reviews, coaching, career development, salary planning, rewards/recognition, and performance management. * Hire to a balanced skill profile (factory support, software craftsmanship, data/diagnostics), emphasizing **player/coach** potential. **Technical Execution** * Own the section’s **reference architecture** for ATE and manufacturing test software: driver abstraction layers, hardware‑interface modules, test sequence orchestration, data logging/traceability, and deployment hardening. * Lead teams through design, implementation, integration on hardware, and verification—**on the bench and on the floor**. * Introduce and enforce standards for code quality, documentation, configuration management, versioning, and release practices for regulated manufacturing environments. * Champion **CI/CD for test software** (build, static analysis, automated tests, staged deployments) appropriate for hardware‑in‑the‑loop systems. * Integrate test software with factory systems (e.g., build records, serialization, calibration data, analytics dashboards) in partnership with Manufacturing/Quality. **Operational Excellence** * Establish on‑call rotations and escalation paths; track and improve MTTR for production software incidents. * Define KPIs and report routinely (e.g., uptime, first‑pass yield, release cadence, defect density, common‑platform adoption, audit findings). * Plan and manage the necessary **staff, facilities, and equipment** for successful execution (licenses, benches, instruments, emulators, labs). * Ensure schedules are planned, resourced, and executed to cost/schedule objectives; manage risk and drive corrective actions. * Support pursuit activities—bids and proposals—by scoping test software work, estimating, and articulating reuse strategies. **Required Education, Experience, \& Skills** * **Bachelor’s degree** in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field **and 10\+ years** of relevant experience (or equivalent experience). * Experience deploying and sustaining software in constrained or regulated factory environments: **configuration management**, **release governance**, change control, and audit readiness. * Demonstrated success in **factory or production support** environments—owning incident response, root cause, and corrective actions for software issues. * Strong written and verbal communication; effective interface with Discipline Leads, Section Leads, Program Engineering Managers, Program Managers, Manufacturing/Test Engineering, and Quality. * Proven experience leading projects to successful execution (on time/on budget), including risk management and stakeholder alignment. **Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills** * **4\+ years** leading a software team (embedded or test solutions) through full lifecycle delivery on hardware. * Hands‑on experience with manufacturing test software: + Languages/Frameworks: **C\#/.NET**, **Python**, **C/C\+\+**, **LabVIEW**, **NI TestStand** (or equivalent), shell/Powershell scripting. + Hardware/Interfaces: DAQ, PXI/VXI, SCPI instruments, GPIB/USB/Ethernet, SPI/I²C/UART, CAN, RS‑422/485\. + OS/Platforms: Windows and/or Linux; experience with **RTOS** (VxWorks, FreeRTOS) or bare‑metal drivers is a plus. * Familiarity with Agile workflows, **CI/CD pipelines**, static code analysis, automated testing, and **software observability** (logging/metrics). * Knowledge of **signal processing**, guidance \& control, or hardware‑in‑the‑loop test techniques. * Experience configuring and deploying embedded OSs and integrating with production testers. **Pay Information** Full\-Time Salary Range: $132962 \- $226035 Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics. **About BAE Systems, Inc.** BAE Systems, Inc. is a defense, aerospace, and security company headquartered in Falls Church, Virginia, with more than 40,000 employees worldwide. We serve, supply, and protect those who protect us. As one of the most geographically diverse international defense companies, we deliver a full range of products and services spanning air, land, maritime, space, and cyber, including advanced electronics, intelligence solutions, and dedicated customer support. Our culture is performance\-driven and values\-led, built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. Purpose isn't a tagline here. It's what drives us. discovery, and secure SaaS\-to\-SaaS integrations. * Advance a Zero Trust architecture across identity, endpoints, networks, data, applications, and cloud workloads. * Oversee security operations, notifications, and coordination with Legal, insurers, and law enforcement. * Embed secure\-by\-design practices into the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines in partnership with engineering and product leaders. * Align business continuity and disaster recovery programs with IT and business leaders. **AI governance and security** * Establish and co\-lead the company's AI governance program with Legal, Privacy, Data, and Engineering, covering acceptable use, AI risk assessments, an approved tool and model inventory, and AI vendor oversight. * Secure enterprise and client\-facing AI, including Microsoft 365 Copilot data governance, Amazon Bedrock and other AWS AI services, and defenses against prompt injection, data leakage, model misuse, and shadow AI. **Client trust and culture** * Represent BI WORLDWIDE in client security and compliance reviews, RFPs, contract negotiations, and leadership briefings, and position security as a competitive differentiator. * program, with measurable gains in risk posture and program maturity. * A track record of achieving and sustaining SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, ISO/IEC 42001, or comparable attestations and certifications. * Experience presenting to executives, customers, and audit and risk committees and translating technical risk into business impact. * Experience managing a security and compliance budget, a multidisciplinary team, and strategic MSSP/MDR partners. **Deep technical foundation** * Current, hands\-on depth securing Microsoft 365: Entra ID, Conditional Access, Intune, Defender XDR, Purview, and Sentinel. * Current, hands\-on depth securing AWS at scale: multi\-account architecture, IAM, network controls, encryption/KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, and infrastructure\-as\-code guardrails. * Experience securing enterprise AI, including Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness (permissions, sensitivity labels, DLP), AWS AI services such as Amazon Bedrock, and the AI threats that the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS describe. * Strong command of identity and access management, Zero Trust, endpoint and network security, data protection, application security, and detection and response. * Experience leading incidents from detection through recovery, regulatory notification, and post\-incident review. **Governance, risk, and compliance** * Deep knowledge of NIST CSF, NIST SP 800\-53, CIS Controls, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, and SOC 1 and SOC 2\. * Working knowledge of global privacy regulation, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and U.S. state privacy laws, and experience partnering with Legal and Privacy on compliance. * Experience building an AI governance program, with knowledge of the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, the EU AI Act, and U.S. state AI laws. * Experience implementing a GRC platform and continuous control monitoring. * Experience leading external audits and client security assessments, including client questions about how the company uses AI with their data. **Leadership presence and communication** * Credibility with the executives, leadership, This hands\-on, full\-stack engineering role focuses on building production\-ready AI solutions that combine advanced AI capabilities with intuitive user experiences and practical business workflows. advanced degree preferred. * **5 years of hands\-on software engineering experience**, including demonstrated success designing, developing, and delivering multiple production\-quality applications or products from concept through deployment. * Required experience deploying at least one LLM\-powered feature or application to real users, regardless of scale. * Required experience working directly with domain experts, business stakeholders, or customers to translate requirements into technical solutions and take ownership of delivered outcomes. * Strong full\-stack software engineering experience, including backend services, data models, APIs, and modern user\-facing applications. * Deep proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language, such as Python, TypeScript, Go, or Java, with demonstrated understanding of language fundamentals, design patterns, and production\-quality development practices. * Ability to quickly learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, and technologies; familiarity with Python and TypeScript preferred. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, application architecture, automated testing, debugging, performance optimization, and development of scalable, maintainable systems. * Experience developing and integrating modern web applications, APIs, authentication mechanisms, and secure enterprise services. * Demonstrated ability to validate technical solutions through measurable outcomes, including automated testing, benchmarks, experiments, evaluation frameworks, or A/B testing. * Strong analytical thinking, technical judgment, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate trade\-offs, resolve ambiguity, and develop practical solutions to complex challenges. * Experience collaborating with nontechnical stakeholders and subject matter experts, with the ability to explain technical concepts and recommendations in clear, business\-focused language. * Familiarity with LLM applications, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), AI evaluation methodologies, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) preferred. * Exposure to agentic AI concepts, including orchestration, tool use, context management, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows preferred; prior experience building AI agents is not required. * Experience with cloud\-based application development and technologies such as Microsoft Azure, containers, PostgreSQL, and React preferred. * Experience working in professional services, regulated industries, or environments serving highly specialized business users preferred; prior Tax, Assurance, or Accounting experience is not required. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical solutions, articulate design decisions, and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, adapt quickly to evolving requirements, and deliver high\-quality solutions in a fast\-paced environment. * Experience using AI\-assisted and agentic development tools to enhance engineering productivity, or a strong willingness to incorporate these technologies into daily development practices. * No professional certifications or licenses required. *The pay rate range for this job position are listed below. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employee*s. *The national pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* *In California: pay rate range is $205,000–$250,000* \#LI\-AC1

Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5\.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram. Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring. *Baker Tilly is an equal* *opportunity/affirmative* *action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.* *Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e\-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.* **Job Description:** ==================== Baker Tilly is seeking a **Sr** **Platform Engineer — Backend** to join the founding team of the firm's AI Product Group (APG), supporting the development and operation of shared platform services that power AI applications and intelligent agents across the organization. This hands\-on engineering role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, secure, and reliable backend services, APIs, runtime components, and integration capabilities that support both internally developed and third\-party AI solutions. The position plays a critical role in establishing foundational platform capabilities, including identity and access management, enterprise data connectivity, telemetry, and production infrastructure, while ensuring solutions are flexible, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise technology standards. As an early member of the AI Product Group, this individual will collaborate closely with platform leadership, enterprise architects, AI engineers, data platform teams, and globally distributed technical teams to develop production\-ready services that enable the firm's expanding AI ecosystem. The role emphasizes strong backend engineering fundamentals, hands\-on development, security, evaluation\-driven engineering, and end\-to\-end ownership of production systems. The ideal candidate brings demonstrated experience building and operating shared services, implementing authentication and authorization capabilities, and delivering reliable cloud\-based solutions. Prior experience with AI, large language models, or agentic systems is not required; success in this role depends on sound technical judgment, strong problem\-solving abilities, and the capacity to quickly learn and apply emerging technologies. **Responsibilities** * **Design and Build Shared Platform Services:** Develop, implement, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and runtime components that support AI agents, enterprise applications, and shared platform capabilities. * **Implement Identity and Access Management:** Build secure authentication, authorization, and entitlement capabilities for users, AI agents, delegated agent activities, and autonomous processes, ensuring appropriate access controls and accountability. * **Develop Secure Data Access and Integration Interfaces:** Build and maintain APIs, service interfaces, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoints that enable AI agents to securely discover, retrieve, and interact with governed enterprise data. * **Support Flexible and Scalable Platform Architecture:** Design reusable services and stable interfaces that enable the firm to integrate, evalu operating production services used by other engineering teams. * Required experience independently building, deploying, and operating shared backend services that other engineers or applications depend on in production, including ownership of the associated build and deployment pipelines. * Required hands\-on experience implementing authentication, authorization, or entitlement capabilities within production applications or services. * Deep proficiency in at least one mainstream programming language, such as Python, TypeScript, Go, or Java, with demonstrated understanding of language fundamentals, design patterns, and production\-quality development practices. * Ability to quickly learn and apply new programming languages, frameworks, and technologies; familiarity with Python and TypeScript preferred. * Strong experience with backend service development, RESTful APIs, service integration, secure application design, and distributed systems fundamentals. * Experience working with relational databases, such as PostgreSQL or comparable technologies, including data modeling, querying, and integration with backend services. * Hands\-on experience with containers, cloud infrastructure, automated build processes, and CI/CD pipelines supporting production applications. * Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, automated testing, debugging, code reviews, performance optimization, and development of reliable, maintainable services. * Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical solutions through measurable outcomes, including automated tests, benchmarks, experiments, performance metrics, or comparative evaluations. * Experience with event\-driven architectures, messaging systems, streaming technologies, or asynchronous processing preferred. * Familiarity with observability, monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing technologies, such as OpenTelemetry or comparable frameworks, preferred. * Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, and associated infrastructure, deployment, and security services preferred. * Additional experience with enterprise identity and access management, entitlement systems, or secure service\-to\-service communication preferred. * Familiarity with telemetry pipelines, operational data integration, or evaluation\-based release processes preferred. * Strong analytical thinking, technical judgment, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate architectural trade\-offs, prioritize practical solutions, and avoid unnecessary technical complexity. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical solutions, explain engineering decisions, and collaborate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver high\-quality solutions in a fast\-paced, evolving environment. * Ability to collaborate effectively with globally distributed engineering teams, external technology partners, and cross\-functional stakeholders. * Experience using AI\-assisted and agentic development tools to improve engineering productivity, or a strong willingness to incorporate these technologies into daily development practices. * Prior experience with AI, large language models, or agentic systems is not required; strong backend engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn emerging technologies are essential. * No professional certifications or licenses required. *The pay rate range for this job position are listed below. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.* *The national pay rate range is $150,000–$225,000* *In California: pay rate range is $150,000–$225,000* \#LI\-AC1

jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy\-grow\-and\-hold\-for\-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. **About 10x People:** At 10x People, we build cloud\-based numbering software that helps telecom carriers, MVNOs, and CPaaS providers order, port, and manage phone numbers. Founded in 2013 and based in Littleton, Colorado, we serve customers across the U.S. and Canada, and our platform is part of their daily operations. We joined Banyan in September 2026, giving us a permanent home and the resources to keep growing. **The Role:** We're looking for an engineer who enjoys both building infrastructure and securing it. You'll own key parts of our AWS and Kubernetes platform while leading our day\-to\-day security and compliance work, with roughly half of your time on security. It's a broad role with real ownership, suited to someone who likes variety and wants to shape how a growing company runs. You'll have a direct impact on how we build and ship. **Platform and DevOps** * **Kubernetes on AWS:** Build, operate, and improve our Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure on AWS. * **EKS Migrations:** Lead and execute workload migrations onto EKS. * **CI/CD with Security Built In:** Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines, building security checks directly into them. * **Automation:** Automate wherever you can. If you do something manually twice, script it. **Security and Compliance** * **SOC 2 Program:** Run our SOC 2 program in Vanta: tracking controls, closing gaps, and keeping us audit\-ready. * **Vulnerability Management:** Own vulnerability management. Triage container CVEs from ECR scans and SAST/DAST findings, then fix them yourself or route them to the right team through GitHub. * **Monitoring and Response:** Monitor and respond to AWS security alerts (GuardDuty, Security Hub) and externally reported issues. * **Access and Policy:** Manage internal access control and maintain policies for secure development and data handling. * **Design and Threat Modeling:** Join design reviews and threat modeling sessions with engineering. * **Security Awareness:** Coordinate penetration tests, run tabletop exercises, and help keep the org security\-aware. **Qualifications for success:** * 2\+ years of experience in DevOps, platform, SRE, or security engineering. * Hands\-on production experience with Kubernetes, preferred. * Solid working knowledge of AWS, including IAM, networking, and core services. * Experience planning and executing infrastructure migrations. * Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash, or similar) and Git\-based workflows. * Ability to work independently, prioritize well, and figure things out without a playbook. * **Based in or able to commute to Littleton, CO, with in\-office attendance on Tuesdays.** **Nice to have:** * Experience supporting a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audit, or using Vanta or a similar compliance platform. * Familiarity with AWS security services such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, and SCPs. * Infrastructure as code experience (Terraform, CDK, or similar). * Experience with SAST/DAST tools or GitHub Advanced Security. * Relevant certifications (CKA, AWS Security Specialty, etc.). **Compensation \& Posting Statement:** The expected base salary for this position is: **$80,000 \- $120,000 USD**. Salary is based on a number of factors including market conditions, location and may vary depending on job\-related skills and experience. Benefits include fully company\-paid medical for employees, a 401(k) with up to 4% company match, company\-paid life and disability coverage, a $1,200 annual wellness benefit, flexible time off, paid holidays, a paid winter break, and a monthly internet stipend. Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Equal Employment Opportunity at Banyan: Banyan affirms that inequality is detrimental to our Global Teams, associates, our Operating Companies, and the communities we serve. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. We support an inclusive workplace where associates excel based on personal merit, qualifications, experience, ability, and job performance. **Please Note**: Banyan Software does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications submitted via email, LinkedIn, or other direct channels. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed. ***Recruitment Notice*** Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation. ***Beware of Recruitment Scams*** We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. **Protect yourself by following these steps:** * Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an **@banyansoftware.com** email address. * Remember, employers will **never** request payment or banking information during the hiring process. * If you receive a suspicious message, **do not respond** — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it. Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer (BI)
jobs.description: **We Go Beyond:** At Bed Bath \& Beyond, we believe that everyone should “Be You!”. Bed Bath \& Beyond is a community that upholds a culture of understanding, acceptance, and respect. We believe a person’s individuality, traits, beliefs, and characteristics should be valued and embraced. Living by this ethos is essential to the success of our business. Our goal is to foster a more inclusive environment where every employee visibly demonstrates inclusive behaviors and respect for individuals. Job Duties: Collaborate with data engineering teams to onboard new data sources required for reporting and analytics. Collaborate with business leaders (including Finance, Marketing, Product) to translate ambiguous requirements into scalable data and reporting solutions. Serve as a subject matter expert for KPI definitions and ensure alignment across teams and reporting layers. Support the overall BI platform strategy, including performance optimization, scalability, and governance of MicroStrategy environments. Analyze business user needs and develop Business Intelligence (BI) reporting solutions, including development of reports and dashboards using MicroStrategy. Work with data scientists to design, develop and/or manipulate data to predict and measure outcome and consequences of design. Develop business intelligence application testing and validation procedures and provide proper documentation. Consult and provide support for customers about BI apps design and maintenance. Work with department managers and executives to identify needs and software requirements to determine feasibility of design within time and cost constraints. Develop, create, and modify general BI applications software or specialized utility programs. Design BI applications for client use with the aim of optimizing operational efficiency. Modify existing MicroStrategy reports and dashboards to correct errors, adapt to system changes, or improve performance. Analyze user requirements and based on findings, design and develop graphs, charts, dashboards and other BI solutions. Apply logical data modeling concepts (e.g., star schema, 3NF, dimensional modeling) to support reporting solutions within existing data warehouse structures. Design and deliver end\-user training and training materials; provide technical support as necessary. Telecommuting: This position is 100% remote; must reside in U.S.; and reports to HQ in Murray, UT. Salary: $116,917 \- $150,000 per year Minimum Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or U.S. equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field, plus 4 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst or in any occupation, job title, or position working with relational databases, developing complex SQL queries, and developing reports and dashboards using MicroStrategy in an enterprise reporting environment. Must also have the following experience: 4 years of professional experience developing reports and dashboards using MicroStrategy, including creation of metrics, filters, and dashboards; 4 years of professional experience designing and implementing logical data models within MicroStrategy, including creation of attributes, hierarchies, facts, and schema objects to support reporting requirements; 4 years of professional experience developing and optimizing complex SQL queries in relational databases, utilizing advanced constructs including window functions, common table expressions (CTEs), multi\-table joins, aggregations, and subqueries to support BI and reporting workloads; 4 years of professional experience performing data validation and reconciliation to ensure accuracy of reports, including identifying and resolving discrepancies between source systems and reporting outputs; 3 years of professional experience working with cloud\-based data platforms (including GCP, AWS, or Azure) including querying large datasets and supporting BI and reporting workloads; and 2 years of professional experience working with relational data models and data warehouse environments (including Big Query or Snowflake) with understanding of fact and dimension structures, and partitioned tables to support reporting and analytics use cases. How to Apply: Apply at www.beyond.com/corporate/careers or via email at beyond@careers.com. Please specify ad code HYMJ. **Physical Requirements:** -------------------------- This position requires you to sit, stand and perform general office functions. You may also be required to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally. Bending, stooping and reaching are also frequently required. **Equal Employment Opportunity:** --------------------------------- It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and associates. This policy includes our commitment to ensure that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, disability, pregnancy, veteran status (including Vietnam era veterans), age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other non\-job\-related characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (AI Products)
jobs.description: **About BizzyCar** BizzyCar is a B2B SaaS company transforming the automotive care experience for consumers, dealerships, and manufacturers. Our mission is to simplify car repairs, enabling consumers to resolve issues like recalls without leaving home or work. Through our automated platform, we streamline the process from manufacturers to dealers to customers, significantly reducing notification times and making repair scheduling seamless. Dealers benefit from increased repair revenue and strengthened customer relationships, while OEMs avoid costly fines. We are solving a $22B industry challenge, with over 70 million cars on the road having unresolved recalls. BizzyCar is a fast\-paced, results\-driven company with an experienced leadership team skilled in building high\-value businesses. Employees enjoy competitive pay, equity opportunities, and medical benefits. While we’re a dispersed team, we prioritize collaboration and meet quarterly to maintain our strong culture. **About the role** As BizzyCar’s founding Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer (FDSE), you will help our customers implement, adopt, and maximize our most cutting edge solutions. We're hiring a curious professional to own product launches on the ground: configuring the product to each dealership's systems and operations, training their staff, and being the calm, credible presence in the building when a brand\-new AI product starts automating processes at the dealership. In this role, you will be assigned to and become a subject matter expert on a specific product being rolled out to dealerships. Your training will make you comfortable with the automotive retail industry, customer processes, BizzyCar, frontier AI technology, application layer AI technology. You will be expected to use your knowledge and skills to make your implemented solutions maximally impactful to our customers and achieve loyalty from customers through delight. This is a net\-new, customer\-facing field role which is slated to expand and re\-invent how BizzyCar goes to market which means you will have a hand in shaping the playbook everyone after you follows. **(\*Please Note: This role is Hybrid requiring being in office a few days a month as well as 50\-70% travel to client dealerships.)** **What you'll do*** Own dealer implementations end\-to\-end — from kickoff through go\-live and early hypercare * Configure solutions to each rooftop: translate a dealer's actual service\-drive workflow and tech stack into product configuration through structured discovery and engineering team collaboration * Validate that customer, availability, recall, and RO data flow correctly across systems before go\-live * Train non\-technical dealership staff to full adoption, and manage the change along the way * Run the implementation like a project — own the timeline, the stakeholders, and the go\-live date * Troubleshoot live: reproduce issues, read logs, tell a configuration problem from a product bug, and write clean repro steps * Know what to fix yourself versus what to escalate, and package escalations cleanly for engineering * Write the runbooks and SOPs that let this be repeatable — for the next dealer, and for the support team that eventually takes over steady\-state * Be the feedback loop — route what you learn on\-site back to product, reliably and specifically **What You'll Need****Required*** **Hands\-on integration \& configuration experience** — you've wired a product to external systems via APIs, webhooks, or config tools and validated it end\-to\-end * Troubleshooting \& log diagnosis — comfortable reproducing issues, reading logs, and isolating a config problem from a product bug * Experience delivering customer training or enablement, ideally to non\-technical audiences * Implementation or deployment project management — you've run a kickoff\-to\-go\-live timeline and owned the stakeholders in it * Comfort validating and verifying data across systems (e.g., confirming records, statuses, or availability sync correctly) **Preferred** * Discovery and workflow\-mapping experience — translating a customer's process into product configuration * Issue triage and escalation experience in a customer\-facing technical role * Light scripting or SQL — enough to query data or script a quick validation (a plus, not a requirement) * Experience writing runbooks, SOPs, or setup documentation for handoff to a support team **Helpful Background** *You don't need deep expertise in all of these on day one, but familiarity with several will help you ramp fast:* * SaaS implementation and deployment methodology — onboarding lifecycle, go\-live, hypercare * APIs and integration patterns — REST, webhooks, authentication, and how systems talk to each other * Automotive retail or fixed\-ops experience — the service drive, repair orders, recalls, and the dealership's daily rhythm * The DMS and scheduling ecosystem — e.g., CDK, Reynolds, Tekion, Xtime, myKaarma * Data structure and validation concepts * Support and escalation processes — tiers, SLAs, and clean handoffs * Change management or adoption principles * Security and compliance basics — PII handling, call\-recording consent **Who You Are*** **Ownership** — you see things through to go\-live, not just to the end of your task list * Bias to action and resourcefulness — you unblock yourself on\-site instead of waiting on someone else * Learning agility — you can ramp fast on a product that's still being built and changing under you * Adaptability — you're comfortable with ambiguity; this is an early product, there's no playbook yet, and things will break * Structured and detail\-oriented — implementations are checklists, and a missed step can cause a go\-live to fail * A calm troubleshooting temperament — you can debug live in front of a customer without losing the room * Empathetic change management — you can move skeptical service staff toward trusting an AI to take their calls * Feedback\-loop discipline — you reliably route what you learn in the field back to product * Low\-ego collaboration — you work easily across engineering, support, GTM, and our partner team **Benefits*** **Competitive base salary** $80,000\-$110,000 plus commission renewals and expansion revenue (OTE $150,000\) * **Comprehensive health benefits** — medical, dental, and vision coverage * **401(k) plan** and equity * **Paid time off**, including vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays * **Career growth opportunities** within a growing Sales and Customer Success organization * **Ongoing training and development**, including access to sales enablement tools and enterprise account strategy resources * **Supportive, collaborative team culture** with cross\-functional partnerships *BizzyCar, Inc. does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in the provision of employment opportunities and benefits.* *At this time, the company does not provide sponsorship for U.S. visas or immigration benefits, and does not provide financial, legal, or administrative support for employment\-based U.S. immigration benefits. In compliance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, all employees must complete Form I\-9 and present unexpired documents showing they are legally authorized to work for any employer in the United States.*

One year of experience as an active SCCM and/or Intune administrator including automating software installs \& mobile device management along with Active Directory, Azure and Microsoft 365 cloud experience. **Position Summary:** Working with members of the Endpoint team, the Endpoint Systems Engineer will assist in the configuration, maintenance, application packaging and management of enterprise devices via Microsoft Intune, following industry best practices. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview:** Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients. BlinkRx is the world's first pharma\-to\-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world\-class support on this first\-of\-its\-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can't afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn't have the medication in stock. We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us! **The Opportunity:** BlinkRx is opening its first Bay Area engineering office, and we are building the founding team now. This is not a lateral move into an established org. This is a chance to be one of the engineers who was there at the beginning, setting technical standards, shaping how AI gets embedded into an engineering culture from day one, and writing code that ships to production fast and reaches real patients immediately. We are looking for Full Stack Engineers who build with AI as a way of working, not as a feature. Engineers who experiment relentlessly, integrate it into everything they touch, and are done waiting for permission to do their best work. The founding team sets the culture and the trajectory. That opportunity does not come around often, and it is rarer still when the company is already proven at scale. **Responsibilities:** * Lead architecture and execution for complex features or systems across multiple teams or domains, with an emphasis on AI\-integrated solutions. * Design and evolve backend and frontend architecture for scalable, high\-performance systems. * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code and lead code reviews that raise the bar for the entire team. * Actively integrate AI tooling into your development workflow and help establish that standard across the engineering organization. * Investigate and resolve complex performance and reliability issues end\-to\-end. * Drive the release of new features with testing, documentation, and monitoring from day one. * Partner cross\-functionally with product, design, data, and operations to shape roadmaps and accelerate impact. * Rapidly prototype, test, and iterate with a learning mindset and a bias for action. * Communicate complex technical topics clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences alike. **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with increasing scope and impact. * Proven experience owning significant systems or product areas from design through launch. * Strong expertise in at least one modern language such as Python, JavaScript, or Go. * Active, hands\-on use of AI tools as a core part of your engineering workflow. * Experience in distributed systems, API design, and performance optimization. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience. **Why Join Us:** It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross\-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Applicants who provide their phone number and consent to receive text messages may receive SMS or MMS updates from Blink Health regarding their application.
