jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Governance & Management Platforms
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ Bloomberg runs on data. Within the Data Management \& Analytics Engineering department, the Data Services team builds platforms, services, and data products that help the firm understand, govern, protect, improve, and use data at scale. Data Services spans Data Governance Services, Data Integrity Services, Common Data Products, and Usage Data Products. The team's capabilities include data discovery, cataloging, classification, lineage, data quality, observability, reference and enrichment services, master data, common data, and usage data with cross\-cutting responsibilities across stewardship, metadata, semantics, privacy, controls, and architecture standards. **Role Overview** ----------------- We are seeking a high\-caliber Staff Software Engineer to serve as a technical lead and architect for our future\-state Data Services platform. This role requires an engineer who possesses strong core computer science fundamentals—excelling in algorithmic problem\-solving, hands\-on coding, and system design—while bringing deep domain experience in data governance and data management. In this role, you will bridge domain\-specific data management requirements (cataloging, lineage, quality, observability, control frameworks) and high\-performance software engineering patterns. You will operate with Tech Lead / Staff\-level scope: driving architecture, setting standards, building prototypes, and guiding engineering teams across the department. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Drive Technical Leadership \& Architecture:** Define future\-state architecture patterns and engineering standards for metadata capture, lineage, data quality, observability, data contracts, and semantic modeling. * **Translate Data Concepts to Scalable Code:** Transform data governance and data management capabilities into production\-ready software patterns, reusable APIs, metadata flows, and platform workflows. * **Hands\-On Development \& Prototyping:** Actively write clean, optimized code, construct prototypes, bootstrap critical modules, and validate technical implementations to de\-risk complex platform updates. * **Unify Data Services Capabilities:** Partner across Data Governance Services, Data Integrity Services, Common Data Products, and Usage Data Products to connect disparate services into a seamless, cohesive platform. * **Provide Cross\-Team Technical Enablement:** Collaborate closely with engineering leads, product managers, data stewards, and data engineers to reduce duplication, enforce standards, and elevate engineering quality. * **Evaluate \& Innovate:** Stay current with modern enterprise data management tooling and industry trends; evaluate build vs. buy choices and import proven patterns from mature data organizations. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * **Strong Software Engineering Fundamentals:** Deep proficiency in software architecture, and problem\-solving, with proven hands\-on coding capabilities in languages such as Python, C\+\+, Java, Scala, or Go. * **7\+ Years of Industry Experience:** Track record in software engineering, data management, data governance, metadata platforms, or enterprise data architecture. * **Data Governance \& Management Mastery:** Comprehensive understanding of core data governance concepts including data cataloging, metadata management, lineage tracking, data quality frameworks, observability, stewardship, and semantic layers. * **Platform \& System Design Expertise:** Demonstrated success architecting distributed systems, data pipelines, metadata integration workflows, and API\-driven data platforms. * **Hands\-On Experience with Data Tools:** Exposure to or experience implementing mature enterprise data platforms (e.g., DataHub, OpenMetadata, Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Purview) or custom internal equivalents. * **Technical Influence \& Communication:** Proven ability to lead architectural discussions, communicate complex technical topics to diverse stakeholders, and mentor engineering teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * **Semantic Technologies \& Knowledge Graphs:** Experience with semantic technologies, knowledge graphs, ontologies, and master/reference data management. * **AI/ML Integration:** Familiarity with AI/ML\-driven data governance automation (e.g., automated data classification, anomaly detection, metadata enrichment, automated lineage inference). * **Leadership Track Record:** Background serving as a Manager, Tech Lead, Platform Architect, or Principal SME in an enterprise\-scale data ecosystem. jobs.title: Network Engineer I Provisioning
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE COMPANY:** Bluebird Fiber is a premier fiber telecommunications provider of internet, data transport, and other services to carriers, businesses, schools, hospitals, and other enterprises in the Midwest. To learn more, please visit bluebirdfiber.com. Join an amazing team of telecommunication professionals! Bluebird is a dynamic growing company in need of a Network Engineer I to be a part of a collaborative team. This is a full\-time, benefit eligible position. All of us at Bluebird work hard to meet objectives for the organization and live the mission and values of this growing company to meet a common goal. Check out this video that highlights our amazing company culture. The Provisioning Engineer is responsible for inside plant engineering of Point of Presence (POP) and Collocation sites in addition to managing engineering projects and providing technical support providing advanced knowledge as it pertains to design, configuration, prioritization, implementation, and documentation of Bluebird’s IP/MPLS Network. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About CANImmunize:** CANImmunize is a Canadian\-owned technology company with over a decade of experience building best\-in\-class digital health solutions for public health. As a fully remote company, we embrace flexibility while staying closely connected across Canada. Our platforms help make immunization programs more efficient, effective, and accessible across Canada. We’re a small but mighty team that values curiosity, accountability, and kindness. Collaborative and innovative by nature, we thrive in a fast\-moving environment and take pride in the real\-world impact of our work. **The Opportunity:** We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our growing Engineering team. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you'll help build and improve the software that public health teams across Canada rely on every day. This opportunity is particularly well\-suited to someone early in their software development career, including recent graduates or developers with approximately zero to three years of professional experience. We're looking for someone with a strong technical foundation, a willingness to learn, and the curiosity to grow into a well\-rounded engineer. You'll write real code that ships to real users, with support from experienced engineers who will help you develop your skills through code reviews, pairing sessions, and day\-to\-day mentorship. **As part of the team, you’ll:** * Build and maintain features and fixes across the front end and back end. * Learn our engineering standards and best practices, and put them into practice. * Work alongside product managers, designers, and engineers to understand what we’re building and why. * Grow quickly with support from a team that genuinely invests in your development. This is a great opportunity for someone who loves solving problems, is eager to develop their skills, and wants their work to make a real difference in public health. **Key Responsibilities::** * Build \& Ship: Develop, test, and maintain well\-scoped features and bug fixes, with attention to quality, security, and reliability. * Learn the Craft: Implement solutions following the design and architectural direction set by senior engineers, and ask questions early when something is unclear. * Code Quality: Write and maintain automated tests, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end (E2E) tests. Participate in code reviews and help identify issues before release. * Collaboration: Work from well\-defined tickets, keep your work visible, and communicate proactively when you hit blockers. * Production Support: Help investigate support tickets and resolve issues with guidance from senior teammates. Shadow on\-call, building toward joining the rotation over time. * Growth: Actively seek out and apply feedback from code reviews, pairing, and mentorship to keep levelling up. * Participate in on\-call rotations to support system availability and incident response. * Other duties as required. **What You Need to Succeed::** * A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience such as co\-op, internships, a bootcamp, or substantial personal projects. * Foundational skills in TypeScript, with hands\-on experience in React and Node.js. * A basic understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and API development. * Familiarity with Git and collaborative workflows: branches, pull requests, and code reviews. * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Clear communication skills, including being comfortable asking questions and explaining your thinking in a remote\-first environment. * A growth mindset and openness to feedback. **Nice to Have:** * Exposure to React Native or mobile development. * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS preferred), CI/CD, or containerization tools like Docker. * Experience on an agile/scrum team through co\-op, internships, or school projects. * An interest in healthcare technology or public health. **What’s in it for You?:** * Competitive compensation: a strong salary, comprehensive health and dental benefits, and a profit\-sharing program so you share in our success. * Generous time off: 3 weeks paid vacation, plus 3 extra CANI Days to recharge, and a paid winter shutdown in December. * Growth that matters: a professional development budget, in\-house coaching, and mentorship to help you level up your career. * Work anywhere in Canada: we’re a fully remote team, and we’ll equip you with the tools and tech you need to do your best work. * Culture that energizes: join a high\-performing, fast\-moving team that values curiosity, kindness, and accountability. * Impact that lasts: your work will directly contribute to making healthcare more effective, accessible, and people\-focused across Canada. **Compensation:** At CANImmunize, we’re committed to paying fairly, transparently, and for growth. This role has an annual base salary range of $70,000 to $155,000\. While the broader salary band accommodates engineers at varying stages of their careers, this particular opportunity is intended for someone early in their development career, and we anticipate compensation will align with that level of experience. Where you land within the range will depend on your skills, experience, and the contributions you bring to the team. We support continued growth through regular career development conversations and performance\-based compensation reviews. **Be Yourself at Work:** At CANImmunize, we know that diverse teams build better solutions. No matter who you are or where you come from, you’ll be valued, supported, and respected as part of our community. We’re committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone can thrive. If you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process, just let us know. We’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We can’t wait to meet you. Come help us build the future of digital health in Canada! **Please Note:** At this time, this position is only available to applicants located in Canada. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Operations Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** We’re looking for an experienced Infrastructure Operations Engineer to help keep CFC’s global infrastructure reliable, secure and resilient. With a particular focus on Microsoft Azure, you’ll use your infrastructure support experience to operate and improve our cloud and hybrid services across compute, storage and networking. You’ll take ownership of complex technical issues, help reduce operational risk and make sure the services our teams rely on are performing at their best. This is a hands\-on role where you’ll have the opportunity to solve challenging problems and make improvements that stick. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Technology, Information Security and engineering, bringing your expertise while continuing to build your own. At CFC, we trust people to take ownership, welcome ideas from every level and encourage people to make things better, making this a great environment for someone who enjoys combining technical depth with initiative### **About the role** * Manage and support our Microsoft Azure infrastructure across compute, storage, networking, monitoring and identity integrations. * Take ownership of infrastructure incidents, problems and service requests across cloud and hybrid environments, seeing them through to resolution. * Monitor availability, capacity, performance and security, spotting potential risks early and implementing sustainable improvements. * Deliver infrastructure changes, upgrades, patching and lifecycle activities in line with change management and operational controls. * Troubleshoot complex technical issues across Azure, Windows Server, storage, backup, DNS, routing, VPNs and firewalls. * Support backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements, helping ensure critical services are recoverable and regularly validated. * Partner with Technology, Information Security and engineering colleagues to automate, standardise and document secure, scalable infrastructure services. * Provide desktop support to the Austin team during planned holidays and periods of sickness. ### **About you** You’ll bring substantial hands\-on experience in infrastructure operations, systems administration or infrastructure engineering within a complex organisation, alongside experience supporting business\-critical services. You’ll be confident working across Azure and hybrid environments and comfortable taking ownership when high\-impact infrastructure incidents arise. Technically, you’ll bring:* Strong Microsoft Azure knowledge across virtual machines, storage, virtual networking, monitoring and Entra ID integrations. * Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, enterprise storage and backup. * A solid grounding in networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls and routing. * Working knowledge of infrastructure security, access management, audit evidence, change control and incident management. * A disciplined approach to risk, documentation and operational controls, with the judgement to escalate when needed. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously, prioritise competing demands and communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Experience with **PowerShell or infrastructure automation would be a bonus**, rather than essential. ### **About CFC**

You will design the control plane, the transfer worker fleet and the integration with Crusoe's storage and network, and set the path for adding other clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers. compiled language (Go strongly preferred). * **Communication:** You can explain an architectural decision to an engineer, a PM and an EM, and you know which parts matter to each. **Bonus Points** * For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. You will move beyond basic prompt drafting to build robust, scalable, and reliable AI systems utilizing state\-of\-the\-art Large Language Models (LLMs). Your role is critical in orchestrating autonomous AI agents, implementing **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** pipelines, and establishing **rigorous testing and observability frameworks**. You will bridge the gap between complex business logic and machine intelligence, ensuring high\-quality, safe, and deterministic AI behaviors. **What You Will Do:** **Prompt Architecture \& Tuning** * Few\-Shot learning). * **Mitigate Risks:** Minimize model hallucinations, jailbreaking, and prompt injections through programmatic guardrails and robust adversarial prompting strategies. * **Model Agnostic Tuning:** Adapt, benchmark, and fine\-tune prompt structures across diverse open\-source and proprietary frontier models. **Agentic Workflows \& RAG Systems** * **Build AI Agents:** Design and orchestrate multi\-agent systems and multi\-step reasoning workflows using frameworks like LangGraph, LangChain. * **Optimize RAG Pipelines:** Integrate and fine\-tune Retrieval\-Augmented Generation architectures, managing semantic search, chunking strategies, embedding models, and vector database queries. * **Tool Execution:** Implement precise function\-calling and tool\-use prompts to assess RAG accuracy and enable continuous validation and benchmarking of Retrieval‑Augmented Generation outputs across datasets and Models . * **Agent Testing:** Build automated regression testing suites and CI/CD pipelines to validate prompt stability, agent trajectory correctness, and tool\-calling accuracy. * **Implement LLM Observability:** Set up production monitoring and observability systems using platforms like Azure Application insights, Microsoft Foundry. * **Monitor Metrics:** Track, analyze, and optimize production runtime metrics including semantic drift, token usage, cost efficiencies, and end\-to\-end latency. **Collaboration \& Continuous Innovation** * **Cross\-Functional Delivery:** Work alongside Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Software Engineers to Systems:** Knowledge of deep learning architectures, fine\-tuning frameworks (QLoRA, PEFT), and platforms like Hugging Face, PyTorch, or TensorFlow. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Experience deploying jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer, Agentic Automation
jobs.description: **About Cerby** At **Cerby**, security is everyone's business. Cerby extends your security perimeter to include your disconnected applications, providing identity automation and eliminating manual processes. It's one of the biggest blind spots in enterprise security, and we're the team closing it. If you want to work alongside the team solving one of the hardest, most overlooked problems in security, you're in the right place. Founded in 2020, Cerby is backed by leading investors and trusted by enterprises across the globe. **OVERVIEW \& IMPACT** Every application Cerby protects needs Cerby to know how it works — its API, or the clicks behind its login, password rotation, MFA setup, or access change — and that knowledge breaks whenever a vendor redesigns its site or changes its API. We are looking for a Staff AI Engineer to own the AI agents that onboard new applications and repair automations when they drift. You will start with two agent systems we have already built and benchmarked: **API catalog generation:** reads a vendor’s public API docs in a headless browser and produces a validated OpenAPI spec, with per\-job cost ceilings and an accuracy benchmark. **Browser workflow generation:** performs a task in a SaaS app’s web UI and writes a replayable automation workflow, handling MFA, one\-time codes, and CAPTCHAs along the way. Your job is to take them to production, make them self\-healing, and set the direction for agentic automation at Cerby. These agents handle real customer credentials and browse untrusted sites, so security is part of the job, not an afterthought. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** ### **Ownership and Production** * Own agentic onboarding and self\-healing end to end: architecture, roadmap, and on\-call once live. * Take the existing systems to production on durable workflows (Temporal), with the observability to run them. ### **Self\-Healing Automation** * Detect drift — a changed login page, a moved button, a renamed API field — from failed runs, before customers notice. * Build agents that diagnose the break, repair the workflow or spec, and re\-validate the fix against real runs before it goes back into service. * Decide what heals automatically and what needs human review. ### **Evaluation and Cost** * Own the benchmarks for generated specs, workflows, and repairs, and make “good enough to ship” a measured threshold. * Own cost and latency per output, choosing between frontier and open\-weight models on measured accuracy versus cost. ### **Security** * Own the threat model: prompt injection from page content, credential isolation, token handling, sandboxed browsing, and egress. * Keep credentials out of prompts, logs, queues, and stored run state. ### **Collaboration** * Partner with the integrations, automation\-runtime, and platform teams; write the design docs they build on, and mentor contributors. **QUALIFICATIONS \& REQUIRED SKILLS** ===================================== ### **Experience** * You have shipped an LLM agent with tool use that ran unattended for real users, and owned a backend system in production. ### **Technical Skills** * Strong in **Python or TypeScript**, and productive in both. * **LLM agents and tool use**: agent loops, structured outputs, retries, and the failure modes they create. * **Eval discipline**: you have built benchmarks or eval harnesses and used them to make decisions. * Depth in **browser automation** (Playwright or similar) **or** **backend and API\-integration systems**, and comfort in the other. * **Distributed systems**: queues, idempotency, and durable workflow engines (Temporal, Step Functions, or similar). * **Security judgment** for systems that handle secrets, including agent\-specific threats such as prompt injection. ### **Desirable** * Temporal in production; Pydantic AI or a comparable agent framework. * Open\-weight model serving (Fireworks, Together, Bedrock) and LLM cost modeling. * Computer\-use agents or browser extensions (Chrome MV3\); OpenAPI tooling. * Identity, IAM, or credential\-management experience; jobs.title: Platform Engineering Manager, AI Submission Ingestion
jobs.description: As the Technical Platform Lead for our AI Submission Ingestion Platform, you will define and drive the end\-to\-end technical vision for how commercial insurance submissions move from inbox to underwriting decision. This role requires deep engineering expertise, with responsibility for shaping the platform’s technical direction, data flows, integration patterns, AI capabilities, and release readiness in close partnership with engineering, architecture, data science, and governance teams. You will own the technical roadmap for your area within the broader platform strategy, making informed trade\-offs across scalability, reliability, data quality, model performance, and delivery sequencing. Rather than acting as a traditional product manager, you will operate as a technical leader who can translate business needs into platform capabilities, challenge design decisions, establish technical standards, and ensure the solution is built for long\-term reuse, resilience, and operational excellence. In the US, you will partner closely with underwriting, operations, and regional business leaders to understand workflow needs and convert them into technical requirements that engineering squads can execute. You will also work with peer leaders in the US and India, along with business\-unit and regional technology teams, global platform engineering squads, architecture, data science, and risk and governance teams, to ensure the platform is designed and delivered with both business outcomes and technical integrity in mind. This is a high\-impact role for a technical leader who has built and scaled platforms, understands AI/ML system design, and can establish a clear end\-to\-end vision for a platform that reduces manual work, improves decision quality, and creates durable capabilities the business can trust. **In this role, you will:** * Lead technical discovery with underwriters, operations leaders, and business partners to assess submission intake needs, platform readiness, and technical feasibility * Define the end\-to\-end technical vision and roadmap for your platform area, including architecture, data flows, integrations, AI evaluation, and operational readiness * Make technical trade\-offs across performance, scalability, maintainability, data quality, and delivery sequencing, and clearly explain recommendations to engineering and business stakeholders * Translate business needs into technical requirements, non\-functional requirements, acceptance criteria, and release gates * Establish platform standards for APIs, event flows, data contracts, observability, and integration patterns * Define and track outcome measures such as straight\-through processing rate, manual\-review volume, time to onboard a product, turnaround time, model precision/recall, and operational defect rates * Set the AI quality bar, including confidence thresholds, human\-review rules, drift monitoring, and evaluation criteria required for release * Convert one\-off line\-of\-business requests into reusable, configurable platform capabilities * Coordinate rollout across regions and ensure North America requirements are represented in platform decisions * Validate key functionality in UAT and production, prioritize regression scope by business and technical risk, and ensure readiness for production support * Partner with risk, governance, privacy, continuity, and disaster\-recovery teams to ensure the platform meets enterprise controls * Communicate release impacts, technical decisions, and business value clearly to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders * 7\+ years of experience in engineering, technical product, platform, or architecture roles, including experience leading complex platform or AI\-enabled solutions * Strong background in software engineering, platform architecture, or technical delivery, with demonstrated ability to shape end\-to\-end technical solutions * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience * Proven ability to define technical strategy, influence senior stakeholders, and make sound trade\-offs using data and engineering judgment * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML\-enabled products, including evaluation design, confidence thresholds, drift, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Strong fluency across APIs, event\-driven architectures, data models, and integration patterns * Ability to analyze data independently using SQL or similar tools * Experience working with cloud platforms, especially Azure, plus workflow orchestration and event streaming * Clear, concise writing that can move decisions for both engineers and executives * Commercial P\&C insurance experience is a plus, including submission intake, clearance, underwriting workbenches, rating, or policy administration * Experience with intelligent document processing, extraction platforms, ontologies, knowledge graphs, or canonical data models is a plus * Prior hands\-on experience as an engineer, architect, or data scientist is strongly preferred Agile delivery experience in a regulated enterprise is a plus * The pay range for the role is $150,000 to $205,000\. jobs.title: AI Engineer, Commercial
jobs.description: A collective energy and ambition. A place where you can make a real difference. We’re a company that genuinely cares about our people, our products, our consumers and the environment. Our unique, informal culture champions courage, determination and collaboration. Knowing we have an open and supportive team means each of us has the freedom to take responsibility and ownership. We have a shared passion to work hard, innovate and push boundaries. United by the belief that when we strive for growth, anything is possible. While we might not be the largest company in our industry, we believe we can have the biggest impact because: Together We Have the Power to Win. **Job Summary** =============== Church \& Dwight is seeking an AI Engineer to join our Commercial Agentic Pod team, which is responsible for designing, building, deploying, and scaling AI\-powered products that transform how Commercial teams make decisions and operate. The AI Engineer, Commercial will specialize in large language models and generative AI, with primary accountability for building reliable retrieval\-augmented generation systems, agentic workflows, orchestration, and production integrations. **About the Role** ================== The AI Engineer, Commercial will translate Commercial business requirements into secure, scalable AI products that combine enterprise knowledge, approved data, machine learning models, tools, and human oversight. The AI Engineer builds the technical foundations that enable agents and generative AI applications to operate reliably in the enterprise. Working closely with Commercial stakeholders, AI Champions, Data Scientists, GTA partners, enterprise architecture, security, data engineering, and platform teams, this role contributes from prototype through deployment, monitoring, adoption, and continuous improvement. Success in this role will be measured by solution quality, accuracy, reliability, security, maintainability, user adoption, business impact, cost and latency performance, and delivery of reusable generative AI capabilities. The role sits within the Global Commercial Analytics \& AI organization, reporting to the Lead, Commercial Analytics \& AI**.** **Work Environment** ==================== Hybrid: This is a hybrid role based in Ewing, NJ, and requires in\- person attendance on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays, with remote work options on Mondays and Fridays. **Role Accountabilities and Responsibilities** ============================================== * Translate Commercial business needs into secure, scalable AI products combining approved enterprise knowledge, structured and unstructured data, models, tools, permissions, and human oversight. * Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain LLM and generative AI applications, agentic workflows, and orchestration patterns covering planning, routing, tool use, memory, handoffs, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Build and optimize RAG systems using vector databases, embeddings, chunking, indexing, metadata, hybrid search, reranking, grounding, and source attribution; create traceable ingestion and refresh processes. * Engineer reusable production prompts and integrations for generative AI APIs, enterprise services, applications, analytical models, workflow tools, and knowledge repositories. * Develop automated and human evaluations for accuracy, groundedness, safety, relevance, task completion, latency, cost, and usability; monitor quality, adoption, incidents, and business outcomes. * Identify hallucination, prompt injection, tool, retrieval, and operational risks; implement guardrails, fallbacks, authentication, authorization, logging, secrets management, and data controls. * Apply strong software engineering practices, including modular design, source control, code review, automated testing, documentation, release management, observability, and production support. * Partner with Commercial stakeholders, Data Science, GTA, architecture, data engineering, platform, security, privacy, and governance teams from discovery and prototyping through deployment, training, adoption, and continuous improvement. * Ensure compliance with enterprise architecture, privacy, security, legal, compliance, data governance, and responsible AI standards; document architecture, controls, dependencies, procedures, limitations, and intended use. **Education and Experience** ============================ **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline required. * 3\+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, AI engineering, data engineering, or a related discipline required. * Hands\-on experience building LLM and generative AI applications, including production prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, model selection, APIs, evaluation, testing, monitoring, and optimization. * Experience building enterprise RAG solutions with vector databases, embeddings, retrieval pipelines, knowledge sources, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and source attribution. * Experience with agent frameworks, workflow orchestration, routing, handoffs, memory patterns, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Proficiency in Python, REST APIs and SDKs, cloud AI services, source control, automated testing, authentication, and authorization. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline preferred. * Experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications, data platforms, security controls, and governed knowledge repositories. * Experience in Consumer Packaged Goods R\&D, Quality, and/or Regulatory environments. * Strong systems thinking, business acumen, product mindset, prioritization, problem\-solving, data\-driven storytelling, collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and ability to influence without authority in ambiguous environments. **Skills and Competencies** =========================== * Action\-oriented, data\-driven problem solver focused on measurable outcomes. * Strategic systems thinker with strong technical, business, and product acumen. * Collaborative, curious, and accountable; effective in ambiguity and influencing without authority. **Technical Skills** * Generative AI: LLMs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, tool calling, model optimization. * RAG \& Agents: Embeddings, vector databases, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, orchestration, memory, human oversight. * Engineering: Python, APIs, SDKs, cloud AI, authentication, source control, automated testing. * AI Operations: Evaluation, observability, safety, failure analysis, monitoring, latency and cost optimization. * Governance: Responsible AI, privacy, security, data governance, access controls, documentation, auditability. **Compensation and Benefits** ============================= The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is $71,000– $101,100\. This position is also eligible for a bonus. As a Church \& Dwight US employee, you (and eligible dependents, as applicable) will have access to medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid vacation and sick time, and Paid Parental Leave. U.S. employees are entitled to paid holidays, floating holidays, and vacation days starting in their first year of employment depending on hire date. You are also able to participate in our 401k retirement plan (with company match and profit\-sharing) and Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The actual base pay offered to the successful candidate will be based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, job\-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal pay parity. Compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate. \#LI\-Hybrid Church \& Dwight is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities. For more information on our company, our brands and our culture visit us at http://www.churchdwight.com/

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.description: **About Circleback** -------------------- Circleback is building the source of truth for everything said at a company–starting with best\-in\-class AI meeting notes, action items, and search. Every company runs on conversations — meetings, calls, emails — but almost none of that context is usable after the fact. We’re building the platform that captures, organizes, and acts on all of it, so teams can actually use what they know. We're a small team backed by Y Combinator. Profitable, growing virally, and thousands of paying customers including PostHog, Browserbase, Gumloop, and more. **Why join** ------------ * We ship fast with a high bar for quality. * Small team, large problem: the category we're building didn't exist a few years ago. * Profitable and growing virally through word of mouth, not paid acquisition. * Build software people actually love and use every day. * Free lunch and dinners, competitive salary and equity. * Flexible health coverage and 401K matching. **The Role** ------------ Circleback grows through the product itself. People get notes from a meeting with someone already using it, like what they see, and try it. Then it spreads inside their company. You'll be our first growth hire. You'll own growth engineering from day one, decide what we build and test, and have plenty of room to grow your scope as the company grows. You'll focus on what happens inside the product, working closely with the founders and our Founding Marketer, who owns channels and brand. You'll ship across the stack as part of a small team. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Improve every step of the product\-led loop: the notes a non\-user receives after a meeting, signup, onboarding, and activation. * Figure out why Circleback spreads to the whole team at some companies and stays with a few people at others, and build the product changes that close that gap. * Build and maintain our analytics and experimentation foundation: event instrumentation, attribution, dashboards, and A/B tests the whole team trusts. * Improve retention by learning what keeps people using Circleback long term and getting more people there. * Ship in\-product growth surfaces like upgrade flows, referral tools, and integrations. You'll work in web (React, Next.js, Prisma, SWR), desktop (Electron, Swift), and mobile (React Native). * Work with the Founding Marketer on what to test, and share what you learn. **You might be a good fit if** ------------------------------ * You've shipped production software, including growth experiments, and you've instrumented a funnel yourself (signup conversion, activation, or retention). * You're comfortable digging into data yourself, whether that's writing queries or reading a funnel, and you're as happy doing that as shipping a feature. * You care about users as much as implementation. * You have strong product judgment and care about experiments that move signup, activation, or retention. * You're low ego, direct, and comfortable operating without much process. People who've thrived here have often been former founders, early startup engineers, or engineers who've owned features end\-to\-end. You don't need that exact background. We care much more about how you think and what you've built. **Interview Process** --------------------- * Recruiter screen * Hiring manager conversation, including a walkthrough of a growth experiment you've shipped * Technical interview * Paid two\-day work trial in San Francisco Compensation Range: $150K \- $220K

You’ll partner across the AI Software and Platform group to set observability standards, deliver platform solutions, and raise the bar for what “great” looks like in production reliability. What’s exciting: you’ll help build an agentic observability outcome where health insights can be surfaced faster and more intelligently than traditional dashboards and alerts. In specific, you will: * Drive a shift\-left security strategy, ensuring security is baked into every aspect of the SDLC * Lead compliance efforts by working with internal and external audit teams; providing evidence; ensuring adherence to controls; and being a point person for security assurance * Perform security architecture reviews, lead threat modeling exercises, do adversarial red teaming on internal products, and ultimately help ship secure\-by\-design products * Create and maintain a risk register within the organization, providing guidance on a risk\-based approach to decision making for the leadership team Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering (or related field) \+ 7 years of experience, Masters \+ 4 years of related experience, or PhD \+ 1 year of related experience. * 2\+ years of experience with AI Agents to perform security testing and evaluations against code and deployed systems. * Experience in shift\-left security, including integrating SAST/DAST into CI pipelines, with knowledge of Prisma Cloud, Wiz, or similar CNAPP tools required. * Experience operationalizing vulnerability management, including setting and meeting severity\-based SLAs/exception handling and reducing developer remediation friction. * Experience securing runtime workloads and cloud infrastructure, including prior rollout of CADR/XDR/CWPP (or similar) plus experience in AWS/GCP/Azure and ability to secure Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm). Preferred Qualifications * CISSP or other ISC2 certification strongly preferred Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time. jobs.title: IT Manager
jobs.description: **IT Manager** -------------- Longmont, CO ### **About Clean Chemistry** Clean Chemistry was founded in 2012 with a mission to develop and commercialize new water treatment and sanitization technologies that align with today’s sustainability goals. Since entering the industrial water treatment market with its core technology in 2014, Clean Chemistry has expanded its offerings as a high\-tech chemistry and service company with a world class team headquartered in Longmont, CO and Midland, TX. These efforts are led by our interdisciplinary team with extensive experience and a passion for success. Throughout the organization we champion core values of safety, innovation, quality and leadership. About the Role The Database and IT Administrator is responsible for creation and maintenance of Clean Chemistry’s SQL databases and overseeing Clean Chemistry’s technology infrastructure including hardware, software, and networks. This is a full\-time position for a well\-rounded, creative IT professional with prior experience in both database administration and IT management. The person in this role will be directly involved with the development of Clean Chemistry water treatment equipment. This role works directly with Clean Chemistry controls and SCADA engineers to maintain and further develop the hardware and software that enables our water treatment technology. As part of IT administration this role will also be a member of the cybersecurity team and will participate in setting policies, data protection, and monitoring networks for security threats. Responsibilities * Set\-up, monitor, and maintain Clean Chemistry SQL databases included controlling user permissions and access. * Utilize PowerShell scripts as needed for cloud \& infrastructure management. * Manage cloud based file storage (G\-Suite), maintaining organization, training new employees, minimizing duplication and assuring appropriate cross functional access to documents and files * Manage company inventory and access to software * Help research and troubleshoot all hardware and software issues * Document and maintain Clean Chemistry code in GitHub. * Manage company hardware inventory including computers, modems, and edge devices. * Provide IT support for local and remote Clean Chemistry employees. * Acquire and set up new computers for new hires * Develop and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) related to commonly used processes so that any high level employee can perform the tasks as needed * Research and develop automation solutions in conjunction with the Programmer / Data Analyst on an as needed basis * Research, propose and implement new software and hardware as needed to improve process flow * Monitor networks for cybersecurity threats. * Work with outside vendors to maintain quality of company webpages * Manage user creation and deletion in key software subscription programs * Other IT as required Requirements * Minimum 3 years experience setting up, maintaining, and controlling access to SQL cloud databases. * Minimum 5 years previous IT and systems management experience required. * Familiar with scripting in Visual Code and PowerShell. * Ability to work with a cross functional team of engineers and scientists. * Ability to understand and function within existing processes, procedures and systems * Expertise with the G\-Suite including Google Docs, Slides and Sheets * Ability to work independently in a fast\-paced startup environment. * Experience with coding and/or scripting, preferred. ### **Compensation and Benefits** * Competitive salary, DOE * Benefits * Company wide bonus initiatives Clean Chemistry is an Equal Opportunity Employer Compensation: $85,000 – $110,000 per year (Annual Salary) Application Deadline: November 30, 2026 (Applications close at 5:00 PM MST).

jobs.title: Software Engineer, PowerClerk
jobs.description: ### **Who Are We?** Looking for a job that makes a real difference in our world today and one that you’ll be proud of when you look back in 20, 30 or 40 years? This is it. Clean Power Research® is advancing the energy transformation through cloud software that informs, streamlines and values energy\-related decisions and processes for utilities, energy professionals and consumers. We’re a growing company that counts 10 of the top 10 Fortune 500 utilities and many of the largest renewable energy companies in the U.S. as our customers. We’re focused on expanding our market reach and impact with new software technologies that help solve the energy industry’s hardest problems. At Clean Power Research, every employee has a seat at the table and an important role. ### **Why Work Here?** * Go from building solutions to being part of the solution * Join a growing team of software and energy veterans from companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Oracle, General Electric and Pacific Gas \& Electric * Bring your passion and ideas to the table * Use your creativity to solve hard problems and make tough decisions * Work in a start\-up like environment coupled with the stability and customer base of an established, profitable company * Realize work\-life balance; we like to see our families, friends and pets at night! * Join a growing company that expects you to grow with us and invests in your growth Clean Power Research offers competitive compensation and benefits to full\-time employees including medical/dental/vision, paid vacation, paid holidays, a bonus plan and 401(k) plan with matching. ### **What You’ll Be Doing as a Software Engineer** Our Engineering Team develops Software\-as\-a\-Service (Saas) solutions hosted in the cloud using sophisticated development tools and cutting\-edge cloud infrastructure. As a software engineer, you’ll be learning and contributing to the development of highly scalable, reliable, performant and secure software products. One of the interesting and fun challenge you’ll face here is: **Energy resource workflow automation** On the PowerClerk® team, you’ll work on the leading software service for utility program automation. PowerClerk powers the rollout and adoption of distributed energy resources (e.g., solar, batteries/storage and electric vehicles) at some of the largest utilities in the U.S. by digitizing utility programs through intuitive, self\-service interfaces that enable extensive process automation as well as utility back\-end system integration. You’ll be writing code used by hundreds of thousands of utility employees, utility customers and energy industry professionals that helps these energy technologies get installed and have an impact. This is a full\-stack position where you’ll design, build, and own features end\-to\-end. You’ll be using C\#, JavaScript/TypeScript, JavaScript frameworks and SQL in a cloud\-hosted (AWS) environment. You’ll be part of an agile, empowered and high\-performing team. You’ll have exposure to customers and the business, and be an important participant in product, design and technology decisions. ### **Duties and Responsibilities** * Deliver high\-quality code and features with a high\-degree of ownership * Participate in writing test automation (unit tests and integration tests) and be part of a combined engineering team * Collaborate with other team members to define the product and make it great * Participate in release testing, monitoring of performance and functionality of the service in production * Effectively use modern AI\-assisted development tools to support software development activities including writing and understanding code, troubleshooting issues, developing tests, and improving developer productivity ### **Who You Are** * 1\+ years of professional software development experience * Someone who has strong aptitude for problem solving and consistently delivers high quality code * BA/BS or MS degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline * Experience in building web applications/services using C\#/ASP.NET/SQL and running in a cloud\-hosted environment is a plus * Some experience with AI\-assisted development tools and a strong interest and willingness to learn, adopt, and become proficient with AI tools as part of the software development process * Passion for renewables and for advancing the energy transition to clean energy ### **Pay Range and Benefits** * Base Salary Range: $90,000 to $110,000 annual depending on experience * Benefits: Performance\-Based Bonus, Company Equity Plan * Benefits: Paid Time Off, Sick Time, Holidays, Medical/Dental/Vision/Life and Disability Insurance, 401(k), Parental Leave, Commuter Benefits ### **How To Apply** Click the link below to submit your resume. Please include a cover letter detailing your interest in this position and the renewable energy space along with your resume. Due to the large number of applicants for our positions, we regret that we can only respond to candidates who meet our requirements. Clean Power Research is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status. The company’s employment decisions are based on merit, competence, performance and business needs.

jobs.description: **Software Developer: Lead Systems \& Marketing Technology** **Cruise Brothers, Palm Beach Gardens, FL (Hybrid)** Cruise Brothers is a travel agency network that helps people build home\-based careers selling cruises and travel. Our in\-house platform, CBAgentTools (CBAT), runs everything: lead capture, agent onboarding, bookings, commissions and the messaging that ties it all together.
