jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Agent Platform & Runtime
jobs.description: **About us** ============ Datasite is the essential infrastructure for M\&A. Also comprising Grata, Blueflame AI, and Sherpany, we help dealbreakers find opportunities, manage transactions, and make key decisions. Whatever your talents, you can find a place for them here. Get involved in some of the biggest business ventures today. Work with other gifted people around the world. Follow your ambitions, or discover a whole new path. Can you help us simplify the complex, create great experiences, and deliver better outcomes? Then let's talk. **Job Description:** **Why Engineering at Datasite** Datasite's engineering organization builds the software the world's dealmakers depend on to find, evaluate, negotiate, and close transactions: secure virtual data rooms, AI\-assisted diligence, deal sourcing, and private\-company intelligence. We're looking for a hands\-on **Staff Software Engineer** to shape the foundational infrastructure for enterprise AI agents. You'll evolve our custom agent harness, build layered memory and secure isolated execution, and make sophisticated agent workflows dependable at production scale. This is an opportunity to solve challenging problems in distributed systems, applied AI, security, and platform engineering \- not simply wrap APIs around models. Help define how agents reason, plan, remember, use tools, delegate work, and recover from failures across complex, high\-stakes business workflows. You'll own architecture decisions and collaborate across Engineering, Product, Machine Learning, and Security to deliver meaningful capabilities for dealmakers. **Location**: We are hiring in **New York City** and **Minneapolis.** Datasite is a hybrid company, with in\-office collaboration on **Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays.** **What You Will Do** * Lead the architecture and evolution of Datasite's custom agent harness, including reasoning and execution loops, planning, tool selection, state transitions, structured outputs, and runtime controls. * Design layered agent memory spanning working context, episodic history, semantic knowledge, and durable workflow state; build retrieval, consolidation, compaction, provenance, retention, and access controls. * Architect isolated, containerized agent execution environments for code, files, and tools, with ephemeral workloads, tenant boundaries, resource quotas, restricted networking, and secure credential handling. * Build resilient agent orchestration: asynchronous tasks, specialized subagents, delegation, checkpoints, resumability, retries, failure recovery, and human approvals. * Create secure, extensible tool integrations using MCP and related interfaces, with authentication, authorization, least\-privilege permissions, and safeguards against prompt injection and unsafe actions. * Establish agent evaluation, tracing, observability, and regression testing to measure task quality, correctness, reliability, latency, and cost; drive measurable improvements * Make high\-impact technical tradeoffs between probabilistic model behavior and deterministic application logic, validation, or human review. * Partner with Product, Machine Learning, Security, and platform teams to turn diligence, research, and deal workflows into production\-grade agent experiences; mentor engineers while remaining hands\-on in critical implementation. **What You Bring** * Experienced in building and operating production software, with a track record of leading complex technical initiatives across teams. * Deep expertise in backend platforms, distributed systems, asynchronous execution, APIs, fault tolerance, and stateful services. * Strong hands\-on Python proficiency and experience with a modern language such as TypeScript, Java, Go, Kotlin, or Rust. * Experience developing production LLM applications involving tool calling, multi\-step workflows, retrieval, agent orchestration, or context management. * Practical understanding of containers, cloud\-native infrastructure, workload isolation, and secure execution patterns. * Strong foundations in data persistence, caching, event\-driven architectures, permissions, multi\-tenancy, and secrets management. * Excellent product and architectural judgment: able to evaluate emerging techniques, balance speed with reliability, and turn ambiguous problems into maintainable platforms. * Ability to influence technical strategy, mentor senior engineers, and communicate complex tradeoffs clearly to engineering and product leaders. **Nice to Have** * Custom agent runtimes or orchestration frameworks; agentic coding systems or autonomous development environments. * Persistent or hierarchical agent memory, context engineering, retrieval architectures, or long\-running agent workflows. * Secure code execution, sandboxing, Docker, Kubernetes, microVMs, or ephemeral compute. * Multi\-agent coordination, MCP servers, tool registries, capability\-based permissions, model routing, or agent evaluation and tracing. * Enterprise SaaS, M\&A, virtual data rooms, regulated data, financial services, or complex document\-centric workflows. The base salary range represents the estimated low and high end for this position based on a good faith assessment of the role and market data at the time of posting. Consistent with applicable law, each candidate’s compensation offer may vary and will be determined based on but not limited to, your geographic region, skills, qualifications, and experience along with the requirements of the position. This position may be eligible for bonuses, commissions, or overtime if applicable. Benefits include health insurance (medical, dental, vision), a retirement savings plan, paid time off, and other employee benefits. Specific details will be provided during the interview process. Datasite reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. $170,000\.00 \- $297,200\.00 Our company is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce where all individuals are respected and valued. We are an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are dedicated to building teams that reflect the diversity of our communities.

jobs.title: Application Support Engineer (US)
jobs.description: **About us** We’re Dayshape—an award\-winning software scale\-up with big ambitions and the momentum to match. Trusted by Big Four and many other top professional services firms globally, our AI\-powered resource management platform is helping organizations to achieve extraordinary results. Our enterprise platform stands apart as the only solution that combines advanced AI, real\-time project financials, and firm\-wide insights to elevate resource management to a strategic function. By driving profitable growth, powering confident decisions, and ensuring satisfied clients and teams—we're helping our customers build strong organizations and careers for the long term. Why our customers love Dayshape: * We help professional firms optimize margins and increase revenue, unlocking access to more profitable work. * We provide complete operational visibility today and the tools to confidently predict tomorrow. * We empower firms to be where top talent wants to work and where top clients want to buy from. Recognized as Scotland’s fastest\-growing tech company in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 for three consecutive years, we’ve consistently proven our ability to innovate and deliver real impact—and we’re always looking for like\-minded people to join us. At Dayshape, our purpose is to improve people's working lives, and our culture is an important driving force in helping us to do just that. We're a friendly, inclusive, and ambitious team—driven by our values and a shared commitment to success. If you’re ready to join a fast\-growing, high\-impact company that’s reimagining resource management, then let’s talk. **About the role** Our customers include some of the world's largest professional services firms, with thousands of users relying on Dayshape every day. As our North American customer base continues to grow, we're expanding our US Support team and looking for an Application Support Engineer to support our enterprise customers across the United States. You'll work closely with customers and colleagues across Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Professional Services to resolve complex issues and help customers get the most value from Dayshape. This role operates during US business hours. While you'll collaborate closely with our growing US team, there is limited overlap with our UK Engineering teams, so you'll need to be comfortable working independently and taking ownership of issues from investigation through to resolution. Our customers provide first\-line support internally, meaning the issues that reach us are often complex, business\-critical, or technically challenging. That's where you'll make the difference. **Why this role is different** Support at Dayshape isn't a traditional help desk role. You'll be a product expert, technical investigator, customer advocate, and problem solver all in one. From supporting global enterprise customers and managing releases to influencing product decisions, adopting AI\-driven ways of working, and improving how we operate, you'll have real ownership and visibility across the business. If you want to move beyond ticket handling and become a trusted partner to customers and colleagues alike, this is the role for you **What you’ll do** * Investigate and troubleshoot complex customer issues, analysing logs, data, and product behaviour to identify root causes. * Act as the technical owner of support cases, driving incidents through to resolution and coordinating with Engineering when code changes are required. * Create high\-quality Jira tickets that provide engineers with the information they need to resolve issues quickly. * Resolve customer issues directly whenever a technical fix, configuration change, or workaround can be applied without development work. * Prioritise and manage support work across customer impact, business priorities, and operational risk. * Become a recognised product expert, supporting customers and colleagues with deep product and technical knowledge. * Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders through regular meetings and ongoing collaboration. * Sort major customer milestones, including go\-lives, white glove activities, and occasional on\-site visits. * Manage customer software releases and help ensure deployments are delivered smoothly and successfully. * Use trends from customer issues and bug reports to help improve product quality, testing, and operational processes. * Work closely with Product and Engineering teams, ensuring customer feedback helps shape future improvements. * Create and maintain knowledge articles, guides, videos, and other self\-service content that enables customers to succeed. * Continuously identify opportunities to improve how we work through automation, AI, and process improvements. **About you** * You've worked primarily in L3 Application Support, Technical Support, or Product Support role supporting external customers. * You are comfortable investigating complex issues independently and can confidently communicate technical concepts to non\-technical audiences. * You've worked in an enterprise software environment and understand the importance of building long\-term customer relationships. * You enjoy taking ownership and seeing problems through to completion rather than simply passing them on. * You're a self\-starter who thrives when trusted to work independently and make decisions. * You're naturally curious and enjoy understanding how systems work beneath the surface. * You have strong problem\-solving skills and can take a structured, analytical approach to troubleshooting. * You communicate effectively with everyone from end users to software engineers and senior stakeholders. * You're comfortable challenging assumptions, raising risks, and escalating concerns when necessary. * You have practical SQL experience and are comfortable writing and running queries. * You have experience with scripting or programming concepts, including JavaScript. * You have an interest in AI and emerging technologies and how they can improve customer outcomes, team efficiency, and product experiences. * Experience with Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform is advantageous. **Bonus points if you have** * Experience supporting SaaS or enterprise business applications (such as WorkDay, Star, SAP etc.). * Experience working with APIs, integrations, or data pipelines. * Familiarity with technologies such as .NET, JSON, JavaScript, or Vue. * Experience working with Azure Data Factory or similar integration technologies. * An understanding of how large professional services organisations operate. * Experience managing customer\-facing software releases or deployment activities. * Experience working within a geographically distributed team across multiple time zones. * Experience using AI tools to improve workflows, troubleshooting, knowledge management, or customer support processes. **What you’ll get** * Starting salary $75,000 to $95,000 (dependent on experience) * 31 days' vacation per year, including public holidays, and increasing by 1 day each year to a maximum of 38 days. * Paid four\-week sabbatical in your fifth anniversary year on top of your holiday entitlement. * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits * Disability and life insurance * 401k with employer matching * At least $1,400 per year to spend on professional and personal development. * Regular All Hands meeting for inspiration and over\-communication * Monthly team events (sometimes in\-person, sometimes virtual). * Volunteering time – up to 20 hours a year to participate in volunteer work. * Genuinely nice, smart people to work with, who are excited about growing our company **Working Details** This is a full\-time role (37\.5 hours per week), working 09AM – 5\.30PM (CT) from Monday to Friday. We are looking for someone ideally to join the team remotely in/around the NJ Tri State, Austin or San Antonio, Texas, in order to support customers across the United States, and to facilitate occasional in\-person collaboration with others within the US team. **Join the team!** Equality of opportunity is more than just a responsibility: we believe it’s a huge advantage to welcome a variety of experiences and perspectives into the team. Diversity is a great asset and, as such, we strongly encourage applications from any background. This is your opportunity to really influence how we get things done, and how our product helps our customers improve their working lives. We're doing well, but there's lots more to do in order to maintain the high bar and pace that we've set. Everyone here is growing personally as the company grows, so if that sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’d love to see your application. The deadline for applications is **5PM CT, Friday 6th November.** \*Please note the successful candidate for this role will be subject to background checks and will have an opportunity to declare anything to us beforehand\*.

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data Lifecycle
jobs.description: **About Decagon** Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences. Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel. We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others. We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team. **About the Team** Data Lifecycle at Decagon builds the systems that govern how sensitive customer data is handled throughout its lifetime: what we store, who can access it, how we redact it, and when we delete it. We turn complex privacy requirements into reliable infrastructure and product that customers can configure and trust. This team is core to how Decagon scales. Our AI agents work with sensitive information across conversations, tool calls, and customer systems. The frameworks we build need to protect that data consistently across the platform, while preserving the context customers need to operate and improve their agents. A failure mode we debug in production becomes a guardrail, a test, or a piece of tooling that catches it everywhere. Our systems run for companies like Hertz, American Airlines, and Notion across chat, voice, email, and SMS. **About the Role** You’ll design and build the platform infrastructure that let customers control how their data is collected, retained, redacted, and deleted. That means strong engineering underneath, and clear abstractions on top that hold up across different enterprise requirements without forking per customer. You’ll work day to day with product management, governance, and security: understanding customer requirements, defining data handling guarantees, reviewing designs, and iterating through launch. You’ll stay close enough to customers to understand their privacy and operational needs in depth and to ensure what you’re building is actually right for them. Engineers here own features end to end, from technical architecture through deployment and the iteration after it. On this team, that includes verifying that sensitive data is protected and the action actually completes. An understanding of durable and fault\-tolerant systems is key. **In this role, you will** * Build PII handling and redaction systems that identify and protect sensitive information across conversations, agent traces, and other customer data * Design configuration abstractions for redaction and retention policies that balance enterprise flexibility with clear, safe defaults * Build reliable data deletion workflows that propagate across storage systems and derived data, with retries, verification, and visibility into failures * Build self\-serve tools and APIs that let customers configure, test, and understand their data lifecycle policies without relying on an engineer * Build LLM\-backed systems that scan and detect data anomalies and violations * Train and/or tune models for detecting data of various forms (including PII and PHI) * Extend redaction and identification to multimodal agents, including images, attachments, voice notes, and documents. * Build monitoring and auditability that make it clear what data was processed, what remains, and where a policy has failed—without exposing sensitive information in the process * Handle data lifecycle systems at scale, including backfills, partial failures, and safe rollouts; your work will touch critical flows for Fortune 100 companies **Your background and skillset look something like this** * 4\+ years building software products, with strong product thinking * Proficient in Python, comfortable working across the entire stack * Experience designing reliable backend systems and data pipelines, including asynchronous processing, retries, and failure recovery * Understanding of what operational maturity looks like for critical systems, including observability and monitoring * Complex systems instincts: you can reason about where data flows, where copies persist, and what happens when one part of a workflow fails * A high degree of comfort debugging system failures in deep technology stacks, using whatever tool gets you to the answer * Judgment about when to ship fast and when correctness, privacy, and irreversible operations require slowing down **Even better** * Experience with PII detection, redaction, tokenization, or secure handling of sensitive data * Experience building data retention, deletion, or privacy request workflows across multiple storage systems * Experience building security\-sensitive product systems, such as authentication, authorization, and data access controls * Familiarity with privacy and compliance requirements such as GDPR, CCPA, or PCI, and translating them into engineering controls * Background with LLMs, evals, or AI agent systems, especially handling sensitive data in model inputs, outputs, and traces * Experience with observability, audit trails, or operational tooling for large\-scale data systems * Work with sensitive data in voice, images, or other non\-text formats **Compensation** $200K – $400K \+ Offers Equity This range reflects the expected compensation for this role. Compensation within the range is determined based on experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities, with flexibility for candidates who demonstrate exceptional impact. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity. Final compensation may vary based on location within the United States. **Benefits** We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees: * Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family * Life Insurance and Disability Benefits * Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension) * Parental Leave * Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot * Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance * Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best * Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave) *These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Philadelphia
jobs.description: The Data Engineer will join the Enterprise Data \& Analytics team to design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines and integrations that support reporting, analytics, and business operations. Alongside hands\-on engineering, this role will help strengthen the firm’s data management and governance practices through improved data quality, clear documentation, and consistent standards. Working with colleagues across IT and business teams, you’ll translate business requirements into practical technical solutions and help ensure data is accurate, accessible, and well\-managed. You’ll support the existing data environment while contributing to efforts to modernize integrations, evaluate new technologies, and improve how data is delivered across the firm. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and integrations using SQL, SSIS, Python, and Boomi as appropriate, connecting databases, applications, APIs, and file\-based sources. * Develop and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and warehouse data structures to deliver consistent, well\-documented datasets for reporting and analytics. * Develop and maintain Azure DevOps build and release pipelines to deploy, schedule, and monitor Python\-based data processes and automation. * Build and maintain a reusable data quality framework, including data profiling, automated validation rules, reconciliation, monitoring, alerts, and quality metrics. * Partner with business data owners and stewards to define quality rules and thresholds, investigate root causes, and track data issues through remediation. * Support data governance initiatives by documenting metadata, lineage, source\-to\-target mappings, and critical data elements, and implementing standards and controls agreed with business owners. * Contribute to the SSIS\-to\-Boomi migration, including inventorying existing processes and dependencies, documenting transformation logic, rebuilding integrations, testing and reconciling results, and supporting production cutover. * Monitor and troubleshoot production pipelines, improving performance and reliability through logging, error handling, alerting, and recovery procedures. * Support data platform evaluation and potential migration activities, including assessing existing workloads, adapting pipelines, validating data, and maintaining continuity for downstream users. * Maintain technical documentation, testing procedures, and operational runbooks; communicate progress, dependencies, and issues clearly to technical and business stakeholders. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:** * Strong proficiency in SQL and SQL Server, including complex joins, stored procedures, indexing, and query optimization. * Hands\-on experience developing and supporting production SSIS packages, ETL processes, and data integrations. * Practical experience implementing data profiling, quality checks, reconciliation, monitoring, and issue resolution * Understanding of data management and governance concepts, including metadata, lineage, data ownership, stewardship, and critical data elements. * Hands\-on Boomi integration development experience is preferred; experience migrating SSIS or other legacy integration processes to Boomi is a plus. * Microsoft Fabric or Snowflake experience is a plus, including familiarity with data ingestion, pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse workloads, and notebooks. * Working knowledge of Python for data processing, validation, and automation. * Familiarity with API and file\-based integrations, version control, testing, and controlled deployment practices; experience with Azure DevOps pipelines and releases is preferred. * Strong analytical, organizational, and troubleshooting skills, with attention to data accuracy, production reliability, and documentation. * Ability to work collaboratively, manage competing priorities, learn new technologies, and explain technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent work experience). * 3–5 years of relevant experience in data engineering, data integration, or data management roles. * Experience supporting integration modernization or data platform migrations is a plus. * Understanding of data warehousing and dimensional modeling, including star and snowflake schemas. * Experience in a law firm, professional services organization, or with financial systems is a plus.

jobs.title: RF Systems Deployment Engineer (5G / AI-RAN)
jobs.description: **Type:** Full\-Time (W2\) On\-Site/Hybrid, Arlington, VA, with travel to customer and test sites as deployments require **Description** DeepSig Inc. is a venture backed and product centric technology startup building revolutionary wireless processing software solutions using cutting edge machine learning techniques to transform baseband processing, wireless sensing, and other key wireless applications. We are seeking an RF Systems Deployment Engineer to be the hands\-on engineer between our AI\-RAN products and the customers, partners and test sites that deploy them. This person will take those products out of the lab: integrating them into customer environments, standing them up at field sites, running them through test events and demonstrations, and bringing what they learn back to the engineering team. The role centers on 5G RAN deployment work and builds on a strong radio and SDR background. You should already be comfortable with RF hardware, software\-defined radios and the signal\-level debugging that comes with them. Prior RAN experience is helpful but not required; you will have a team of RAN and ML specialists behind you for the deep details. The day\-to\-day work is hands\-on systems integration, troubleshooting, and optimization. **What You'll Be Doing** * Own customer and partner integrations of DeepSig software end to end: scoping the deployment, configuring radios, timing and networking, installing and configuring the OCUDU stack and dApps, and carrying the system through acceptance * Plan and execute site visits: pre\-visit jobs.title: Senior Principal Engineer, Hardware Engineering - AI Server Systems
jobs.description: **Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG)** builds the products that power infrastructure, solutions, and data management our customers need most. Our teams design and develop the hardware and software that connect infrastructure, accelerate computational workloads, integrate across the stack, protect data continuity, and deliver the platforms, applications, and diagnostics our customers rely on every day at enterprise scale. **Some product builders follow the rules. Ours rewrite them.** Within ISG, innovation isn't just about creating new technology\- it's about challenging assumptions and reimagining how work gets done. Engineers define intent, author precise specifications, and orchestrate AI agents that execute at speed and scale. AI is embedded throughout our development process, helping us move faster, learn quicker, and deliver greater impact. Yet the most important contribution remains uniquely human: deciding what to build, designing how it should work, and applying the judgment needed to earn our customers' trust. When your products power critical infrastructure around the world, that responsibility matters. We move quickly toward the work that matters most. We reward experimentation, encourage bold thinking, and remove unnecessary barriers so great ideas can become reality faster. Our teams embrace a customer\-first, first\-to\-market mindset, transforming rapid feedback into better products and better outcomes. We aren't looking for people who are content with the status quo\- we look for builders who question it, improve it, and occasionally rewrite it. If you're energized by solving complex systems challenges, excited to work alongside AI to amplify your impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape what's next instead of simply maintaining what's been done before, you'll find your place here. **Senior Principal Engineer, Hardware Engineering \- AI Server Systems** The reputation of Dell Technologies for delivering award\-winning hardware is legendary and our Hardware Engineering team is at the heart of it. We design and develop analogue as well as digital hardware products – not just computer or network hardware devices but peripherals too. Recognized for our high level of technical expertise in a variety of engineering disciplines, we’re involved across the development lifecycle – from research to the building, testing and delivery of completed products. Innovators in our field, we lead the way in exploring new concepts, approaches, processes, materials and components. **What you’ll achieve:** As a **Senior Principal Engineer, Hardware Engineer** on the **AI Platforms and Rack Scale Infrastructure** team you will architect and develop next\-generation AI server and rack\-scale platforms. In this role, you will provide technical leadership across complex hardware development efforts, drive system\-level problem solving, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver innovative infrastructure solutions that power advanced AI workloads. You will work alongside electrical, firmware, mechanical, thermal, power, and manufacturing teams to influence product direction, resolve challenging technical issues, and help deliver industry\-leading AI platforms for strategic customers. Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as a **Senior Principal Engineer** in **Austin, Texas**. (relocation assistance available). **You Will:** * Lead hardware design and system engineering activities for next\-generation artificial intelligence server and rack\-scale platforms * Drive root cause analysis and resolution of complex hardware, firmware, and system\-level integration challenges throughout the product lifecycle * Partner with architecture, design, validation, product quality, and GPU (graphics processing unit) partners to translate customer and business requirements into scalable hardware solutions * Collaborate with original design manufacturer and joint design manufacturer partners, as well as global engineering teams, to support platform development, validation, and manufacturing readiness * Communicate technical strategy, design tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to engineering teams, business partners, and leadership stakeholders **Take the first step towards your dream career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role: **Essential Requirements** * 12\+ years of hardware engineering experience, or equivalent skill, with a proven track record of delivering complex server and platform solutions * Experience in hardware design and integration of server enclosures, including processing, storage, and input/output subsystems, while balancing mechanical, power, and thermal requirements * Prior background in leading cross\-functional engineering teams through architecture, design, validation, and issue resolution * Strong knowledge of server architecture, system integration, and root cause analysis of complex hardware and system\-level issues * Proven ability to collaborate and influence across global engineering teams, original design manufacturer and joint design manufacturer partners, and manufacturing organizations **Desirable** * Bachelor’s or graduate degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering discipline * Experience developing artificial intelligence, high\-performance computing, or large\-scale data center platforms, including familiarity with rack\-scale infrastructure, systems management technologies, and customer\-driven product development **Compensation** Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. **The base salary range for this position is $176,000\- $242,000**

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Job Description** **Senior Mechanical Engineering Manager** 05/19/2026 **Reports to: SVP of Operations and Engineering** **Direct Reports: 21** **Position Type/Hours:** Full\-time, on\-site position. Core office hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m. **Position Purpose:** We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineering Manager to lead and elevate our mechanical engineering team. This role blends deep technical expertise in custom machine design with people leadership, with a primary focus on strengthening design excellence, solving application challenges, advancing Design for Manufacturing (DFM), expanding engineering analysis capabilities, and increasing financial awareness across the team. This leader operates with a servant leadership mindset by removing obstacles, developing people, and ensuring the team delivers high\-quality, practical, cost\-effective, and on\-time solutions without unnecessary process constraints. **Essential Functions:** **Servant Leadership \& Team Development** * Lead, mentor, and develop a team of mechanical engineers with varying levels of experience * Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement * Build team capability in first\-principals, risk identification, critical thinking, and proactive problem solving * Remove barriers that slow down engineering productivity or create unnecessary friction * Promote a “scrappy but disciplined” approach focused on value, not bureaucracy * Promote professional growth by identifying skill gaps and creating targeted development plans * Recruit and onboard strong engineering talent * Facilitate individual one\-on\-one and team meetings * Model, steward, make decisions upon, and expect to be held accountable to Delta ModTech’s values which include: * BELIEVE IN PEOPLE * FEARLESS INNOVATION * INTEGRITY * PASSIONATE \& TENACIOUS * SERVANT LEADERSHIP * Above all, this position should demonstrate a passion for serving others and a commitment to play a key role in creating a people\-first, value\-based culture that delivers our purpose of "serving people by solving problems". Steps to success include: * Always lead by example — act the way you expect others to act. * Ask for feedback and welcome suggestions on improvements that can be made. * Be aware of team members doing the right thing, then acknowledge and encourage them. * Care for your team members personally by being empathetic and encouraging work/life balance. * Delegate, encourage team members to innovate, and be the first to pick up the pieces with them if things don’t go as planned. **Technical Leadership** * Lead the development of robust and scalable mechanical design practices for custom converting, packaging, and coating machinery and automation * Champion DFM principles across all projects to reduce cost, lead time, and complexity * Expand team capability in engineering analysis while ensuring it is not over\-applied * Identify technical and execution risks early in the design phase and drive proactive mitigation plans * Drive consistency in design standards while maintaining flexibility for unique or outlier projects * Provide hands\-on technical guidance and design reviews for complex or high\-risk systems * Implement lessons learned and feedback loops from design, machine assembly, debug, and field performance **Project Execution and Schedule Leadership** * Own and drive mechanical engineering schedule performance across all projects * Plan and maintain up\-to\-date resource planning for the mechanical engineering team, ensuring projects remain properly staffed while adapting to project changes and business needs * Ensure design deliverables are defined, sequenced, and completed in alignment with overall project timelines * Partner with operations leadership and project management to develop realistic schedules, resource plans, and milestones * Establish clear accountability within the team for meeting commitments and deadlines * Introduce and instill strong financial ownership within the mechanical engineering team * Collaborate with project management and leadership on scope, budgets, and risk management * Ensure engineering decisions align with overall business objectives **Operations Team Participation and Leadership** * Participate and contribute within the Operations and Engineering leadership team, enabling tactical decisions and strategic planning while solving problems * Develop and maintain strong relations across engineering, production, sales, business, manufacturing, and people \& culture departments * Represent and advocate for mechanical engineering team throughout the company **Other Duties:** This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. The employee frequently is required to walk; use hands to finger, handle or feel; reach with hands and arms; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand. The employee must frequently lift or move objects up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision and ability to adjust focus. **Salary Range:** $160,000 \- $220,000 per year (DOE \- Depending on Experience) **Benefits Offered:** Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance Short\-term and Long\-term disability Flexible Spending Account (FSA) Life Insurance Health Savings Account (HSA) with up to a $500 match (on HDHP) 401(k) \*match Paid Time Off (PTO) Discretionary Bonus

jobs.description: **The Company** Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** At Dexcom, we are reimagining how innovation happens across engineering, science, and product development through the power of Artificial Intelligence. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of how Dexcom discovers, designs, and develops life\-changing technologies. **Where you come in:** * You define and execute the strategy, roadmap, and vision for AI Engineering, Discovery \& Co\-Design capabilities across Dexcom's R\&D organization. * You lead the development of AI\-powered platforms, engineering workflows, knowledge systems, and scientific reasoning capabilities that accelerate innovation and engineering effectiveness. * You establish scalable co\-design environments that enable collaboration across sensor, hardware, firmware, algorithm, antenna, mechanical, and systems engineering teams. * You partner with Engineering, Research, Systems Engineering, Product Development, Data \& Analytics, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, IT, and Executive Leadership teams to identify and deliver high\-impact AI solutions. * You evaluate emerging technologies and drive build\-versus\-buy\-versus\-partner decisions that maximize business value and competitive advantage. * You build, lead, and develop a high\-performing organization of AI engineers, research engineers, architects, scientists, and technical leaders. * You establish strategic relationships with universities, research institutions, and technology communities to strengthen innovation pipelines and attract exceptional talent. jobs.title: Senior Developer
jobs.description: THE OPPORTUNITY Join our Customer 360 development team at a pivotal moment in our technological evolution. We are building the next generation of our customer database, moving toward a unified source of truth that powers critical enterprise applications. In this role, your work will directly influence the customer experience by ensuring that every interaction—from personalized shopping recommendations to enterprise support—is informed by accurate, comprehensive data. You will collaborate closely with a dedicated team of developers to transform complex data ingestion workflows into streamlined, automated processes. We are looking for a forward\-thinking developer who is passionate about data integrity, excellence in software development, and creating tools that drive measurable business growth. THE TEAM The Customer 360 team is a cross\-functional, collaborative group dedicated to building the definitive "source of truth" for Dillard's customer intelligence. We are a high\-trust, self\-driven team that values curiosity and adaptability as we modernize our customer data strategy to provide a holistic, full\-view understanding of our customers. Our scope encompasses the full data lifecycle—from initial research and data modeling to designing robust APIs and developing complex, scalable batch processes. We are looking for a senior developer who is ready to take ownership of foundational systems, champion architectural integrity, and thrive within a team that is as passionate about software development as it is about the success of our colleagues. WHAT YOU WILL DO The responsibilities below represent the core functions of the role and are not an exhaustive list of all duties: * Design \& Model Data: Architect and implement scalable data models that serve as the foundation for a unified "source of truth" for Dillard's customer data. * Architect Ingestion Pipelines: Develop and maintain complex, high\-throughput batch processes to ingest, standardize, validate, and deduplicate customer data from disparate sources. * Build Robust APIs: Design and develop high\-performance backend services and APIs using Spring Boot and Java to power enterprise\-wide customer engagement applications. * Modernize Infrastructure: Drive the architectural integrity of our platforms by creating and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and leveraging containerization for deployment across multiple\-environments. * Champion Development Standards: Uphold technical excellence through rigorous code reviews, automated testing, and proactive vulnerability remediation. * Collaborate \& Innovate: Engage actively within our cross\-functional, co\-located team, leveraging AI\-assisted development tools and continuous research to stay ahead of industry standards and deliver new features. THE "MUST\-HAVES" * Expert Java Development: Deep proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and associated ecosystems; or similar tech stack. * Data Modeling Proficiency: Demonstrated experience in architecting, developing, and optimizing data ingestion pipelines, batch processes, and complex data models. * System Design \& Architecture: Strong understanding of scalable architectural patterns, API design, and best practices for creating maintainable, high\-throughput backend services. * Version Control \& CI/CD: Advanced proficiency with Git\-based source control and the ability to maintain robust CI/CD pipelines in a containerized environment. * Strategic Problem\-Solving: A proven ability to own the full lifecycle of a feature, from research and design to implementation, testing, and deployment. * Collaborative Mindset: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of thriving in cross\-functional, co\-located teams and mentoring junior developers. * AI\-Enabled Development: A forward\-thinking, adaptive mindset with a strong desire to integrate AI\-assisted development tools (like Copilot/Gemini) into all facets of the software development lifecycle. THE "NICE\-TO\-HAVES" * Data Strategy Expertise: Experience with Master Data Management (MDM) concepts, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), or data governance strategies in an enterprise environment. * Relational Database Depth: Proficiency in IBM Db2 (LUW) or similar relational database management systems. * Distributed Systems \& Big Data: Familiarity with high\-volume, distributed data processing frameworks or NoSQL database patterns. * Observability \& Performance Tuning: Experience designing systems with comprehensive monitoring and logging, or a track record of performance tuning for complex, high\-throughput batch processes. * Data Security \& Privacy: Familiarity with secure data handling techniques and compliance standards, ensuring sensitive information is protected throughout its lifecycle. * Containerized Development Experience: Familiarity with containerized environments, container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes), and best practices for packaging and deploying enterprise applications. *Location \& Hours: This is a full\-time, on\-site position located at our Little Rock, Arkansas headquarters. A high level of attendance is required as an essential function of this position.* *No immigration sponsorship (ex. H\-1B, TN, STEM OPT) is available for this position*

equipment, process changes, and manufacturing improvements. **Engineering Collaboration \& Equipment Development** * Provide structured production feedback to equipment design teams on machine Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Reliability (DFR) initiatives. **Fleet Standards \& Technical Documentation** * Develop and improve standard work, maintenance procedures, and calibration With more than 60 years of experience, Envanio Universal delivers custom inlet systems, exhaust silencers, filtration products, and complete turbine and engine silencing solutions that support safe, reliable, and efficient operations. **Role Overview** Working closely with Designers, Application Engineers, Structural and Acoustic Engineers and Manufacturing Engineers, the Project Engineer completes a variety of complex design assignments with extensive latitude in the use of initiative and independent judgement. The Project Engineer provides direct engineering input for the development of original designs or adaptions. Investigates and procures all data required to develop a design and confers with Engineering Team to resolve details not completely defined. Prepares or oversees the creation of system layout and fabrication drawings to meet customer requirements. **Key Responsibilities** * Proficiently and accurately completes general arrangement, quote and layout drawings. Creates bill of materials and drafts other engineering documentation. * Works closely with Application Engineers and Designers in the development and release of fabrication drawings. * Uses 2D and 3D CAD to develop, model and design new products or modify/adapt existing products or systems. * Processes and schedules engineering work requests (EWR), order change requests (OCR), and prepares and reviews engineering drawings and supporting documentation to verify adherence to standard practices. * Advanced and broad cross\-functional knowledge of various product lines and designs. * Advanced knowledge of engineering dept. processes, internal tools, specifications and calculations, drawing version and revision control. * Meets departmental metric targets for throughput, quality and on\-time delivery. * Can work independently and lead the development of new designs; engaging engineering and plant staff appropriately. * Collaborates with engineering, plant staff and customers on engineering proposals and drawings, bill of materials, construction and assembly. * Strong contributor to problem solving activities can implement alternative designs or adaptations. * Basic knowledge of acoustical, aerodynamic and emissions principles and applications. * Lead or assist in field measurements to support accurate design, layout and installation requirements. * Performs additional design related functions as assigned by supervisor. **Candidate Requirements** * Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related technical field preferred * Experience with engine exhaust and inlet applications preferred. * Proficient in 3D CAD. PTC Creo preferred. * Proficient in 2D CAD. AutoCAD Mechanical preferred. * Experience with ERP systems. SAP preferred. * Experience with product data management, drawing revision and version control. * Advanced experience in design of sheet metal fabricated products, steel fabrication and their welding and manufacturing process. * Applied Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles with emphasis on product design optimization for manufacturability and cost efficiency. * Proficient in application of engineering specification, design standards and practices. * Good oral and written communication skills, including proficient technical writing skills. * Team\-oriented, proactive, and open to feedback and collaboration. * Ability to prioritize high volume of work and meet deadlines. * Demonstrates ability to work well in an independent, self\-motivated work situation. * Strong organizational and project management skills, with a commitment to quality and accuracy. * Excellent problem solving skills. *Envanio provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.* *This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. We maintain a drug\-free workplace and perform pre\-employment drug and alcohol testing.* *Note to all Staffing Agencies: Envanio has a team of dedicated Human Resources professionals who are responsible for all hiring needs. Our practice is to partner and work with our approved vendors on an as\-needed basis. We do not accept resumes from agencies that are not on our preferred vendor list and have not signed our Recruiting and Permanent Placement Contract. Any resumes submitted from unapproved vendors will be considered unsolicited, and Envanio will not be obligated to pay a referral fee.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Mobile Engineer- Tulip Platform
jobs.description: It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun\-loving, mind\-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time. **Position Overview:** Dutch Bros is investing in enterprise AI capabilities to accelerate delivery, enable self\-service technology, and help teams solve meaningful business problems faster. Tulip is a strategic AI platform that provides reusable patterns, tools, and services to make AI\-enabled solution delivery easier, safer, and more scalable across the organization. Increasingly, Tulip reaches the business through mobile experiences used by shop crews, field leaders, and operators who are rarely at a desk. The Senior AI Mobile Engineer \- Tulip Platform is a hands\-on role responsible for designing, building, and shipping the mobile and field\-facing experiences that sit on top of Tulip. The focus is user experience and workflow automation: turning manual, paper\-based, and desktop\-bound processes into fast, intuitive mobile workflows, and integrating Tulip's AI services into the apps and devices field teams use every day. The role also contributes to platform architecture, integration patterns, and engineering standards, and mentors peers through design discussion and code review. The ideal candidate is a pragmatic builder and strong technical partner who obsesses over the end\-user experience, designs for real shop and field conditions including intermittent connectivity and one\-handed use, navigates ambiguity, and consistently delivers high\-quality, AI\-enabled mobile solutions aligned to business priorities. **Job Qualifications:** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands\-on experience building and shipping production mobile applications (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform such as React Native or Flutter). * Demonstrated focus on user experience: partnering with design, prototyping and testing with real users, and shipping interfaces that are fast, accessible, and intuitive for non\-technical frontline staff. * Experience automating manual and paper\-based workflows into mobile\-first digital processes, including offline\-first data capture, sync and conflict resolution, push notifications, camera and barcode scanning, and location\-aware features. * Experience integrating AI\-enabled services into end\-user applications, including large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation, agent or workflow orchestration, conversational and voice interfaces, and responsible AI guardrails at the point of use. * Strong API and integration skills: consuming and shaping REST, GraphQL, and event\-driven services, and working with backend and platform engineers to make mobile clients performant and resilient. * Experience with mobile release and quality practices: app store and enterprise distribution, MDM\-managed devices, CI/CD for mobile builds, crash and performance monitoring, automated UI testing, and phased rollouts. * Working proficiency in Python or a comparable backend language, with enough platform and cloud fluency (Azure, AWS, or GCP; containers; CI/CD; observability) to extend Tulip services where the mobile experience requires it. * Experience securing mobile and enterprise integrations, including OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect, SSO on shared and personal devices, on\-device data protection, and secrets management. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to work directly with field and operations teams to observe how work actually gets done and translate that into technical designs and executable engineering work. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience. * **Location Requirement:** This role is located in Tempe, Arizona. This position is required to be in office 4 days per week (Mon\-Thurs); Fridays are optional remote work days. **Key Result Areas (KRAs):** * **Mobile Experience and Product Delivery:** Design, build, and ship mobile experiences on Tulip that field and shop teams find fast, intuitive, and worth using every shift. * **Workflow Automation in the Field:** Replace manual, paper\-based, and desktop\-bound steps with automated mobile workflows, using AI capabilities such as orchestration, RAG, agents, and conversational interfaces where they add real value. * **Integration and Platform Contribution:** Integrate mobile experiences with Tulip services and enterprise systems, and extend platform capabilities where the experience requires it. * **Engineering Excellence:** Apply and improve practices for secure, maintainable, testable, and observable mobile and service engineering, including release management and phased rollouts. * **Engineering Practices and Knowledge Sharing:** Contribute to documentation, design reviews, and shared UI and integration patterns that strengthen how the team builds mobile AI solutions. * **Business Alignment and Value Realization:** Spend time in shops and with field leaders, translate what you observe into product decisions, and tie delivered experiences to measurable business value. **Skills:** * Mobile application engineering (iOS, Android, or cross\-platform) and hands\-on delivery * User experience design partnership, prototyping, usability testing, and accessibility * Workflow automation and digitization of manual, paper\-based, and field processes * Offline\-first design, device capabilities, push notifications, and mobile performance tuning * API, integration, and eventing patterns across enterprise and AI services * LLM, RAG, agentic workflows, and AI evaluation applied to end\-user experiences * Python, SQL, cloud\-native engineering, and secure service design * Mobile CI/CD, release management, crash and performance monitoring, and automated testing * Field discovery, stakeholder communication, and translating operational needs into product Peer mentorship, engineering standards, design reviews, and code quality * **Physical Requirements:** * **In\-Office Environment:** Must be able to work in a busy, crowded, and loud office with frequent distractions and interruptions * Must be able to collaborate in\-person with occasional impromptu in\-person meetings * **Office Conditions:** Adaptability to typical office conditions, which may include exposure to air conditioning, heating, artificial lighting, and varying noise levels * **Mobility** : Ability to sit, stand, reach, twist, stretch, and work at a desk for long stretches. Must be able to occasionally move or lift office items up to 25 pounds * **Hearing Requirements:** Hearing must be sufficient or correctable to ensure clear understanding of spoken information, including participating in virtual meetings and phone calls. Use of hearing aids or other assistive devices is acceptable if needed. * **Reading and Writing Proficiency:** Ability to read and write in English is essential for processing documents, drafting reports, and following up on necessary actions. Proficiency in written communication is required to handle job\-related tasks effectively. * **Vision Requirements:** Vision must be adequate or correctable to perform essential job duties, such as reading documents on a computer screen and using other visual tools. Use of corrective lenses or other measures to meet visual requirements is expected if needed. * **Technology Proficiency:** Must be proficient in operating a computer and other office productivity tools such as printers, scanners, and collaboration software. * **Effective Communication:** Must possess strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with team members, clients, and other stakeholders via email, video conferencing, and other in office communication tools. **Compensation:** DOE If you like wild growth and working in a unique and fun environment, surrounded by positive community, you'll enjoy your career with us!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Dynamo Technologies LLC is seeking a **Senior Data Engineer** to support the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB). The selected candidate will provide technical expertise in data engineering, data operations, data quality, analytics, and data management. This role will support the design, development, operation, and maintenance of data pipelines, data products, ETL processes, and data warehouse solutions in support of CFPB mission requirements. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with Python or R, complex SQL development, enterprise databases, Linux/UNIX environments, and data engineering practices. Experience supporting cloud\-based data environments, particularly Amazon Web Services (AWS), is highly desirable. **Duties/ Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, maintain, and troubleshoot data pipelines and data products supporting enterprise analytics and reporting. * Develop and maintain ETL processes to extract, transform, cleanse, validate, and load data from multiple sources. * Use Python or R to support data analytics, data operations, automation, backend development, and data pipeline activities. * Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries using enterprise databases such as PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server. * Develop and maintain data warehouse solutions, including data structures, transformations, and operational processes. * Support data quality initiatives by identifying data issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing solutions to improve data accuracy, consistency, and reliability. * Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, ETL processes, databases, and other data operations to ensure reliable and timely data delivery. * Develop database stored procedures, functions, and other database objects to support data processing and application requirements. * Support data integration efforts across enterprise applications and data sources. * Work in Linux/UNIX and Windows server environments to support data operations, application deployments, and troubleshooting. * Apply DevOps principles and practices to data engineering and application development processes. * Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and translate mission needs into scalable technical data solutions. * Support the development and maintenance of web applications and other technical solutions that enable data analytics and data\-driven decision\-making. * Support integration and analysis of Salesforce data and other enterprise data sources. * Document data processes, technical requirements, data flows, pipelines, and operational procedures. * Identify opportunities to improve data engineering processes, automation, performance, and reliability. * Collaborate with developers, analysts, business stakeholders, and other technical teams throughout the software and data development lifecycle. **Required Skills/Abilities:** * Hands\-on professional experience with **Python or R** for data analytics, data operations, automation, backend development, or data pipeline development. * Strong proficiency writing and optimizing complex SQL queries using enterprise databases such as **PostgreSQL or Microsoft SQL Server**. * Experience developing and supporting **ETL processes and data pipelines**. * Experience with **data warehouse development and operations**. * Experience working in both **Linux/UNIX and Windows** environments. * Knowledge of **DevOps principles and practices** as applied to data engineering and software development. * Experience troubleshooting data operations, data pipelines, data quality issues, and backend data processes. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and technical documentation skills. * Ability to gather requirements and translate business and operational needs into technical data solutions. * Ability to work collaboratively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and end users. **Nice\-to\-Have Skills:** * Experience developing and operating data pipelines and data products in **Amazon Web Services (AWS)** or other cloud environments. * Experience creating database **stored procedures and functions**. * Experience developing web applications or backend services that support data analytics. * Experience working with **Salesforce data** and Salesforce integrations. * Experience with cloud\-based data engineering, data warehouse, or analytics platforms. * Experience with additional programming or scripting languages used for data engineering. * Experience with automated testing, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and DevOps tools. * Experience supporting federal government or financial regulatory organizations. * Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, and enterprise data quality practices. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor's degree or advanced degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related technical or quantitative field is highly preferred. * Minimum of six (6\) years of relevant professional experience supporting data engineering, data operations, data quality, data analytics, data management, or related technical functions. * Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered. **Salary Range:** The salary range for this position represents Dynamo's good\-faith estimate of the compensation expected to be offered at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, the responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, skills, education, work location, and internal equity. $100k\-$125k annually Dynamo is a full lifecycle digital transformation company providing best\-in\-class technology and mission support services to our clients. Dynamo’s mission is to lead the digital transformation industry and provide best\-in\-class solutions for our clients with a truly human touch. We leverage industry leading practices to empower our clients, ultimately providing them with the necessary tools, knowledge, and information required to successfully achieve their strategic goals, while optimizing their operations. Through our partnerships, boldness, and authenticity, Dynamo goes against the grain of a traditional government contracting company by providing top\-caliber team members, delivering quality results, and always exceeding expectations. Dynamo Technologies is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, pregnancy, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III $90,000- $120,000 Missoula/Hybrid/Remote
jobs.description: ELM Utility Services, is a team of over 1900 employees nationwide. ELM is seeking an experienced software engineer who combines strong technical depth with ownership, sound judgment, and a commitment to quality. Software Engineer IIIs lead the development of complex applications and cloud solutions, independently carry work through the full SDLC, and mentor junior engineers while contributing to system design and architecture decisions. This role works closely with Product, QA, and fellow engineers to turn business requirements into well\-defined, well\-tested solutions. Software Engineer IIIs play a key role in raising code quality, strengthening engineering standards, and delivering reliable, scalable, and secure systems that support utility operations and regulatory workflows. At ELM, our mission is important \- helping keep our communities safe by reducing accidents involving underground utility infrastructure. Our Total Rewards Package Includes: * Optional benefits like Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, FSA, H.S.A., and Teladoc. * Company Paid Life Insurance Paid\-Time Off (PTO) for vacation and sick time * * 6 Paid Holidays * 401(k) plan * Bonuses for milestone anniversaries * Competitive pay based on experience * Long history of stable employment and promoting from within * Opportunity to lead and modernize production systems with meaningful operational impact Roles \& Responsibilities: * Lead the design and development of complex applications, services, and integrations from refinement through deployment. * Design and implement scalable, high\-performance cloud solutions on Azure, including Functions, Service Bus, Logic Apps, Cosmos DB, Data Factory, Event Grid, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). * Design and develop complex APIs and integration points. * Contribute to technical decision\-making, system design, and the overall architecture of ELM’s platforms. * Independently shepherd user stories through the entire SDLC, from refinement to production. * Lead story refinement sessions and break down business requirements into well\-scoped, deliverable work. * Create comprehensive acceptance criteria and technical specifications. * Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive, actionable feedback. * Mentor and guide junior engineers in story development, implementation, and engineering best practices. * Develop and maintain coding standards and best practices. * Ensure proper test coverage and documentation throughout the SDLC. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, including production incidents and root cause analysis. * Optimize application performance and resource utilization. * Facilitate collaboration between development, QA, and product teams. * Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, and share learnings with the team. Education and Experience * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Advanced knowledge of software development methodologies and design patterns. * Strong proficiency in object\-oriented programming languages such as C\# and .NET, with experience across multiple languages and frameworks. * Solid understanding of API design and integration patterns. * Experience with relational databases; SQL Server preferred. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) for coding, debugging, and testing. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and maintainability. * Understanding of responsible AI usage, including data privacy and security. * Ability to leverage AI tools to improve development productivity and efficiency. * Strong understanding of cloud computing and microservices architecture, preferably on Azure. * Experience working in Agile/Scrum product delivery environments. * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide other engineers. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications * Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field * Experience with Azure DevOps, Git\-based workflows, and CI/CD pipelines. * Experience integrating AI/LLM capabilities into enterprise applications. * Familiarity with Azure AI services and AI APIs. * Understanding of prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and LLM application patterns. * Experience building AI\-powered automation or intelligent workflows. * Experience with containerization and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). * Experience with Azure SQL Managed Instance or Azure Database for PostgreSQL. * Familiarity with observability platforms such as Datadog, Azure Monitor, or similar tooling. * Working knowledge of GIS and spatial data concepts. * Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, JavaScript, Angular, and/or React. * React Native and mobile application development experience. * Experience operating within regulated or compliance\-driven environments. WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

jobs.title: Unity Developer
jobs.description: We’re looking for a Unity Developer to join our simulation team at Excel Driver Services. You’ll contribute to a commercial vehicle training simulation platform running on multi\-display simulators and integrated with our learning management system. The majority of this role is focused on backend and application systems: data, networking, and services. You’ll also contribute across the application in areas such as UI, tooling, and scenario development. This is a hands\-on, in\-person role where you’ll collaborate daily with a tight\-knit dev team shipping training technology to real customers. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Build and maintain backend and application systems in Unity, including session management, scenario logic, data persistence, and networked features * Support multiplayer and instance synchronization across simulators * Consume and contribute to APIs connecting the simulation to our web platform and cloud services * Contribute across the Unity application as needed, including UI, editor tooling, scenario scripting, and bug fixing * Write clean, maintainable C\# that conforms to the existing architecture * Collaborate with the rendering and physics developers to integrate their systems into the application * Participate in team meetings, sprint planning, and code reviews * Contribute to documentation and help establish engineering standards for the platform **REQUIRED SKILLS \& TECHNOLOGIES** * C\# programming, with a solid grasp of OOP, collections, and async/await * Unity fundamentals: MonoBehaviours, ScriptableObjects, scene management, and the Unity lifecycle * Experience building at least one complete project in Unity (personal, academic, or professional) * Basic understanding of REST APIs and JSON * Version control experience (Git or Plastic SCM) and the ability to adopt our branching and review workflow * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills * Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to the rest of the team **PREFERRED SKILLS** * .NET experience, such as ASP.NET Core, Web API, or Entity Framework * Basic SQL and data modeling * Exposure to multiplayer or networking in Unity (Netcode, Mirror, Photon, or similar) * Familiarity with unit testing (NUnit, Unity Test Framework) * Familiarity with cloud platforms, especially AWS **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** * Someone with strong technical fundamentals and the discipline to build on them * Able to move between backend logic, UI, and tooling work as project needs change * Reads existing code and architecture before writing new systems * Can articulate why a system works, not just that it does * Reliable and accountable, with consistent effort and attitude in the workplace * Works well both independently and within a team **NICE TO HAVE** * Background in simulation, learning management systems, or industrial software * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and multi\-platform builds * Experience with WebGL builds or browser\-to\-backend communication * A portfolio, GitHub profile, or shipped projects demonstrating your work * An interest in the application of emerging AI technology **WORK ENVIRONMENT** This is a full\-time, in\-person position. You’ll be on\-site with the team, working on real projects, and expected to take ownership of your work. To apply, send your resume and a brief introduction to the hiring team.
