As a trusted name in payments, we partner with thousands of institutions to increase access to financial services and protect transactions for hundreds of millions of consumers and small businesses. Early Warning follows a hybrid work model to allow for a more collaborative working environment. Candidates responding to this posting must independently possess the eligibility to work in the United States, for any employer, at the date of hire. This position is ineligible for employment Visa sponsorship. **Role Summary** The Staff Site Reliability Engineer applies software engineering and systems engineering practices to improve the reliability, resilience, scalability, and operational health of production services. The role partners with Software Engineering and other technology teams to ensure reliability, observability, recoverability, performance, and operational readiness are engineered into systems throughout their lifecycle. The role provides technical leadership across multiple services and engineering teams, identifying cross\-service risks and influencing engineering decisions beyond an individual application or team. **Core** **Responsibilities** * Use software engineering, automation, and DevOps principles and practices to continually improve how services are built, tested, deployed, observed, operated, and recovered. * Use data, evidence, experimentation, and rigorous engineering analysis appropriate to the level to identify reliability risks, test assumptions, and guide technical decisions. * Define, implement, or improve SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and other service\-health measures appropriate to the scope of responsibility. * Improve observability through metrics, logging, tracing, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and service\-health instrumentation. * Drive continuous improvement across CI/CD, observability, deployment practices, Infrastructure as Code, automation, testing, incident response, capacity management, resilience, and operational readiness. * Identify recurring or systemic production issues and translate operational experience into improvements in code, architecture, automation, tooling, and engineering practices. * Partner with Software Engineering teams to incorporate reliability, resiliency, scalability, performance, observability, recoverability, and operational readiness throughout the development lifecycle. * Participate in or lead incident response, troubleshooting, service restoration, and blameless post\-incident learning appropriate to the level. * Provides technical leadership and escalation support for significant or complex production incidents and improves on\-call effectiveness and sustainability across multiple services and teams. * Reduce operational toil and unnecessary manual intervention through software, automation, reusable patterns, and better engineering practices. **Leveling Intent** Staff represents the transition from owning reliability outcomes to driving reliability engineering across teams. Staff SREs identify cross\-service patterns and risks, develop reusable solutions, and multiply engineering capability across teams. **Level Expectations** * Acts as a force multiplier across teams through reusable engineering patterns, tooling, automation, technical guidance, mentoring, and knowledge transfer that enable engineers to solve reliability problems more effectively. * Demonstrates software engineering, systems thinking, troubleshooting, and production reliability capabilities appropriate to the level. * Applies evidence\-driven reasoning and technical rigor to distinguish observed facts from assumptions and make defensible engineering recommendations. * Shares knowledge and contributes to sustainable engineering capability rather than creating dependency on individual expertise. * Operates across complex cross\-team reliability problems and drives technical decisions without formal authority. * Develops reusable approaches and demonstrates impact materially beyond an individual application or service. **Minimum Qualifications** * Typically 8\+ years of relevant professional experience in Software Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, Systems Engineering, Cloud/Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Architecture where applicable, or a comparable technical discipline. * Experience with software development or scripting using one or more modern programming languages. * Experience with software engineering principles, distributed systems, production troubleshooting, automation, and observability appropriate to the level. * Experience with public cloud technologies and architectures, preferably AWS, along with infrastructure, networking, Linux/Unix, and modern application architectures appropriate to the level. * Demonstrated analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and co  Work may require occasional standing, walking, kneeling and reaching. jobs.title: Software Engineer III — Evaluation
jobs.description: **GENERAL OVERVIEW:** Education Advanced, Inc. is a rapidly growing educational technology (Ed\-Tech) company in the K\-12 industry. Our goal is to create operational software that empowers educators to work more efficiently in specific areas. Evaluation is our teacher and staff observation and evaluation product. It is a Ruby on Rails application hosted on AWS, and it includes AI\-powered features that help educators do their best work. We are hiring a Software Engineer III to own significant parts of the product. This is a small, tight\-knit team, so the role carries real breadth: you will work across the Rails application, our AI\-powered features, the data integrations that connect Evaluation to other systems, and the cloud infrastructure it all runs on. You will also help others understand how the system works, so documentation and mentoring are part of the job, not something you get to after the sprint. You will start with a structured onboarding period, then help shape where the product and its architecture go next. This is a remote role with core availability during US Central Time business hours. We foster a supportive, inclusive, and innovation\-driven culture where every voice matters and your work directly empowers teachers and students. Join us to grow, collaborate, and build solutions that transform K–12 education. **QUALIFICATIONS:** **Roles and Responsibilities** * Design, build, ship, and support features across the Evaluation application, from the first product conversation through release and production support. * Build and improve AI\-powered product features: integrate large language models (LLMs) into real user workflows, and help design the prompts, safeguards, and quality checks that keep AI output accurate, safe, and useful for educators. * Build and maintain data integrations between Evaluation and other systems, with a focus on reliability and data quality. * Lead technical improvements on the roadmap, such as simplifying configuration, reducing technical debt, and modernizing parts of the application, and sequence that work so delivery keeps moving. * Write clean, high\-quality, testable, secure, and maintainable code, and help strengthen our automated testing practices. * Build and operate in AWS using CI/CD and infrastructure as code, and troubleshoot production issues end to end across the application and infrastructure. * Meet FERPA, state student\-privacy, and WCAG accessibility requirements as part of normal delivery. * Use AI\-assisted development tools as a core part of how you work (planning, coding, testing, code review, and documentation) while checking everything they produce and standing behind every line you ship. * Help shape how the team uses AI in the development lifecycle, including shared conventions, reusable prompts and instructions, and guardrails for safe use. * Partner with Product Management to refine requirements, take part in backlog refinement and sprint planning, and turn specifications into scalable, secure implementations. * Mentor teammates through code review, pairing, and technical planning, and write clear documentation that helps others work confidently in the system. * Other duties as assigned. **Qualifications and Education Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years building and operating production web applications, including recent, hands\-on Ruby on Rails experience (Ruby, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS). * Strong relational database skills (MySQL or similar): schema design, indexing, query performance, and safe migrations in a multi\-tenant application. * Hands\-on experience writing automated tests in Rails (for example, RSpec) at the unit and integration level. * Hands\-on experience deploying, running, and debugging applications in AWS, including containers, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code. * Solid grasp of secure web development (for example, OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorization, input validation, and secrets management). * Daily, hands\-on use of AI\-assisted development tools in professional work (for example, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or OpenAI Codex), beyond autocomplete to multi\-step work such as building features, refactoring, writing tests, and exploring unfamiliar code. * Skill at directing AI tools: giving clear specs and context, breaking work into small, checkable steps, and using tests and code review to catch output that is wrong, insecure, or made up. * Sound judgment about AI and data safety, including what code and data should never be shared with an AI tool, especially student and educator data. * A track record of owning ambiguous work end to end, from design through delivery and support, without needing it broken down for you. * Comfort working productively in a mature codebase and improving it without stalling delivery. * Excellent written and verbal communication for async, cross\-time\-zone teamwork, including explaining technical tradeoffs to non\-engineers. * Experience working in an Agile team (backlog refinement, sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives). * Core availability during US Central Time business hours. * Authorized to work in the United States. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building LLM\-powered features in production: prompt design, testing and evaluating AI output, cost and latency tradeoffs, and safeguards against unsafe or low\-quality results. * Experience with managed AI services from a major cloud provider. * Experience building AI tools into a team's development process, such as shared repo instructions, reusable prompts, or custom agents that help AI tools follow team standards. * Experience introducing or expanding automated testing in an existing codebase. * Frontend modernization experience in a server\-rendered Rails application (for example, Hotwire, Stimulus, or a component\-based approach). * Accessibility remediation experience against WCAG 2\.1 AA. * K\-12 or public\-sector software background, or experience with student information system (SIS) data and student data privacy. * Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their career. **How We Work** * Small teams with real ownership: feature branches, a release branch model, frequent deploys, and feature flags for controlled rollout. * AI across the whole lifecycle: We use AI tools throughout R\&D, and we keep building them into how we plan, build, test, review, and release software. How we do that is still changing, and you'll help shape it. * You own what you ship: if you can't explain code you submitted, it isn't ready, no matter what wrote it. * Privacy first: student and educator data is handled with care in every tool and every environment.

jobs.title: Engineering Supervisor- Hardware Design
jobs.description: **Overview:** Egan Company is seeking an experienced, highly motivated **Hardware Engineering Supervisor** to join our Industrial Controls team in Champlin, MN. This role leads and directs a multidisciplinary team of Hardware Engineers and CAD personnel dedicated to the selection, design, and execution of complex electrical control panels. You will play a critical leadership role in driving innovation, operational efficiency, standardizing hardware engineering processes, and ensuring compliance with industry standards and safety regulations. In addition to technical leadership, team mentorship, and scheduling, the supervisor collaborates closely with Project Managers, the Panel Shop, and Controls Engineering Teams to deliver robust, high\-quality electrical design solutions that align with customer expectations and budget requirements. \#LI\-TV1 ### **Responsibilities:** The responsibilities of the **Hardware Engineering Supervisor** for hardware design include but are not limited to: * Lead and manage a team of hardware controls engineers and CAD personnel, assign tasks, monitor progress, hire and onboard, conduct performance reviews, and provide development opportunities and coaching. * Oversee all aspects of the hardware controls engineering function, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and meet quality standards. * Promote a positive safety culture and ensure adherence to safety protocols and procedures in the design, installation, and maintenance of hardware control systems. * Identify and manage risks associated with hardware controls engineering projects. * Facilitate the development and documentation of standard engineering processes. * Lead planning meetings to assign team members to projects. * Participate in the design, selection, and specification of hardware components for control systems. * Review and approve control system designs and schematics for functionality, safety, UL 508A/UL requirements, and compliance with industry standards. * Assist the UL inspector with any questions or direction. * Collaborate with other engineering functions to ensure successful integration of hardware controls systems. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware control system problems. * Identify and implement process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the hardware controls engineering team. * Stay up\-to\-date on the latest advancements in hardware controls technology, innovative AI solutions, and industry standards/certifications. * Contribute to the development and implementation of departmental goals and objectives. ### **Requirements:** * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a relevant engineering field or equivalent combination of education and experience. * 8\+ years of experience in hardware controls engineering. * UL MTR certified or the ability to become certified. ### **Qualifications:** * Expert in AutoCAD Electrical platform and automation. * EPLAN, DTM, or SolidWorks experience is a plus. * Experience with Rockwell hardware and software is a plus. * Experience in the electrical controls industry in engineering, project management, and/or engineering sales experience. * Ability to lead a team of 6–10 individuals and work collaboratively with leaders and others within and outside the Industrial Controls group. * Knowledge of safety regulations, policies, and procedures. * Team oriented and an effective communicator. * Ability to understand schematics and build specifications. * Ability to foresee events and anticipate changes in conditions and operations to the greatest extent possible and react to these appropriately. * Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and Google Workspace applications. * Willingness to occasionally travel overnight and out of state. * Familiarity with UL, cUL, CSA, and ETL standards and certifications for industrial control panels. * Familiarity with NEC and NFPA standards for industrial wiring and electrical safety. * Ability to conduct site walk\-throughs in manufacturing facilities to assist with project scoping. * Ability to serve as the primary point of contact for field personnel regarding hardware technical issues and inquiries. * Ability to accurately estimate and quote hardware components and materials required for control panel manufacturing. ### **Working Conditions:** * Performance of duties will be in an office setting with visits to the shop and job sites as needed. * Ability to stand or sit for extended periods of time. * Exposure to loud noise, dirt, and exposure to the elements. * Climbing ladders/stairs, uneven ground, bending, kneeling, and twisting are to be expected on job sites. ### **Benefits, Perks and Pay Beyond the Industry Standard** Egan supports team members and their families with comprehensive benefits. From robust healthcare benefits and generous paid time off, to flexible working options and career growth opportunities, Egan is committed to providing a workplace that helps you thrive both personal lead incentive program, and safety buck program * Community Involvement: our “Beyond the Jobsite” program supports causes in the communities in which we live and work through regular volunteer events to connect with each other and help those in need The benefits information listed above may not apply to union positions (benefits for union roles are governed by applicable collective bargaining agreements) nor part\-time and temporary roles. View more information online about Egan’s investment in benefits for you. Salary Range: $109,038 \- $141,750 (subject to such factors as experience, education, and/or skill set) plus potential annual discretionary bonus. Hybrid: This role is eligible for our hybrid work model. To ensure a strong start, we ask for a minimum of 90 days in the office at the start to wrap your arms around the role, build essential in\-person connections, and gain the organizational knowledge needed for success before transitioning to our hybrid schedule. ### **Strong Culture Built on Values and Keeping Promises** At Egan, you’ll be part of a team that shares a passion for redefining the industry by setting a new standard of customer care. Together, we'll promote teamwork, embrace innovation, act with integrity, pursue growth, and prioritize safety. You’ll have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to providing the growth and success you're looking for, both for yourself and for the customers you serve. You’ll love being part of success shaped by the strength of our team, which is enhanced by: * Solid history as a legacy leader in specialty contracting and system integration for over 80 years * Private ownership and operations by employees who work in the company (not a holding company or private equity firm) * Engaging leadership who prioritizes your safety, your development, and your impact * A proven track record of employee retention and loyalty * Flexible and hybrid workplace models that prioritize collaboration and customer needs From general contractors and architects to building owners and facility engineers, Egan collaborates throughout the entire construction or project process with the shared goal of maintaining best\-in\-class relationships with our internal teams, customers, and business partners. At over 1,000 employees occupying our offices and work sites, we aim to ensure every project is done with quality craftsmanship, integrity, and an aggressive commitment to safety. In fact, we’re proud to be recognized as one of America's Safest Companies for recurring years. ### **Application Instructions and Employment Practices** Egan Company will not discriminate against or harass any employee or application for employment because of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, sexual orientation), disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), veteran status, marital status, familial status, local human rights commission activity, or status with regard to public assistance. We do not accept application materials by mail or email except as a reasonable accommodation for qualified disabled applicants. Individuals who are unable to use our online process due to a disability should email recruiting@eganco.com. Creating and maintaining a safe and drug\-free working environment is important to all of us. Employment with Egan requires successful completion of a pre\-employment drug screening. We also participate in E\-Verify. Egan reserves the right to hire any individual without legal or financial obligation on unwanted solicitations. Any resume submitted to any employee of Egan without a prior signed search agreement will be considered unsolicited and the property of Egan. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis without requiring current or future sponsorship for employment visa status No agency emails, calls, or solicitations will be accepted without a valid agreement.

The team is small, senior, and startup\-paced. At Layla, engineers can influence a product used by travelers around the world. We are looking for someone energized by the opportunity to bring ideas forward, explore possibilities, and turn them into reliable experiences at global travel scale. You do not need to arrive with every answer or every technology; curiosity, sound judgment, initiative, and a willingness to learn are essential. **WHAT WE VALUE BEYOND THE CHECKLIST** The scope of this role is intentionally broad, but it is not a request for one person to be an expert in everything. We value engineers who can connect disciplines, identify where they can contribute most, collaborate generously, and bring in the right partners when deeper expertise is needed. Strong candidates may have different paths through full\-stack engineering, applied AI, product development, or startup environments; what matters is the ability to learn, make sound tradeoffs, and turn ideas into outcomes. **In this role, you will:** * Design, build, and operate agentic AI experiences that support travel discovery, itinerary planning, personalization, and booking\-related workflows. * Develop reliable agent orchestration patterns, including planning, tool use, routing, state management, memory, retries, guardrails, and human confirmation where appropriate. * Build and evolve backend services, APIs, data models, integrations, and event\-driven workflows that connect agent experiences to Expedia Group and Layla capabilities. * Build user\-facing experiences that make AI behavior clear, useful, and actionable across web and other relevant product surfaces. * Integrate retrieval, knowledge, and recommendation capabilities using appropriate data contracts, embeddings, search, ranking, and grounding strategies. * Establish evaluation and observability practices for agentic systems, including quality, task completion, latency, cost, safety, failure modes, and user impact. * Take shared ownership of a meaningful product surface, from framing the problem and exploring solutions through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration. * Translate ambiguous product opportunities into thin, testable increments and ship quickly while preserving operational and architectural quality. * Partner closely with Product, Design, Data, and Engineering to shape product direction, define success metrics, and connect technical decisions to traveler outcomes. * Apply strong software engineering practices across testing, CI/CD, observability, security, incident response, and production support. * Use AI\-assisted engineering tools thoughtfully to explore designs, accelerate implementation, improve test coverage, and investigate production behavior — whil cture, and cloud\-native systems. * Experience designing agent evaluation frameworks, offline test sets, online monitoring, quality rubrics, or experimentation programs. * Experience building systems with strong safety, privacy, security, reliability, and responsible\-AI considerations. * Experience in travel, commerce, marketplace, recommendations, search, personalization, or other high\-scale consumer products. * Experience using AI coding assistants or software\-engineering agents in day\-to\-day development, including examples of validating, correcting, and hardening generated output. Experience working in a startup, incubation, or rapidly evolving product environment where priorities and requirements change quickly. * Expedia Group is proud to offer a wide range of benefits to support employees and their families, including medical/dental/vision, paid time off, and an Employee Assistance Program. jobs.description: ***\*\*\* Please note that this is a HYBRID role, requiring this person to work at our Cottonwood Heights office in SLC two days a week. We are not able to provide work sponsorship (i.e. OPT, STEM\-OPT or H\-1B visa) for this role \*\*\**** As a Sr. Application Security Engineer at Extra Space, you'll be a trusted security partner embedded in how our engineering teams design, build, and ship software. They're built mostly with C\# .NET, TypeScript, and React/Next.js, backed by SQL Server and other relational and non\-relational databases. **Duties \& Responsibilities** * Conduct security architecture and design reviews for new and evolving features, surfacing risk early and recommending practical mitigations. * Perform threat modeling and manual and automated code reviews, and partner with developers to prioritize and remediate what you find. * Drive a risk\-based approach to application security, helping teams understand vulnerabilities in terms of business impact. * Mature our Secure SDLC, including secure coding standards, security requirements, and automated checks (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning) in our CI/CD pipelines. * Build and maintain security tooling and automation that scales across teams, with a focus on reducing risk rather than adding tools. * Lead and grow the security champions program, training champions so each team has security expertise close at hand. * Serve as the application security subject matter expert for engineering, product, and leadership, and mentor engineers on secure development practices. * Make sure AI tools and AI\-powered features are adopted within acceptable risk limits. * Align our applications with SOC 1, SOX, CIS v8, and PCI DSS (SAQ\-A, SAQ\-P2PE), and support audits with evidence and remediation plans. **Requirements** * 6\+ years of combined experience in software engineering, application security, product security, or a closely related field. * Proficiency in most of our primary languages code review experience. * Strong understanding of SSDLC principles and experience implementing or maturing secure development programs. * Solid understanding of common vulnerabilities and attack techniques (OWASP Top 10, API security, authentication and authorization flaws). * Experience integrating security tooling into delivery pipelines (GitHub, TeamCity, or similar). * Familiarity with AI security risks and emerging attack surfaces, including agentic systems, MCP, and LLM\-powered workflows. * A risk\-focused mindset: you can explain security risk in business terms, weigh it against the business's needs and risk tolerance, and help teams make pragmatic decisions without security theater. * A proven ability to build trusted relationships with engineering teams and guide behavior without direct authority. * Strong written and verbal communication, equally comfortable in a design review with engineers and a risk conversation with leadership. **Preferred Qualificatio****ns** * Hands\-on security certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, GWEB, PNPT, or similar. * Experience running or triaging a bug bounty program. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** Performs sedentary work in an office environment with limited lifting (less than 10 pounds) or walking required. Close visual acuity required to perform work at computer terminal. No exposure to adverse environmental conditions. Requires repetitive typing motion, talking, hearing, grasping and feeling. jobs.description: **Who We Are** ============== Join a team that puts its People First! Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people\-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ\+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.**What We Do** ============== The Security Engineer – Attack Surface Platforms operates and improves the organization’s cloud native application protection platform (CNAPP) and related attack surface capabilities. The role reviews and triages findings, validates risk and ownership, coordinates remediation with cloud and application teams, and maintains the quality of the platform’s policies, integrations, workflows, and reporting. It also delivers tested, incremental enhancements that help teams identify and address cloud security exposure. This role is suited to internal candidates with a security or technology foundation and an interest in developing cloud security skills.**Essential Functions** * Monitor CNAPP queues, dashboards, alerts, and platform health. Review new and aging findings, identify duplicates or data quality issues, and route actionable items to the appropriate cloud, platform, application, or security owner. * Triage cloud misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, exposed assets, excessive permissions, and workload or container risks. Use asset context, exploitability, business criticality, and available threat information to validate severity and recommend an appropriate response. * Investigate findings by reviewing cloud configurations, resource relationships, platform evidence, and available logs or metadata. Document the technical basis, affected resources, recommended remediation, and any applicable exception or compensating control. * Coordinate remediation with engineering and service teams. Track progress against agreed service targets, follow up on overdue or recurring issues, validate fixes in the CNAPP platform, and escalate material or time\-sensitive exposure through established processes. * Administer and support CNAPP capabilities, including user and role access, cloud account and subscription onboarding, integrations, asset inventory, notification routes, policy configuration, and platform settings. * Improve platform coverage and signal quality by tuning existing policies, adjusting thresholds, testing new or changed detections, and reviewing false positives, missed coverage, and recurring finding patterns with the relevant security and engineering partners. * Build and test modest platform enhancements such as custom policies, dashboards, reports, API\-based utilities, workflow changes, or integrations. Maintain clear change notes and supporting procedures, and follow the organization’s change and release practices. * Prepare operational reporting on exposure trends, remediation status, platform coverage, finding quality, and service health. Explain notable changes and data limitations so teams can act on the results. * Contribute to security risk assessments, cloud security reviews, incident investigations, and audit evidence requests involving CNAPP data or cloud attack surface exposure. * Maintain runbooks and knowledge articles for recurring operational tasks. Share platform guidance with users and help improve support handoffs and repeatable triage practices. **Working Relationships** Partners with Cloud Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, application teams, Security Operations, Security Architecture, and other technology groups to resolve exposure and maintain effective CNAPP operations. Communicates clearly with technical and business stakeholders and works with platform vendors when troubleshooting or evaluating product capabilities. **Knowledge and Skills** * Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform, including its core services and terminology; experience across multiple cloud platforms is useful. * Understanding of CNAPP capabilities and related areas such as cloud security posture management (CSPM), cloud workload protection (CWPP), cloud infrastructure entitlement management (CIEM), vulnerability management, and container security. * Ability to interpret cloud assets, identities and permissions, network exposure, vulnerabilities, and configuration findings, then explain risk and remediation steps to engineering teams. * Experience with security operations practices such as alert or finding triage, ticket ownership, prioritization, escalation, remediation tracking, and evidence\-based closure. * Ability to troubleshoot SaaS security platforms, integrations, data ingestion, policy behavior, access, and reporting issues in partnership with platform or cloud administrators. * Basic scripting or API experience in a language such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash to support investigation, data checks, or small platform enhancements. Infrastructure as Code experience is useful but is not the primary focus of this role. * Strong written and verbal communication, attention to detail, sound judgment when handling security findings, and the ability to manage multiple operational priorities. **Typical Education** Generally requires a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. **Typical Range of Experience** Typically requires 2–3 years of experience in information security, cloud security, security operations, cloud engineering, or a related technical role. Experience supporting a CNAPP or comparable cloud security platform is preferred. **Required Certification** Candidates must hold an introductory cloud or cloud security certification at the time of selection. Accepted certifications include AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals, Google Cloud Digital Leader, or the Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK) from the Cloud Security Alliance. An equivalent foundational certification may be accepted with manager approval. Pay Range: $97,700\.00 \- $130,300\.00 Annually This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location. **\*\* Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. \*\*** First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer\-imposed criminal history requirements. **What We Offer** ================= By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees \- not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term. Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

jobs.title: Cloud Architect - Senior
jobs.description: **Senior AWS Architect — Multi\-Cloud \& AI Platforms** FSS Government Solutions is seeking a Senior AWS Architect to lead the design, implementation, and operation of **Amazon Web Services** cloud solutions for complex government programs, with **Microsoft Azure as the secondary cloud** in a multi\-cloud estate. You will shape AWS\-first architecture for scalability, security, and operational excellence, stand up infrastructure from the ground up, and optimize platforms for AI\-enabled products. Azure is in scope where programs, data, or identity already live there, or where dual\-cloud resilience is required. The work spans solution architecture, secure multi\-cloud infrastructure, event\-driven systems, and hands\-on delivery with engineering teams. \*80% remote \- in office (Woodlawn, MD) one day per week \*Requires ability to obtain a Public Trust **Responsibilities** * Lead cloud architecture for client programs with **AWS as the primary landing zone**: accounts/OUs, network, identity, data, integration, and application patterns aligned to security and scalability requirements. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **THE POSITION** Our roster has an opening with your name on it We are looking for a full stack Senior Software Engineer to lead the design, development, and delivery of high\-scale applications. In this role, you will autonomously architect resilient systems, establish modern engineering standards, and collaborate closely with cross\-functional partners to drive key technical and product initiatives across the organization. You'll own the frontend architecture of our web and mobile products end to end, while working comfortably across the stack to build and extend the services that power them. This is a senior role: you'll set technical direction, raise the quality bar, and mentor other engineers. In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs. **THE GAME PLAN** Everyone on our team has a part to play * Autonomously drive sustained business impact across team goals, product capabilities, and technical systems. * Take ownership of semi\-annual and annual technical objectives, consistently delivering high\-quality, mission\-critical systems on schedule. * Define and shape the long\-term architectural vision for core full stack and microservices platforms. * Architect technical solutions for complex, ambiguous engineering challenges, making sound trade\-offs between immediate velocity and long\-term system health. * Lead cross\-team technical initiatives to extend software standards and platform impact across the engineering organization. * Mentor engineers, influence organizational design standards, and champion best engineering and operational practices. * Proactively manage technical dependencies and align architectural strategy across external engineering teams. * Partner with product and business stakeholders to resolve ambiguity, clarify requirements, and address technical risks early in the lifecycle. * Leverage deep domain knowledge to guide technology choices independently in fast\-paced, high\-scale environments. * Streamline complex application architecture by focusing on core scalability, efficiency, and critical business outcomes. * Architect and build applications that are resilient, secure, and maintainable under high traffic loads. * Develop high\-performance front\-end interfaces and back\-end microservices utilizing modern frameworks and design patterns. * Design, build, and optimize high\-throughput GraphQL APIs to power seamless client applications and backend integrations. * Lead rigorous code reviews, establish testing strategies, and enforce engineering excellence across the software development lifecycle. **THE STATS** What we're looking for in our next teammate * Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, with 5\+ years building and shipping production software. * Deep expertise in modern web frontend architecture with TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6\+), and React — including component design, state management, and hooks. * Mobile development with React Native, plus readiness to work natively: we're migrating our mobile apps to native (Swift/iOS and Kotlin/Android) with the help of AI tooling, so you're either comfortable in native mobile or a strong engineer eager to pick it up fast. Existing Swift or Kotlin experience is a plus. * Strong command of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and cross\-browser/cross\-device compatibility across web and mobile. * Proven track record of frontend performance optimization: code splitting, lazy loading, bundle/asset optimization, rendering performance, and Core Web Vitals. * Test\-first mindset with hands\-on frontend testing experience (e.g., Jest, React Testing Library) and a commitment to code quality, maintainability, and observability. * Working knowledge of backend services in Java and Spring Boot — enough to build and extend APIs and collaborate closely with backend teams. * Experience consuming and integrating APIs on the client, including GraphQL. * Solid grasp of software design patterns and architectural best practices for reliable, scalable, maintainable systems. * Hands\-on use of AI development tools (AI coding assistants, agentic IDEs, LLM\-based testing or review tools) in real projects. * Strong communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Proven technical leadership: mentoring engineers, setting technical direction, and raising engineering standards across a team. Preferred Skills * Experience with design systems, reusable component libraries, and accessibility (WCAG) best practices. * Familiarity with relational databases, messaging/streaming concepts (e.g., Kafka), and GraphQL federation (e.g., Cosmo). * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and build tooling (e.g., Gradle, Buildkite). * Cloud infrastructure (preferably AWS), containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes); exposure to Helm and Terraform a plus. **ABOUT FANDUEL** FanDuel Group is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States and Canada. FanDuel Group consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including: America's \#1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; the industry's unquestioned leader in horse racing and advance\-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. In addition, FanDuel Group operates FanDuel TV, its broadly distributed linear cable television network and FanDuel TV\+, its leading direct\-to\-consumer OTT platform. FanDuel Group has a presence across all 50 states, Canada, and Puerto Rico. The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company's affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia. FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT). **PLAYER BENEFITS** We treat our team right We offer amazing benefits above and beyond the basics. We have an array of health plans to choose from (some as low as $0 per paycheck) that include programs for fertility and family planning, mental health support, and fitness benefits. We offer generous paid time off (PTO \& sick leave), annual bonus and long\-term incentive opportunities (based on performance), 401k with up to a 5% match, commuter benefits, pet insurance, and more \- check out all our benefits here: **FanDuel Total Rewards**. \*Benefits differ across location, role, and level. FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, "We are One Team!". As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, local or federal law. FanDuel is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please email Benefits@fanduel.com. ***The applicable salary range for this position is $138,000 \- $173,000 USD, which is dependent on a variety of factors including relevant experience, location, business needs and market demand. This role may offer the following benefits: medical, vision, and dental insurance; life insurance; disability insurance; a 401(k) matching program; among other employee benefits. This role may also be eligible for short\-term or long\-term incentive compensation, including, but not limited to, cash bonuses and stock program participation. This role includes paid personal time off and 14 paid company holidays. FanDuel offers paid sick time in accordance with all applicable state and federal laws.*** ***It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.*** \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Sportsbook - FBG (REMOTE)
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.**About the Team** ------------------ Launched in 2021, Fanatics Betting and Gaming is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics, a global digital sports platform. The Fanatics Sportsbook is available to 95% of the addressable online sports bettor market in the U.S. Fanatics Casino is currently available online in Michigan, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and West Virginia. Fanatics Betting and Gaming operates twenty\-two retail sports betting locations, including the only sportsbook inside an NFL stadium at Northwest Stadium. Fanatics Betting and Gaming is headquartered in New York with offices in Denver, Leeds and Dublin. As an Engineering Manager, Client Services at Fanatics Betting \& Gaming (FBG), you'll lead engineers within the Sportsbook Client team—an innovative, culturally driven group powering the rapidly growing Fanatics Sportsbook app. The team owns the core customer experience, from showcasing markets, events, and player statistics to rendering highly dynamic, real\-time data. Together, we build features that elevate performance, usability, and engagement, driving customer loyalty through an exceptional user experience. You are expected to partner with product and design leadership to shape strategy, optimize engineering processes, remove blockers, and foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and technical excellence. You play a key role in growing engineering talent, driving delivery rigor, and ensuring your team consistently executes against business commitments. We embrace principles of data\-driven development, operational excellence, and continuous process optimization to deliver a stable, scalable platform. Central to our strategy is Kotlin, and Kotlin Multiplatform, which empowers us to deliver high\-quality features quickly and consistently across multiple ecosystems. By focusing on object\-oriented design, modern coding practices, open\-source frameworks, and third\-party platform integrations, we continuously innovate and deliver at speed in this exciting and fast\-moving market. ### **Responsibilities** * Hire, retain, and develop strong engineers, providing regular actionable feedback, coaching, and clear career growth plans. * Lead team execution and delivery planning, ensuring clear ownership, proactive risk management, and consistent velocity against business commitments. * Partner closely with product, design, and technical leadership to prioritize work, align team roadmaps with business strategy, and balance feature delivery with technical debt. * Establish team norms, rituals, and operational rhythms that support high performance, psychological safety, continuous learning, and effective cross\-team collaboration. * Guide architectural decisions and technical quality standards on the team, acting as a technical soundboard and player\-coach without needing to be the primary author of design specs or code. * Drive operational health, system reliability, and observability for team\-owned services and client applications, including participating in incident escalation management and post\-incident reviews. * Optimize sprint planning, grooming, story pointing, and retrospectives to scale practices and improve delivery metrics across client engineering initiatives. * Guide teams in operational best practices, actively raising the bar for observability, reliability, and system resilience. Design, stress\-test, and refine systems for maintainability. * Improve the team's processes and response rhythms for handling high\-pressure situations, scope changes, or production incidents, fostering an environment of composure and continuous learning. * Develop, test, document, and deploy high quality software into production. * Develop a fundamental understanding of our industry, product, feature set and roadmap. * Work closely with our product team, design, and other internal stakeholders to make technology decisions that grow and improve our products. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to address urgent issues outside business hours and contribute to app enhancements and operational efficiency (OE) by troubleshooting and resolving application\-related problems. * Escalate when tasks or projects hit roadblocks. * Be open to occasional travel to Fanatics offices and other locations for conferences, events, meetings, and team\-building activities. ### **Experience and Skills** * 7\+ years of software engineering experience with 2\+ years of direct engineering management or technical leadership experience managing software engineers. * Demonstrated experience hiring, mentoring, and growing engineering talent, building high\-performing, inclusive teams. * Strong technical foundation in mobile or client\-service systems, with sufficient architectural depth to evaluate designs, guide trade\-offs, and support engineering best practices. * Proven track record of managing delivery plans, unblocking engineers, and driving operational rigor and quality in an Agile/Scrum environment. * Team\-first mentality, with a willingness to do what it takes to get the job done and a desire to strive for better. * Able to effectively communicate complex technical subjects to a variety of audiences (engineers, technical leaders, marketing and operations teams, non\-technical functional leaders). * Familiar with Agile software product delivery and SCRUM methodology. * Thrives in a high\-growth environment where priorities evolve regularly and decisions are made quickly. * Able to effectively work cross\-functionally within an enterprise environment. * A Bachelor's degree, or professional certification, or a combination of education and experience **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience designing and building backend services using Spring Boot or similar Java frameworks * Experience working in large\-scale distributed systems and event\-driven architectures * Exposure to cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and observability tools * Familiarity with functional programming paradigms and actor\-based concurrency frameworks like Apache Pekko (or Akka). *If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!* Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in\-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi\-day cultural immersion in New York City for full\-time, non\-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

jobs.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: **About MISUMI Americas** MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas. The Senior Manufacturing Engineer role is a senior\-level, hands\-on manufacturing engineering position responsible for defining how custom parts are built and priced—reviewing manufacturability, generating competitive quotes, and providing design feedback that brings products to market faster. The role serves as a technical authority who helps raise the bar for costing and DFM (Design for Manufacturability) quality across regions. MISUMI Americas serves three sets of customers—builders who order parts through us, manufacturing partners who make and assemble those parts, and our world\-class sales professionals who rely on fast, accurate quoting and DFM support to win and serve accounts. This role sits at the interface of all three. As a senior member of the team, this person also coaches and mentors other engineers and partners closely with the Global Capability Center (GCC) Costing and DFM team, with room to grow their scope and influence over time. **Manufacturing Engineering \& Quoting** * Release package review — Analyze models, drawings, parts lists, and other data to determine scope of work, manufacturing feasibility, requirements, and minimum lead time. * Quoting — Combine engineering analysis with platform recommendations to generate quotes for builders or collaborate with external suppliers to determine the parameters needed to quote. * Cost calculator generation — Use fabrication expertise and an understanding of process cost drivers to build cost calculators that bring quoting in\-house for new service offerings. * DFx feedback — Provide design\-for\-manufacturability and design\-for\-assembly feedback to builders, recommending changes that improve manufacturability, reduce part cost, or ease assembly. * Automation feedback — Feed insights back to the quoting software team to improve the accuracy of automated quoting across manufacturing services. * Drawing generation — Produce high\-quality 2D drawings per ANSI/ASME Y14\.5 standards. jobs.description: Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost\-effective, multi\-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by *TIME* as a “Best Invention”, *MIT Technology Review* as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and *Fast Company* as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron\-air batteries is underway at our first high\-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now \- right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing \- might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better. **Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading \- you’ve come to the right place.** **Role Description** -------------------- Form Energy is hiring a Senior Test Engineer to join our Systems Test organization onsite at Form Factory 1 (FF1\) in Weirton, West Virginia. In this role, you will be the primary on\-site mechanical test engineering owner responsible for the execution, hands\-on root\-cause analysis, and telemetry data reporting across major multi\-pack integrated test assets and mechanical subsystems. You will partner closely with the California\-based mechanical test engineering organization to co\-develop, refine, and translate mechanical, structural, fluidic, and thermal requirements and DFMEAs into rigorous, executable test plans following the Test @ Form process. Onsite in Weirton, your primary focus will be leading physical test execution (including structural loading, transportation vibration, seismic simulation, pressure/leak verification, and fluidic flow characterization), triaging mechanical anomalies, and validating data integrity to feed actionable results back to design and test engineering teams. *Relocation assistance is available.* ### **What you'll do:** * Partner closely with the California\-based mechanical test engineering team to translate mechanical, structural, and fluidic requirements and DFMEAs into actionable test plans (VERTs/VALs) following the Test @ Form process. * Lead physical test execution across module stands, auxiliary skids, and multi\-pack test assets in Weirton, WV. * Execute campaigns covering structural loading, transportation vibration/shock, seismic simulation, and fluidic handling loops (electrolyte, N2 purge, hydrogen dilution, and air\-handling circuits). * Collaborate with partnering design and test engineers to deploy and calibrate mechanical test rigs, pressure decay fixtures, strain gauge layouts, accelerometers, load cells, and flow/pressure instrumentation. * Act as the primary on\-site triager when mechanical or fluidic anomalies occur (e.g., seal leaks, structural deflection, flow restrictions, or mechanical fatigue), applying pressure decay, dye testing, and structural inspection techniques to isolate root causes. * Process raw mechanical telemetry (strain, acceleration/vibration spectra, fluid flow rates, differential pressures, temperatures) to validate data integrity and synthesize findings into clear, actionable test reports for CA and WV engineering stakeholders. * Enforce strict mechanical/fluidic safety protocols, pressure vessel safety standards, Lock\-Out/Tag\-Out (LOTO), chemical handling guidelines, and 5S standards in the laboratory. ### **What you'll bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in mechanical test engineering, structural/vibration testing, fluidic system validation, or physical laboratory testing (highly valued within battery systems, EV, aerospace, grid\-scale storage, or heavy industrial sectors). * Proven experience deriving mechanical and fluidic test plans directly from structural/fluid requirements, CAD/FEA/CFD design intent, and DFMEAs. * Strong technical background in fluid mechanics, piping/tubing manifolds, pumps, valves, pressure regulation, and gas dilution/purging systems. * Direct familiarity with structural loading, vibration/shock testing standards (e.g., ISTA, ASTM, MIL\-STD), and seismic testing methodologies. * Practical expertise with mechanical instrumentation: strain gauges, load cells, accelerometers, pressure transducers, flow meters, and thermal cameras. * Proficiency using data acquisition systems and analysis tools (Python, MATLAB, LabVIEW, or similar suites). * Familiarity with Atlassian toolsets (JIRA, Confluence) and requirements management platforms (e.g., Jama) ### **Where you'll work:** This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000\-square\-foot facility is our hub for high\-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. **Relocation assistance is available.** *\#LI\-Onsite* *Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.* *When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full\-time employees \- and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.* *To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.* *If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.* *Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will* ***never*** *solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.*

jobs.title: Controls & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive. We deliver automation through a Robotics\-as\-a\-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full\-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment. Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high\-performance, Made in America production. **About the team:** The Project Engineering Team is a multidisciplinary engineering group within Automation Engineering Group, bringing mechanical, electrical, and controls engineering together under a single organization. The team serves as the engineering escalation path for the deployed fleet, taking on problems that exceed field\-level troubleshooting and converting them into scoped, engineered, and standardized solutions. The team's work spans three connected areas. The first is the troubleshooting of complex problems: diagnosing multi\-discipline failures across deployed robotic systems and engineering permanent, root\-cause fixes rather than repeat repairs. The second is continuous improvement: converting recurring issues and field data into reliability upgrades and fleet\-wide standardization. The third is support for existing and new product development and enhancements, in partnership with teams across the organization, to improve equipment currently in the field and to bring new capability online. Positioned at the intersection of design, commissioning, and field support, the team operates as a cross\-functional unit, with engineers at the Bolingbrook hub working alongside field implementation resources across North America. The work is a deliberate blend of reactive support and proactive engineering, and each role on the team contributes to uptime, performance consistency, and long\-term customer outcomes across the fleet. **About the role:** As a Controls and Automation Engineer, you will apply advanced engineering principles to the design, analysis, optimization, reliability, and continuous improvement of deployed robotic systems. You will independently evaluate complex, multidisciplinary technical problems, develop engineered solutions, and exercise technical judgment in determining how those solutions are designed, validated, and implemented across Formic's fleet in demanding production environments. This role blends reactive support with proactive engineering. You will diagnose complex issues, implement structured improvements, and partner cross\-functionally to strengthen system stability across the fleet. Your work directly impacts uptime, performance consistency, and long\-term customer outcomes. **In this role, you will:** * As a Robotics and Automation Project Engineer, Provide advanced engineering support for escalated technical issues, analyzing system behavior and developing troubleshooting and remediation strategies for execution by onsite teams. * Diagnose and resolve complex automation failures to minimize production downtime * Design and implement preventative and predictive strategies that improve system reliability * Lead system\-level continuous improvement initiatives, including hardware and software upgrades * Analyze production data and diagnostic trends to identify systemic performance gaps * Provide remote support by responding to service tickets, guiding troubleshooting efforts, and triaging to onsite teams when needed * Partner with Product, Deployment, and Engineering teams to standardize equipment configurations and improve repeatability * Own and maintain system documentation, including procedures, maintenance logs, and change\-control records * Serve as the escalation point for complex technical issues across the fleet * Mentor field technicians and engineers on troubleshooting and system health best practices * Ensure compliance with safety standards, internal quality requirements, and industry regulations * Collaborate with vendors to improve parts availability, diagnostics capability, and technical support **What makes you a great fit:** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, controls engineering, mechatronics, robotics engineering, or another directly related engineering discipline * 10\+ years of experience in manufacturing automation or industrial robotics environments * Strong proficiency in programming PLCs, robots, and industrial control systems * Solid understanding of robotic systems, motion systems, and automated manufacturing equipment * Hands\-on experience diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and control system failures * Ability to read electrical schematics and technical drawings * Experience working in uptime\-critical manufacturing environments * Strong problem\-solving skills and structured troubleshooting approach * Clear written and verbal communication skills * Ability to work independently while collaborating cross\-functionally * Willingness to travel up to 50% based on business needs * Valid driver's license and ability to support local travel **Bonus points if you have:** * Experience in high\-volume manufacturing environments * Experience standardizing equipment across multiple deployed sites * Exposure to data\-driven maintenance or predictive monitoring tools **What we look for:** We're building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you! * **Fearless Optimism:** You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren't paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn't yet exist. * **Create the Magic:** You absorb complexity so customers don't have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value\-added, and outcome\-driven. You don't say "not my job." You make things work. * **Today, Not Tomorrow:** You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don't confuse activity with results. * **Seek Truth:** You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You're willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer. * **Made of Rubber:** You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit. * **One Formic:** You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit. **Equal Opportunity Employment:** Formic is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion or religious creed, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, marital status, family or parental status, disability, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. All employment decisions are based on a person's merit, business needs, and role requirements. If you require further accommodations or have questions regarding accessibility of our roles, please reach out to careers@formic.co. **AI Use:** At Formic, fairness and transparency are at the heart of our hiring process. We use AI\-powered tools in some interviews to help our teams evaluate candidate responses, but all final hiring decisions are made by humans. You can learn more about how AI is used in our recruitment process by reviewing our AI Hiring Disclosure linked here.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **About Formlabs:** A 3D printer is one of the most demanding machines you can build. Lasers, optics, precision motion, thermals, airflow, materials handling, chemistry, sensing, controls, and software all have to work at micron\-scale precision, for thousands of layers, with almost no tolerance for error. Making that work reliably is an extraordinary engineering problem. That's what we do. At Formlabs, we're building 3D printers that are changing the way things get made. We have the smartest minds across every engineering discipline, and the technology they're building is deployed at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. If you're energized by the idea of making the impossible happen, come join us as an **Electrical Engineer.** **Include an example of your work with your application to show us what you can do.** **The Job:** * Design and build prototypes and production electronic systems, including circuit design, PCB layout, bring up, and validation Own projects, not skills * \- this role is for a "full\-stack" engineer with a focus on shipping products, not a specialist in any one area of electronics engineering Go beyond the board * \- be responsible for the design of subsystems such as sensors, actuators, and optoelectronics that require tradeoffs between electrical and mechanical requirements * Back up your design decisions with data gathered through simulations and experiments * Hone your skills and grow: engineers at Formlabs have grown into deep technical experts, system architects, product technical leads, and team leaders / managers. We support talented people growing in any direction. **You:** * Are an electrical engineering generalist, comfortable with analog and digital design, PCB layout, validation, and debugging techniques Are comfortable working with electronics that interact with the physical world * \- our most complex problems tend to involve the integration of electronics, mechanical designs, and systems integration. * Are hands\-on and interested in supporting your designs throughout the product life cycle, from early research to debugging field failures **Bonus Skills:** * Familiarity with embedded software development, for example: microcontroller firmware developed in C or C\+\+, device drivers or board support packages for embedded Linux systems, or C\+\+ application development. Hardware design is a core part of our team's responsibilities, but we also extend into low\-level software development when knowledge of the physical system is key to writing the best code. **Our Perks \& Benefits:** * Unlimited 3D printing with any Formlabs material on any Formlabs printer * An equity program that will let you build wealth through RSUs * Healthcare coverage (medical, dental, vision) that includes a totally free employee\-only plan, effective starting on your first day on the job * 401K matching with no vesting or tenure requirement * Generous parental leave (fully paid up to 16 weeks) * Flexible time off so you can take time when you need it * Six\-week fully paid sabbatical after hitting tenure milestones (with the option to take an additional six weeks after that) * Free on\-site parking \& pre\-tax commuter benefits * Free on\-site lunch, snacks, beverages, treats, beer kegs, and employee\-favorite local coffee and espresso * Self\-driven professional development opportunities like conferences, trade shows, and hackathons * One\-of\-a\-kind activities and events like monthly socials, the annual weekend summer camp, a can't\-miss company hackathon, and lots of other social opportunities **You don't need to check every box to apply for a role. Rate** * **No Trouble Found (NTF) Rate** * **Root\-Cause \& Corrective\-Action Closure** * **Engineering Hold Aging** Success requires balancing **repair speed, technical accuracy, product quality, cost, and customer satisfaction**, rather than simply maximizing repair volume.**Customer \& Cross\-Functional Leadership*** Serve as a senior technical escalation point for critical customer and field issues. * Coordinate containment, failure reproduction, root\-cause investigation, corrective action, validation, and effectiveness monitoring. * Lead technical reviews and communicate complex failures clearly to engineering, operations, customers, and executive leadership. * Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Test, Process Engineering, NPI, Program Management, Supply Chain, suppliers, and customer engineering organizations. * Ensure field\-return data is translated into actionable improvements to manufacturing processes, test coverage, supplier quality, firmware, and manufacturing, or related industries. * **3\+ years** of engineering leadership or people\-management experience. * Strong experience with **system\-level troubleshooting, failure analysis, manufacturing, repair, RMA, NPI, or field\-return operations**. * Demonstrated ability to lead complex root\-cause investigations and corrective actions. * Experience working directly with customers, methodologies * MES, PLM, QMS, ERP, and RMA tracking systems * ISO 9001 or similar quality\-management environments * Accelerated\-computing or advanced GPU server architectures **Leadership urgency without sacrificing technical rigor * Effective cross\-functional and supplier leadership * Clear written, verbal, and executive\-level communication * Ability to develop engineers, technical leads, and repair technicians Above all, this leader understands the difference between **replacing the failed part, repairing the system, and eliminating the root cause**. 5nte0RCue7

jobs.title: SafeGrid Regional Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Regional Solutions Engineer – SafeGrid** The Regional Solutions Engineer (RSE) is responsible for maintaining and growing revenue within an assigned region by combining account management with technical solution positioning.
