The RSE is the primary technical and commercial point of contact for assigned utility accounts, positioned to customers as a solutions and engineering resource rather than a traditional sales representative. In the SafeGrid go\-to\-market model, the RSE is the named technical owner for an account from initial discovery through purchase order — referred to in GTM and sales\-process materials as the “SafeGrid Solution Specialist” or “SG Expert.” At Order Management, primary ownership transitions to the SafeGrid Technical Solutions Engineer (SG\-TSE aka SG\-AE), and the RSE's role shifts from leading to reviewing — remaining the account's L1 support contact and the person best positioned to identify the next expansion opportunity. **As a Regional Solutions Engineer you will:** ***Regional Revenue \& Account Ownership*** * Own regional revenue performance across assigned accounts, including forecasting, pipeline management, and bookings against quota. * Lead customer\-facing sales calls and technical discussions positioned around system expansion, reliability outcomes, and grid modernization — not product pitches. * Coordinate with external sales representative firms operating in the region to ensure consistent account coverage and message alignment. ***New Customer Acquisition (Land)*** * **Discovery / Interest:** Lead the initial one\-hour meeting and educate the customer on SafeGrid's value proposition. * **Evaluation / Buy\-In:** Lead the evaluation process, educating stakeholders and building internal buy\-in with support from the SafeGrid TSE on follow\-ups. * **Intent / Agreement:** Coordinate the proposal — translating topology into a formal quote — while the Sales Rep drives commercial progress and the SafeGrid TSE leads the process. * **Action / Purchase:** Lead the customer through budget, terms, and standards discussions, supported by the SafeGrid TSE, ahead of PO issuance. ***SafeGrid Solution Selling \& Technical Positioning*** * Identify and develop expansion opportunities within existing accounts for SafeGrid hardware and SaaS components, building on installed\-base relationships. * Develop and deliver solution\-oriented value propositions focused on improving grid reliability, enhancing system resiliency, and mitigating operational and environmental risks. * Support commercial terms discussions, including SaaS contract structure, in partnership with Contracts and Legal. ***Account Handoff \& Post\-Sale Technical Support*** * Transition account ownership to the SafeGrid Technical Solutions Engineer (AE) once a Purchase Order is received, ensuring a clean handoff with no loss of customer momentum. * Serve as the L1 support contact for assigned accounts once installed — the first response for customer technical questions, escalating account\-level issues to the Customer Success Engineer (L2\), engineering\-level issues to PGA Engineering (L3\), and platform or data\-science issues to SG Finland (L4\). * Participate in installation, training, and system configuration and finalization activities alongside the SafeGrid Technical Solutions Engineer (AE) and, where required, PGA Engineering. knowledge of electrical distribution systems, protection and control concepts, or grid monitoring technologies. * Experience managing a revenue\-bearing territory or account base, including forecasting and pipeline discipline. * Ability to translate technical capability into customer\-specific operational and financial value. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to both engineering and commercial stakeholders. * Proficiency with Salesforce (SFDC) or equivalent CRM for pipeline management and reporting. **Ideally you will also have:** * Prior experience with SaaS or subscription\-based solution selling alongside hardware. * Existing relationships with utility engineering, operations, or asset management organizations within the assigned jobs.description: At GSK we see a world in which advanced applications of Artificial Intelligence will allow us to develop novel therapies to existing diseases and to quickly respond to emerging or changing diseases with personalized drugs, driving better outcomes at reduced cost with fewer side effects. It is an ambitious vision that will require the development of products and solutions at the cutting edge of AI and Machine LEarning. We're looking for an accomplished **Machine Learning Engineer** to help make this vision a reality. In this role, you will imagine and engineer agentic systems and machine learning models to elucidate the molecular mechanisms of disease and accelerate the development of new therapies. You will work with frontier models, foundational genomics models, and multiomics datasets from patients and lab experiments to model aspects of molecular biology and medicinal chemistry that will inform our understanding of disease, drug design and response, and longevity. Familiarity and experience with genomics and RNA biology is a plus, but not required. This position is open to machine learning engineers with a track record of excellence in other domains who have a desire to learn. Strong candidates will have a track record of shipping high performing AI/ML products, academic excellence, and a passion for solving challenging problems in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Education in the biological sciences is a plus but is not necessary; passion to help therapies for new and existing diseases, and a pattern of continuous learning and development is mandatory. The AI/ML team is built on the principles of ownership, accountability, continuous development, and collaboration. We hire for the long term, and we're motivated to make this a great place to work. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. If salary ranges are not displayed in the job posting for a specific country, the relevant compensation will be discussed during the recruitment process. Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees. **Why GSK?** **Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.** GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale. People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. jobs.title: Senior Security Software Engineer, Advanced Security
jobs.description: **Job Description** **The Role** General Motors’ Advanced Security Engineering team develops advanced security capabilities to help secure GM and reduce real security exposure. We leverage artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities to strengthen defenses, validate weaknesses, and support authorized offensive security testing in controlled environments. By combining security findings with code, cloud, and runtime context, we identify issues that are real and reachable and help deliver remediation, mitigation, or detection. You will design, build, and operate the cloud services and AI agents that support this work. These systems analyze untrusted code, handle sensitive security data, and give agents controlled access to security tools and computing environments. Designing that access safely is a core part of the role. As a senior individual contributor, you will work independently with minimal guidance, turn broad challenges into practical engineering solutions, and own delivery across team boundaries. You will evaluate options, exercise sound technical judgment when information is limited, and bring your work through review at key decision points. You will be accountable for the reliability, security, and cost of the systems you deliver. This is an opportunity to help shape a new team and build new security capabilities at GM. You will help define what to build, not only how to build it, while collaborating with security specialists and mentoring other engineers. **What You’ll Do** * Design, build, and operate production cloud services in Python, including containerized workloads, event\-driven processing, and data storage. Define and manage the supporting infrastructure as code. * Integrate findings and context from security tools, source control, and cloud application programming interfaces (APIs). Build AI agents that triage findings, gather evidence from source code and cloud configuration, and propose fixes. * Build and harden sandboxed environments for AI\-enabled testing of authorized targets. Apply defense in depth, designing for the possibility that any individual containment boundary can fail. * Control agent access through isolation, least\-privilege identities, network egress limits, and secrets management. Separate agents that produce results from those that verify them. Treat source code, tool output, and model responses as untrusted input, defend against prompt injection, and keep sensitive data out of prompts and logs. * Evaluate model accuracy, cost, and latency to inform model selection and detect regressions. Use evidence to explain technical trade\-offs and guide improvements to the systems you own. Partner with application security, penetration testing, and cloud security engineers to turn expert judgment into repeatable checks and deliver solutions across teams. Communicate technical risks and recommendations to non\-specialists, review code, and mentor less\-experienced engineers through constructive feedback and collaborative problem\-solving. * **Your Skills \& Abilities (Required Qualifications)** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, or security engineering. * Strong experience writing production Python. * Experience with infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) on a major cloud platform. * Working knowledge of application security, including common vulnerability classes, how security scanners work, and where they produce false positives. * Experience building secure systems using least privilege, secrets management, isolation, and safe handling of untrusted input. * Ability to own work across teams, make sound decisions with limited information, and explain technical risk to people who are not security specialists. Experience using agentic large language model (LLM) tools and solutions. * **What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)** * Experience building applications with large language models and agent frameworks, including tool use and output evaluation. * Experience with containers and Kubernetes. * Experience with sandboxing and isolation, or securing systems that execute untrusted code. * Experience with static or program analysis, such as writing Semgrep or CodeQL rules. * Experience in vulnerability research, penetration testing, or exploit development. * Familiarity with AI security risks and controls, such as the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 for LLM Applications. Public examples of shipped work, such as open\-source contributions, published tools, or technical write\-ups. * \#LI\-SB3 \&\#xa;\&\#xa;GM does not provide immigration\-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1\-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J\-1, etc).\&\#xa;\&\#xa;This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Relocation benefits are available for candidates who qualify under company policy.\&\#xa;\&\#xa; **About GM** Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all. **Why Join Us** We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team. **Benefits Overview** From day one, we're looking out for your well\-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting **Total Rewards resources** . **Non\-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.)** General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role\-related assessment(s) and/or a pre\-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit **How we Hire** . **Accommodations** General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. jobs.description: **Job Description** The Executive Lead for Global SMB Engineering is the senior technology executive for Global Payments' SMB business worldwide. It carries full accountability for technology strategy, engineering delivery and platform health across a global organization of around 3,500 people. This role sets the leadership direction for SMB engineering and owns the platforms behind our SMB products, which serve over 6 million merchants. The role has two priorities: keep delivering the products merchants rely on today, and modernize the platforms behind them for the next decade. Modernization includes standardizing and simplifying our product estate to remove duplication. It also means moving to API first, cloud native, event driven architecture, setting one standard for how software is built, tested and operated across SMB, and making a step change in developer productivity. The role partners closely with Product leadership and the business to decide what we build, what we buy, and which technology partners we work with. It leads engineering delivery against those plans and is measured on results against growth, reliability and security targets. **What you'll own** ------------------- * SMB engineering strategy, with every major investment tied to growth, reliability or security outcomes. * A global engineering organization of around 3,500 people, including its operating model and the strength of its leadership team. * Standardizing and simplifying the SMB product estate, and moving it to API first, cloud native, event driven design. * One standard for SDLC, testing and SRE practice across every SMB team, with developer productivity measured and improved. * Delivery of the largest SMB programs in modernization, resiliency, performance and cost, with the organization held to its commitments on scope, quality and timelines. * PCI DSS compliance and data privacy across all SMB platforms, working with Risk and Security on threat modeling and fraud mitigation. * Build or buy decisions, made together with Product leadership and the business, plus governance and performance management of strategic technology vendors. * Joint delivery with Product, Operations, Finance and Sales so that engineering work shows up in commercial results. * A clear point of view on unified commerce, embedded payments and AI in risk and operations, built into the roadmap. * Hiring, developing and keeping strong engineering leaders, with successors in place for senior roles. * Representing SMB engineering to the CTO, the President of SMB and the Senior Leadership Team. **What you bring:** * You've led engineering at global scale on large, customer\-facing platforms, at or close to the top technology seat. * You've led large engineering organizations and set their vision, plan and roadmap. * You have a strong product engineering background and know how to run platforms that customers depend on every day. * You have a record of delivering complex integrations and APIs, with results you can show on resiliency, security and performance. * You've owned enterprise and platform architecture, including a large cloud modernization. * You make sound build or buy calls across development, corporate applications and cloud. * You've moved a legacy estate onto a modern platform while keeping the business running. * You turn business goals into technology priorities and make trade\-offs in the open. * You've changed engineering culture at scale. * You build teams by growing internal talent and hiring leaders others want to work for. **What sets you apart** ----------------------- * You've led engineering through an acquisition, from diligence to post\-merger integration. * You've applied AI and machine learning to fraud and risk, routing or developer productivity. * You've scaled a platform used by millions of small businesses. * You have experience in payments, POS or omnichannel commerce. **Leadership Competencies** --------------------------- This leader helps decide where Global Payments competes and how it wins. The role needs deep business knowledge, a global view and the ability to keep changing as the business and the market change. * **Shape direction.** Read change early, challenge assumptions and make the calls that set the company up for what comes next. * **Transform to win.** Redesign how work gets done, combining people, AI, automation and systems to make better decisions faster and raise performance. * **Strengthen connection.** Build trust through consistency and accountability, rally people around a shared purpose and develop successors. **Global Payment Perks \- what we'll bring for you** ---------------------------------------------------- We know it’s bigger than just your career. Our passion drives excellence in everything we set out to do. * **Accountable. Empowered. Innovative.** We take accountability – working at pace to own our outcomes. jobs.title: AI enabled PDK Development Engineer
jobs.description: About GlobalFoundries GlobalFoundries is a leading full\-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com. Summary of Role GlobalFoundries is seeking an AI\-Enabled PDK Development Engineer with strong artificial intelligence and software\-engineering skills to develop, implement, test, and support AI\-guided physical\-verification, extraction, manufacturability, and design\-documentation solutions. The engineer will work closely with technical experts in PDK development who will provide domain expertise across LVS, DRC, PEX, OPC, and Design Manual development. The role will apply Python, machine learning, large language models, code generation, natural\-language processing, and software\-development practices to improve efficiency and quality for advanced CMOS, cryogenic, quantum, photonic, and heterogeneous\-integration technologies. Semiconductor or prior PDK experience is beneficial but not required. **Essential Responsibilities** Develop, implement, test, maintain, and support PDK code and rule content for layout\-versus\-schematic (LVS), design\-rule checking (DRC), parasitic extraction (PEX), optical proximity correction (OPC), and associated Design Manual requirements. Apply AI\-guided methods to generate, translate, review, debug, optimize, and regression\-test rule\-deck code under established expert review, traceability, and release controls. Implement, test, and support automated pipelines that convert approved process and design requirements into structured rules, test cases, documentation, and quality evidence. Contribute to the development and maintenance of representative positive and negative test layouts, golden reference results, coverage metrics, and regression suites for physical\-verification and extraction deliverables. Use machine learning, natural\-language processing, code\-generation techniques, and data analytics to identify rule gaps, inconsistencies, duplicate content, likely failure modes, and opportunities for development acceleration. Analyze and correlate PEX and OPC outputs with silicon, process, metrology, electromagnetic, and simulation data as applicable, and contribute improvements to model and rule fidelity across relevant operating conditions. Implement, test, document, and support deliverables within commercial EDA environments and PDK release flows, using version control, continuous integration, issue tracking, change management, and release documentation. Collaborate with process integration, device, modeling, mask, lithography, design enablement, PDK, EDA, and circuit\-design teams to translate technology requirements into accurate, maintainable, and customer\-usable design collateral. **Other Responsibilities** Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety \& Security requirements and programs. Work and collaborate on other projects and/or assignments as needed. **Required Qualifications** Education \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Microelectronics, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. Experience \- Relevant experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, software engineering, data science, automation, or a closely related field. Approximately 2\+ years of relevant experience for Level 5 and 3\-5\+ years for Level 6 are preferred; final experience requirements and leveling will be aligned with GF scoping guidelines. Relevant academic research, internships, co\-ops, and substantial project experience may be considered. Strong Python programming and software\-engineering skills, including development of maintainable code, automated testing, debugging, version control, documentation, and integration of software components or workflows. Strong practical experience with AI/ML methods, large language models, code generation, natural\-language processing, retrieval or knowledge\-grounding techniques, optimization, or data analytics applied to engineering or software\-development workflows. Demonstrated ability to learn a highly technical domain, collaborate closely with subject\-matter experts, and translate domain requirements into accurate, maintainable, and testable software solutions. Proficiency with at least one additional programming language or development environment such as Tcl, Perl, C/C\+\+, Java, or equivalent, and experience working in Linux/Unix environments. Ability to validate AI\-generated outputs through deterministic checks, regression testing, expert review, version control, and documented acceptance criteria. Experience designing and executing automated tests, regression suites, acceptance criteria, and structured technical documentation for software or AI\-enabled workflows. Travel \- Up to 10%. Fluency in English \- written and verbal. **Preferred Qualifications** Semiconductor, foundry, or PDK background, including familiarity with semiconductor device physics, process layers, devices, connectivity, geometry rules, parasitic effects, layout verification, and PDK release practices. Experience with EDA rule\-deck development or physical\-verification and extraction platforms for LVS, DRC, PEX, or OPC, such as Siemens Calibre, Synopsys IC Validator/StarRC, Cadence Pegasus/PVS/Quantus, or equivalent tools. Experience developing AI\-assisted coding agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, rule or code translation, automated test generation, static analysis, or engineering knowledge systems. Experience with foundry Design Manual development, machine\-readable design\-rule specifications, requirements traceability, or links among documentation, rule decks, and test cases. Knowledge of PCell and technology\-file development, reliability rules, density/fill, antenna checking, electromagnetic extraction, or advanced\-package/3DIC verification. Experience with cryogenic, quantum, photonic, superconducting, advanced packaging, or heterogeneous\-integration design enablement. Familiarity with model governance, data provenance, secure use of proprietary design data, reproducibility, and responsible deployment of AI\-enabled engineering methods. Experience with continuous integration/continuous delivery, containerized environments, issue\-tracking systems, and automated PDK QA dashboards. Project execution and organizational skills, including the ability to contribute ideas, implement practical solutions, collaborate effectively, and navigate ambiguity. Strong written and verbal communication skills and strong planning and organizational skills. **Expected Salary Range** $69,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 The exact Salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience and location. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact us by email at usaccommodations@gf.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. Requests for accommodation will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. Please note that only inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to from this email address. An offer with GlobalFoundries is conditioned upon the successful completion of pre\-employment conditions, as applicable, and subject to applicable laws and regulations. GlobalFoundries is fully committed to equal opportunity in the workplace and believes that cultural diversity within the company enhances its business potential. GlobalFoundries goal of excellence in business necessitates the attraction and retention of highly qualified people. Artificial barriers and stereotypic biases detract from this objective and may be illegally discriminatory. All policies and processes which pertain to employees including recruitment, selection, training, utilization, promotion, compensation, benefits, extracurricular programs, and termination are created and implemented without regard to age, ethnicity, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third\-party affiliation, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic or category specified by local, state or federal law

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. These generally include medical, dental, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance. Holiday \& Vacation Policies We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year. Financial Wellness \& Retirement We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities. We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state\-of\-the\-art on\-site health centers in certain offices. This highly visible role combines advanced modeling with extensive stakeholder engagement: you’ll explain complex methodologies, navigate diverse perspectives, support member understanding, and help turn analytical results into informed program decisions. A typical day may consist of: * Lead complex SERVM studies covering LOLE, ELCC, capacity accreditation, and planning reserve margins * Recommend study assumptions, sensitivities, and methodologies, and work with WRAP participants to build understanding and alignment * Serve as the primary technical liaison for members, committees, vendors, regulators, leadership, and the board * Translate complex analyses into clear reports, presentations, board materials, and defensible recommendations * Build strong member relationships by answering technical questions, addressing concerns, and explaining implications for the WRAP program * Establish QA/QC and model\-governance standards and review the team’s modeling work * Mentor engineers and analysts and promote consistent technical and documentation practices * Identify emerging reliability risks and resolve complex or precedent\-setting analytical issues * Represent WPP at stakeholder meetings and industry forums **Who You Are:** You’re a technical expert in probabilistic resource adequacy modeling who has led complex SERVM studies and stood behind the results. You understand that your analysis informs significant utility planning and investment decisions, and you build confidence by engaging stakeholders openly, answering tough questions, and making complex findings understandable. Qualifications include: * **Experience:** Typically 10\+ years of progressively responsible experience in resource adequacy, generation or transmission planning, integrated resource planning, power\-system analysis, or electric markets * **SERVM:** Recent, hands\-on experience leading complex SERVM studies, including LOLE and ELCC, capacity accreditation, and planning reserve margin work * **Technical leadership:** Experience leading highly complex studies, setting QA/QC and model\-governance standards, mentoring others, and resolving novel technical issues * **Communication:** Strong public speaker and writer with experience presenting technical work to boards, regulators, committees, or executives * **Tools:** Advanced skills in Python, SQL, R, MATLAB, or Excel * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Energy Systems, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field Preferred Qualifications: * Knowledge of resource adequacy practices in the Western Interconnect, or experience at WRAP, an ISO or RTO, or a utility * Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Operations Research, Statistics, or a related field **Who We Are:** Western Power Pool (WPP) is a non\-profit organization that helps keep the lights on by ensuring power utilities in the West achieve maximum benefits from coordinated operations. Our work is customer\-driven, relationship\-based, and collaborative. We’ve been serving the energy sector for over 80 years and are at the forefront of ensuring the reliability and security of the power grid while spearheading the integration of renewable energy sources. jobs.title: IT Operations Team Lead (Fulfillment Centres)
jobs.description: **The role** ------------ For our growing North America IT function, we are looking for a Team Lead, IT Operations to own the technology experience across all US fulfillment centres. Spanning locations from Phoenix to Newark, this is the most operationally embedded senior IT leadership role in the North America portfolio; directly accountable for the infrastructure, endpoints, and field technology that keep HelloFresh's US fulfillment network running. You will translate global IT strategy into consistent, high\-performance execution at every US site; driving standardization, being a business partner for key initiatives, and ensuring the endpoint and device estate that underpins daily fulfillment operations is resilient and well\-managed. As the lead you will operate as the trusted senior IT interface for USA Operations leadership, be an active contributor to Global IT strategy, and a HelloFresh DNA ambassador across the Field IT team. Above all, we are looking for people who will **make HelloFresh** **better.** We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own the Fulfillment Centre IT portfolio roadmap,** setting direction across service delivery, tooling, and team capability across all US Fulfillment Centres. Make trade\-off decisions quickly, communicate them clearly to operations leadership, and reduce ambiguity for your team. * **Be present in the field.** Regular travel across US sites is expected. You assess what is happening on the ground, make decisions in the room, and hold the standard. When a site is struggling, you go there. * **Lead the Fulfillment Centre IT team** dispersed across US locations, balancing performance management with the freedom to operate. Coach engineers into IT leaders. Recognize contributions and manage conflicts before they become problems. * **Act as the senior IT interface for USA Operations leadership,** building trusted relationships with site directors and operations VPs. Communicate proactively, push back when an ask is unreasonable, and deliver credible timelines. Operations culture in Fulfillment Centres is demanding and fast\-paced, and you are practiced enough in that environment to hold your position without it becoming adversarial. * **Lead major cross\-functional projects and initiatives:** You'll be a key partner for standardization across all Fulfillment Centres. Including coordinating IT coverage and readiness during changeover windows, and technology refreshes, and rollouts in collaboration with the production technology and network infrastructure teams. * **Own the full endpoint and device estate for field operations:** MDM (Jamf/Intune), Zscaler deployment, and endpoint compliance across all locations. Use Jira Service Management data to hold the team accountable for SLA performance. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * **Fulfillment Centre IT Operations Leadership**: Proven senior IT leadership in a Fulfillment Centre, logistics, manufacturing, or high\-density multi\-site environment, with direct accountability for distributed team performance and site\-level infrastructure delivery. * **Willingness and Ability to Travel**: This role requires regular travel across US Fulfillment Centre locations. You are comfortable spending significant time on\-site and prefer direct operational presence to remote coordination. * **Operational Stakeholder Management**: Track record of managing operations leadership, including site directors and VPs, with the confidence to push back on unreasonable asks and the credibility to hold that position. You protect the IT function without becoming an obstacle to the business. * **Infrastructure and Endpoint Depth**: Hands\-on experience with MDM (Jamf for macOS/iOS, Intune for Windows), RF scanner management, FC/DC network infrastructure, and endpoint compliance at scale. Familiarity with WMS platforms (HighJump/Korber or equivalent) and production technology deployment. * **ITSM and Performance Management**: Experience running or improving helpdesk operations using Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent, with a track record of driving first\-contact resolution and SLA improvement across distributed field teams. * **AI and Automation Mindset**: Applied experience using AI tools to improve operational efficiency, personally and within a team. You use the tools and can lead others toward doing the same. **What we offer** ----------------- Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest\-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion. * Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90\+ nationalities. * Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh\- subsidized Pension Scheme and a Hybrid working model. * Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals. * Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy. * Plus, we've got your well\-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working\-parent\-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!

jobs.title: Principal Engineer -- Full-Stack TypeScript (Node.js, React, Cloud)
jobs.description: **WHO WE ARE** -------------- We're Hook, an award\-winning creative content agency. With a collaborative, maker\-centric team, and an emphasis on production\-led design, we make ads, campaigns, and experiences that drive growth for the world's most innovative brands. Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what's most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they've ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they've had yet. **THE ROLE** ------------ We're looking for a senior full\-stack engineer who lives in TypeScript. You write clean, well\-typed, well\-tested TypeScript on both sides of the stack — React and Next.js on the front end, Node.js services and APIs on the back end — and you deploy and operate what you build on Google Cloud or AWS. As a Principal Engineer, you'll own Hook's internal applications and platform end to end: architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and long\-term health. You're self\-directed, comfortable owning complex products from first idea through continued development, and you make confident architectural decisions without needing a roadmap handed to you. When a client project needs a strong technical lead, you step in with that same ownership mindset. **OUR STACK** ------------- * **Language:** TypeScript, end to end * **Front end:** React, Next.js * **Back end:** Node.js, Express (or similar: Fastify, NestJS, Hono), REST and GraphQL APIs * **Cloud:** Google Cloud Platform and AWS (serverless, containers, managed databases, queues, storage), plus Vercel * **Data:** PostgreSQL / relational databases and document stores (Firestore, MongoDB, or similar) * **Tooling:** Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar), modern TypeScript tooling (Vite, Vitest/Jest, ESLint, pnpm/npm workspaces) * **AI:** LLM APIs and AI\-assisted development (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * Architect, build, and ship production full\-stack web applications in TypeScript, from React/Next.js front ends to Node.js services and APIs * Design and own back\-end services, APIs, and integrations with third\-party platforms * Deploy, operate, and monitor applications on Google Cloud or AWS, including infrastructure, CI/CD, task queues, observability, security, and cost * Own product areas end to end: problem discovery, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement * Partner with creative, production, and operations teams to understand their workflows and turn them into reliable, well\-designed software * Integrate AI capabilities (LLM APIs, agents, automation) into the applications you build * Set the technical bar: drive code review, testing standards, documentation, and best practices * Serve as technical lead on select client web projects and occasionally direct freelance developers * Evaluate and recommend tools, frameworks, and approaches as Hook's needs evolve **WHAT YOU'LL NEED** -------------------- * **8\+ years** of professional software engineering experience, with at least **5 years writing production TypeScript/JavaScript** as your primary language * **Expert\-level TypeScript:** advanced types and generics, strict\-mode codebases, type\-safe API contracts, and a strong grasp of the JavaScript runtime (event loop, async patterns, modules, gotchas) * **Deep Node.js experience:** building and maintaining production HTTP APIs and back\-end services with Express or a comparable framework, including auth, validation, error handling, background jobs, and performance * **Deep React expertise:** component architecture, hooks, state management, data fetching, and performance optimization for complex, highly interactive, multi\-user applications, CSS solutions * **Production Next.js experience:** App Router, server components, server\-side rendering, routing, and caching * **Strong hands\-on Google Cloud Platform or AWS experience** — you have personally deployed and operated production applications, not just consumed them. For example: * + GCP: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Cloud SQL, Firestore, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, IAM + AWS: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, S3, IAM * **Containers and delivery:** Docker for development and production, CI/CD pipelines, and environment/secrets management * **Databases:** strong SQL (PostgreSQL or similar) and working knowledge of document databases, including schema design and query performance * **Testing discipline:** unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing (e.g., Vitest/Jest, Playwright) as a normal part of how you ship * **Software engineering fundamentals:** you write secure, reliable, maintainable code and make well\-reasoned architectural trade\-offs without over\-engineering * **AI\-assisted development:** you use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot fluently, while remaining the expert owner of system design and code quality * **Clear communication:** you can explain architecture to engineers and the same ideas, plainly, to creatives, producers, and clients * **Ownership and autonomy:** you thrive with ambiguity, set your own direction, and see work through to production and beyond **NICE TO HAVE** ---------------- * Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or AWS CDK) * Experience building internal tools, workflow automation, or developer/creative productivity platforms * Familiarity with plugin or extension development for creative tools (e.g., Figma, Adobe UXP) — in TypeScript * Python or Bash for scripting and automation * Experience with LLM APIs, AI agents, or AI\-powered product features * Experience working in an agency, studio, or other creatively driven, fast\-paced environment * Open\-source contributions **WHAT ELSE** ------------- Qualified applicants will include a resume, a statement of interest that lets us learn a little more about you, and code samples — a link to your public GitHub or other examples of your work. **Please include TypeScript work (React/Next.js and/or Node.js) where possible.** Be prepared to discuss your code in depth as part of the interview process. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are. Come join us! Hook believes in compensation transparency and equity. We’ve designed a 10\-level advancement framework that’s applied consistently across disciplines and departments and aligns to location\-based salary ranges. This role is leveled as L7\. During the interview process we’ll review your location, skills, experience, and other relevant factors to determine where you fall within our leveling framework and corresponding salary ranges. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Project Manager
jobs.description: **Job Overview** ---------------- The Manufacturing Engineering Project Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating strategic manufacturing projects across multiple Industrial SBU facilities in the United States, Mexico, and Canada. The primary focus of the position is ensuring that each facility has the manufacturing capacity, equipment, processes, and infrastructure required to deliver the annual operating plan while supporting the SBU’s longer\-term, five\-year manufacturing strategy. This position leads a portfolio of approximately five to ten active projects at any given time. Projects will typically include capital equipment and automation investments, capacity expansions, product transfers between facilities, manufacturing process improvements, facility and infrastructure projects, and support for new product development and industrialization. Individual capital projects will generally exceed $500,000, although the portfolio may also include strategically important product transfers or capacity initiatives with limited direct capital investment. The Manufacturing Engineering Project Manager leads projects from concept and business justification through design, funding approval, procurement, implementation, qualification, start\-up, and operational handoff. The role partners closely with manufacturing operations, engineering, finance, sourcing, supply chain, quality, EHS, maintenance, facilities, product management, and external suppliers. This is an individual\-contributor position with significant project and matrix leadership responsibility. The position does not have direct reports but provides direction, coordination, and accountability to cross\-functional project teams across multiple locations. **A Day In The Life** --------------------- Every day at Hubbell is different and you’ll contribute in many ways. On any given day, you’ll make a difference by: **Capacity and Manufacturing Strategy** * Working with SBU and plant leadership to identify capacity requirements necessary to deliver the annual operating plan. * Developing and maintaining a five\-year manufacturing capacity roadmap aligned with expected demand, product strategy, manufacturing footprint, and business growth. **Project and Portfolio Leadership** * Leading a portfolio of approximately five to ten active manufacturing projects across multiple facilities. * Managing capital equipment and automation projects that will typically exceed $500,000 in total project cost. * Leading strategically important product\-transfer and capacity\-expansion projects, including projects with limited capital investment but significant operational complexity or business impact. * Establishing clear project charters that define the business need, scope, objectives, deliverables, financial justification, schedule, assumptions, risks, and required resources. **Capital and Financial Management** * Developing capital expenditure requests and AFEs for manufacturing equipment, automation, tooling, capacity expansion, and facility\-related investments. * Preparing project financial justifications, including capacity requirements, cost estimates, labor impact, productivity improvements, savings, margin contribution, payback, return on investment, and implementation costs. * Managing approved project budgets, purchase commitments, invoice approvals, cash\-flow timing, capital forecasts, and project closeout. **Equipment, Automation, and Supplier Management** * Developing equipment and process specifications based on required capacity, quality, safety, reliability, maintainability, and operating\-cost expectations. * Coordinating technical and commercial evaluations of equipment, automation, tooling, and supplier proposals. * Working with sourcing to select suppliers based on technical capability, quality, delivery performance, total installed cost, lifecycle support, and commercial value. * Leading supplier design reviews and monitoring supplier performance against agreed milestones and deliverables. **Product Transfers and Industrialization** * Leading product transfers between Industrial SBU manufacturing facilities. * Developing transfer plans that address equipment, tooling, routing, capacity, labor, training, inventory, quality, customer approvals, supplier readiness, and production cutover. **Cross\-Functional Leadership** * Providing indirect leadership to engineers, technicians, plant personnel, contractors, suppliers, and other project resources. * Building alignment among manufacturing, operations, engineering, finance, sourcing, supply chain, quality, EHS, maintenance, facilities, product management, and commercial stakeholders. **Operational Readiness and Handoff** * Ensuring that safety reviews, equipment documentation, drawings, operating procedures, maintenance plans, spare\-parts requirements, training, process controls, and validation activities are completed before operational handoff. * Confirming that new capacity is operational, sustainable, and capable of supporting the required production rate. **What will help you thrive in this role?** ------------------------------------------- * Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, or Industrial (required) * 10\-15 years prior experience in Manufacturing Engineering with proven leadership and management abilities (required) * Proficiency in using Solid Edge CAD software required (required) * Advanced Knowledge of business administration, project management, lean, Six Sigma, operational excellence preferred * Ability to read and interpret drawing requirements and specifications is required. * Excellent teamwork, interpersonal, and oral/written communication skills are required. * Demonstrated ability to effectively manage multiple priorities simultaneously and meet critical deadlines. **Hubbell Incorporated** Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. **Hubbell Electrical Solutions** Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. HES provides the critical components that allow operators of buildings, factories and other industrial infrastructure to connect, protect, wire and manage power. Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class. The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

Responsibilities** #### **Product Design \& Development** * Design, 3D model, and prototype custom metal products using CAD software (*SolidWorks, AutoCAD*). * Develop detailed engineering drawings, fabrication, troubleshooting design challenges or applying required modifications. #### **Materials \& Manufacturing Process Selection** * Select and recommend optimal materials and fabrication methods (*welding, cutting, stamping, bending, CNC machining*) based on structural requirements and budget. * Collaborate with the broader engineering team to refine manufacturing workflows, minimizing unit costs while maintaining superior product quality. #### **Design Validation \& Testing** * Conduct formal design reviews, simulations, and empirical testing to validate structural integrity, performance, and functionality. * Identify and address design limitations or flaws, making adjustments to maximize ease of manufacturing and cost savings. #### **Documentation \& Technical project status updates to executive leadership and project managers. #### **Continuous Improvement \& Innovation** * Identify and implement engineering enhancements to optimize production efficiency, processes, as well as tooling and fixture design. * **Technical Standards:** Strong mastery of blueprint reading, interpreting technical specifications, quality standards, and **GD\&T (Geometric production. * **Engineering Principles:** Solid foundation in structural engineering concepts and manufacturing constraints. * **Soft Skills:** Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving abilities, design validation. * Familiarity with **ERP** (Enterprise Resource Planning) and **PLM** (Product Lifecycle Management) systems. * Practical working knowledge of industry welding codes and standards The position combines business\-facing consulting with hands\-on engineering, with a significant focus on designing, developing, integrating, testing, deploying, and supporting AI solutions. jobs.title: Sr. AI Software Engineer (Remote)
jobs.description: The Sr. AI Software Engineer reports to the Sr. Director, AI Center of Excellence, in the Technology Department, and has no direct reports. Be a part of a growing team that is directly impacting the way our business operates. In this role you embed with business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering. You are a consultant at the edge of our internal teams, helping to identify AI opportunities, define requirements, build prototypes, and ship governed, measurable AI agents into production. The primary duties include finding and scoping AI\-suited business problems; building and shipping production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms; baselining processes and measuring and reporting ROI before and after deployment; applying AI governance and compliance controls to every build; and converting repeat work into reusable patterns while raising AI fluency across the business teams this role supports. You bring information back to the CoE and deliver value to our business partners. If you love finding new challenges, showing people new was to solve problems, and to build and tinker while delivering critical business value continuously, this role is a perfect fit. **Duties \& Responsibilities:** * Embed within business teams across Health \& Benefits, Retirement \& Wealth, operations, contact center, finance, HR, marketing, sales, and engineering to identify work that is repetitive, automatable, or bottlenecked. * Translate and communicate a business need into a written solution statement, success criteria, data requirements, and a documented recommendation on whether AI is the appropriate solution. * Build working prototypes to validate feasibility before committing to a full build. * Scope each opportunity appropriately, determining whether the right solution is a single\-purpose agent, an automated workflow, a multi\-tier agent system, or an existing approved vendor capability. * Build production agents and automations on approved enterprise platforms, including assistant and agent frameworks, low\-code workflow automation, document intelligence, conversational and agent\-assist capabilities, and natural language analytics. * Design multi\-tier agent systems where an orchestration layer routes to specialized agents with scoped tools, defined boundaries, and a clean handoff to a human. * Integrate with business systems through approved connectors and MCP servers and support the approval process for new connectors when a use case requires one. * Hand off completed builds with documentation, a runbook, a named owner, and a business user able to operate the solution independently. * Baseline process performance prior to each build, capturing cycle time, volume, error and rework rates, handle time, and cost per unit as applicable. * Instrument deployed agents so that value is measured continuously rather than asserted once at launch. * Report outcomes honestly, including builds that did not deliver value and the resulting lessons learned. * Apply an ISO/IEC 42001 governance mindset to every build, including defined purpose, risk classification, data handling, human oversight, and evidence that controls operated as intended. * Define and implement governance, security, and compliance telemetry for each agent, covering tool calls, scope adherence, escalation and override rates, data access, output quality, and cost. * Build monitoring and alerting so drift, boundary violations, and unexpected spend are surfaced to an owner. * Operate within the AI Governance Committee process and the AI Acceptable Use Policy. * Report business team needs, governance friction points, recurring patterns, and tooling gaps back to the AI Center of Excellence. * Convert repeat builds into reusable patterns, templates, and starter kits for use by other consultants and delivery teams. * Run enablement sessions and working labs to raise AI fluency within the business teams this role supports. * Perform other duties as assigned. Requirements: **Education \& Experience:** Minimum required: * Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering or Computer Science * AI Continuous learning certifications are a plus * 3\-6 six years of software engineering experience shipping and supporting production systems. * 2 \+years of hands\-on experience building AI solutions across assistants, agents, workflow automation, retrieval, and document processing. **Skills \& Abilities:** * Demonstrated end\-to\-end ownership, taking a business idea from initial concept through requirements, prototype, and production use. * Ability to define and measure business value, including constructing a baseline, defending a measurement method, and communicating cost and benefit independently. * Working knowledge of at least one AI governance or management framework, such as ISO/IEC 42001 or NIST AI RMF, and the ability to convert it into implemented controls. * Experience instrumenting telemetry as part of the build process rather than after an incident. * Ability to work effectively within unfamiliar business functions, build credibility quickly, and influence stakeholders while building relationships. * Ability to learn and adapt to a changing AI platform and tooling landscape. * Financial services, healthcare, benefits administration, or other regulated industry experience preferred, particularly environments handling PII, PHI, or fiduciary data. * Process improvement experience preferred, such as Lean, Six Sigma, or process mining. * Fluency in low\-code automation platforms alongside code\-first development preferred. * Experience with contact center, claims, or back\-office operations technology preferred. * Experience developing internal enablement materials, documentation, or practitioner communities preferred. **Other Requirements:** * Ability to occasionally work outside normal business hours to meet project deadlines as needed. * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Serving more than 7 million clients and representing over $62 billion in assets, Inspira partners with thousands of employers, plan sponsors, recordkeepers, TPAs, and other institutional partners to help the people they support plan, save, and invest for a brighter future. Through solutions including automatic rollover services, health savings accounts, emergency savings, and custody services, Inspira is focused on delivering better outcomes for all. jobs.title: Communications Data Specialist
jobs.description: **Communications Data Specialist** The UAW has taken an all\-new approach to bargaining and striking. During the 2023 negotiations with Ford, General Motors, and Stellantis, our union ran a contract campaign for the first time, initiated strikes against all three companies at the same time, and brought a whole new level of transparency to bargaining. The result was record\-breaking contracts. From our Stand Up Strike to the recently announced new organizing drive across 13 non\-union automakers, the UAW is at the forefront of rebuilding a fighting labor movement. Our union is seeking a Communications Data Specialist to join our powerhouse Communications team in assisting strategic campaigns across the country. The Communications Data Specialist will help build, maintain, and improve the data, communications, and technology infrastructure that powers the UAW's strategic campaigns. The ideal candidate is a technically strong, self\-motivated problem solver who can work across the full technology stack—from user\-facing web tools and dashboards to server\-side applications, databases, APIs, integrations, and automated communications systems. This position also requires exceptional people and customer service skills. The successful candidate will be highly responsive to colleagues and campaign partners, able to translate technical problems into practical solutions, and comfortable working with stakeholders across departments and levels of the organization. The ideal candidate understands that getting things done in a large organization requires both technical expertise and the ability to navigate organizational structures, competing priorities, hierarchy, and bureaucracy while maintaining momentum toward strategic goals. Candidates must be comfortable working in a high\-intensity, high\-velocity environment and be willing to work long and irregular hours, along with travel, including overnight stays. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. Strategic Campaign \& Cross\-Department Collaboration** * Work with the Communications Director and staff across departments to leverage data, member lists, communications platforms, and technology in support of strategic campaign objectives. * Translate the needs of communications and campaign staff into practical, user\-friendly technical solutions. * Navigate organizational hierarchy, competing priorities, and bureaucracy with sound judgment and strong interpersonal skills while finding ways to move projects forward. * Identify opportunities to improve technology, data practices, and workflows and proactively implement solutions. **2\. Full\-Stack Web Development \& Technical Systems** * Design, build, maintain, and improve full\-stack web applications and internal tools using TypeScript and related technologies, including frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs, and databases. * Develop responsive, accessible, and intuitive web experiences and data\-driven tools for staff and campaign use. * Assess, troubleshoot, document, and improve websites, web applications, databases, communications platforms, and other technical systems. * Diagnose technical problems independently and communicate clearly about solutions, risks, timelines, and technical needs. **3\. Data, Systems Integration \& Automation** * Analyze large communications datasets to generate strategic insights, improve targeting, and support campaign planning and decision\-making. * Develop and maintain data pipelines, APIs, automated workflows, and integrations between Solidarity Tech, CRMs, databases, websites, communications platforms, and other systems. * Maintain a strong working knowledge of Solidarity Tech and its integration with the UAW's broader technology and data ecosystem. * Improve data quality, system interoperability, automation, and the reliability and accessibility of campaign information. **4\. Staff Support, Training \& Customer Service** * Provide highly responsive technical and customer support to Communications staff and other stakeholders, following issues through to resolution and prioritizing urgent campaign needs. * Provide ongoing training and support for Solidarity Tech, communications platforms, data systems, dashboards, and other technology tools. * Develop documentation, training materials, and processes that enable staff to effectively use systems and reduce dependence on individual technical staff. * Build strong relationships with technical and non\-technical users and serve as a trusted, solutions\-oriented resource. **5\. Project Management \& Execution** * Manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining attention to detail and meeting campaign deadlines. * Take ownership of technical projects and problems from identification through implementation, testing, training, and ongoing support. * Balance urgent campaign needs with longer\-term technology, data, and infrastructure improvements. * Work independently, proactively identify problems and opportunities, and foll ervice orientation and responsiveness, with the ability to provide ongoing technical support, training, and guidance to staff with varying levels of technical expertise. * **Self\-direction, collaboration \& execution:** Highly self\-motivated, organized, and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and stakeholders; independently identify problems, research solutions, and follow work through to completion. * **Judgment, adaptability \& organizational navigation:** Strong interpersonal skills, sound judgment, and the ability to work effectively within a complex organization with multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, established hierarchies, and bureaucracy. Must be persistent, solutions\-oriented, adaptable, and able to build relationships while finding practical ways to get things done. Basic understanding of labor unions and strategic communications, eagerness to learn about the sectors represented by the UAW, and commitment to the mission of the UAW. Successful candidates will exhibit discerning judgment, exemplary people skills, adept writing capabilities, and a strong commitment to service. The ideal candidate is both a team player who can collaborate with an enthusiastic staff and a self\-driven individual who can independently identify problems, develop solutions, manage competing priorities, and follow projects through to completion. The successful candidate will be comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, communications, data, and organizing. They will be able to move fluidly between writing code, analyzing data, troubleshooting a communications platform, answering a colleague's urgent technical question, and working with senior stakeholders to determine the best path forward. **Salary and Benefits** This is a full\-time, exempt position, represented by News Guild, with a remote workplace. The UAW offers a salary of $118,566\.76, along with best\-in\-class health, retirement, and paid time off benefits. **How to Apply** To be considered for this position, please apply through Indeed and provide the following: * A current resume reflecting qualifications for this position, including months and years of employment. * A short letter of application (500 words or less) which specifically explains how your experiences and accomplishments have prepared you to work with the UAW's aggressive and bold Communications Department. * An example work product—such as a web application, web asset, dashboard, database, data analysis, API integration, mass communications system, or other technical project—that demonstrates your ability, along with a short written explanation of your role and the technology used. If you have any issues with attaching the required documents to your Indeed application please email them to recruiting@uaw.net. *The UAW is dedicated to promoting a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that our collective strength is amplified when all voices are represented. Women and people of color are strongly encouraged to apply.* **About Us** The International Union, United Automobile, Aerospace and Agricultural Implement Workers of America (UAW) is a progressive, militant union with one of the largest and most diverse memberships in North America, representing 400,000 active members and 600,000 retirees. Our members are employed in a range of workplaces, from multinational corporations to small manufacturers, from state and local governments to colleges and universities, hospitals and private non\-profit organizations. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: From $118,566\.76 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years have you been a member of the UAW or any other labor union? * Are you a UAW member? Willingness to travel: * 25% (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **About Karoo Health** ====================== Cardiovascular care is often the \#1 cost for health plans and employers, with the current fee for service model incentivizing providers to maximize volume and throughput at the expense of clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction. Karoo’s mission is to improve the lives of every cardiac patient in America by transforming the current care model to improve patient outcomes at significantly lower cost. Karoo deploys a value\-based approach which combines a blend of traditional, guideline\-based medicine and state of the art digital tools to accomplish this important mission by enabling the conversion to, and success in, value\-based care arrangements for cardiovascular networks, health systems and payers. Karoo is backed by leading venture capitalists, including First Trust Capital Partners and BIP Ventures, and has near and medium\-term plans for further rounds. **Senior Data Engineer** ======================== Job Description **Overview** ============ **Location:** Pittsburgh preferred, or remote, U.S.\-based**Type:** Full\-time technical role**An Industry Defining Company** ================================ Karoo is a venture\-backed startup, prior to Series A, on a mission to transform cardiovascular care. Our platform is designed to empower large provider groups and health systems to succeed in value\-based care contracts with payers by improving patient outcomes and reducing cost of care through better coordination, analytics, and disease management. While our initial focus is cardiology, we are building a scalable operating system for managing complex conditions across the healthcare spectrum. This is a rare opportunity to join a mission\-driven founding team at a pivotal stage and help define the future of healthcare technology, with the power to improve the lives of patients with cardiovascular disease, the number one cause of death in America today.**The Role** ============ Karoo Health is seeking a skilled and dedicated developer to join our Engineering team. As a software engineer at Karoo Health, you show a clear passion for quality and love to bring software to life. You are energized by the idea of building something new and want to work on problems that matter. In order to do this job well, you must be a curious and eager problem solver with a hunger for building well\-designed, high\-quality solutions. You have a passion for great work and strive to produce simple solutions to complex problems. Knowing there are always multiple answers to a problem, you know how to engage in a constructive dialogue to find the best path forward. When applying, please include a description of why you’re interested in this role.**What You'll Do** ================== * **Design and Architect Data Systems**: Lead the design, construction, installation, and optimization of highly reliable, scalable, and secure data architecture. * **Design Core Healthcare Data Models:** Own the design and evolution of foundational data models and schemas from the ground up, leveraging industry standards such as TUVA, OMOP and FHIR to translate clinical, operational, product, and reporting needs into scalable table structures, entities, and relationships. * **Develop Data Pipelines**: Build and maintain complex, production\-grade data pipelines that ingest, process, enrich and normalize large volumes of healthcare data ensuring consistency, usability, and data integrity across downstream applications. * **Data Quality and Governance**: Establish and enforce data quality standards, monitoring, and validation processes to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data used for analytics. * **Performance Optimization**: Implement query tuning, indexing, and partitioning strategies to maximize the performance and efficiency of data processing systems and data retrieval. * **Cloud Infrastructure**: Design and deploy scalable, secure, cloud infrastructure leveraging infrastructure\-as\-code best practices. * **Safeguard Data**: Ensure strict compliance with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) and implement data security best practices. * **Build and Maintain EMR Integrations:** Develop direct, bi\-directional integrations with electronic medical record platforms. **What We're Looking For** ========================== * Deep, hands\-on experience working with healthcare data, including healthcare data standards and common data models such as TUVA, OMOP, or FHIR. * Demonstrated experience designing core data models and schemas from scratch, including translating business, clinical, product, or user requirements into scalable data structures. * Experience mapping raw healthcare data into standardized healthcare data models, including resolving data quality, normalization, terminology, and structural inconsistencies. * Hands\-on experience integrating directly with EMR/EHR platforms, ideally including eClinicalWorks, AthenaOne, Epic, or comparable systems. * Experience with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST) and data formats (e.g. FHIR) * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience * Minimum 5 years of dedicated professional experience in a Data Engineering role, preferably within a startup or fast\-paced healthcare technology environment. * Expert proficiency in **SQL** and at least one programming language used for data processing (**Python** or Scala). * Deep experience designing and managing **Data Warehouses** (e.g., Snowflake, Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift) and experience with Data Lake technologies (e.g., S3, Delta Lake). * Demonstrated hands\-on experience with **Big Data processing frameworks** like **Apache Spark** or Dask. * Deep understanding of **cloud platforms (AWS preferred)** and cloud\-native development, including services like S3, Lambda, and RDS. * Hands\-on experience with workflow orchestration tools such as **Apache Airflow** or AWS Step Functions for managing data pipelines. * Expert knowledge of system architecture, scalability, and performance optimization for data systems. * Experience with test automation, CI/CD, and DevOps best practices for data deployments. * Ability to work independently and make high\-impact technical decisions. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future **Why Join Us** =============== * Competitive salary and equity in an early\-stage startup. * Opportunity to define the technical solution from the ground up * Possibly fully remote work environment with flexible hours * Health benefits, learning stipends, and professional development support * A collaborative and transparent company culture that values creativity and ownership **Equal Opportunity Statement** =============================== At Karoo Health Inc (“Karoo”), we believe that improving healthcare starts with creating a more equitable and inclusive world, both inside and outside our organization. We are committed to fostering a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve, and to building a culture where every team member feels valued, supported, and empowered. Our commitment to inclusion is reflected in initiatives such as equitable compensation practices, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more. Karoo Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We maintain a strict policy of non\-discrimination for all applicants and employees. What does that mean for you? It means that we are dedicated to providing a workplace that is inclusive, respectful, and free from discrimination or harassment of any kind. Employment decisions at Karoo Health are made based on merit, qualifications, and business need, without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, political affiliation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. This policy applies to every aspect of the employment journey, from recruitment and hiring to compensation, benefits, training, promotion, performance evaluation, and beyond. We’re committed to doing the right thing, always, and that includes creating a fair and inclusive hiring process and workplace for all.**Karoo Health welcomes all.** ============================== In the United States, compensation is determined by factors including location, role level, job\-related skills, experience, and market conditions. Some positions may also be eligible for bonuses, equity, or other benefits. To learn more about Karoo Health’s benefits, please contact our People Team.

jobs.description: **WE HAVE CREATED A WORLD WHERE ART AND SCIENCE ARE BEST FRIENDS** Known is a modern marketing company engineered for the unprecedented opportunities and challenges facing marketers today.
