SKEPTIC™, Known's proprietary AI analytics and optimization platform, powers our full service agency and has received industry\-wide recognition for innovation in marketing technology and analytics. In 2025, SKEPTIC was recognized by Fast Company as one of the *Next Big Things in Tech*. Additionally, Digiday recognized SKEPTIC as *Best Marketing Analytics Platform* (2023\) and the *Best AI Platform* (2025\). Together, these honors underscore SKEPTIC's evolution into an award\-winning platform now being licensed to enterprise marketers. We couldn't create this award\-winning work without seeking out and hiring the best talent. What does it mean to be a Knowner? We are curious innovators, knowledge\-hunters who are constantly challenging ourselves to do better and be better for our clients, for our team and for our world at large. Our offices around the U.S. are open and while most of our people work in a hybrid setting, we are a distributed workforce with a number of Knowners working remotely. **BUT ENOUGH ABOUT US, LET'S TALK ABOUT YOU** About the role: Known's Media Science team uses advanced analytics, machine learning, statistics, and algorithms to plan and optimize advertising dollars. We partner with our clients to translate their business goals into meaningful metrics, and buy media across all channels to drive those target outcomes. We are looking for a Manager, Data \& Media Science to join the team and work alongside strategists, analysts, data scientists, and software engineers. In this role, you will lead the data science arm of our media campaigns, owning the relationship with the client when it comes to optimization and data. You will be in a primarily client\-facing position with heavy project ownership and emphasis on communicating with executive stakeholders. **WHAT YOU'LL DO** * Serve as the primary client point of contact on campaign optimization and data * Delight our clients with meaningful analyses, compelling stories, and beautiful slides * Own analytics, science, and optimization for our media campaigns * Work with other data analysts \& scientists to deliver rigorous measurement, consistent campaign performance, and insightful reporting * Consult with agency and client leadership to set measurement frameworks, design experiments (A/B, incrementality, geo\-testing), and evaluate campaign lift and ROI across channels * Stay current on industry trends in digital media, analytics, and privacy regulations Seniority is flexible and subject to experience. **WHO YOU ARE AND WHAT YOU HAVE** * A degree from a well\-regarded college or university, preferably a Masters or PhD. Our culture is propped up by four values that we aspire to every day: We are one team. We see the good. We never stop learning. There's always a better way. At Known we are setting out to build something more than just a company. We are building a legacy filled with exceptionally talented people with a kaleidoscope of backgrounds, experiences, and origin stories who feel encouraged and empowered to bring their whole selves to work, and to partner with us in molding and shaping our culture through our values. *Known is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against employees or qualified job applicants on the basis of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or locally protected class.* ***The base salary for this position is $135K \- $150K.*** ***This range is posted in compliance with state and municipal Pay Transparency laws. jobs.title: AVP, IAM AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Where Ambition Meets Innovation** Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting\-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals. **Job Overview:** We are looking for an AVP, IAM AI Engineer to design, operationalize, and automate the identity controls that govern both human and non\-human actors across our environment — with a specific focus on AI agents and the emerging class of agentic and non\-human identities (NHI). This is a hands\-on engineering and technical leadership role: you will build the runtime controls, secrets workflows, and governance guardrails that let the organization adopt AI safely, while standing up and growing a team to sustain and scale that work. You will be embedded in new AI application development from the earliest design stages, ensuring identity, authentication, and authorization are built in rather than bolted on. **Responsibilities**: * **Identity runtime controls.** Operationalize and automate identity runtime controls across human and non\-human identities, including real\-time authentication, authorization, and policy enforcement. * **NHI \& agentic governance.** Design, build, and automate governance controls for AI agents and non\-human identities — covering the full lifecycle: provisioning, entitlement, rotation, certification/attestation, and deprovisioning. * **Secrets management for AI.** Develop and automate secrets\-manager workflows for AI systems and agents, including secret rotation, just\-in\-time and ephemeral credentials, and secure secret delivery to workloads. * **Least privilege \& policy\-as\-code.** Define and enforce fine\-grained, least\-privilege authorization models for agents and workloads, expressed as policy\-as\-code wherever possible. * **Reference architecture \& standards.** Establish standards and reference patterns for how identity flows through agentic systems — user\-to\-agent, agent\-to\-agent (A2A), and workload\-to\-service authentication and authorization. * **Embedded in AI development.** Partner with engineering and data science teams on all new AI application development, ensuring identity, AuthN/AuthZ, and secrets handling are designed in from the start. * **End\-user IAM deployment.** Support the deployment and adoption of IAM controls for end users where required. * **Monitoring \& response.** Integrate identity telemetry with SIEM/SOC tooling; build monitoring and anomaly detection for NHI/agent behavior; support incident response for compromised or misused credentials. * **Governance, risk \& compliance.** Partner with GRC, risk, and audit stakeholders to ensure controls satisfy regulatory and internal requirements, and to produce audit evidence. * **Team building \& leadership.** Recruit, build, mentor, and lead a team to support these workstreams; set technical direction and roadmap for NHI and agentic IAM. **What are we looking for?** We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast\-paced, team\-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness, act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work. **Requirements:** * 5\+ years in identity \& access management or information security, including hands\-on engineering. * Demonstrated experience building and/or leading technical teams. * 5\+ years with Ping Identity (PingFederate / PingOne / PingAccess) or a comparable access\-management / federation platform. * 5\+ years with SailPoint (IdentityIQ / Identity Security Cloud) or a comparable identity governance \& administration (IGA) platform. * 3\+ years with Idira (CyberArk, formerly Conjur) / HashiCorp Vault or a comparable secrets\-management platform. **Core Competencies:** * Working knowledge of identity and authorization for both users and agents: user\-to\-agent and agent\-to\-agent (A2A) patterns, OIDC and OAuth 2\.0/2\.1 tokens, and API keys, across both authentication (AuthN) and authorization (AuthZ). * Strong automation and engineering skills: proficiency in a scripting/programming language (e.g., Python), infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform), CI/CD pipelines, and REST API integration. * Experience jobs.title: Senior Agentic Planning Engineer
jobs.description: **About LightSpeed** -------------------- LightSpeed Build Technologies is revolutionizing the construction industry through AI\-powered robotics. Our flagship systems—BRUTE for automated wall panel manufacturing and DEX for on\-site collaborative construction—are addressing the global housing crisis by delivering unprecedented speed, precision, and affordability in homebuilding. **Position Overview** --------------------- As Senior Agentic Planning Engineer, you will own how LightSpeed's robots decide what to do next. Every robot action is one of two primitives, move or actuate. You will build the planner that reasons over a goal, sequences those primitives, chooses classical control or a learned policy for each step, and recovers when a step fails. Planning doesn't stop after the first step. Your planner keeps deciding as the robot works, using live data from the sensors and the result of every action. When it works, a robot finishes a whole panel or room on its own, with every decision it makes. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- ### **Primitives and contracts** * Define primitives and their contract: inputs, preconditions, success checks and failure codes * Define the interface between the planner and the executor: step request, choice of classical or policy, result and evidence * Keep the primitive library callable by the planner, not wired by hand for each task ### **Planning and reasoning** * Build the task graph from BIM: the elements in front of the robot and the dependencies between them * Build the planner in two layers: a reasoning layer for open\-ended decisions, and solvers for reach, collision and trajectory * Decide when to use a reasoning model and when not to; keep it off the real\-time control path * Set the rule for choosing classical control or a learned policy for each step, based on world\-model confidence and how structured the step is * Extend the planner's reasoning and sequencing for each new trade * Measure success by how fast a new trade can be taught ### **Execution and recovery** * Build the execution monitor: verify each step, then retry, switch executor, skip and flag, or escalate to a person * Log every decision with its reason and evidence, so any outcome can be explained * Keep the planner inside guardrails: a constrained action space, declared parameter ranges, and safety that is never the planner's to decide * Build the operator view for escalations and remote assistance ### **Multi\-robot readiness** * Design the planner so two robots can share one world model and divide work: one holds, one fastens; one supplies, one installs ### **Foundation and skill pipeline** * Co\-own the foundation interfaces with the world sensing and robot learning principals, and own the primitive contract * Run the new stack alongside production on our existing robots, switchable per job, so it is tested on real work from the start * Prove the system by running whole tasks end to end on real robots, with recovery ### **Technical leadership** * Set planning and autonomy architecture across both robot families * Mentor autonomy and motion planning engineers * Make the system something engineers can teach new trades with, without you in the loop * Stay hands\-on: write production code and test on real robots every week **Required qualifications** --------------------------- ### **Autonomy and planning** * 5\+ years building autonomy, task planning or decision\-making systems for robots or autonomous vehicles, with systems deployed in production * Task\-level planning on real robots: behavior trees, task and motion planning (TAMP), HTN or similar * Execution monitoring and fault recovery in a deployed system * Built interfaces between planning, perception and control that other teams built against * Hands\-on with reasoning models or LLMs in a decision loop, and a clear view of where they help and where they don't ### **Engineering and leadership** * Strong Python and C\+\+ * Experience with ROS2, Linux, Docker and CI/CD workflows * A record of setting technical direction across teams and mentoring senior engineers **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, AI or a related field * Behavior or decision planning on an autonomous vehicle team * LLM or VLM agents for robotics, with constrained action spaces and guardrails * Motion planning and trajectory optimization: MoveIt, OMPL or similar * Multi\-robot coordination, task allocation or fleet orchestration * Functional safety or formal verification for autonomous systems * Planning from CAD or BIM models * Background in construction, manufacturing or industrial automation **Why Join LightSpeed** ----------------------- * Build the decision\-making of robots that are addressing the housing crisis * Own autonomy end to end, from the primitive contract to whole tasks finished on their own * Shape the foundation every trade is built on * Work on rare real\-world problems: agentic planning on physical robots, recovery in messy sites, two robots sharing one task * Hands\-on culture with direct access to robots, sensors and manufacturing environments * Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits **Employment Relationship** --------------------------- This position is at\-will, meaning either you or the Company may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- LightSpeed Build Technologies is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Product Partnership Engineer
jobs.description: **TL;DR:** We’re hiring a Product Partnership Engineer to build and scale Lovable’s most strategic product partnerships. You’ll work directly with enterprise partners to design and ship high\-impact integrations, reading their stack, prototyping solutions yourself, and shaping both our roadmap and theirs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and enterprise relationships, and will directly accelerate Lovable’s ecosystem growth and enterprise adoption. **Why Lovable?** Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024\. And we’re just getting started. We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent\-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low\-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest\-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. **What we’re looking for** * 5\+ years in Partner Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or as a technical founder/CTO \- in high\-velocity environments. * Fluent in modern frontend (React/TypeScript) and/or backend (Golang, Rust) development. * Track record of structuring and executing product\-centric partnerships that involve real technical depth. * Genuinely technical; comfortable reading technical documentation, understanding cloud architectures, and forming independent views on integration feasibility. * Strong enterprise and commercial instincts: comfortable navigating senior stakeholders in negotiating, building relationships and managing complex deals while maintaining technical credibility. * High agency and bias for action; you prototype first and refine later than waiting for full specs. **What you’ll do** * Own and deepen relationships with Lovable’s most strategic product and enterprise partners — driving urgency, alignment, and executive\-level momentum. * Independently assess partner architectures, APIs, and other integration points to identify high\-impact integration opportunities, validate feasibility, and proactively surface risks or blockers. * Prototype and spike early integrations yourself to shape requirements, accelerate decision\-making, and reduce engineering lift. * Scope and, where appropriate, ship production\-ready integrations that deliver measurable value to Lovable users and our partners. * Develop compelling business cases for integrations that clearly demonstrate long\-term value creation for partners, Lovable, and end customers with a strong focus on measurable impact. * Feed technical and market insights back into Lovable’s product organization, while collaborating cross\-functionally (Engineering, Product, Marketing, Growth) and leading workshops to drive alignment and successful go\-to\-market execution. **About your application** Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally \- if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal. Compensation Range: $199K \- $271K

solve integration problems. * Understand Lynxspring’s Quality Policy and Quality Objectives and how you can contribute to them. **Technical skills:** * Python development in production software environments. * Designing and developing RESTful APIs and backend services. * API authentication, data validation, error handling, and integration patterns. * AWS or comparable cloud platform experience, including deploying and operating production applications. * Docker and containerized application development. * Linux\-based development and server environments. * NoSQL databases such as MongoDB, DocumentDB, Cassandra, or Amazon Keyspaces. * Data modeling and working with large or time\-series datasets. * Git and modern source\-control workflows. * Software testing, debugging, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Java, or C\#. * Hands\-on experience with specific AWS services, such as EC2, S3, Lambda, Cognito, CloudWatch, VPC networking, IAM and cloud security concepts, and Application Load Balancers. * AI, machine learning, or data analytics. * Energy analytics or time\-series analytics. * Project Haystack. * SkySpark and Axon. * Niagara Framework. * HVAC systems. * Engineering, or a related field is preferred. jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Mercor** ================ Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real\-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents. Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast\-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in\-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices. **Summary of role:** All of Mercor’s AI work, from training and serving models to building agents, runs on GPUs. Your job is to make that compute fast, fault\-tolerant and fully utilized. You’ll own the accelerator platform end to end. That means the clusters and schedulers across AWS, GCP, neoclouds and on\-prem, the training and LLM serving on top, and the observability and cost data that show where every GPU\-hour goes. This is a software engineering role, not an ops role. You’ll write production code every day, own systems from design through on\-call, and build the platform that sets how fast Mercor can move. **Representative projects** * Stand up a multi\-cloud GPU fleet spanning hyperscalers, neoclouds and on\-prem, orchestrated through custom Kubernetes and Slurm operators so researchers never have to think about where their job lands. * Build a scheduling layer with gang scheduling, bin\-packing and fair\-share quotas that measurably raises accelerator utilization across teams. * Ship a high\-throughput vLLM serving stack with prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache offload and FP8/FP4 quantization. Back it with a benchmarking and traffic\-replay harness that tracks TTFT, TPOT and latency percentiles against per\-config baselines. * Build a self\-healing health\-check and remediation system that rides out fault storms across hardware, network and software without paging a human. * Build an end\-to\-end cost\-attribution pipeline. It ingests utilization, occupancy and billing data into the warehouse, attributes every GPU\-hour to a team and workload, and drives capacity planning. * Build internal tools and dashboards that researchers and non\-engineers use every day. **Responsibilities:** * Design, deploy and operate GPU clusters across AWS, GCP, and other hyperscalers/neoclouds/on\-premise data centers, including custom Kubernetes and Slurm operators and the metadata services behind them. * Build scheduling that keeps accelerators busy: gang scheduling for distributed jobs, bin\-packing to reduce fragmentation, and quotas and fair share for multi\-tenant teams. * Run distributed training infrastructure on PyTorch Distributed, Ray, or Megatron, with fast checkpointing and model loading. * Deploy and tune high\-throughput LLM serving with vLLM or similar: tensor and model/expert parallelism, prefill/decode disaggregation, KV cache offload, FP8/FP4 quantization. * Build benchmarking and traffic\-replay tools that measure TTFT, TPOT and latency percentiles, and set per\-config performance baselines. * Build health checks across hardware, network and software layers, and automated remediation that handles fault storms without human intervention. * Instrument fleet utilization with DCGM, Prometheus and Grafana. Write recording rules and alerts that teams rely on. * Ingest utilization, occupancy and billing data into a warehouse, attribute spend to teams and workloads, and support capacity planning. * Drive autoscaling, rightsizing and idle\-capacity recovery programs with measurable cost results. * Write clear runbooks and documentation, and explain infrastructure tradeoffs to researchers, finance and leadership. * Build internal tools or dashboards that researchers and non\-engineers use daily. **You may be a good fit if you** * Have 5\+ years building and operating production distributed systems or ML infrastructure * Write production\-quality Python plus Go or C\+\+, and are fluent in shell scripting for system administration. * Have deep hands\-on Kubernetes and container experience, plus working knowledge of Slurm or another HPC resource manager. * Have run GPU workloads at scale, including scheduling, orchestration and troubleshooting. * Have hands\-on experience with at least one distributed training or serving stack: PyTorch Distributed, Ray, vLLM or Megatron\-LM. * Have deep experience with at least one major cloud provider. * Know observability tools like DataDog, Prometheus, PromQL and Grafana, and are comfortable on\-call for critical systems. * Own projects end to end and gather your own requirements with little direction. **Strong candidates may also have experience with (or a strong desire to learn deeply)** * LLM inference optimization: KV cache systems, disaggregated serving, quantization, speculative decoding * High\-performance networking: RDMA, InfiniBand, NCCL, NVLink * GPU profiling with Nsight or similar, and CUDA or Triton kernel work * Accelerators beyond NVIDIA: AMD MI\-series, TPU, Trainium * Capacity planning, billing normalization or cost attribution across providers * Automated fault diagnosis, log mining or AIOps at fleet scale * Configuration management (Ansible, Puppet) and secure or air\-gapped deployments **Benefits** * Bi\-annual performance bonus structure * Generous equity grant vested over 4 years * Up to $15k Relocation bonus * $10K housing bonus (if you live within 0\.5 miles of our office) * $1\.5K monthly stipend for meals * Free Equinox membership * $200 monthly laundry reimbursement * $200 monthly personal wellness reimbursement * Health, Dental, Vision insurance Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

jobs.title: Freelancer Senior Value Engineering Consultant
jobs.description: **1\. Background and Objectives** --------------------------------- MJV Technology \& Innovation is seeking a Senior Value Engineering Consultant to support the transformation of its commercial approach to selling technology services and solutions. Traditionally, a significant portion of the technology services market relies on engagement models based on resource allocation, billable hours, or estimated effort (Time \& Materials). With the rapid evolution of Artificial Intelligence, automation, and technology delivery models, MJV aims to develop commercial approaches that prioritize the actual business value delivered to clients, including productivity improvements, operational efficiency, cost reduction, risk mitigation, and measurable business outcomes. The primary objective of this engagement is to develop and implement a commercial methodology that enables MJV to structure, price, and sell technology projects based on the value and business outcomes delivered to clients, reducing its dependence on traditional effort\-based pricing models. **2\. Key Responsibilities** ---------------------------- ### **Value Engineering Strategy** * Assess MJV’s current commercial model and identify opportunities to transition toward value\-driven engagement models. * Develop a structured methodology for identifying, quantifying, and communicating the economic and strategic value of technology solutions. * Translate technical benefits into financial and operational indicators relevant to clients. * Identify the categories of projects and services best suited for value\-based and outcome\-based commercial models. ### **Financial Modeling and Pricing** * Develop methodologies and financial models for calculating ROI, TCO, payback periods, and economic benefits. * Define Value\-Based Pricing and Outcome\-Based Pricing approaches applicable to technology services and solutions. * Evaluate alternative commercial structures, including value\-based fixed pricing, outcome\-based compensation, gainsharing arrangements, and hybrid models. * Establish guidelines for financial risk assessment, margin protection, and long\-term commercial sustainability. ### **Business Outcome Measurement** * Define methodologies for establishing performance indicators, baselines, and measurable business targets. * Develop mechanisms to measure, validate, and demonstrate the business benefits delivered by technology projects. * Identify client dependencies and external factors that may affect outcome measurement or attribution. * Support the definition of commercial acceptance criteria and mechanisms for validating achieved results. ### **Commercial Enablement** * Develop reusable tools and templates for building business cases and value\-driven commercial proposals. * Support the evolution of MJV’s commercial narrative, shifting discussions from resource allocation and effort estimation toward measurable business benefits. * Participate in structuring pilot commercial proposals using the newly developed methodology. * Transfer knowledge and methodologies to MJV’s sales and technical teams. **3\. Required Experience and Qualifications** ---------------------------------------------- ### **Essential Requirements** * Proven experience in Value Engineering, Value Consulting, Value\-Based Selling, or Outcome\-Based Pricing strategies. * Professional background in technology consulting, digital transformation, enterprise software, or complex B2B technology services. * Hands\-on experience developing business cases and financial models to justify technology investments. * Strong understanding of pricing strategies for technology services and solutions. * Demonstrated ability to translate operational improvements and productivity gains into measurable economic value. * Experience designing or transforming commercial models, preferably including transitions from Time \& Materials to value\-based or outcome\-based engagements. * Ability to engage effectively with executive stakeholders across Sales, Finance, and Technology. * Experience developing reusable methodologies, frameworks, tools, and commercial processes. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience with global technology consulting firms or enterprise software companies. * Understanding of how Generative AI and automation are transforming technology service delivery and pricing models. * Experience with process automation, software engineering, digital transformation, or AI agent solutions. * Familiarity with commercial negotiations involving shared risks, performance\-based compensation, and gainsharing arrangements. * Knowledge of Value Realization methodologies and post\-implementation business outcome measurement. **4\. Expected Deliverables** ----------------------------- Considering an initial engagement of approximately 80 hours over two months, the consultant is expected to deliver the following: ### **Deliverable 1 — Assessment and Strategic Direction** Assessment of MJV’s current commercial model, identifying key opportunities for adopting value\-based approaches and prioritizing offerings with the highest implementation potential. ### **Deliverable 2 — Value Engineering Framework** Development of a structured, reusable methodology for identifying, quantifying, communicating, and measuring the business value generated by technology projects. ### **Deliverable 3 — Commercial and Pricing Models** Definition of alternative commercial structures applicable to different types of projects, including pricing methodologies, outcome measurement criteria, gainsharing mechanisms, and guidelines for managing financial risks and protecting margins. ### **Deliverable 4 — Commercial Enablement Tools** Development of practical tools and templates, including ROI financial models, business case frameworks, and value\-driven proposal structures. ### **Deliverable 5 — Practical Implementation** Application of the methodology to up to two real MJV commercial opportunities, supporting the development of concrete proposals using the new approach. ### **Deliverable 6 — Knowledge Transfer** Delivery of training and knowledge\-transfer sessions to relevant teams, ensuring that MJV can independently apply and evolve the methodology after the consulting engagement. **5\. Professional Profile** ---------------------------- We are looking for a business\-oriented professional with strong analytical capabilities and a hands\-on approach to execution. The ideal candidate should be comfortable navigating financial, commercial, and technological discussions, with a clear understanding of how technology solutions translate into measurable business outcomes. Strong consulting skills, executive communication abilities, pragmatism, and the capacity to develop methodologies that can be effectively applied within the organization are essential. We are not looking for a purely theoretical or academic consultant. Proven hands\-on experience designing and implementing value\-based commercial models is essential. **6\. Engagement Model** ------------------------ The initial engagement will consist of approximately 80 hours of specialized consulting services, to be consumed flexibly over an estimated two\-month period. The consultant will collaborate closely with representatives from MJV’s Sales, Technology, and Operations teams. The expected outcome is a set of practical, reusable methodologies, frameworks, and tools that will enable MJV to progressively incorporate value\-based and outcome\-based approaches into its commercial processes. **7\. Candidate Evaluation Criteria** ------------------------------------- Candidates should be able to present at least one real\-world example in which they actively participated in designing or implementing a value\-based or outcome\-based commercial model. The example should demonstrate: * How the business value was identified and quantified. * How the pricing model was structured. * How business outcomes and success criteria were established. * How commercial and financial risks were allocated between the service provider and the client. * What measurable results were achieved.

making high\-stakes decisions with incomplete information, and being candid about the tradeoffs. * Experience owning outcomes while partnering with expert engineering and design leaders as true counterparts. * Experience creating structure where no playbook exists. * Experience with collaboration or productivity software. * Experience with forward\-deployed or customer\-embedded product work. * Experience with agent interoperability, including MCP. ### **Equal Opportunity** We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer (Full\-Stack, AI\-Native)** ====================================================== **Marvin** · Denver/Los Angeles \- Hybrid 2\-day in office · Full\-time · $160k\-190k **About Marvin** ---------------- Marvin helps people navigate their mental health and wellbeing. We partner with employers and health plans to give their members one place to understand their coverage, find care, and get support, including an AI coach built into the product. We're a small team shipping a production healthcare application, which means every engineer touches things that matter and owns them end to end. **The role** ------------ We're hiring a senior full\-stack engineer who has made AI a core part of how they build software, not a novelty. This is not a machine learning research role. You won't train models or tune GPUs. You will ship product in a modern TypeScript/Next.js stack, and you'll do it with AI woven into both the product and your own workflow. Two things distinguish this role from a standard senior web position: * **You build with AI.** You've moved well past autocomplete. You direct agentic coding tools to do real, multi\-step work, you know exactly where they break, and you own every line they produce. * **You build AI into the product.** You've shipped LLM\-backed features to real users and lived with them in production: prompts, tool calls, evals, tracing, cost, latency, and failure modes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Own features end to end across our Next.js/React/TypeScript app, Prisma/Postgres backend, and AWS infrastructure. * Extend our AI coach and build new LLM\-powered member experiences: retrieval over benefits data, structured extraction, guided flows, and agentic tool use against our own APIs. * Design evaluation and observability for AI features so we know when they get worse, not just when they crash. * Push our AI\-assisted development practice forward: agent instructions, reusable skills, hooks, MCP integrations, and review practices that keep quality high as velocity climbs. * Handle sensitive health data responsibly. PHI boundaries, redaction, audit trails, and vendor data agreements are part of the design, not an afterthought. * Review code, whether written by a human or an agent, with a critical eye. Mentor teammates and raise the bar on testing and reliability. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **Core engineering** * 5\+ years building production web applications, with deep TypeScript, React, and Node experience. Next.js is a strong plus. * Comfort across the stack: relational data modeling (we use Prisma and Postgres), auth flows, caching, background jobs, and cloud deployment (AWS, Docker, Terraform or similar). * A real testing habit at every layer: unit, component, and end\-to\-end. We use Vitest, Storybook, Cypress, and Playwright. * Strong product judgment and the ability to work directly with design, clinical, and partner\-facing teammates. **AI fluency (the part that sets you apart)** * Daily, expert use of agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. You write project instructions and reusable skills for your agents, hand them multi\-step tasks, and review the output like a senior reviewer, not a rubber stamp. * Hands\-on experience shipping LLM features: prompt design and versioning, structured outputs, tool/function calling, streaming UIs, retrieval\-augmented generation, and multi\-turn conversation state. * You've run evals and traced production LLM traffic (LangSmith, Braintrust, Langfuse, or homegrown), and you can explain what changed the last time a model version bumped underneath you. * You understand the cost, latency, and quality triangle and have made real trade\-offs: model selection, caching, prompt compression, and fallback strategies. * Clear\-eyed about limits. You know when an LLM is the wrong tool, how to constrain one when it's the right tool, and how to keep a hallucination from ever reaching a member. **Nice to have** * Healthcare, benefits, or other regulated\-data experience (HIPAA, SOC 2\). * Building MCP servers or internal agent tooling for a team. * Experience with Clerk, Stripe, or Sentry. * Contributions to AI developer tooling, open source or internal. **How we work** --------------- AI is part of our engineering culture, not a side experiment. Our repository ships with agent configuration, we maintain shared skills for code review and security checks, and we expect engineers to spend more of their time on judgment and less on typing. We also expect the opposite discipline: no unreviewed AI\-generated code lands, and "the agent wrote it" is never an explanation for a bug. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- 160\-190k base salary · Equity · Health, dental, and vision · \[401(k)] · Unlimited PTO · Hybrid 2 days/wk in office (LA or Denver) Marvin is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Compensation Range: $160K \- $190K

jobs.title: Network Administrator
jobs.description: **Overview** Network Services \& Support, Inc. (NSS) is seeking a knowledgeable and security\-minded Network Engineer / Network Administrator to install, manage, maintain, secure, and improve network infrastructure across our managed services customer base. This position will be responsible for administering and troubleshooting multi\-vendor network environments, including firewalls, switches, wireless access points, VPNs, and related infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience with enterprise networking and network security, strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to implement and document consistent technical standards across multiple customer environments. Experience with Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco Meraki, Adtran, Fortinet, and Palo Alto Networks equipment is preferred. Candidates should be comfortable working across different platforms, identifying root causes of complex network issues, and implementing solutions that prioritize security, reliability, and performance. Experience with cybersecurity frameworks, regulatory compliance, and the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) program is a plus. **Key Responsibilities** \- Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot client network environments, including firewalls, routers, switches, wireless access points, VLANs, routing, DHCP, DNS, and other core network services. \- Manage firewall policies, site\-to\-site VPN tunnels, remote\-access solutions, network segmentation, access controls, firmware updates, and security configurations across multiple vendor platforms. \- Deploy and maintain business Wi\-Fi networks, including SSID configuration, VLAN assignment, authentication, guest access, coverage optimization, and troubleshooting. \- Assist with designing, upgrading, and deploying secure, reliable network solutions that meet customer requirements and align with company standards. \- Monitor network performance and availability, diagnose complex connectivity and security issues, resolve escalated support tickets, and coordinate with ISPs and vendors as needed. \- Maintain accurate network diagrams, IP addressing plans, device configurations, firewall and VPN documentation, and change records. Support security assessments and compliance initiatives, including CMMC and NIST\-based requirements where applicable. \- Provide technical support across multiple client environments, communicate clearly with customers, manage assigned tickets and projects, and participate in scheduled after\-hours maintenance or emergency support when needed. **Qualifications** \- Demonstrated experience administering and troubleshooting business or enterprise networks. \- Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, subnetting, VLANs, routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, NAT, and firewall fundamentals. \- Hands\-on experience configuring and managing network security appliances and firewall policies. \- Experience implementing and troubleshooting site\-to\-site VPNs and remote\-access VPN solutions. \- Experience managing business wireless networks, including SSIDs, authentication, security, and performance troubleshooting. \- Understanding of network security principles, including network segmentation, least privilege, secure administration, and access control. \- Ability to diagnose complex network problems methodically and identify root causes. \- Strong documentation, organization, and communication skills. \- Ability to manage multiple customer environments, prioritize work, and follow issues through resolution. \- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a technical team. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer II-III
jobs.description: **Position Description:** Position Summary The National Radio Astronomy Observatory (NRAO) is a prestigious research and development organization that plays a vital role in the study of the universe. Associated Universities, Inc. (AUI) is a nonprofit organization that manages and operates the NRAO under a cooperative agreement with the National Science Foundation. The Observatory is a hub for technological and scientific collaboration, operating state\-of\-the\-art radio telescope facilities for use by the international scientific community. The Observatory has been instrumental in the study of black holes, galaxies, and the early universe. NRAO is seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join the Online Software Group. The online system is the real\-time heart of our observing software. It is responsible for configuring, controlling, and monitoring the real\-time systems of our telescopes, including the the Very Large Array (VLA) in New Mexico, the Very Long Baseline Array (VLBA) spread across the US and its territories, and the Green Bank Telescope (GBT) in West Virginia. This software is responsible for taking scientific\-domain configuration parameters and decomposing them into the hardware settings and motion commands required by our antennas, and into the corresponding configurations for the associated digital signal processing instruments (e.g. VEGAS for the GBT, and correlators for the VLA and the VLBA). When an observation runs, this software is what makes it happen. This position will be based in Albuquerque, NM, Socorro, NM, Charlottesville, VA or Green Bank, WV. For well\-qualified candidates, a remote work arrangement may be considered. What You Will be Doing * Designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining components of the online software that configure and control the VLA, VLBA, and GBT in real time. * Develop and extend the translation layer that decomposes scientific\-domain observing parameters into the engineering parameters the hardware understands: IF\-chain configurations, antenna motion commands, and digital signal processing configurations for instruments like VEGAS, WIDAR, and DiFX. * Model the observing domain in software — frequency setups, subband and baseband layouts, polarization products, timing and integration structure — and implement the rules, constraints, and legality checks that determine which configurations are achievable on which instrument. * Work from interface control documents and hardware specifications, in close collaboration with the engineers and scientists who own the underlying subsystems, to ensure the commands the online system emits are correct and complete. * Diagnose and resolve issues that span the layers between a scientist's observing specification and the command stream sent to the telescope, often in collaboration with telescope operators, engineers, and scientific staff. * Support the evolution of the online system to meet new observing paradigms and instrumentation, including work that informs and feeds into the next generation Very Large Array (ngVLA). * Write and maintain critical documentation, including requirements, software design documents, interface control documents, and user documentation. * Participate in code review, testing, and release processes for software that runs mission\-critical, 24/7 scientific facilities. Work Environment The successful candidate will join a team of professionals engaged in research and development in the fields of science, engineering, software development, and education. Work is typically performed in a research or development environment. Must be able to operate a personal computer. Occasional travel (domestic and international) may be required. **Who You Are:** Education * A Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, scientific or related field; highly relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a Bachelor's degree. * While not required, you may have an advanced degree in a related field. Experience * One or more years of experience developing software applications. Candidates with progressively more experience will be considered for a higher\-level position ranking. * Relevant experience with radio astronomy operating software and procedures is preferred. Knowledge of radio astronomy theories and practice would be valuable. Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership of complex data acquisition, scheduling, and operational support systems is preferred. Skills and Competencies * Proficiency with Java; familiarity with C/C\+\+ and Python is valuable * A solid understanding of object\-oriented design and development * Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new software languages and unfamiliar domains * Understanding of networking concepts and technologies: multicast, TCP, UDP, HTTP, XML, JSON, REST * Experience with version control software, testing methodologies, and CI/CD * Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with scientists and hardware engineers * Comfort working in a Linux (RHEL) environment **The following are highly preferred:** * Experience translating high\-level domain concepts into machine\- or hardware\-level representations — compilers, planners, schedulers, configuration engines, or similar systems that turn intent into instructions * Skill in domain modeling and in expressing complex validation rules and constraints clearly in code * Experience with distributed systems, or with control and monitoring software for scientific, industrial, or other physical instruments * A working comfort with mathematics and unit\-bearing quantities — coordinate transformations, frequency and time calculations, and the care required to get them right * Familiarity with signal processing concepts, digital IF chains, or correlator architectures * Familiarity with basic astronomical principles, radio astronomy, or interferometry * Experience collaborating in an Agile/Scrum environment, including sprint planning, estimating tasks, and breaking down requirements into user stories Note that this position does not involve direct hardware or firmware development; though an understanding of these systems and real\-time control principles can be valuable. Your work will live at the layer above, producing correct hardware\-level configurations and commands from scientific intent, against interfaces defined and maintained by others. Additional Requirement Observatory employees must be authorized to work in the United States. The Observatory presently cannot sponsor H\-1B Visas for this position. **Total Rewards:** Compensation The starting salary of this position is between $87,000 and $121,000\. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include; education, experience, skills, competencies, other qualifications of the successful candidate, as well as internal equity and labor market conditions. **Benefits:** Associated Universities, Inc (AUI) offers a comprehensive benefits package addressing the needs of employees and their families with most benefits beginning on the first day of employment, subject to eligibility requirements. AUI provides: * Excellent paid time off (13 holidays, annual accrual of up to 24 vacation days) * Medical, dental and vision plans are effective on the first day of employment. * AUI’s retirement benefit contributes an amount equal to 10 percent of a qualified participant’s base pay with no required employee contribution. * Click Total Rewards for more information. **Application Instructions:** Select the “Apply” button above. Please be prepared to upload your current CV/Resume and a cover letter describing interest and suitability for the position. **Equal Opportunity Employer Statement:** AUI is an equal opportunity employer. To view our complete statement, please visit https://public.nrao.edu/careers/. If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, you may submit your request by sending an email to resumes@nrao.edu. PM20

We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence powers innovation in all areas of the business, from helping members choose the right title for them through personalization, to better understanding our audience and our content slate, to optimizing our payment processing and other revenue\-focused initiatives. Building highly scalable and differentiated ML infrastructure is key to accelerating this innovation. ML models can only be as good as the data we provide them. That's why we continue to innovate on making data and feature engineering as simple, scalable, and efficient as possible. Are you interested in joining us on this mission? You will have the opportunity to build cutting\-edge data and feature infrastructure that will power ML models across various domains, including personalized recommendations, payments, games, ads, and more. **The Opportunity** In this role, you will have the opportunity to build a next\-generation ML data and feature platform to significantly improve the productivity of ML practitioners. Our goal is to enable our ML practitioners to easily define and test ML features and labels, while our platform takes care of the computation, storage, and serving of feature values for both high\-throughput training and low\-latency member\-scale inference use cases. You will also have the opportunity to build a centralized feature and embedding store to enable sharing across various ML domains. Unlocking access to these shared datasets will foster innovation through ML in new business areas that otherwise wouldn’t have been feasible. You will collaborate closely with ML practitioners and domain experts to ensure that our models are built with high\-quality features and labels. You will also get to work with the broader AI Platform organization to deliver a cohesive end\-user experience that significantly improves the productivity of ML practitioners. **Here are some examples of the types of things you would work on:** * Design and build a near\-real\-time feature computation engine to generate ML features for both high\-throughput training and low\-latency inference applications. * Operate and manage the feature computation pipelines and feature serving infrastructure for various ML models across multiple ML domains. * Build and scale systems that accelerate training through performant data loading, transformation, and writing. * Create frameworks to streamline and expedite the availability of new data for training and serving. * Develop feature stores that enable feature discovery and sharing. * Increase the productivity of ML practitioners by making it easy to define and access features and labels for experimentation and productization. **Minimum Qualifications** * Experience in building ML or data infrastructure * Strong empathy and passion for providing a fantastic user experience to ML practitioners * Experience in building and operating 24/7 high\-traffic and low\-latency online applications * Experience with large\-scale data processing frameworks such as Spark, Flink, and Kafka * Experience with data storage and serving technologies such as Iceberg and Cassandra * Experience in working with and optimizing Java and/or Python codebases * Experience with public clouds, especially AWS * Self\-driven and highly motivated team player **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in building and operating ML feature stores, such as Chronon * Experience in building embedding\-based retrieval systems * Experience working with Notebooks such as Jupyter or Polynote Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $600,000\.00 \- $1,066,000\.00\. This compensation range will vary based on location. Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family\-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full\-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full\-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here . Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here . Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service. Job is open for no less than 7 days and will be removed when the position is filled.

jobs.description: At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode \- pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting\-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next. Netflix is on the journey to rebuild the AI/ML model serving platform and infrastructure that turns trained models into served predictions across real\-time, async, and agentic workloads, at a scale few companies operate at. Supporting many production clusters, from classical to foundation models, spanning latencies from milliseconds rankers to LLM calls, and powering everything members see from homepage ranking to search, messaging, and internal AI productivity tools. We are re\-building a new model serving platform from the ground up, designed from first principles to meet industry standards. It unifies our in\-house inference infrastructure, third\-party model hosting, and external LLM providers under a single serving, routing, and experimentation layer. Teams get one consistent way to deploy, route, and A/B test any model, regardless of where it runs. Re\-engineering how GPU capacity is provisioned and used. During off\-peak periods, the same fleet that serves latency\-critical production traffic is repurposed to run open\-weight models for internal coding and developer productivity use cases. This role sits at the center of Netflix’s GenAI and Foundation Model serving strategy, with real R\&D scope on frontier AI infrastructure. You will tackle the efficiency problems that most directly drive cost per inference and capacity: disaggregated serving, intelligent routing across models and providers, speculative decoding, prompt caching, and multi\-GPU inference. These are the levers that turn GPU spend into measurable business value. You will lead the technology behind some of Netflix’s largest bets, embedding AI capabilities into member\-facing products at global scale. You will also build durable, resumable execution for long\-running agentic workloads. Online and asynchronous/ Near\-Real\-Time inference is projected to grow fast in 2028, so getting this foundation right now is what keeps costs sustainable and reliability high as demand scales. This is a rare very senior level opportunity to set and own the technical direction for a platform at the intersection of massive production scale, aggressive cost/ utilization engineering, and genuinely unsolved problems in GenAI serving by leading the technical architecture and directions for a growing engineering organization. jobs.title: Infrastructure Administrator
jobs.description: Are you interested in a dynamic IT career where you can solve challenging technical problems, make a difference for customers, and share in the success of the company? Network Center, Inc. (NCI) is a Managed Service Provider supporting more than 600 customers across the Midwest. We are 100% employee\-owned and focused on building a positive, team\-based culture. Our core values guide how we work: Commitment to Employees, Dedication to Customer Success, and Responsible Innovation. We are looking for a well\-rounded **Infrastructure Administrator** who enjoys troubleshooting, learning new technologies, and working directly with customers. This role works across traditional infrastructure, networking, Microsoft 365, Azure, security, and cloud technologies. You don't need to be an expert in everything. We're looking for someone with a strong infrastructure foundation, good troubleshooting instincts, excellent communication skills, and the ability to learn. **What You'll Do** * Manage, maintain, troubleshoot, and improve customer server, network, cloud, and Microsoft infrastructure. * Support and implement Windows Server, Hyper\-V/VMware, Microsoft 365, Azure, and Entra ID environments. * Configure and troubleshoot networking, firewalls, switching, routing, VPNs, and wireless infrastructure. * Help manage backup, disaster recovery, security, system performance, and availability. * Support modern Microsoft technologies including Intune, Conditional Access, MFA, Azure Backup, and cloud/hybrid infrastructure. * Participate in infrastructure upgrades, migrations, deployments, and customer projects. * Work with NCI Engineers and Solutions Architects to design and implement technology solutions. * Clearly document work and proactively communicate with customers and internal teams. * Look for opportunities to improve customer environments through better processes, tools, automation, and technology. **What You Need to Succeed** * Approximately 4\+ years of hands\-on experience supporting servers, networks, operating systems, storage, cloud, or similar infrastructure. * Strong troubleshooting skills across servers, networking, virtualization, cloud, and security. * Experience with Microsoft Windows Server and Hyper\-V and/or VMware. * Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Azure. * Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls, and VPNs. * Experience with backup and recovery technologies. * Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain technical issues clearly to customers. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with engineers, architects, and customers. * A customer\-first mindset with the ability to understand why a customer needs something, not simply implement what was requested. **Nice to Have** Experience with any of the following is a plus, not necessarily a requirement: * Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, PIM, or SSO * Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager * Azure infrastructure, Azure Backup, Site Recovery, Azure Migrate, Azure Arc, or Azure Monitor * PowerShell or other scripting/automation * SAN/NAS and enterprise storage * Microsoft security technologies * Microsoft 365 Copilot or other emerging AI technologies Relevant Microsoft certifications such as AZ\-104, MS\-102, MD\-102, and AI\-900 are a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer / Technical Lead \- Adobe CommerceIntegrations to help architect, evolve, and operate our enterprise e\-commerce platform and its ecosystem of business\-critical integrations. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role for an experienced engineer who excels at solving complex operational challenges, designing resilient integrations, enforcing modern engineering standards, and elevating the capabilities of an engineering team. A primary focus of this role is leading backend architecture, performance optimization, and operational reliability on Adobe Commerce (Magento 2\.4\+), alongside designing the integration pipelines that connect our storefront directly to our enterprise systems. Our broader technology stack includes ERP, CRM, marketing automation, vendor networks, and external services connected through APIs. Our environment currently features Microsoft Dynamics GP, Magento, and HubSpot, with Dynamics GP planned to transition to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. The successful candidate does not need to be an expert in every individual tool across our enterprise. We are seeking someone with strong software engineering fundamentals, deep and proven Adobe Commerce / Magento 2 backend architecture experience, and a track record of building resilient integrations between transactional storefronts and core enterprise platforms. While our storefront runs on Adobe Commerce on Cloud (PaaS), we strongly welcome applications from master Magento 2 architects whose background is primarily in Microsoft Azure, AWS, Docker, or enterprise on\-premise hosting. True Magento architectural mastery, clean module design, and systems integration expertise are what matter most; we will fully support your onboarding to Adobe Cloud\-specific tooling. This position combines active code contribution with technical leadership. You will remain hands\-on in the codebase while shaping architecture, instituting automated testing and code\-quality gates, guiding sprint delivery, and mentoring internal developers and external agency partners. **Responsibilities** *What You'll Do* *Adobe CommercePlatform Engineering* * Lead backend architecture, module development, customization, and maintenance on Adobe Commerce (Magento 2\.4\+). * Design clean, decoupled custom modules following Adobe best practices (dependency injection, plugins/interceptors, service contracts, declarative schema). * Oversee platform deployment lifecycles, environment configurations, and build/deploy processes on Adobe Commerce Cloud. * Configure, tune, and troubleshoot core platform infrastructure dependencies including Fastly / Varnish caching, Redis cache and session management, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, and RabbitMQ message brokers. * Lead version upgrades, security patch implementations (Quality Patches Tool), and technical health audits to minimize technical debt and security vulnerabilities. * Ensure optimal application performance, Core Web Vitals compliance, efficient indexing, and checkout transaction throughput. * Enforce strict code governance across third\-party marketplace extensions to prevent performance bottlenecks, security vulnerabilities, or upgrade conflicts. * Collaborate with infrastructure teams to optimize platform hosting on Microsoft Azure, including media storage, networking, and cloud resource provisioning. *Systems IntegrationData Synchronization* * Architect, build, and support high\-reliability integrations connecting Adobe Commerce with ERP (Microsoft Dynamics GP and Dynamics 365 Business Central), CRM, marketing automation (HubSpot), payment gateways, tax calculation engines, and fulfillment providers. * Implement integration flows utilizing Adobe Commerce asynchronous and bulk APIs, REST/GraphQL endpoints, webhooks, and event\-driven patterns. * Design resilient integration pipelines with idempotency, robust queue processing, automated retries, failure reconciliation, and comprehensive audit trails. * Establish centralized logging, application monitoring, and real\-time alerting for storefront health and data\-sync failures. * Partner with ERP and martech teams to establish clear system\-of\-record boundaries and data governance rules across products, inventory, customer records, contract pricing, and orders. * Leverage secure enterprise networking patterns (e.g., Azure Private Link, secure service bus/queues, and API gateways) to establish low\-latency, private connectivity between Adobe Commerce and internal Microsoft Dynamics ERP services. *Technical LeadershipGovernance* * Provide hands\-on technical leadership to a small\-to\-medium development team (including internal developers and specialized agency partners) while contributing directly to production code. * Translate business and commercial requirements into scalable technical architectures, detailed implementation plans, and clear technical tickets. * Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews and enforce strict engineering standards, PSR compliance, and Magento marketplace coding guidelines. * Identify architectural bottlenecks, integration risks, and operational dependencies early in the project lifecycle. * Mentor engineers, foster engineering best practices, and lead technical post\-mortems for production or data synchronization incidents. *Agile DeliveryCollaboration* * Actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, daily stand\-ups, and retrospectives. * Collaborate closely with product managers, digital leadership, infrastructure teams, and vendor engineering groups to ensure alignment on milestones and technical feasibility. * Translate intricate business logic into clear technical specs, acceptance criteria, and Definition of Done standards. * Clearly articulate technical tradeoffs, risk assessments, and architectural decisions to technical peers and executive business stakeholders. *Quality, SecurityOperations* * Champion automated testing practices, including PHPUnit unit and integration tests, API verification, and operational health checks. * Maintain structured, automated CI/CD pipelines supporting seamless branching, testing, staging, and zero\-downtime production deployments. * Ensure strict compliance with secure development standards, PCI\-DSS requirements, role\-based access control, input validation, and secure credential handling. * Maintain comprehensive observability over platform transactions, API rate limits, and synchronization health using APM and log\-management tools. *AI\-Assisted Software Development* We view AI\-assisted development tools as a valuable component of modern engineering workflows. We welcome engineers who responsibly leverage AI to improve productivity, code quality, and delivery speed. Potential applications include: * Accelerating boilerplate generation for modules, XML schema definitions ('di.xml', 'layout.xml'), and data patches. * Generating unit and integration test coverage. * Parsing and diagnosing complex error logs, deploy scripts, and stack traces. * Accelerating documentation and code comprehension across large, inherited codebases.

jobs.title: Electrical Diagnostic Enhancement Designer
jobs.description: New Flyer is North America's heavy\-duty transit bus leader and offers the most advanced product line under the Xcelsior® and Xcelsior CHARGE® brands. It also offers infrastructure development through NFI Infrastructure Solutions™, a service dedicated to providing safe, sustainable, and reliable charging and mobility solutions. Further information is available at www.newflyer.com. **POSITION SUMMARY** As an Electrical Engineer or Designer – Electrical Diagnostic Enhancement, you will be working as a team member within a brand\-new Engineering Services team that will be that will be focused on improving our overall vehicle diagnostics with the goal of enhancing our ability to troubleshoot vehicle issues effectively and independently across platforms in a timely manner. The intent of this new team is to directly link into our current Electrical Engineering \& Smart Bus Technology teams, serving as a centralized group that will assess on\-going projects and new systems for overall diagnostic coverage and enhancement opportunities. Reporting to the Engineering Design Manager – Electrical Diagnostic Enhancement and working closely with other core team members, you will be accountable for engineering design releases, programming and diagnostic development projects in support of the above objectives. You will ensure the timely completion and accuracy of assigned tasks at all phases from design stage to implementation within production **WHAT YOU WILL DO:** * Strategize, evaluate, develop, and execute innovative diagnostic methods that will improve the tools that NFI Group employees have for understanding the nature of vehicle electrical system issues in our transit and coach vehicles * Monitor the prevalence of different vehicle electrical system issues across our fleets and devise solutions to mitigate those issues * Assess new systems, features, and components for proper diagnostic capability and address any gaps found * Prepare data and create reports on project status related to diagnostic capability and address any gaps found * Establish effective communication, cooperation, and information flow with other groups and departments * Provide engineering support to Production, Quality Assurance, Customer Service and others as required * Interact with vendors and customers on design related issues and document vendor approvals * Complete diagnostic testing of components and system to meet system \& vendor requirements * Assists Designer / Draft person on tasks as required by Design Manager * Other duties as assigned **WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL:** * University Degree or Technical Diploma in electrical engineering or related field * 1 – 10 years of experience in electrical engineering or a related field * Strong understanding of control system algorithms and multiplexing system logic * Functional diagram / structured text experience preferred * Experience with CAN/J1939 Ethernet communication protocols preferred * Strong teamwork, problem solving and communication skills * Demonstrated ability to multitask and work efficiently in a fast\-paced work environment. * Ability to work independently * Proficient in Microsoft Suite * Required travel (less than 15%) to Canada/within the US **OUR WHY:** We exist to move people. Our mission is to design and deliver exceptional transportation solutions that are safe, accessible, efficient and reliable. **NFI Group** is a leading independent global bus manufacturer providing a comprehensive suite of mass transportation solutions. News and information are available at www.nfigroup.com, www.newflyer.com, www.mcicoach.com, www.arbocsv.com, www.alexander\-dennis.com, www.carfaircomposites.com and www.nfi.parts. **Requirements** Salary range: $60,000 \- $80,000 (based on skills and experience)

jobs.description: Post\-training \- San Francisco **About the Team** The Human Flourishing team’s mission is to ensure AI systems understand and advance human flourishing. As AI becomes more capable and plays a larger role in people’s lives, we want its human benefits to grow with its capabilities. The Human Flourishing team is part of the broader Personal AGI organization. Our approach has two parts. Firstly, we measure and improve models’ understanding, capability, and propensity to act according to people’s values and to help them achieve their long\-term goals. Secondly, we directly scale tangible impact for users in human domains like education and mental health, working across research, product, and partnerships to increase the benefits over a billion people experience weekly when they use ChatGPT. Our recent work includes Beneficial RL, which investigates how training for beneficial behavior generalizes across settings, and MentalHealthBench, a benchmark developed with mental health experts to evaluate realistic conversations. **About the Role** We’re looking for an exceptional, hands\-on researcher to turn difficult\-to\-define signals of long\-term flourishing into measurable improvements in model behavior. You’ll help set research direction, build what is needed to test your ideas, and drive successful work into the models and products we ship. We’re especially interested in researchers with deep experience improving frontier models through pretraining or reinforcement learning (RL) / post\-training, especially on less verifiable problems, or researchers who combine strong LLM skills with deep expertise in domains like education or mental health. Prior experience in these domains is not required. **In this role, you will** * Develop scalable training methods across the training stack that improve how models understand people’s values, support their agency, and help them achieve long\-term goals. * Lead high\-leverage research from an open question to a shipped improvement: choose a hard\-to\-define problem, iteratively define success, run experiments, and integrate into frontier models. * Build RL environments for difficult\-to\-verify outcomes, and study whether beneficial behavior generalizes across settings. * Create evaluations grounded in human expertise and feedback that reveal capability gaps, unintended incentives in RL, and failures that aggregate scores can miss. * Test whether measures of model behavior predict better learning, wellbeing, and other long\-term outcomes, and use those findings to guide training. * Build new 0 1 capabilities in human domains that may have an increasing impact with upcoming increases in model intelligence and test\-time compute. * Partner with product teams, engineers, partnerships teams, and domain experts to deploy promising methods, measure their effects in real use, and turn what you learn into further improvements. * Assess AI’s impacts on human flourishing at the scale of over a billion users. **You might thrive in this role if you** * Care deeply about helping AI improve people’s lives, and feel this is a responsibility that comes with increasingly capable models. * Have an unusually strong research record in pretraining or RL / post\-training research, especially in a hard\-to\-verify area; Working knowledge of packet processing and networking fundamentals, including Ethernet, IP, TCP/UDP, routing, and switching. Experience implementing or debugging networking software such as forwarding, encapsulation, virtual switching, or network policy. Familiarity with the basic storage I/O path, latency, throughput, and failure handling, and ability to investigate issues with storage partners. departments at a corrugated plant, completing assigned learning objectives and technical training in each area. * Organize and implement moderate to large process improvements, problem elimination and * Attend and participate in POE program conferences and assigned off\-site training. * Collaborate with other Plant Optimization Engineers, the plant leadership team, and machine and maintenance operators to complete projects. * Work with the POE Mentor/manager to conceptualize a career path to follow the POE program. * Know and follow policies and procedures of the company, share information that would benefit other members of the team and find ways to improve the delivery of service to our customers. * Strive to continually strengthen PCA’s business philosophy of meeting needs and exceeding expectations for customers specifically supporting PCA’s Commitment to Service that involves doing what is right for our customers, focusing on strategies that add value and support growth, rotation as needed. * Must be self\-driven and passionate about working in a hands\-on, manufacturing environment. * Must be able to travel as necessary and possess valid documents for travel via air and car. **Preferred Qualifications:** * A minimum of one Internship or Co\-op is preferred, especially in a manufacturing environment. * Obtaining a Bachelor of Science degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Paper Engineering, Industrial \& Systems Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or Engineering Technology is preferred.
