jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Accounts
jobs.description: PENN Entertainment, Inc. is North America's leading provider of integrated entertainment, sports content, and casino gaming experiences. From casinos and racetracks to online gaming, sports betting and entertainment content, we deliver the experiences people want, how and where they want them. We're always on the lookout for those who are passionate about creating and delivering cutting\-edge online gaming and sports media products. Whether it's through Hollywood Casino, theScore Bet Sportsbook, or theScore media app, we're excited to push the boundaries of what's possible. These state\-of\-the\-art platforms are powered by proprietary in\-house technology, a key component of PENN's omnichannel gaming and entertainment strategy. When you join PENN Entertainment's digital team, you'll not only work on these cutting\-edge platforms through theScore and PENN Interactive, but you'll also be part of a company that truly cares about your career growth. We're committed to supporting you as you expand your skills and explore new opportunities. With locations throughout North America, you can build a future at PENN Entertainment wherever you are. If you want to challenge conventions in gaming, media and entertainment, we want to talk to you. **About the Team** As part of the Accounts team, you will be working with a group of talented and friendly individuals. Our goal is to deliver and maintain the performant, resilient, accurate, best\-in\-class software platform to drive player registration and authentication, identity verification (KYC), fraud and AML checks, geolocation compliance, responsible gaming enforcement, regulatory enforcement, and player communications (push, email, SMS) that is at the core of everything we do as a company. As a result, our stakeholders span the entire range of the business, and we must support them with whatever they are required to deliver without sacrificing the quality and performance we strive to maintain. This will include building a lot of cross\-service integrations, with internal and external stakeholders. We are also hyper\-vigilant about software performance, resilience, reliability, and accuracy, constantly tracking risks and regressions on all fronts, and proposing improvements where opportunities exist. The systems we own are among the most business\-critical at PENN: every player signup, login, identity check, and responsible gaming decision runs through them, and getting them right is a regulatory obligation, not just an engineering goal. **About the Work** * Design, scale, and performance\-tune REST APIs, low\-latency gRPC services, and SQL queries powering player registration and authentication (OAuth2, MFA, biometrics), identity verification, fraud and AML screening, geolocation compliance, responsible gaming and self\-exclusion enforcement, regulatory reporting, and player notifications, among other things. * Own technical problems of the highest scope and complexity, drafting proposals and presenting them to leadership and partner teams for feedback * Design, architect, and deliver new features end\-to\-end in a collaborative agile/scrum environment * Identify bottlenecks and areas of risk in production, and drive the changes that make the platform more scalable * Set up and refine monitoring and alerting in Datadog for the systems you own * Mentor engineers on the team and across teams that ship into our codebase, through specs, pairing, and code review * Interact with multiple stakeholders across a wide variety of business domains to deliver best in class products, operational improvements, and cost efficiency optimizations. * Be comfortable with bridging the gap between internal, third party (identity verification, fraud, geolocation, and messaging vendors), legacy, and modern systems; and excel at doing what this entails, including, data migrations, intermediate data translation, the building and stewardship of additional supporting infrastructure as required, etc. * Other duties as required. **About You** * You possess a minimum of 5 years of experience in Software engineering * A solid foundation in computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, distributed systems, algorithms, and software design * Strong grasp of production systems at scale, and experience identifying areas of improvement in a production environment through load testing and tracing * Experience investigating and remediating production performance regressions, including CPU, I/O, and memory hotspots as well as latency regressions in high\-throughput services * Experience with on\-call rotations for a production service, including owning release cycles end\-to\-end * Passionate about clean code architecture and software craftsmanship * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of authoring tech specs, runbooks, and cross\-team design docs that stand up to scrutiny * Experience with modern web frameworks and API development (Phoenix, Ruby on Rails, FastAPI, Laravel, Node) * A strong grasp of relational databases, including PostgreSQL and MySQL. Additionally, a strong understanding of relational database theory, including, but not limited to, normalization and denormalization, particularly from a flexibility vs performance mindset, is a major asset. * Experience with Kubernetes and comfort operating services in a containerized environment * Comfortable working in the terminal, with Git and GitHub or similar, and in an editor of your choice * Experience with testing frameworks such as ExUnit, RSpec, Jest, pytest, or equivalent * Experience with background job processing (Oban, Exq, Sidekiq, Celery, Beanstalkd) * Experience with asynchronous event handling infrastructure (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Google Cloud Pub/Sub) * Experience with agentic software development tools, building and using agentic workflows, and validating quality of agentic outputs is a major asset. * Experience with building authentication, identity, or other regulated systems with strong security and auditability is paramount. * Strong understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, JWT, MFA) and secure handling of PII. * Experience integrating third\-party KYC, fraud, geolocation, or messaging providers (e.g., push, email, SMS) is an asset. NICE TO HAVE: * Experience building applications in Elixir, hexagonal architecture, Domain\-Driven Design, contribution to open source software, experience working at startups, passion for sports and/or esports * Experience with building financial, legal, and / or process accounting systems with strong correctness and auditability * Experience designing and evolving GraphQL schemas for product surfaces used by multiple clients (iOS, Android, Web) is an asset. * Experience building and integrating multi\-client / white\-label platforms, including geo\-based routing and per\-jurisdiction configuration * Familiarity with gaming regulatory requirements across jurisdictions (e.g., AGCO, DGE) and responsible gaming controls is an asset. **What We Offer** * Competitive compensation package * Fun, relaxed work environment * Education and conference reimbursements. * Opportunities for career progression and mentoring others \#LI\-REMOTE *Penn Interactive is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.Base pay is one part of the Total Rewards that Penn Interactive provides to compensate and recognize employees for their work. Most sales positions are eligible for a Commission under the terms of an applicable plan, while most non\-sales positions are eligible for a Bonus. Additionally, Penn Interactive provides best\-in\-class benefits to eligible employees. We believe that benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That's why we provide an array of options, expert guidance and always\-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality – to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life.*

jobs.title: Head of Fraud
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market, and trust in every account, deposit and trade is core to the product. As Head of Fraud, you will own Polymarket's fraud risk end to end: defining the strategy, building preventative and detective controls, and making sure every finding is resolved. Your scope covers first\-party fraud (customers abusing the platform themselves) and third\-party fraud (bad actors targeting our users and systems, including account takeover). You will hold the bar for what good looks like both commercially and in the eyes of our regulators, and you will move fast. You will partner with and influence Product owners and engineers you don't manage build and ship most fraud controls, so influencing them is critical to success in this role. You'll also work closely with Compliance, Legal, Data, Payments, Customer Support and Security. **What you'll own** ------------------- **Strategy and risk ownership** * Own the fraud risk framework and appetite, and set the roadmap to deliver it. * Maintain a living fraud risk assessment and typology library across onboarding, funding, trading and withdrawals. * Report fraud exposure, losses, control performance and emerging threats to senior leadership and governance forums. **Preventative and detective controls** * Partner with Product and Engineering to assess fraud risk before new products, payment methods, promotions, and material feature changes launch. * Define and implement controls that stop fraud before it happens: identity and device signals, step\-up authentication, velocity and limit rules, and payment and withdrawal checks. * Build detective controls that surface fraud fast: monitoring rules, ML and AI models, anomaly detection, alerting and case management. * Tune controls continuously against loss rates, false positives and customer friction. **Fraud types in scope** * **First\-party fraud:** chargeback and friendly fraud, promotion and referral abuse, ACH fraud, multi\-accounting, and identity misrepresentation by genuine customers. * **Third\-party fraud:** account takeover, synthetic and stolen identities, stolen payment methods, phishing, social engineering, scams, and organized fraud rings. **Findings and resolution** * Own investigations, from triage to root cause to closure. * Make sure every finding from monitoring, audits, regulatory exams and incidents has an owner, a fix and a deadline, and is closed out. * Feed lessons back into product, controls and policy so issues don't recur. **Team and partnership** * Build and lead a high\-performing fraud team of analysts, investigators and fraud data specialists. * Drive delivery through Product and Engineering: shape their roadmaps, win prioritization for fraud work, and design prevention into features from day one. * Work with Compliance and Legal on regulatory expectations, SAR\-related escalations and exam readiness. * Select and manage fraud vendors and tooling. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- Influence is the most critical skill for this role, and we'll assess it at every interview stage. * **Exceptional influence.** You have a track record of getting fraud controls shipped by product and engineering teams you don't manage. You build trust fast, make a clear case using data, win prioritization against competing roadmaps, and turn disagreement into decisions. * **Deep fraud expertise.** 10\+ years of experience in fraud within fintech, payments, banking, crypto, trading, online gaming, or other high\-volume digital platforms, including at least five years in leadership, with direct accountability for fraud prevention, investigations, operations, and measurable outcomes. * **Control design that works.** A track record of building preventative and detective controls from scratch and proving they cut losses without hurting good customers. * **Breadth across fraud types.** Hands\-on experience with both first\-party and third\-party fraud, including account takeover, identity fraud and payment fraud. * **AI native.** You use AI and automation as your default way of working: for detection models, investigation tooling, case triage and your own day\-to\-day productivity. You know where models beat rules and where they don't. * **Commercial judgement.** You understand that the goal is the right balance of loss, friction and growth, not zero fraud. You can put a number on the trade\-offs. * **Regulatory lens.** You know what regulators expect from a fraud program (governance, documentation, testing, escalation) and can defend our approach in an exam. * **Pace and ownership.** You drive outcomes quickly, prioritize ruthlessly and close things out. You're comfortable in a fast\-moving, high\-growth environment. * **Data fluency.** Comfortable working directly in SQL and with data teams to size problems and measure control performance. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience at a regulated exchange, derivatives venue or broker, or at a crypto platform with on\-chain and fiat flows. * Familiarity with blockchain analytics and wallet\-level risk signals. * Exposure to market abuse and trade surveillance, and how it intersects with fraud. * Experience building fraud capability across multiple jurisdictions. * Hands\-on experience shipping LLM or agent\-based tooling for investigations. **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive salary \& equity * Unlimited PTO * Full Health, Vision, \& Dental coverage * 401k match * Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, \& accessories **Pay Transparency** -------------------- Base salary range: $500,000 to $6000,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good\-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through. Compensation Range: $500K \- $600K

design reviews and able to coach others. * Proven AI\-led engineering experience: you have built and run a team where AI is central to how software is designed, written, tested and shipped (AI\-assisted development, agentic workflows, LLM\-powered product features),  , North Dakota, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, or Wyoming. **What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member** incentive awards, subject to program guidelines and approvals. You will also be eligible to receive an annual bonus based on individual and company performance, subject to program guidelines and approvals. Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing. * Our traditional healthcare benefits include three (3\) Medical plan options, two (2\) Dental plan options, and a Vision plan from which to choose. * Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Accident plans are offered on a voluntary basis. * We offer pre\-tax savings options including a partially employer funded Health Savings Account and employee Flexible Savings Accounts including healthcare, dependent care, and transportation savings options. * We provide company paid Basic Life and AD\&D, Short and Long\-Term Disability benefits. We also offer Voluntary Life and AD\&D plans. * Both traditional and Roth 401(k) plans are available with a discretionary employer match. * Supportlinc is part of our employer paid wellbeing program and provides employees and their families access to on demand guided meditation and mindfulness exercises, mental health coaching, clinical care and online access to confidential resources including will preparation. * LifeBalance is a free resource to employees and their families for year\-round discounts on things like gym memberships, travel, appliances, movies, pet insurance and more. * Our wellness programs include flexible paid vacation, company\-paid holidays of typically nine per year, paid sick time, paid parental leave, identity theft program, travel assistance, and fitness and other discounts programs. \#LI\-NH1 \#LI\-Remote **What’s next?** Submit your application and our Porch Group Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - ML Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ Preference Model is a superintelligence data research company. We build RL environments for training capable, better\-aligned superintelligences. Almost every aspect of how a model behaves is shaped by the reward signals it's trained on. The biggest problem with AIs today is that they don't always do what we intend. Sometimes that's because they aren't capable enough, and sometimes it's because they aren't aligned. Both problems come down to the training objectives. We're trying to address both of these issues in the most direct, highest leverage way available to us, which today means researching how to build RL environments better, not just for the AIs of today but for the AIs as they will be when they outsmart us. Over the past year, we've built RL environments for several frontier labs, and we're backed by $16M in seed funding led by a16z. Our founding team has previous experience on Anthropic’s data team building data infrastructure, and datasets behind Claude. **About the Role** ================== An RL environment is only useful once it runs reliably inside a lab's training stack. Every environment we build has to be packaged, sandboxed, run at scale, checked against each lab's requirements, and delivered in the format that lab's platform expects. Much of that work is still manual today, and it takes time away from the people designing environments. As an **MTS on our ML Platform team**, you will own the systems that take an environment from a builder's repo to a lab's training run. That includes Karotte, our open\-source framework for defining RL environments, the internal platform that builds, runs, and reviews environments on CPU, GPU, and TPU, and the integrations that deliver them to each lab we work with. This is a **senior ML platform engineering role** where you will ensure what our Capabilities team builds runs and ships cleanly. You'll join a small Platform team and work directly with environment builders and post\-training researchers. In your first six months, success looks like a delivery path to each partner lab that is mostly automated: tasks marked ready get built, validated against that lab's requirements, and packaged without hand work. Our needs change quickly, so you'll also pick up other platform and infrastructure work as priorities shift. **What You Will Do** ==================== * Own the integrations that deliver our environments to partner labs: build container images, match each lab's submission format, and automate the checks that confirm requirements are met before anything ships. Do the delivery work by hand where you have to, then automate it. * Build and maintain Karotte, our open\-source environment framework, from API design through releases and migrations that keep existing environments working. * Run and scale the infrastructure that builds, runs, and grades environments, including containerized rollouts and grading across CPU, GPU, and TPU, VM\-based sandboxing, and the resource limits and isolation that stop a model from gaming its own grader. * Build the internal tools environment builders use every day (CLI, docs, data catalog, access controls, and run monitoring) so they spend their time on environment design instead of infrastructure. * Partner with environment builders and post\-training researchers to turn recurring pain points into platform features, and ship quickly in response to their feedback. **What We are Looking For** =========================== * **5\+ years of experience** building and owning ML Platform Engineering, ideally AI related ML Platform Engineering * Strong software engineering fundamentals and a track record of building and operating production infrastructure or developer platforms that other engineers depend on. * Hands\-on experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar) and at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or similar). * A working understanding of how to run untrusted code safely: isolation, resource limits, and what happens when a process fills the disk or refuses to exit. * You've owned something tedious end to end, such as a migration, a release process, or a delivery pipeline, and automated away as much of it as you could. * Extensive hands\-on use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar), and an intuition for where models cut corners. * Proficiency in Python, including writing libraries and APIs that other people build on. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building RL environments, eval harnesses, or agent benchmarks (Terminal\-Bench, SWE\-bench, or similar). * Familiarity with RL post\-training and inference stacks (verl, Ray, SkyPilot, vLLM, SGLang, or similar). **You may be a good fit if one of the following applies** ========================================================= * You've built sandbox or code\-execution infrastructure (microVMs such as Firecracker, gVisor, or similar) at an infrastructure startup or frontier lab. * You've been an early platform or infrastructure engineer at a startup and built the internal platform the rest of engineering relied on. * You've worked as a forward deployed or integrations engineer, getting your company's software running inside customers' own environments. * You've built developer tooling or internal platforms used by ML researchers, even outside a formal ML role. * You've maintained an open\-source developer framework with real external users. **What We Offer:** ================== * Competitive cash and equity compensation (\>90th percentile) * Ownership and autonomy in a fast moving startup environment * Opportunity to work alongside senior and staff engineers from frontier labs and infrastructure companies, plus top ML engineers * Health, vision, dental, benefits * 401K match * Lunch provided everyday onsite * Weekly snack orders * Visa sponsorship \& relocation support available **We value diverse perspectives and experiences. If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we still encourage you to apply.** Compensation Range: $180K \- $350K

jobs.title: Staff Business Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Proofpoint is a global leader in human\- and agent\-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people. **How We Work:** At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values: **Bold** in how we dream and innovate **Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities **Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes **Visionary** in future focused problem\-solving **Exceptional** in execution and impact **The Role** ------------ Proofpoint is building a single, governed analytical foundation for the company at a moment when it matters most: a Snowflake platform consolidation is underway, a transformative acquisition is signed and pending, and the company is moving toward AI\-native analytics. The business definitions already exist and are Finance\-approved. What's missing is the durable, auditable, machine\-readable layer that lets dashboards, self\-service tools, and AI agents all give the same answer. You will build it. You own the analytical and semantic layer in Snowflake: governed data models, metric logic, and the context that sits between raw data and business consumers. IT and Data Engineering own ingestion and upstream pipelines. You partner with them to establish the analytical requirements, interfaces, validation standards, and data models that enable consistent downstream consumption. You are the technical counterpart to two business\-facing pillars and to the Senior Director who owns Proofpoint's ARR/NARR metric definitions. Their recurring questions become your reusable assets. You’ll be expected to understand the business behind the questions, not just the schema behind the data. This is a senior\-level individual contributor role, reporting to the Senior Director, Business Analytics. **Location:** This is a hybrid role based in our Sunnyvale, CA HQ, 4 days a week. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- ***Semantic Architecture \& Governed Data Assets*** * **Semantic Layer:** Design and build governed analytical data models and the semantic layer in Snowflake, translating approved metric definitions (ARR, NARR, retention, customer lifecycle) into reusable, versioned calculation logic. * **Metric \& Context Registry:** Establish a machine\-readable metric and context registry so that business definitions, relationships, and calculations are interpreted consistently across Power BI, self\-service tools, and AI\-driven interfaces. This does not exist today; you will design it. * **Acquisition Integration:** Integrate acquired businesses into the governed metric layer, including entity mapping, definition reconciliation, and historical restatement. ***AI\-Native Analytics \& Business Intelligence*** * **AI\-Native Analytics:** Design and implement AI\-native analytical capabilities on Snowflake's Cortex ecosystem and governed semantic models, evaluating the architectural approaches that enable reliable natural\-language and agent\-based access to business information, and recommending how they scale on the platform the company is standardizing on. * **Business Intelligence:** Evolve Power BI from fragmented functional reporting toward integrated cross\-functional views connecting commercial activity, product performance, and financial outcomes. ***Data Quality, Governance \& Technical Leadership*** * **Reliability Controls:** Implement reconciliation, validation, lineage, and monitoring controls that make analytical outputs reproducible, traceable, and suitable for financial reporting governance and audit support. * **Technical Standards:** Set technical standards and reusable patterns (modeling, dbt usage, testing, documentation) that let analysts and engineering partners build consistently without central bottlenecks. * **Upstream Issue Resolution:** Identify upstream data quality and architectural issues and drive resolution with system owners. **What you bring to the team** ------------------------------ ***Required*** * 8\+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, BI, or data architecture, with substantial hands\-on ownership of production analytical models. * Advanced SQL and deep expertise in dimensional and semantic modeling on a modern cloud data platform. * Experience building enterprise BI and governed self\-service reporting at scale. * Experience implementing governed business metrics, reconciliation controls, and consistent analytical definitions across enterprise reporting environments. * Demonstrated habit of starting from the business questi what breaks if it’s wrong, and why the definition is what it is, before you decide how to build it. You don’t need to be a finance expert, but you should be the person who asks. * Track record of leading technical initiatives across teams without formal authority, and of turning ambiguous business requirements into architecture. * Strong written and verbal communication with both technical and finance/business stakeholders. ***Preferred*** * Snowflake and Power BI (our current stack) and dbt. * SaaS or recurring\-revenue metrics (ARR, retention, cohorts); the definitions are owned by the team, so you'll be implementing them, not inventing them. * Hands\-on work with semantic layers, metric stores, or context layers built for LLM/agent consumption (Cortex Analyst, dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, or similar). This area is new for everyone; we are looking for transferable depth and demonstrated curiosity, not years of experience. * Experience integrating acquired\-company data into enterprise models. * Familiarity with CRM, ERP, and financial planning systems as analytical sources. **What success looks like in year one** --------------------------------------- * Core ARR, NARR, and retention metrics are implemented in a governed semantic layer and validated against approved Finance definitions. * Priority reporting and analytical use cases consume shared, tested data assets rather than bespoke extracts. * An initial AI\-native analytical capability returns consistent, governed answers to a defined set of business questions. * Integration requirements and mappings for acquired businesses are established, with priority metrics incorporated as integration progresses. * Manual reconciliation and redundant analytical work measurably decline for the supported use cases. \#LI\-AN2 **Why Proofpoint?** At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us: * Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefits * Career success on your terms * Flexible work environment * Annual wellness and community outreach days * Always on recognition for your contributions * Global collaboration and networking opportunities **Our Culture:** Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success\-every day, for everyone. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. If you need accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to accessibility@proofpoint.com. **How to Apply** Interested? Submit your application along with any supporting information\- we can’t wait to hear from you! Consistent with Proofpoint values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets as set out below. Pay within these ranges varies and depends on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate. The range provided may represent a candidate range and may not reflect the full range for an individual tenured employee. This role may be eligible for variable compensation and/or equity. We offer a competitive benefits package, including flexible time off, a comprehensive well\-being program with two paid Wellbeing Days and two paid Volunteer Days per year, plus a three\-week Work from Anywhere option. **Base Pay Ranges:** SF Bay Area, New York City Metro Area: Base Pay Range: 166,500\.00 \- 244,200\.00 USD California (excludes SF Bay Area), Colorado, Connecticut, Illinois, Washington DC Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Texas, Washington, Virginia, and Alaska: Base Pay Range: 136,200\.00 \- 199,760\.00 USD All other cities and states excluding those listed above: Base Pay Range: 124,100\.00 \- 182,050\.00 USD

jobs.title: Director of Security
jobs.description: ### **About Prophecy** The leader in AI\-native data preparation and analysis, Prophecy is revolutionizing how the world's top enterprises turn data chaos into reliable insights. We introduce the AI\-native data lifecycle (generate, refine, deploy) where our industry\-leading AI agents and humans work hand\-in\-hand in visual and document interfaces to analyze, transform, and prepare data to ship trusted insights at enterprise scale. Join us as we build the next data revolution. ### **About The Role** Prophecy is entrusted by some of the world's largest organizations, including leading banks and telecoms, to handle sensitive, business\-critical data. We've built a strong security foundation to earn that trust, including ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification and SOC 1 Type II and SOC 2 Type II reports, and now we're hiring our first dedicated security leader to take it to the next level, especially as AI agents become central to how our customers work with their data. You'll own security end\-to\-end and lead a small team of security engineers and IT staff as a player\-coach: setting strategy while doing much of the hands\-on work yourself. You will be responsible for product and AI security, cloud and infrastructure security, compliance, and customer trust, along with the corporate security strategy that supports them. You'll partner closely with our engineering teams across the US and India, and with our go\-to\-market team as they sell into some of the world's most security\-conscious enterprises. This role reports directly to the CTO. ### **Responsibilities** #### **Security Strategy and Program** * Own Prophecy's security strategy and roadmap across product, cloud infrastructure, and corporate environments. * Build and scale the security program, including policies, controls, risk assessments, and a clear view of where to mitigate risk and where to accept it. **Product Security** * Partner with Engineering across the US and India to embed security into how we design, build, and ship our AI agents and data platform. * Own threat modeling for agentic systems, including tool and permission scoping, prompt injection defenses, credential handling, data isolation between customers, and runtime monitoring. * Lead AI governance for our agent platform, building on our alignment with the EU AI Act and NIST frameworks, including how customer data flows through models and third\-party LLM providers. * Lead application security practices across secure code review, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and secure\-by\-default engineering standards. * Secure our integrations with Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, and other customer data platforms. #### **Internal AI Agent Security** * Set guardrails for the agents we run internally: least\-privilege access to data, systems, and MCP servers, short\-lived credentials, and human approval for high\-risk actions. * Review new internal agents and AI tools before they touch production or customer data, set policy for employee AI use, and extend logging and incident response to agent activity. * Build agents for the security team itself, such as questionnaire automation and alert triage. #### **Cloud and Infrastructure Security** * Own the security posture of our AWS and Kubernetes environments, including identity and access management, secrets management, logging, and detection. * Build and run incident response, from detection and triage through post\-incident review and remediation. #### **Compliance and Customer Trust** * Own and evolve our compliance programs, including ISO/IEC 27001:2022, SOC 1 Type II, and SOC 2 Type II, maintaining continuous audit readiness and expanding coverage as the business requires. * Own data privacy compliance across the regions where we operate, including GDPR, CCPA, and India's DPDP Act. * Lead security reviews, questionnaires, and trust documentation for enterprise and regulated\-industry customers. * Join customer calls with CISOs and security teams to answer hard questions directly and help close deals. #### **Corporate Security** * Partner with IT and People on access management, device security, vendor risk, and security awareness across the company. ### **Requirements** #### **Required** * 10\+ years in security, with at least 3 years in product, application, or cloud security at a software company. * Led a small security or IT team as a player\-coach. * Hands\-on experience securing AWS and Kubernetes environments. * Experience owning ISO/IEC 27001 and/or SOC 2 Type II programs, including audits and ongoing control management. * Experience supporting enterprise sales through security reviews, questionnaires, and customer CISO conversations. * Comfortable being both strategist and hands\-on practitioner as the first dedicated security leader at a fast\-growing startup. * Strong written and verbal communication, including translating technical risk for executives and customers. #### **Preferred** * Experience securing AI/LLM\-powered products, including prompt injection, agent permissioning, and data handling with third\-party model providers. * Background at a data platform or data infrastructure company (Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, or similar). * Experience selling into regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or telecom. * Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones. #### **Benefits** **and Perks** * Prophecy covers 99% of employee health insurance premiums and 75% for dependents * Discretionary allowance for cell phone, wifi, gym memberships, wellness, and more * Flexible PTO * Professional development allowance * Company sponsored Long Term Disability and Life Insurance, FSA/HSA, dental, vision * Ability to have your fingerprint on an innovative product * End\-to\-end ownership of your projects * Benefits and perks may vary per country #### **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** At Prophecy, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Prophecy are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio\-economic status, and any other protected characteristics.

jobs.description: ### **About the role:** At Provectus, you don’t prototype in a sandbox and hand a client a slide deck. You embed inside a bank, an insurer, or a health system, learn the work, and ship a Claude \+ AWS system into their real, regulated production — then you watch the business number move. That means the newest models, real budgets, and problems that matter — without the layers, politics, and years\-to\-impact of a hundred\-thousand\-person firm. 350\+ builders, 100\+ customers in production, founder\-led since 2010, offices across North America, LATAM, and EMEA. **Why Provectus** ----------------- * **Frontier access** — Anthropic Preferred Partner: newest Claude models, real budgets, real problems. * **Real tasks (not scope), real deployment.** You go where the operating problem is and ship production code to real users, not slide decks that sit in a drive. * **Embedded, not engaged.** You are part of the customer’s team and inside their process — not a vendor running a project alongside it. Embedded is not staff\-augmented. * **Autonomous.** You own the work from framing through to production, visible to clients and founders. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. * **Your experience stays portable.** Every engagement is a new problem, often in a new industry, so your skills compound instead of narrowing to one product. No legacy\-maintenance grind, not a single stack. * **Craft \& growth** — build beside senior FDEs on a Claude\-certified team; a real platform (talks, OSS) to grow your name. * **We give you a stage:** Claude certification, conference talks, open\-source contributions, published work under your own name. ### **Requirements:** * Typically 7\+ years building software, a substantial share of it writing production code you were accountable for. You are hands\-on today and intend to stay that way. * Genuinely willing to spend time understanding someone else’s job before writing code; demonstrated ability to become conversant in an unfamiliar business function quickly. * Shipped GenAI/LLM systems to production — not demos, not notebooks. You’ve handled the parts that get hard after the prototype works. * You evaluate. jobs.title: AI Inference Framework Engineer
jobs.description: Quadric is redefining edge AI with the industry's first General Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU), enabling developers to run both neural network inference and conventional C\+\+ code on a single programmable architecture. Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems. Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real\-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co\-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co\-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21\. **The Opportunity** =================== Quadric's GPNPU runs both neural networks and C\+\+ code on a single programmable architecture. As a member of our AI Application team, you will make the GPNPU a first\-class backend in the frameworks developers already use, such as llama.cpp, PyTorch, and vLLM. That way, customers can move their applications from GPUs to Quadric with minimal changes. You'll own backend integration from memory and dispatch through serving features, working closely with our kernel, runtime and compiler teams. **What You'll Do** ================== Integrate GPNPU backend into AI compute frameworks (llama.cpp, PyTorch, vLLM, Optimum) * Implement framework backend interface, memory allocation, compute dispatch, registration and operators/kernels * Implement model compute pipelines including prefill, decode, batching, multi\-sequence and multi\-modal * Support important framework serving features including KV\-cache management, paged attention, continuous batching, speculative decoding Optimize framework performance and accuracy for GPNPU backend * Reduce host\-device dispatch overhead, implement graph capture/replay, integrate efficient kernels, minimize latency * Support quantization formats such as GGUF (Q4/Q8\), GPTQ/AWQ, int8/fp16 * Validate accuracy against reference backends (perplexity, task benchmarks) and drive improvements **What Success Looks Like** =========================== Within your first 6\-12 months, you’ll: * Bring up a new LLM/VLM family end to end on the GPNPU backend, with accuracy matching the reference * Deliver measurable tokens/s or latency gains on a frontier model * Ship one serving feature (e.g. paged KV cache) in a production release **What We're Looking For** ========================== **Required** ------------ * 3\+ years building or extending ML frameworks or inference runtimes * BS/MS in CS/CE or related fields * Strong C/C\+\+ and Python * Solid understanding of framework internals: tensor memory management, graph scheduling, operator dispatch * Solid understanding of AI compute performance analysis and optimization * Fluent with AI coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor), and interested in building agent\-driven workflows for backend and model bring\-up **Preferred** * Experience writing an accelerator backend (CUDA, Metal, Vulkan, Hexagon or another NPU) for an open\-source framework * Contribution to open\-source frameworks (PyTorch, llama.cpp, vLLM) * Understanding of low level AI compute pipelines, CPU/NPU, DMA * Understanding of graph compilers and kernel fusion **What We Offer** ================= The base salary range for this position is $160,000 to $195,000\. This range reflects the full span of levels and geographies at which Quadric hires for this role. The actual base salary offered will depend on a number of factors, including the specific level of the role, years and depth of relevant experience, technical skills and competencies, the criticality of the role to the business, internal equity, and work location. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for equity and a discretionary annual performance bonus as applicable to the role and level. In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US\-based offerings; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance from day one \- Premiums covered at 99% for Employees * Company\-paid life Insurance * Voluntary supplemental life insurance * STD \+ LTD insurance * Commuter support including parking or Caltrain reimbursement. Our office is conveniently located within walking distance of the Caltrain station * FSA \+ HSA * Equity with the business * Paid Parental Leave * 401(k) Retirement Plan * Flexible PTO * Winter holiday shutdown * Catered lunch each day in our office * Downtown Burlingame office location, close to shops, cafes, and local amenities * Collaborative, low\-ego culture with significant ownership and impact * A work culture focused on innovative disruption If this role resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not perfectly match every qualification. We value potential, curiosity, and a willingness to learn just as much as direct experience. ### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Quadric is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Developer Relations Engineer (San Francisco, California)
jobs.description: Qdrant is an **open\-source vector** search engine powering the next generation of AI applications, from semantic search and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) to AI agents and real\-time recommendations. Trusted by global leaders like **Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom**, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising **$50M in Series B** funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data. As a remote\-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI. **The Team and Your Impact** ---------------------------- As our **Senior Developer Relations Engineer** in San Francisco, you'll lead Qdrant's developer engagement in one of the most active AI communities in the world. In this senior individual contributor role, you'll combine hands\-on engineering (about 40% of your time) with public speaking, content, and community building (about 60%). **Your impact** will show up in two places. Externally, you'll turn your Bay Area relationships with engineers, founders, and event organizers into joint projects and workshops with our ecosystem partners, while your talks at premier conferences and your technical content reach hundreds of thousands of developers worldwide. Inside Qdrant, you'll bring what you hear from developers directly to our core engineering team to shape the roadmap, and you'll raise the bar for the DevRel team by starting new initiatives and mentoring others. **What You Will Own** --------------------- * **Demos and applied research.** Build and maintain open\-source demo applications, such as end\-to\-end retrieval pipelines, recommendation engines, and AI search tools. Prototype new Qdrant use cases by experimenting with emerging patterns like neural sparse encoders, agentic workflows, and AI memory. * **Technical content.** Write in\-depth technical articles, record video tutorials, and create practical guides that make complex concepts easy to follow. * **Talks, events, and Bay Area partnerships.** Give talks and live coding sessions at conferences, and lead Qdrant's presence at hackathons and workshops. Work with our partnerships team to turn local relationships into joint workshops, demos, and speaking opportunities. * **Developer community.** Answer technical questions on Discord, X, LinkedIn, and Reddit, and bring what developers need back to our product and engineering teams. **Who You Are** --------------- * **Senior DevRel experience.** You have 5\+ years in software engineering, Developer Relations, or technical marketing, including at least 3 in Developer Relations. You've independently delivered technical talks, workshops, and community programs, and you can share examples of working applications and collaborations you started. * **Technical depth and clear communication.** You have strong software engineering skills in **Python, Rust, TypeScript, or Go.** You can build and debug applications that use vector search, embeddings, and large language models, and explain the "how" and "why" behind them, whether in writing or on stage. * **Ownership of outcomes.** You've owned a DevRel program or initiative end to end: you set the goals, chose what to build or say, and measured whether it worked, for example through adoption, community growth, or content reach. You can walk us through what you changed based on the results. * **Influence beyond your own work.** You've changed a product or engineering decision based on developer feedback, and you've helped other team members grow through mentoring, reviews, or shared practices. * **Established San Francisco network.** You're an active part of the Bay Area developer and AI community, with real relationships among engineers, event organizers, and founders. * **Judgment and empathy for developers.** You follow the AI ecosystem closely, test new tools for their practical value, and can tell useful technical work from hype. You understand what developers need and use that to choose topics and create content that respects their knowledge. **Nice To Have** ---------------- * **Search and retrieval depth.** You've worked on search or information retrieval systems, or at a search company, and understand how indexing, ranking, and relevance tuning work under the hood. * **Applied research.** You go deeper than tutorials. You read papers, run experiments or benchmarks, and turn what you find into something developers can use. * **Video and social reach.** You've built an audience through video or social media, for example YouTube tutorials, livestreams, or technical posts on X or LinkedIn. **Why join us** --------------- * A remote\-first, international team working on cutting\-edge AI infrastructure. * A competitive salary with additional perks. * Flexible working hours and async\-friendly culture. * High ownership and real impact. * Open\-source, engineering\-driven culture. * Choose your own laptop equipment. For US\-based full\-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy. Qdrant is an equal\-opportunity employer. We believe the best ideas come from diverse teams, and we actively welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If this role excites you but you don't check every single box, we'd still love to hear from you! We don't want to miss out on great people because of a checklist. **Come build with us!** ### **For information on how we handle your personal data, please refer to our** **Recruitment Privacy Policy** **\#LI\-REMOTE**

jobs.title: Machine Learning Research Engineer, Senior
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Machine Learning Engineering **General Summary:** Qualcomm AI Research is looking for world\-class researchers in deep learning to join a high\-caliber team of engineers inventing machine\-learning technology to provide best\-in\-class solutions while running with the most efficient use of power, memory, and computation. Members of our team are part of a multi\-disciplinary core research group within Qualcomm which spans software, hardware, and systems. Our members contribute technology deployed worldwide by partnering with our business teams across mobile, compute, automotive, cloud, and IOT. We also perform and publish state\-of\-the\-art research on a wide range of topics in machine\-learning, ranging from general theory to techniques that enable deployment on resource\-constrained devices. Our research team has demonstrated first\-in\-the\-world research and proof\-of\-concepts in areas such model efficiency, neural video codecs, generative ai, video semantic segmentation, federated learning, and wireless RF sensing, to name a few. We work to then convert our research and industry state\-of\-the\-art methods. Please see our AI focus page at https://qualcomm.com/ai for more details. Role responsibility can include both applied and fundamental research in the field of machine learning with development focus in one or many of the following areas: * Drives systems innovations for model efficiency advancement on device as well as in the cloud. This includes model compression, model sparsity, quantization optimization methods, plus unified optimization of models and their implementation on\-target to balance memory, speed, and power. * Conducts fundamental machine learning research to create new models or new training methods in various technology areas, e.g., large language models, deep generative models (transformers, state\-space networks, diffusion networks, VAEs, etc.), reasoning models, agentic frameworks, and reinforcement learning techniques. * Performs advanced platform research to enable new machine learning compute paradigms, e.g., compute in memory, on\-device learning/training, edge\-cloud distributed/federated learning, quantum machine learning, causal and language\-based reasoning. * Creates new machine learning models for advanced use cases that achieve state\-of\-the\-art performance and beyond. The use cases can broadly include computer vision, audio, speech, NLP, image, video, power management, wireless, graphics, and chip design. * Design, develop \& test software for machine learning frameworks that optimize models to run efficiently on edge devices. Candidate is expected to have strong interest and deep passion on making leading\-edge deep learning algorithms work on mobile/embedded platforms for the benefit of end users. * Research, design, develop, enhance, and implement different components of machine learning compiler for HW Accelerators. * Design, implement and train DL/RL algorithms in high\-level languages/frameworks. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field and 2\+ years of Hardware Engineering, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. jobs.title: Product Data Management Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Product Data Management Engineer (Shop Floor) **Salary:** $80,000 \- $118,000 **Location:** Fremont, CA (On\-site) **Type:** Full\-time/Exempt **Job Summary:** PDM Engineers (Product Data Management Engineers) support manufacturing operations by preparing and maintaining the shopfloor system to ensure accuracy, traceability, and efficient production. At Level 1, the engineer assists in configuring system details, assigning serial numbers, generating identification stickers, and monitoring shopfloor activities under close supervision. They learn to troubleshoot common system errors, update data for changing supply conditions, and support cross\-functional teams with basic tasks. This entry\-level role focuses on building foundational skills in data management, system troubleshooting, and manufacturing processes. The Process Engineering team plays a critical role in bringing new products into manufacturing and ensuring they can be built efficiently and at scale. Process Engineers develop process flows, define equipment and manpower requirements, and coordinate with cross\-functional teams to establish new production lines based on customer and headquarters specifications. They validate tools and materials, lead pilot runs, train production leaders, and continuously monitor yield, quality, and performance to refine processes and support smooth mass production. **Duties/Responsibilities:** * Assist in configuring shopfloor systems based on Customer Requirement Documents (CRDs), with guidance from senior engineers. * Support serial number assignment and sticker generation for accurate component tracking. * Monitor basic shopfloor scanning activities and escalate issues such as misplacements or incorrect numbers to higher\-level engineers. * Update system data daily under supervision to reflect part supply changes. * Provide support to Process Engineers and production staff by documenting issues and reporting recurring errors. * Learn and apply database and data integrity concepts in a production environment. **Required Skills/Abilities: (Example of skills set)** * Foundational knowledge of data management; familiarity with SQL or similar tools is preferred. * Basic understanding of hardware or manufacturing processes. * Ability to follow instructions and learn troubleshooting techniques for system\-related errors. * High attention to detail and process consistency. * Strong willingness to learn, adapt, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams. * Manage production activities, WIP tracking, repair records, routing, etc., on the manufacturing floor. **Education and Experience:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered. * 1–3 years of relevant experience in data management, production support, or manufacturing. **Physical Requirements: (Example of requirement)** * Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. * Ability to access and navigate various departments within the organization’s facilities. ***Our company does not guarantee immigration sponsorship. Any sponsorship will be subject to internal review and approval based on employee performance, current immigration law and business needs.***

jobs.title: Data Security Architect
jobs.description: **Data Security Architect1\. Job Details** * **Job Title:** Data Security Architect * **Location:** Remote * **Duration:** 12 months * **Work Model:** Primarily remote, with a few onsite visits per month in Westbrook, Maine * **Primary Focus:** Data Security Architecture, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Snowflake Security, and Data Governance **2\. Job Summary** Clint is seeking an experienced **Data Security Architect** to help build and mature its enterprise data security program. This professional will define how sensitive data is classified, accessed, governed, and protected across complex enterprise environments, regardless of where the data resides. This is an architecture\-focused role rather than a tool administration position. The architect will translate business requirements and data\-related risks into enterprise security standards, reference architectures, and reusable protection patterns that engineering teams can implement. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in DLP and enterprise data protection, along with experience designing data security architecture, classification and governance standards, access\-control models, and integrated security controls. The role will also contribute to Clint emerging DSPM capabilities and initial data security architecture service blueprint. **3\. Key Responsibilities** * Design and develop enterprise data security architecture, standards, and reference models across complex data environments. * Develop an initial **data security architecture service blueprint** to guide the enterprise data security program. * Define reusable data protection patterns and security standards that engineering teams can implement. * Establish data classification, tagging, cataloging, and governance approaches for sensitive enterprise data. * Define data access\-control models and determine appropriate controls based on data sensitivity and business risk. * Evaluate and define the appropriate use of encryption, masking, tokenization, and other data protection mechanisms. * Design Snowflake security and data governance integrations. * Integrate identity, data, platform, and cloud security controls into a cohesive enterprise architecture. * Define how DLP, DSPM, CASB, data governance, and identity controls should work together. * Partner with engineering teams, application teams, business users, vendors, and technical stakeholders to translate architecture into implementation. * Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to DLP engineers, vendors, and internal implementation teams. * Communicate security risks, architectural decisions, and recommended controls in business\-friendly terms. * Influence stakeholders and drive adoption of data security standards across engineering and business teams. **4\. Minimum Qualifications and Experience** * Demonstrated experience designing enterprise data security architecture across complex data environments. * Strong foundation in Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and enterprise data protection, with experience progressing from hands\-on technical work into architecture and design. * Experience defining data classification, tagging, cataloging, access, and governance standards. * Strong understanding of data protection controls, including encryption, masking, tokenization, and identity/access controls. * Understanding of Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) and its role within an enterprise data security architecture. * Experience developing reusable security patterns, reference architectures, and standards for engineering implementation. * Ability to connect data security, identity, governance, and platform security controls. * Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to explain technical security risks in business terms. * Ability to collaborate with engineering teams and guide implementation without necessarily performing all tool configuration or administration. * Must be located within reasonable commuting distance of Westbrook, Maine, or elsewhere in New England with the ability to travel to Westbrook for onsite visits a few times per month. **5\. Mandatory SkillsA. Data Security Architecture** * Enterprise data security architecture and design * Security standards, reference architectures, and reusable protection patterns * Integration of data, identity, platform, and security controls **B. DLP and Enterprise Data Protection** * Data Loss Prevention (DLP) * Enterprise data protection principles and controls * Experience translating hands\-on data protection knowledge into architecture and design **C. Data Classification and Governance** * Data classification and tagging * Data cataloging and governance standards * Sensitive\-data access and protection requirements **D. Data Protection Controls** * Encryption * Data masking * Tokenization * Identity and access controls * Ability to select appropriate controls based on data sensitivity and risk **E. DSPM** * Understanding of Data Security Posture Management * Ability to integrate DSPM capabilities into broader data security architecture **F. Architecture Communication and Influence** * Development of architecture standards and implementation guidance * Collaboration with engineering and business stakeholders * Ability to communicate security risks and architectural recommendations clearly **6\. Preferred Skills** * Snowflake security and governance * Zscaler DLP * DSPM platforms * Alation or similar data governance and cataloging platforms * Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB) * AWS, Azure, and/or GCP security * Identity and Access Management (IAM) * AI governance * Enterprise data governance **Note:** Specific product expertise is beneficial but not the primary selection criterion. Clint prioritizes candidates who can architect how data, identity, governance, and security controls work together over candidates whose experience is limited to administering individual tools. **7\. Technical Environment** * Data Loss Prevention (DLP) / Zscaler * Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) * Snowflake * Alation * CASB * Data classification, tagging, and cataloging * Encryption, tokenization, and masking * Identity and access controls * Cloud security * AI governance and data governance Pay: $70\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Manager of Infrastructure
jobs.description: The Infrastructure Manager is a people leader responsible for directing the day\-to\-day work, development, and performance of the Helpdesk and Systems Administration teams. The position establishes operational priorities, strengthens service delivery, promotes consistent infrastructure practices, and ensures that team activities align with business, security, compliance, and availability requirements. This role maintains sufficient technical knowledge across server, cloud, identity, endpoint, virtualization, backup, and networking technologies to guide decisions, assess risk, support escalations, and communicate effectively with technical specialists. The manager is not expected to serve as the organization’s primary senior engineer or to personally own every complex technical implementation. The Infrastructure Manager reports to the Director of IT and works in partnership with systems engineering and cybersecurity\-related roles. These specialist roles report directly to the Director of IT and are key collaborators rather than direct reports of the Infrastructure Manager. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **People Leadership \& Team Development** * Provide direct supervision, coaching, performance management, and professional development for Helpdesk Technicians and Senior Systems Administrators. * Establish clear expectations, individual objectives, development plans, and accountability for assigned staff. * Conduct regular one\-on\-one meetings, team meetings, performance reviews, and constructive feedback discussions. * Assess staffing capacity, skills, workload, and coverage needs; recommend hiring, training, succession, or organizational changes to the Director of IT. * Lead recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and role\-specific training for positions within the manager’s reporting structure. * Promote cross\-training, knowledge sharing, documentation, and dependable backup coverage across the Helpdesk and Systems Administration functions. * Build a service\-oriented culture focused on ownership, communication, collaboration, continuous improvement, and timely follow\-through. **Operational Management \& Service Delivery** * Plan, assign, prioritize, and monitor operational work, support queues, maintenance activities, and infrastructure projects performed by direct reports. * Oversee Helpdesk service delivery, incident escalation, request fulfillment, user communications, and resolution quality; use service metrics and recurring issue trends to improve performance. * Coordinate Systems Administration activities supporting servers, identity, Microsoft 365, Azure, endpoints, virtualization, storage, backup, and related enterprise platforms. * Establish and maintain practical operating procedures, support standards, escalation paths, on\-call or after\-hours coverage expectations, and handoff practices. * Ensure infrastructure work is planned and executed with appropriate change management, configuration management, testing, documentation, rollback planning, and stakeholder communication. * Monitor operational risk, aging work, service interruptions, resource constraints, and unresolved dependencies; escalate material concerns to the Director of IT. * Coordinate response and recovery activities during infrastructure incidents while ensuring that technical specialists and business stakeholders are engaged appropriately. **Infrastructure Governance, Planning \& Compliance** * Provide management oversight for the availability, performance, lifecycle, standardization, and supportability of on\-premises and cloud infrastructure. * Contribute to infrastructure roadmaps, capacity planning, hardware and software lifecycle planning, disaster recovery, business continuity, and technology standardization. * Ensure direct reports follow approved security policies, access control requirements, change controls, documentation standards, and compliance obligations, including applicable CMMC and NIST requirements. * standardization activities for supported equipment and software. * Assist the Director of IT with infrastructure budget planning, forecasting, purchasing priorities, vendor performance, licensing, support agreements, and service delivery. **Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Technical Collaboration** * Partner with the systems engineering and cybersecurity teams on architecture, complex incidents, security requirements, technical standards, and major changes without assuming direct supervisory authority over those roles. * Collaborate with business leaders and other departments to clarify requirements, set realistic priorities, communicate risk, and coordinate infrastructure\-related work. * Serve as  lation, change management, documentation, maintenance planning, and project delivery **Required Technical Knowledge** Candidates should possess broad working knowledge sufficient to supervise technical teams, evaluate recommendations, recognize operational risk, and participate effectively in escalations. Deep hands\-on engineering expertise in every area is not required. * Windows Server and Active Directory environments, including identity, authentication, permissions, Group Policy, and related administration concepts * Microsoft 365 and Azure services, cloud infrastructure, and cloud security fundamentals * Virtualization, server, storage, endpoint, and systems monitoring concepts * jobs.description: Please note: ONLY engineers currently living in Texas will be considered We are building a new billing platform from the ground up and need the senior engineer who owns its core: the engine that moves claims and payments through their lifecycles, the background job system that runs every automated step, and the integrations with payers, clearinghouses and banks. Experience you must have: * Seven or more years of backend engineering in production, in a typed language: TypeScript or Node.js, C\#, Java, Go or Kotlin. TypeScript is what we use. jobs.title: AI Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **About REP:** REP designs world\-class, innovative gym equipment that is sold around the world, and we are now expanding into apparel, supplements, athletes, and events. REP was established in 2012 by two brothers who shared a deep passion for fitness. From our humble beginnings of selling bumper plates out of a small garage, REP has experienced remarkable growth, now occupying over 300,000\+ square feet of office and distribution space in the USA and internationally. With a dedicated team of over 200\+ fitness enthusiasts, our vision is to be the \#1 Strength Brand in the World. Our commitment to innovation, customer service, and value sets us apart. We believe in building a culture centered around fitness, so we specialize in outfitting home gyms, commercial gyms, and strength and conditioning facilities. Our dedication to excellence has been recognized multiple times when we were featured in the Inc. 5000 fastest growing private companies in 2018 and 2021 and then voted the best home strength product launch in 2022 by Garage Gym Experiment. Our team works out together, and we regularly invite fitness superstars to join us. We organize fun challenges to test our limits \- and the limits of our equipment. At REP, we continue to grow and bring new opportunities for those who want to be a part of a winning team. We firmly believe that being surrounded by like\-minded individuals fuels creative energy and fosters a fun and collaborative work environment. This role is based in our state\-of\-the\-art headquarters with a bright, spacious, shared workspace; scenic views of the Rocky Mountains; and a kitchen always stocked with healthy snacks, protein powder, and coffee. We offer a hybrid work environment with a minimum of three days in the office, but there's flexibility about which days and hours. **Our Core Values:** * **Think Like a Customer** \- We empathize with our customers; understand the '*why'* behind every decision we make * **Progress not Perfection** \- We don't let perfect get in the way of *good*; we are better today than we were yesterday * **Positive Attitude** \- Be a *glass half\-full* kind of person and remember to have fun * **Teamwork without Ego** \- We put the *team* above ourselves; we only win together * **Take Initiative** \- We *drive* momentum; if there is an opportunity to make us better, we want to hear it **About This Role:** We have already decided to put AI in front of our data. This role decides whether we can trust what it says. REP's analytics direction is MCP\-first: our internal agents, ChatDash (internally built, conversational BI platform), and Claude now query our Microsoft Fabric data platform and other sources directly. Agents are only as accurate as the definitions underneath them. In addition to building pipelines to model data from sources into Fabric, the AI\-Native Analytics Engineer builds the semantic models and context layers that let both people and AI agents get accurate, grounded answers from REP's enterprise data. Where a traditional analytics engineer stops at clean models for dashboards, this role extends the work into the agentic control plane: the certified metric definitions, data skills, evaluation suites, and guardrails that AI depends on to query data and act without hallucinating. And you will do it the AI\-native way — using AI coding assistants to take new data from bronze to gold, with generated tests and automated reconciliation, compressing work that traditionally took a data engineer, a QA tester, and rounds of business UAT into one seat. What AI cannot do is the judgment: the spec, the review, and the call on whether the answer is correct. That is the job. Just as important: at REP, the business builds first. Our end users create working versions of the analytics they need on their own — in Claude or directly in ChatDash — often before certified data or clear semantics exist for that domain. You will not be writing requirements documents and building from scratch. The requirements are the thing the business has already built and is already using. Where certified data and semantics exist, your job is to make sure they are readily accessible through Claude, ChatDash, and other development approaches, so people build on trusted ground from the start. Where they do not, your job is to take the working version and figure out how to get its data flowing systemically, with clear semantics and guardrails, without breaking what the business made. This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You will own REP's metric definitions of record, develop data pipelines according to a medallion architecture, direct our external data engineering partner as the technical owner, and work alongside our AI Solutions Engineer — they build the agents and tools; you build the governed data those agents rely on. **Essential Functions:** Include the following. Other duties may be assigned. **Business\-Built Solutions (Harden)** * Treat working ver ault and holding the line without supervision. **Productionizing Business\-Built Work** – Turning working prototypes into governed, systemic data products while keeping the builder in the loop. **Partner Direction** – Specifying, reviewing, and accepting or rejecting vendor work as REP's technical owner. **What's in it for You:** Our commitment to quality and transparency applies not only to our products, but to our people. We are focused on creating a fun, exciting, collaborative space that's centered around health and well\-being. We empower everyone on our team to take control of their careers and balance their work and life in a modern, fast\-paced environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to sit and use hands to operate the telephone, type and operate the computer and mouse. Physical effort may include stooping, kneeling, touching, feeling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, grasping, talking, hearing, and repetitive motions. The employee is frequently required to talk, hear, and bend and twist their necks. The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 00 pounds and rarely lift and/or move up to 00 pounds assisted. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision. REP provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, REP complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. ***This specification is intended to indicate the kinds of tasks and levels of work difficulty that will be required of positions that will be given this title and shall not be construed as declaring what the specific duties and responsibilities of any particular position shall be.
