jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer — Conversational Agents (Senior/Staff)
jobs.description: **Senior/Staff Applied AI Engineer — Conversational Agents** ============================================================ Revin · Agents Platform · Flatiron, New York City **$225,000–$325,000 base salary \+ meaningful early equity** · Full\-time Four days per week in our Flatiron office, with one remote day and flexibility when life comes up. We’re hiring at Senior and Staff levels. Final compensation depends on level, based on your demonstrated experience, scope of ownership, and impact. **About Revin** --------------- Revin builds AI\-powered software for the businesses that keep our homes running: roofing, HVAC, plumbing, remodeling, and more. We help these businesses respond to customers, book appointments, and manage the customer experience across voice, SMS, and email. Revin handles around half a million customer conversations a month. Businesses with hundreds of millions in annual revenue rely on our products for work that directly affects their customers and their bottom line. Our customers include Vertex Service Partners, a national roofing and exterior\-services platform with over $600M in revenue, and Del\-Air, a $300M\+ HVAC and plumbing business. See the impact of our work: we’ve helped Del\-Air book 11,000\+ membership appointments, while ImproveIt uses Revin to set 34% of its booked appointments. **The role** ------------ Make our conversational AI agents more capable, responsive, and natural through rigorous experimentation. You’ll join our Agents Platform team at the intersection of software engineering and data science, using real customer conversations to understand where agents fall short and ship improvements that hold up in production. You’ll own the full improvement cycle: identify a problem, form a hypothesis, design an experiment, implement a change, and validate its impact. Your work will span instruction following, tool use, task completion, latency, and conversational experience, with a substantial focus on voice. You’ll improve agents through model selection, prompting, context, orchestration, and real\-time voice behavior. We care most about your ability to learn from evidence and turn that learning into better customer experiences. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Find the problems worth solving.** Analyze production conversations, listen to calls, inspect traces, and work with customer\-facing teams to identify failure patterns and prioritize improvements. * **Build measurement you can trust.** Define quality dimensions and representative evaluation datasets. Combine human judgment, automated graders, and production metrics, and validate that they measure what customers actually experience. * **Develop and test hypotheses.** Design reproducible experiments, compare approaches, and use offline evaluations and controlled production rollouts to understand what works, where it works, and what tradeoffs it introduces. * **Improve the voice experience.** Investigate turn\-taking, interruptions, response latency, transcription errors, speech quality, and spoken naturalness. Use audio and system telemetry together to diagnose causes and validate changes. * **Ship improvements into the agent system.** Implement changes, monitor their effects in production, and take responsibility for reliability, cost, and regressions alongside quality gains. * **Make improvement repeatable.** Turn production failures and experimental findings into reusable datasets, evaluations, debugging tools, and release checks that help the team move faster. At Staff level, you’ll also shape our evaluation and experimentation strategy across agent capabilities, identify the highest\-impact opportunities, and raise the broader team’s ability to diagnose and improve agent behavior while remaining hands\-on. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * **A demonstrated track record improving substantial AI agent systems deployed to external customers.** You can explain the system’s scale and complexity, the problems you identified, your hypotheses and experiments, what you personally implemented, and how you established that it improved production outcomes. * **Strong experimental and analytical judgment.** You can define useful baselines, design informative comparisons, reason about noisy or confounded results, and learn from experiments that don’t support your hypothesis. * **Strong software engineering ability.** You can analyze conversational data with code and SQL, debug complex agent behavior, and turn an experimental improvement into maintainable production software. * **Practical understanding of agent systems.** You can reason about how models, instructions, context, tools, and orchestration interact, and weigh quality against latency, reliability, and cost. Specific frameworks matter less than your judgment and results. * **Ownership and clear communication.** You make progress through ambiguity, communicate findings and tradeoffs, and work closely with engineers and product to carry improvements through to customers. * **A desire to work in an early\-stage startup.** You’re energized by broad responsibility, rapid iteration, and high standards. We use AI programming tools heavily and expect you to use them effectively while owning the quality of your work. **Voice experience** -------------------- Hands\-on experience improving production voice agents is strongly preferred. We value experience diagnosing conversational timing, speech recognition and generation, audio quality, and end\-to\-end latency, across any provider or stack. We’re also open to engineers with an exceptional track record improving other customer\-facing agents who can demonstrate strong judgment on voice problems and are excited to develop deeper expertise. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Experience building simulation, replay, or evaluation tools for multi\-turn agents. * Experience developing human review workflows or calibrating automated evaluations against human judgment. * Experience at a strong startup or on a small team with substantial ownership. **Why join Revin** ------------------ You’ll work with a large, varied set of real customer interactions and a short path from an idea to measurable impact. Improvements you ship can reach hundreds of thousands of conversations, and what you learn will help shape the direction of our agent platform. We’re still early. You’ll join a small team of sharp, ambitious people, have substantial influence over how we build, and receive meaningful equity ownership with the opportunity to share substantially in the upside you help create. **Compensation and benefits** ----------------------------- * **$225,000–$325,000 base salary**, with final compensation dependent on level. * **Meaningful early equity** in the company you’re helping build. * **Excellent health coverage.** $0 employee premiums for individual medical coverage on most plans, plus dental and vision insurance. * **401(k) matching up to 4% of salary.** Contribute 5% to receive the full match. * Unlimited PTO. * Commuter benefits. * Free lunches and dinners in the office. * $100/month gym membership stipend. * Tech equipment of your choice. Compensation Range: $225K \- $325K

jobs.title: Plant Engineer
jobs.description: Who we are For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon\-negative outcomes. Our Vision Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon\-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment. Our Business Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting\-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals. Our Value Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world. All that we’re missing is you. Apply today! **About the role** Reworld is seeking a hands\-on Plant Engineer to improve performance, efficiency, and equipment reliability at its waste\-to\-energy facility in West Wareham, Massachusetts. This position combines field troubleshooting and operations support with applied engineering, process optimization, equipment replacement, and project execution. The successful candidate can interpret operating trends, understand combustion and steam generation, and independently move problems from diagnosis to implemented solutions. * **Work arrangement:** Full\-time, on\-site * **Reports to:** Manager, Regional Engineering, working closely with the Facility Manager * **Annual Bonus Target:** 10% performance bonus opportunity * **Sign\-on bonus:** Eligible for a sign\-on bonus. At Reworld, engineers apply their technical expertise to an essential industry that converts waste into energy and supports more sustainable communities. The Plant Engineer partners with Operations, Maintenance, regional engineering, and corporate process engineering to improve plant output, address recurring equipment problems, and deliver practical engineering improvements. The role balances operations support and engineering with roughly equal emphasis. It requires someone comfortable investigating plant problems, performing engineering analysis, developing technical recommendations, and coordinating implementation. Plant performance and project execution are the primary focus; all work must support safe operation and applicable environmental requirements. The successful candidate must be able to analyze operating trends, determine why the plant is not achieving expected load or output, and implement practical corrective actions that improve reliability, efficiency, and performance. **Key Responsibilities** **Plant Performance and Process Troubleshooting** * Review daily plant performance metrics, equipment history, alarms, and operating trends to identify deviations from expected performance. * Investigate why the plant is not achieving expected load or output, identify contributing process and equipment limitations, and implement corrective actions. * Troubleshoot combustion, steam\-generation, process\-control, and equipment\-reliability issues using field observations, engineering calculations, operating data, and root cause analysis. * Optimize operating conditions and controls to improve combustion performance, efficiency, equipment availability, and reliable plant output. * Prepare performance reports, lead weekly production\-improvement discussions, and maintain the facility's Production Action Items list. * Present findings, recommendations, implementation needs, and measured results to facility and regional leadership. **Applied Mechanical and Process Engineering** * Perform engineering calculations, evaluate design alternatives, size equipment, and develop equipment specifications for plant modifications and replacements. * Support mechanical and process systems including boilers, pumps, piping, fuel handling, combustion equipment, grates, and spray dryer absorber (SDA) systems. * Apply working knowledge of instrumentation, process controls, and basic electrical systems to multidisciplinary troubleshooting and modifications. * Evaluate equipment condition and recommend repair, replacement, or redesign based on safety, reliability, performance, lifecycle cost, and operating requirements. * Interpret Boiler Condition Assessment Reports and translate findings into prioritized engineering and maintenance recommendations. * Obtain required technical reviews and approvals before implementing operational, process, or equipment changes. **Engineering Projects, Outages, and Contractor Oversight** * Independently develop and execute capital and operational improvement projects, coordinating scope, calculations, design, specifications, budgets, schedules, construction, commissioning, and handover. * Coordinate internal technical resources, equipment suppliers, third\-party engineers, and contractors across mechanical, process, controls,   Massachusetts Second Class Engineer license or a higher\-grade Massachusetts Engineer license. **A Massachusetts Second Class license is beneficial, not required.** * U.S. Coast Guard engineering credentials. Relevant USCG credentials and substantially equivalent operating experience are accepted qualification pathways and will be considered alongside demonstrated engineering capability. * Professional Engineer licensure, PMP certification, or an MBA. * Experience using AutoCAD, SketchUp, and/or SolidWorks. All Reworld positions require a candidate's ability to perform the duties and responsibilities of the role while upholding Reworld's Values, including (but not limited to) contributing to a safe and inclusive workplace, delivering results through trust, and building breakthrough capabilities. Please note that Level, Title and/or Salary may be adjusted based on the applicant's experience or skills. **Pay Transparency** Reworld is committed to paying its staff equitably, and we strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits packages. The range below reflects Reworld’s reasonable estimate of base pay for this role based on primary posting location. It is expected that most qualified candidates in this location will fall within the posting range. The final salary offered for this role will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to: experience, education, geographic location, skills and competencies, travel requirements and/or union contracts (if applicable). Pay ranges are reviewed from time to time and may be modified in the future. The pay range for the primary location of this position is: $108,900\.00 \- $155,600\.00 USD per annum Reworld™ provides an industry\-leading benefits package that supports the whole person—and their families—through a balanced approach to mental, physical, and financial wellbeing. Regular full\-time employees based in the USA have access to comprehensive medical, prescription drugs, dental, and vision coverage, FSA, HSA, short\- and long\-term disability benefits. Our 401(k) plan is industry\-leading, with an up to 7% company match. Additional benefits include Company\-paid life and AD\&D insurance, EAP, paid parental leave, and educational assistance. For more information regarding these offerings, please visit the Reworld Careers Benefits Page. Reworld™ reserves the right to amend, suspend or terminate any benefit plan, in whole or in part, at any time. **Our DEI Commitment** Reworld is an Equal Opportunity Employer, has developed an Affirmative Action Program (AAP), and will not discriminate against any qualified applicants because of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability (including perceived disability, physical, mental, and/or intellectual disabilities), veteran status, liability for service in the Armed Forces of the United States, or any other characteristic protected by law. Know Your Rights (Click to view poster) If you are an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site because of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by going to Reworldwaste.com and clicking on the ‘Contact Us’ button. Under Inquires, select ‘Careers’ in the Interest field, fill out all required fields including your message. In the message section, please note this is a ‘Job Application Accommodation Request’. **Attention Staffing Agencies \& Search Firms** Reworld may sometimes selectively collaborate with staffing agencies and search firms (Agencies). Reworld will only consider candidates from Agencies with whom a signed agreement and a duly authorized work order (for a specific role) has been duly executed. Any unsolicited candidate submissions or candidate submissions from Agencies that do not meet these criteria, will be deemed invalid and ineligible for any fees.

jobs.title: Point-of-Sale Software Developer
jobs.description: Job Description Ricochet POS is seeking a Point\-of\-Sale Software Developer to help develop, maintain, and enhance software for retail and consignment businesses. The ideal candidate will have experience building web\-based applications, integrating payment systems, managing inventory data, and developing reliable software features that improve daily business operations. This role focuses on developing and improving point\-of\-sale functionality, inventory management tools, customer account features, reporting systems, and third\-party integrations. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with technical and product teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user\-friendly software. Responsibilities * Develop, test, and maintain point\-of\-sale software and web applications. * Build and improve features for sales transactions, refunds, discounts, and receipts. * Develop inventory management, customer account, and consignor management functionality. * Integrate payment processing services and third\-party business applications. * Design and maintain APIs, database queries, and data\-processing functions. * Troubleshoot software defects and improve application performance. * Support integrations between retail systems and online storefronts. * Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and software releases. * Maintain technical documentation and follow coding standards. * Collaborate with product, customer support, and engineering teams to improve the user experience. Required Skills * Experience in software development or web application engineering. * Proficiency in JavaScript and modern web development technologies. * Understanding of APIs, database design, and SQL. * Familiarity with application testing, debugging, and version control. * Knowledge of secure software development and data protection practices. * Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work collaboratively and manage development tasks effectively. Preferred Qualifications * Experience developing point\-of\-sale, retail, inventory, or payment applications. * Familiarity with payment gateway integrations and transaction processing. * Knowledge of cloud\-based software and SaaS applications. * Experience with React, Node.js, or comparable development technologies. * Understanding of accounting integrations, reporting systems, and e\-commerce platforms. * Familiarity with automated testing and continuous integration tools. About the Company Ricochet POS is a Boise, Idaho\-based software company that develops point\-of\-sale and retail management software for consignment, resale, and other retail businesses. Its platform combines sales processing, inventory management, customer accounts, consignor payouts, reporting, payment processing, and online store integrations. The company focuses on helping retailers streamline operations and manage in\-store and online sales through an integrated software platform. Compensation and Benefits * Estimated annual salary: $75,000–$105,000, depending on experience and technical expertise. * Opportunities to contribute to retail technology and software product development. * Technical training and professional development may be available. * Health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, and other benefits must be confirmed with the employer. This job description is a draft and does not confirm an active vacancy. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Relocation assistance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Deployment Lead
jobs.description: **About the company:** Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, Finance, and global employment. It brings together workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company—like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers—so businesses can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system, anywhere in the world. That unified platform provides a powerful foundation for putting AI to work. By connecting live business data, organizational context, and built\-in permissions, Rippling AI can answer complex questions and take action across systems while respecting each user’s access and required approvals. Rippling Data Cloud extends this foundation to third\-party business data, enabling customers to build AI workflows across their operations. Customers are embracing this approach: Rippling AI generated more ARR in its first two months than any previous Rippling product launch, with revenue growing 121% from July to September. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role:** Rippling is standing up a new business line: Rippling AI Solutions. This covers everything from (1\) custom applications and AI point solutions sold through Sales (“Build”) to (2\) a full turnkey AI consulting and implementation service (“Transform”). We cover the full spectrum, with a focus on G\&A and other non R\&D orgs. We will help customers identify, design, build, and ship production AI workflows, while also supporting adoption and change management within the org to tie automations to ROI. We will be an AI thought partner to our customers \- though Rippling will be a central part of all solutions we implement, we are model agnostic and insert other 3P AI tools around Rippling as needed. The ultimate vision is to scale AI Solutions into a large product line that is central to Rippling’s AI strategy of delivering value to its customers and being their “go to” for their AI needs. This is a founding role on the AI Solutions team. We are hiring our first AI Deployment Lead to own customer engagements end to end, from discovery through measurable impact. This role combines (1\) an AI Transformation Lead, who identifies high\-value opportunities, shapes them into a transformation roadmap, owns the client relationship, and drives adoption; and (2\) a Forward Deployed Product Manager, who translates customer workflows into product requirements and ships solutions in partnership with our team of Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs). You will report to the General Manager of AI Solutions and work closely with FDE, Product, and Sales. **What you will do:** 1\. Own the customer relationship* Serve as the customer’s day\-to\-day lead from kickoff through value realization, working with executive sponsors, operators, and end users. * Align the GM, Sales, FDEs, and the customer on scope, success criteria, and the path to launch. * Run the operating cadence for each engagement, including status updates, steering committees, risks, decisions, and executive readouts. 2\. Run the AI diagnostic and create the AI transformation roadmap* Diagnose customer workflows and identify the highest\-value opportunities for AI\-driven operating leverage. * Create a sequenced, quantified and prioritized AI Transformation Roadmap with baselines, target KPIs, and clear success measures. * Bring a practical point of view on where Rippling, third\-party AI tools, and custom workflows can create the most value. 3\. Define and ship AI workflows with FDEs* In partnership with FDE, translate customer workflows into MVP definitions, requirements, acceptance criteria, and evaluation criteria. * Product manage the implementation with FDE, from scoping through testing, launch, and iteration. * Pressure\-test solution design with FDE across architecture, integrations, data access, permissions, and edge cases. 4\. Drive adoption, ROI, and repeatability* Lead training, workflow redesign, and change management so shipped workflows are adopted and trusted. * Measure realized value against the baseline and turn results into case studies, references, and expansion opportunities. * Codify repeatable patterns into playbooks, templates, ROI models, and product feedback. 5\. Build the AI Solutions motion with the GM* Help refine the nascent AI Solutions playbook across discovery, scoping, delivery, adoption, ROI measurement, and expansion. * As a founding member of the team, help turn early engagements into a repeatable motion that can scale across customers and future AI Deployment Leads. * Partner with the GM and FDE leadership on engagement health, staffing needs, delivery capacity, and how the motion should evolve as it scales. **What you will have**:* You have 5 to 10 years of experience as a commercially minded product manager, technically minded consultant, deployment lead, solutions lead, implementation lead, or similar operator in a high\-growth environment. * You have led complex, cross\-functional programs from ambiguous problem framing through production launch, adoption, and measurable impact. * You can communicate clearly with C\-level sponsors, operators, end users, product leaders, and engineers. * You have AI fluency, including enough depth in LLMs, agents, retrieval, evaluations, data, APIs, and integrations to scope solutions, write precise requirements, and earn the trust of technical teams. * You think in ROI: you can map a workflow, understand where time and money go, quantify the value of changing it, and build a credible business case. * You are comfortable in zero\-to\-one environments, where a playbook may not exist and will need to be defined. * You are highly customer\-facing, structured, and pragmatic, with the judgment to balance ambition, feasibility, and speed. * You build with AI yourself, through side projects, prototypes, automations, or practical experimentation, and can explain what worked, what failed, and why. Bonus points:* Experience at a forward\-deployed, applied AI, or technical services organization. * Experience in HCM, payroll, ERP, finance systems, or G\&A workflows. * Experience serving executive buyers and mid\-market customers. * Ability to prototype or write light code, especially in Python or SQL. * Experience hiring, coaching, or building a delivery team. * Founder, early\-stage operator, or other entrepreneurial experience. **Additional Information:** Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 181,200 \- 252,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **Integration Engineer** **Location:** Irwindale, CA (100% remote flexibility is an option) **About the Role** ------------------ Rize Credit Union is looking for an Integration Engineer to build and operate the integrations and automated processes that connect our core, ancillary, and SaaS applications. An automated process is only as capable as the systems it can reach and only as trustworthy as the controls around it, and this role owns both. You will design, build, deploy, monitor, and retire integrations. You will also expose internal and vendor applications as governed, authenticated, least\-privilege services. Working closely with our business analysts, who identify and shape automation opportunities, you will decide what should be automated, what should not, and how to do it safely in a regulated financial institution. This position is based out of our headquarters in Irwindale, CA, with the flexibility to work 100% remotely. You will report to the Director, Business Technology. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, and maintain integrations using our iPaaS platform, REST and SOAP APIs, webhooks, event\-driven patterns, and AWS services (e.g., Lambda, EventBridge, Step Functions) * Build and maintain API wrappers and connectors, with accurate specifications and documentation * Choose the right approach for each opportunity (deterministic integration, conventional code, or a change to a human process) and document your rationale * Establish how integrations authenticate and what they are permitted to do, including scoped IAM permissions, credential vaulting, and rotation * Define controls and action boundaries for every integration, and treat all external data as untrusted input * Build automated test suites and track error, latency, and failure metrics * Instrument integrations with logging, monitoring, alerting, and runbooks so every action can be reconstructed for troubleshooting, audit, and regulatory examination * Maintain the technical inventory of integrations, automated processes, and APIs, and retire what is unused or superseded * Work with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance to review integrations before production release, including member data handling and third\-party and open\-source components * Keep all code in source control with peer review, testing, and CI/CD, and document architecture and reusable patterns so knowledge is shared **What You Bring** ------------------ * 4–7 years of experience building and operating production software, integrations, or automation, with strong hands\-on Python * Demonstrated experience integrating systems through REST APIs, including authentication patterns (e.g., OAuth 2\.0, JWT, API keys), error handling, retries, idempotency, and rate limiting * Experience deploying and supporting workloads in AWS * Experience with version control, peer code review, automated testing, and CI/CD practices * Working knowledge of SQL, AWS services for integration workloads, and containerization * Sound judgment about what an automated process should and should not be permitted to do * A security\-first mindset, with default assumptions of least privilege and untrusted input * Ability to explain the capabilities and limits of automation honestly to non\-technical stakeholders, including recommending against automation when that is the right answer * Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel) * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent demonstrated experience and a reviewable portfolio of built work will be considered in lieu of a degree. **Strongly Preferred** ---------------------- * Financial services or credit union experience * Administration and development on an iPaaS platform * Event\-driven architecture on AWS (e.g., SQS, SNS) and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform) * Experience with test automation, logging, and monitoring tooling * Identity and secrets management (e.g., Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Amazon Cognito, AWS Secrets Manager) and API gateway patterns * Familiarity with NCUA expectations and GLBA and nonpublic personal information handling **Pay** ------- The pay range for this position in California is **$87,500 – $121,000 per year**. Actual pay will be based on experience, skills, and qualifications. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Rize Federal Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer of women, minorities, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Capacity & Efficiency
jobs.description: **Join us in building the future of finance.** ---------------------------------------------- Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you're ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. **About the team \+ role** -------------------------- We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem\-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high\-performing, fast\-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The **Capacity \& Efficiency Engineering team** builds the software that manages, governs, and reduces Robinhood's AWS cloud spend across compute, databases, and storage, operating at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, data engineering, and FinOps. We own the full lifecycle of cloud cost, from attribution and forecasting to automation that rightsizes infrastructure at fleet scale and keeps a bursty, latency\-sensitive trading platform both reliable and cost\-effective. Our work carries CEO\-level visibility, has already driven millions of dollars in annualized savings, and is delivered in close partnership with Infrastructure, Finance, and product engineering teams across Robinhood. As a **Senior Software Engineer** on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood's storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0\-to\-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill. This role is based in our **Bellevue, WA office**, with in\-person attendance expected at least **3 days per week**. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in\-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high\-performing teams. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Build forecast\-driven capacity planning for the storage and database fleet, turning traffic history, load tests, and known events (market open, earnings, IPOs, promotions) into plans that scale up ahead and back down after, with an expiry on every temporary capacity hold * Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules * Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right\-sized as load changes * Own S3 efficiency at scale: storage class and Intelligent\-Tiering strategy, lifecycle and retention policies, noncurrent versions and incomplete uploads, and request costs, using Storage Lens and inventory data * Take every recommendation to closed\-loop automation with guardrails, progressive rollout, and rollback, in partnership with the Storage infrastructure jobs.title: Principal Data & Applied Scientist – Ontologies, Knowledge Graphs & AI Research
jobs.description: **Company Description** **We help the world run better** At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. **Job Description** **Teach AI how business actually works** AI agents are starting to take on real business work: releasing blocked invoices, re\-planning supply, preparing the financial close. To do it safely, they need more than access to data. They need to know what an order, a supplier and a cost center are, how they connect, which rules and authorizations apply, and what happened the last time someone made a similar decision. When executing mission\-critical business processes, an answer or action that is right 90% of the time is not good enough. SAP systems hold the context for many of the world's largest companies. SAP's knowledge graph for SAP S/4HANA alone is based on 452,000 tables, 80,000 CDS views (semantic data models) and 7\.3 million fields. Yet much of the meaning, especially in each company's own extensions, configuration and decision history, is still implicit. A 'customer' in sales, a 'business partner' in finance and an 'account' in CRM can be the same company described three ways, and an agent deciding whether to raise a credit limit has to know that. This is not a data\-cleaning problem, it is a knowledge\-representation problem. Today that context, the semantic layer agents rely on, is mostly modeled by hand, one company at a time. We think it can be learned, so AI agents can act on business data, not just read it. SAP's Autonomous Enterprise depends on that, and it is what makes the agents people work with in Joule Work, SAP's AI workspace, accurate enough to trust. As Principal Data Scientist, you will define and lead our research toward that goal and work with product teams to ship the results. This is a research and modeling role, not product analytics. **SAP Research \& Innovation North America** We are a team of scientists and engineers at SAP Labs in Palo Alto, minutes from Stanford. We look a few years ahead and scout emerging technologies, take the early, riskier bets that product teams can’t always take, and prove or drop them fast. SAP's product teams build and run SAP Knowledge Graph, we look beyond and find and prove methods that demonstrate improvement or paradigm shifts. Our job is to spot the opportunities that will matter most to SAP and our customers, and to get there early. We prototype with dedicated GPU compute on realistic business data and, in co\-innovation projects, on real data for training and evaluating models. We publish research, work with startups, universities and institutes including Stanford HAI and UC Irvine, and hand what works to SAP's product teams. We move like a small lab, with the reach of a company whose software runs finance, supply chain and HR for many of the world's largest companies. **What you will work on** * **A research agenda with a point of view.** Pick the two or three bets where SAP can lead in AI on business data, agree up front how we will know each one is working, and stop the ones that aren't. Closely collaborate with top universities and institutes such as Stanford HAI. * **What comes next.** Track emerging research, such as relational and graph foundation models, neuro\-symbolic agents and context graphs, test it on SAP data before the market settles, and make the case for the next bet. * **Business semantics that can be learned.** New methods to learn, align and evolve ontologies and knowledge graphs of business objects, rules and actions from SAP metadata, master data, documents and process data, combining LLM\-assisted ontology learning, schema matching and entity resolution with targeted expert review. * **Agents grounded in business semantics.** Graph\-grounded retrieval; semantic parsing into SQL, SPARQL and OData calls, including finding the right API, across very large schemas; and governed actions: checks that an agent's plan respects business rules and the user's authorizations before it runs. * **Models that combine structure and statistics.** Graph learning and relational foundation models (such as SAP\-RPT\-1\.6\), using knowledge\-graph structure to predict, explain and simulate business outcomes. * **The yardstick.** Benchmarks and simulation environments for agents on ERP data, where today's public benchmarks fall short, so SAP knows when AI is accurate and reliable enough to act on. * **Results that land.** Work directly with data teams and domain experts in co\-innovation projects, turning messy enterprise data problems into tractable ontology problems, and work with the teams behind SA ur own to adopt, fund or drop something. You are able to work through a design with skeptical engineers. **Preferred** * Publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, ACL/EMNLP, SIGMOD/VLDB, ISWC, WWW, or widely used open\-source software, datasets or semantic standards work. * LLM\-assisted ontology learning, neuro\-symbolic methods, agent memory, context graphs and decision traces, or reinforcement learning for tool\-using agents. * Process mining (including object\-centric event data), causal inference, forecasting, or privacy\-preserving and synthetic data. * Familiarity with how enterprises run (finance, supply chain, procurement, HR), and experience mentoring scientists or leading university collaborations. * SAP experience is a plus, not a requirement. If you recognize yourself here but do not match every line, apply. **Additional Information** All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. About SAP With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives. As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business\-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience. We win with inclusion SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **About Scale:** ================ For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science\-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding. Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands. We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact. Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company. If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Data Engineer to own the data infrastructure behind all of Scale Media's brands. You'll build and run the pipelines that bring together data from Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Meta, Google Ads, Klaviyo, and Odoo, etc. and make sure the teams who rely on that data can trust it. You'll join our existing engineering team as its dedicated data specialist. That means real ownership: you'll set the direction for how we model, move, govern, and use data, with engineering teammates around you to build alongside. Most of your time will go to data engineering. You'll also be a thought partner on key cross\-functional projects, most notably Odoo, which our inventory team uses for inventory management. There, you'll help plan upgrades, design integrations, and keep its data flowing cleanly into the rest of our stack. This is a hands\-on builder role for someone who enjoys solving messy data problems and turning them into reliable systems. **What You'll Own** ------------------- **Data Architecture \& Pipelines:** * Own and optimize the company's data architecture and ETL/ELT pipelines, including scheduling, orchestration, and monitoring with tools like Airflow and dbt. * Maintain, optimize, and expand our hosting infrastructure and scripts as data volume and use cases grow. * Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across every source system, so reporting and decisions rest on numbers people trust. **Integrations \& Data Connectors:** * Maintain API integrations and data connectors with platforms including Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, Meta, Google Ads, Klaviyo, etc. * Scope and build new data integrations as the business adds tools, channels, and brands. **Odoo Partnership:** * Act as the go\-to technical partner for Odoo, supporting our inventory team on Odoo\-related initiatives. * Help plan and execute Odoo upgrades with minimal disruption to day\-to\-day inventory operations. * Design, build, and maintain integrations and ETL processes between Odoo and our other internal and external systems. **Data Governance \& Documentation:** * Oversee data governance, access controls, and security practices that protect our systems and customer data from breaches. * Document configurations, integrations, and data flows so the rest of the team can understand and build on them. * Act as a thought partner to analytics and marketing teams to define, standardize, and maintain business\-critical KPIs across all data models and reporting layers. **AI/ML \& Automation:** * Implement AI/ML\-driven solutions for data enrichment, anomaly detection, forecasting, and process automation. * Continuously review data workflows and performance, and find new ways to use data to make the business run more efficiently. * Ownership and setup of MCP connection to the data warehouse to allow users access to data through LLM **What You Bring** ------------------ * Strong SQL and Python skills, with hands\-on experience building and maintaining production data pipelines. * Experience with modern orchestration and transformation tools such as Airflow and dbt, and with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or similar). * Hands\-on experience with Odoo, including working with its data model, building integrations, and supporting or executing version upgrades. * Experience working with Shopify data and APIs, and integrating ecommerce and marketing platforms such as Amazon Seller Central, Meta, Google Ads, or Klaviyo. * Comfort managing cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar) and the scripts and jobs that run on it. * A solid grasp of data governance, security, and access\-control practices. * Clear documentation habits and the ability to explain data systems to non\-technical teammates. * 3–5 years of experience in data engineering or a closely related role. Strong backgrounds include: * Data engineers at DTC or ecommerce brands who have owned the full stack from source to warehouse * ERP or Odoo developers who have grown into broader data engineering and pipeline work * Analytics engineers who have taken on infrastructure, orchestration, and integration ownership **Preferred, But Not Required** ------------------------------- * Experience in DTC, consumer subscription, supplements, or wellness. * Experience building custom Odoo modules in Python. * Hands\-on work applying AI/ML to forecasting, anomaly detection, or data enrichment. * Familiarity with inventory, supply chain, or demand\-planning data. **What Makes You a Fit** ------------------------ * **High Ownership:** As our dedicated data specialist, you treat the data stack as yours to improve, not a ticket queue to work through. * **Thought Partner:** You bring ideas to the table and help teams like inventory shape the right solution, not just implement the request. * **Detail\-Oriented:** You care about getting the numbers right, because the whole business makes decisions on them. * **Self\-Starter in a Remote Environment:** You're comfortable in a fully remote, fast\-paced environment and communicate clearly without needing to be in the same room. * **Curious Problem\-Solver:** You enjoy untangling messy data problems and keep an eye out for new ways data can make the business more efficient. **Reporting Structure** ----------------------- You will report directly to Uday Dorawala, Engineering Manager. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Salary: $130,000 \- $150,000 depending on experience * Excellent Medical, Dental, Vision and Life insurance * Fully remote, full\-time position * Monthly WFH stipend * Generous Paid Time Off program * Discounted Products * An amazing team to work alongside Applicant Privacy Policy Notice GZepjI5mRv

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Integration Center
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ **Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.** **Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:** * **Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority\- and woman\-owned enterprise in the U.S.** * **Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.** * **Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.** * **World\-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.** **Job Summary** =============== SHI’s IDCS organization specializes in the factory integration and deployment of enterprise data center infrastructure, including servers, networking equipment, storage, and complete rack\-level solutions. Our in\-house automation platform deploys, configures, and validates racks across multiple customers, vendors, and cold rooms in parallel. We are seeking a Software Engineer to build and maintain the applications that sit on top of that platform, including the operator web application, pipeline and orchestration engine, inventory and addressing services, and CLI tooling. This role will turn deployment and QC workflows that engineers run manually into reliable, observable software that integration technicians and engineers can run independently. This role is well suited for an engineer who enjoys building real products for internal operators and is comfortable working alongside hardware, networks, and a factory floor. The Software Engineer will collaborate with systems engineers, network engineers, integration and QC teams, and OEM technologies, while also mentoring junior engineers. **Role Description** ### **Application and Platform Development** * Design, build, and maintain the operator\-facing web application, including rack views, pipelines, dashboards, work orders, and approvals. * Develop backend services and REST APIs in Python using FastAPI or similar technologies to expose inventory, device actions, and run status. * Build and extend the pipeline/DAG engine, including stage ordering, retries, parallel fan\-out across devices, run history, and resume\-from\-failure behavior. * Build real\-time features such as live run output, device status, and rack health using SSE or WebSockets. * Develop and maintain CLI tools and a command router that dispatches actions by customer, device type, and OEM. Create reusable libraries and frameworks rather than one\-off scripts, with clear module boundaries and per\-page front\-end separation. * ### **Data and Inventory** * Own the schema and data access layer for the inventory database, including racks, devices, addressing, credentials, and run results. * Maintain the inventory as the single source of truth for addressing and device identity, ensuring consistency across the tools that read and write to it. Build reporting that produces QC coversheets, command logs, and audit evidence for each run. * ### **Device and Vendor Integration** * Integrate with vendor and infrastructure APIs, including Redfish, DHCP server APIs, and device CLIs over SSH. * Support heterogeneous hardware, including Dell, HPE, Lenovo, and Supermicro servers; Cisco, Arista, and Juniper switches; PDUs; and console servers through a common adapter model. jobs.description: **Project Engineer II** ======================= This position is based out of our Savannah, GA regional office. You'll help deliver projects The Samet Way, keeping budgets, schedules, and quality standards on track while exceeding client expectations at every step. **What You'll Do** * Coordinate and perform administrative functions. * Strong proficiency with construction management software and the Microsoft Office suite. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to work effectively in team environments. * Experience with scheduling software (Primavera, Microsoft Project). * Knowledge of construction codes, regulations, and safety standards. * Construction project management certification (a plus). **Additional Requirements** **Physical Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, walk, walk on rough or uneven jobs.title: CMM Quality Technician
jobs.description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** **Schunk Carbon Technology** **Job Title:** CMM Quality Technician **Department:** Quality **FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt **Reports to:** Quality Manager **POSITION SUMMARY** The CMM Quality Technician performs various complex quality\-related testing and inspection functions to support quality efforts throughout the company. This role focuses heavily on operating and programming Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) to verify part dimensions, ensuring alignment with strict engineering specifications. This position reports directly to the Quality Manager and has no direct reports. **QUALIFICATIONS** * **Education \& Experience:** Associates Degree from a two\-year college or technical school, or 3\+ years of equivalent work experience and/or training. * **Professional Certifications:** ASQ Certified Quality Technician (CQT) or Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) is highly preferred. * **Quality Standards \& Systems:** Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 with practical experience performing internal audits. Experience utilizing QT9 QMS software is highly preferred. * **Blueprint Reading:** Strong proficiency in reading and interpreting complex part drawings, process specifications, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T) symbols. * **Mathematics:** Solid understanding of mathematical concepts such as probability, statistical inference, and the fundamentals of plane/solid geometry and trigonometry. * **Software \& Tools:** Experience utilizing Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Teams, Word) and modern Quality Management System (QMS) software platform applications. **CMM SPECIALIZATION \& SKILLS** * **CMM Programming:** Strong preference for candidates with a proven track record of writing and editing new CMM programs from 3D CAD models and blueprints, rather than just operating them. * **Equipment Preference:** Hands\-on experience with **Zeiss CMM hardware** and **Zeiss software** ecosystems is highly preferred. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS** * **Dimensional Inspection:** Measure complex parts using surface plate layouts, traditional hand tools (calipers, micrometers, indicators), and Zeiss CMM programs. * **QMS Documentation:** Log and track corrective actions, non\-conformances, and calibration events within the QT9 QMS platform. * **Calibration \& M\&TE:** Maintain basic calibration knowledge. Select appropriate Measurement and Test Equipment (M\&TE) tools for various tasks, assess tool accuracy, and ensure standards traceability. * **Drawing Interpretation:** Read and interpret blueprints, demonstrating clear understanding of critical, major, and minor part characteristics. * **Non\-Conforming Material:** Identify, report, and isolate non\-conforming materials. Initiate resolutions when inspection errors or part deviations occur. * **CAPA \& Auditing:** Apply elements of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), including root cause analysis, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and internal quality audits. * **Traceability:** Understand and maintain complete product, material, and calibration traceability across all inspection stages using spreadsheet and word processing documentation. * **Sampling Plans:** Apply basic inspection and testing techniques, including various standardized sampling plans. **AMERICANS WITH DISABILITY SPECIFICATIONS** **Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Frequently required to walk. * Occasionally required to stand, sit, and reach with hands and arms. * Use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls. * Ability to talk and hear clearly. * Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 40 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required include close vision and the ability to adjust focus. **Work Environment:** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Work is performed indoors in areas that are generally well\-lit. * Temperature and humidity can vary greatly depending on the weather, ranging from 60°F to 100°F. * Regular work near moving mechanical parts with regular exposure to manufacturing vibration. * The noise level in the work environment is moderately loud. **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** This job description is not intended to be all\-inclusive. The employee will also perform other related job duties as assigned by the supervisor or other management. Offered compensation: $30/hr \- $36/hr ##### **Experience and License Requirements** * ASQ Certified Quality Technician (optional) * Coordinate Measuring Machine * Zeiss CMM programing

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Active Learning
jobs.description: **Senior Machine Learning Engineer \- Active Learning** ------------------------------------------------------- **About Sense** --------------- Sense is a climate tech company that turns electric signals in homes and on the grid into real\-time insight about energy use, devices, and faults. These insights help people lower their electric bills and use less electricity, and they help utilities prevent wildfires, among other applications. These insights come from load disaggregation and fault detection models that are running on meters today. The technology team at Sense researches, trains, deploys, and supports these models. We are looking for an experienced Senior Machine Learning Engineer with expertise in active learning systems to help us scale our data operations so we can continue to improve our core production models and build the foundation model of electrical devices and energy. **The role** ------------ This Senior Machine Learning Engineer will own the loop from data to labels to improved models. You will use active learning and weak supervision methods to generate labels, decide what to label next, and turn errors we find in the field into new labels. This is a hands\-on role. You will be expected to write code, train models, analyze data, and document experiments. You will work with data scientists, annotators, product, and engineers to get labels and improve models. You will direct the development of annotation tools and the work of our annotators to speed up and scale labeling. Success in this role is measured by the reduction in cost per annotation (i.e., time per annotation), while keeping label quality at or above our targets. Responsibilities: * Design and run active learning to choose which homes, devices, and time periods to label next, based on where models are uncertain or wrong. * Turn bad detections, field accuracy results, and user corrections into new ground truth, and track whether retrained models improve. * Find rare events and hard cases in home data, such as uncommon or mislabeled devices, and add them to labeling and evaluation sets. * Own the ground truth plan: which data, how much, and in what order. * Direct a team of annotators: set priorities, track throughput, and provide guidance. Set data quality standards. * Direct development of our annotation tool. Add features that enhance our ability to collect new and better data, including features that rely on models. * Measure and improve label quality through metrics, outlier detection, human review, etc. * Work with data engineers and ML operations to version labels and track which labels trained which model. Keep evaluation sets separate from training data so offline results predict performance in the field. * Be a good teammate: review code, provide peer feedback on research and experiments, and contribute to shared documentation. Help mentor/coach less experienced team members. **Requirements** Qualifications: * MS or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in data science or machine learning, including 2\+ years building or managing labeled datasets for ML. * Hands\-on experience applying active learning to real data, including choosing a sampling strategy and measuring whether it helped. * Experience finding rare or hard examples in large datasets, i.e., from model errors, uncertainty, or similarity search. * Experience training deep learning models, and with weak supervision or model\-assisted labeling. * Experience measuring label quality and fixing label errors. * Experience with Python, SQL, and data pipelines. * A track record of working with other teams, i.e., product, software, or hardware. Preferred qualifications: * Experience with time series, audio, sensor, or other signal data. * Experience leading an annotation team or directing development of annotation tools. * Experience using embeddings from large or foundation models for data analysis. Logistics: * Location: able to work from our Cambridge, MA office at least 2 days per week. * Salary range: $165,000 to $185,000 * Work authorization: required. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Short Term \& Long Term Disability * Work From Home * Free Food \& Snacks * Wellness Resources * Stock Option Plan

Experience deploying models directly on devices, such as smartphones, is particularly valuable as we continue developing AI technologies that can operate across different environments and hardware platforms. This engineer will help us expand our machine learning research and development capacity while bringing additional expertise in model optimization, quantization, machine learning operations, and on\-device computing. We don't particularly care which machine learning frameworks or technical stacks you're most familiar with, as long as you have strong foundational knowledge and experience working with widely used tools. However, it's important to be ready for intensive onboarding. We aim to get new engineers up and running as quickly as reasonably possible. **Compensation** Base Salary: 120,000\-160,000 annually **Additional Benefits** Health insurance, stock options, and professional development support. **Company Description** Sign\-Speak is a fast\-growing startup on a mission to improve communication between the Deaf and Hard of Hearing communities and the hearing world. Our innovative language software recognizes sign language and translates it into spoken language, and vice versa, using machine learning. We're proud to have raised institutional funding and received funding from the National Science Foundation (NSF), and we're positioned for continued growth. At Sign\-Speak, we're a fun and compassionate team, but we're also extremely hardworking. We're looking for individuals who are as dedicated to our mission as we are and who are willing to put in the effort to help us achieve our goals. If you're a highly skilled and motivated software engineer who's passionate about using technology to make the world a more accessible place, we encourage you to apply. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technology, collaborate with a diverse and talented group of individuals, and make a real difference in people's lives. We offer a dynamic and supportive work environment that values innovation, creativity, and teamwork. If you're ready to join a team that's making a real impact in the world, we want you to be a part of Sign\-Speak. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, train, evaluate, and improve machine learning models used in our sign language recognition and communication systems. * Implement and experiment with machine learning architectures and techniques described in research papers. * Optimize machine learning models for accuracy, latency, throughput, and computational efficiency. * Develop and improve GPU\-accelerated training and inference pipelines. * Apply optimization techniques such as model quantization, pruning, and other performance improvements. * Deploy and maintain machine learning models in production environments. * Develop and optimize models for execution on local devices, including smartphones and other edge computing platforms. * Integrate machine learning models into real\-time applications. * Improve machine learning infrastructure, model serving, and deployment workflows. * Investigate performance bottlenecks related to model execution, memory utilization, and hardware acceleration. * Evaluate tradeoffs between model accuracy, inference speed, and computational resource requirements. * Write and execute technical design documents. * Collaborate with the research and engineering teams to translate experimental models into production\-ready solutions. **Qualifications** * Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, or equivalent professional experience. Preferred PhD. * Experience developing, training, and evaluating machine learning models. * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with commonly used machine learning frameworks. * Experience implementing or adapting machine learning techniques from research papers. * Understanding of neural networks, deep learning architectures, and model optimization. * Experience developing or deploying machine learning models in production or other performance\-constrained environments. * Strong understanding of GPUs and hardware\-accelerated machine learning. * Familiarity with model inference optimization and performance benchmarking. * Understanding of software engineering principles, backend systems, and machine learning pipelines. * Willingness to learn and work in a fast\-paced startup environment. **Preferred Areas of Technical Experience** * PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar machine learning frameworks. * GPU computing and optimization, including CUDA. * Deep learning model training, fine\-tuning, and evaluation. * Model quantization, pruning, distillation, and compression. * Model inference optimization using technologies such as ONNX Runtime or TensorRT. * Machine Learning Operations (MLOps), model serving, and deployment pipelines. * On\-device machine learning deployment using Core ML, TensorFlow Lite/LiteRT, or similar frameworks. * Experience optimizing models for mobile GPUs, NPUs, or other edge accelerators. * Real\-time machine learning inference and low\-latency AI applications. * Computer vision, video understanding, human pose estimation, or related applications. * Sequence modeling, multimodal machine learning, or transformer\-based architectures. * Distributed model training and cloud\-based GPU infrastructure. * Performance profiling, memory optimization, and hardware\-aware model development. * Knowledge of the Deaf and Hard of Hearing (D/HH) community is always preferred, but if you're unfamiliar with the community, we'll help you learn! **Sponsorship** Sign\-Speak sponsors H1B transfer but unfortunately does not support new H1B sponsorship at this time. **Location** Required: Living in the Upstate New York region, such as Syracuse, Buffalo, or Rochester. Preferred: In\-person in Rochester, New York. **Equipment, Machines, and Software Used** This position requires regular use of a computer and related equipment. A reliable internet connection is required. Sign\-Speak will provide a work\-issued laptop, monitor, and other standard workstation equipment. Additional development equipment or access to specialized computing resources will be provided based on the needs of the position. **Disclaimer** * All requirements are subject to possible modification to reasonably accommodate individuals with disabilities. * This description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) occupying this position. * Employees will be required to follow any other position\-related instructions and perform other position\-related duties as reasonably requested. * Sign\-Speak reserves the right to add to or revise an employee's duties in accordance with applicable law. * This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an at\-will employment relationship. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Cloud Administrator
