jobs.title: Engineer, Identity & Access Management
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE: Headquartered in Southern California, Skechers—the Comfort Technology Company®—has spent over 30 years helping men, women, and kids everywhere look and feel good. Comfort innovation is at the core of everything we do, driving the development of stylish, high\-quality products at a great value. From our diverse footwear collections to our expanding range of apparel and accessories, Skechers is a complete lifestyle brand. ABOUT THE ROLE: The Identity and Access Management team at Skechers works as part of the global information security program to ensure authentication systems are designed and operated securely, and the right access exists for the right needs at the right time. As part of this team, the IAM Engineer’s role is to help ensure that authentication and authorization systems are designed and operated with a focus on security and efficiency. Technology changes quickly and adversaries are constantly evolving new ways to break and bypass all types of local, federated, human, and machine authentication protocols. This technical specialist will bring a broad understanding of threat actor tactics and deep expertise with authentication systems to help ensure that our capabilities are constantly evolving to meet and exceed the current threat environment. The candidate who will find the most success and fulfillment brings a genuine interest and passion for information security, a love for learning, a positive attitude, and that nagging curiosity that makes you want to push past where others stop. WHAT YOU'LL DO: * Assist with design and implementation of security focused IAM solutions including PAM, MFA, JIT, vaulting, etc. * Leverage understanding of threat actor techniques and technical solutions to provide guidance on and develop requirements for secure authentication methods. * Help continuously evaluate and modernize authentication systems and process by researching and participating in the pilot of emerging technologies. * Develop and improve joiner, mover, leaver workflows, including access requests, approvals, provisioning, and timely access removal, in partnership with process and system owners. * Identify risks and potential weak configurations in existing environments as well as new proposals and implementations. * Contribute to and/or lead projects and efforts related to core authentication systems and secure authentication initiatives, including phishing\-resistant and risk\-based authentication. * Collaborate with diverse stakeholders including business and technology teams, infrastructure, cloud, application development, and more to drive security and consistency across the organization. * Exhibit critical thinking and creativity by helping develop elegant solutions to complex technical challenges. * Demonstrate curiosity and a continuous learning mindset by staying up to date on current threat actor tools, techniques, and procedures and emerging IAM capabilities. * Use scripting, APIs, and workflow tools to automate repeatable IAM tasks and improve integration reliability. WHAT YOU'LL BRING: * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with multiple authentication and authorization solutions and directory platforms. * 5\+ years of experience with identity security solutions, such as CyberArk, Delinea, Duo, Okta, etc. * GIAC, (ISC)2, or similar security certification is a plus. * Hands\-on experience with enterprise identity platforms such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID, plus experience with and understanding of approaches to securing directory services such as Active Directory. * Experience with cloud infrastructure and familiarity with authentication systems in IaaS. * Deep understanding of authentication protocols (NTLM, Kerberos, SAML, OIDC, FIDO2, WebAuthn, etc.). * Understanding of general enterprise network and system components and their roles. * Familiarity with network and application protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, SSH, DNS, etc.). * Understanding of modern cybersecurity concepts like Zero Trust and Just in Time access provisioning. * Strong understanding of the identity and access security implications of emerging technologies, such as agentic AI, MCP servers, etc. * Awareness and understanding of current and emerging threats and attacker techniques. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to excel in a fast paced and rapidly changing environment. * Exposure or working knowledge of identity providers and IGA solutions. * Excellent communication skills, and experience collaborating with diverse stakeholders. * Proven ability to take ownership of tasks and responsibilities. * Reliable self\-reliant contributor with a strong work ethic. The pay range for this position is $125,000\-$165,000/yr USD. **About Skechers** Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Skechers is committed to providing a safe, inclusive, and respectful work environment. Skechers provides equal employment opportunities for all employees and applicants for employment without regard race, color, religion, gender, gender identification and expression, national origin, marital status, age, disability, genetic information, military status, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic established by local, state or federal law. **Reasonable Accommodation** Applicants for employment who require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job should request appropriate accommodation by emailing benefits@skechers.com. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each job responsibility satisfactorily. The skills, abilities and physical demands described are representative of those duties that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities, who are otherwise qualified for the job position, to perform the essential functions.

jobs.title: Skytrac Mechanical Engineer & CAD/PDM Power User
jobs.description: **MECHANICAL ENGINEER \& CAD/PDM POWER USER** **Position Department:** Engineering **Reports To:** Engineering Manager **Status:** Salary, Exempt **Location:** Tooele, UT **Employment** **Type:** Full Time **Work Schedule:** In Office / Opportunity to Transition to Hybrid Remote **Travel Required:** Up to 10% **Position Overview** We are seeking a motivated, detail\-oriented Mechanical Engineer \& CAD Power User to join our engineering team. In this dual\-focus role, you will spend approximately 70% of your time on core mechanical design engineering and 30% serving as our internal CAD and PLM/PDM technical champion. The ideal candidate is not just a skilled product design engineer, but a SolidWorks expert who thrives on troubleshooting complex modeling challenges, optimizing large assemblies, and ensuring seamless data synchronization with our PDM Vault. You will be the go\-to technical resource for the engineering team, resolving daily operational bottlenecks and maintaining data integrity. **System Integration \& Migration Support** You will maintain and troubleshoot the day\-to\-day data interface between our current PDM and Manufacturing ERP systems to ensure seamless BOM and metadata synchronization. Additionally, you will help guide our team through an upcoming transition to a new PDM/ERP ecosystem. Rather than building a system from scratch, you will serve as the local technical lead to adapt, test, and implement the standardized workflows and infrastructure already established by our parent company. **Company Description** Skytrac Services, Inc. delivers turnkey installations of fixed grip aerial ropeways and automated people moving systems, utilizing our Engineering team throughout the entire project lifecycle. Ropeway manufacturing is a specialized industry, providing engineers with diverse multidisciplinary opportunities that extend beyond traditional mechanical engineering, requiring robust fundamental engineering principles and advanced problem\-solving skills. In this role, you will collaborate closely with our Mechanical and Civil Engineering teams to achieve project objectives. You will design and develop systems featuring complex welded structures, precision\-machined and custom sheet metal parts, as well as commercial purchased components. This position offers many unique learning opportunities to see your designs move directly from the computer screen to our on\-site fabrication shop, and to installation sites in various locations. You will have the opportunity to collaborate closely with skilled fabricators and on\-site construction experts, gaining valuable hands\-on exposure to all aspects of aerial ropeway systems. This position is located at the corporate offices of Skytrac based in Tooele, UT. Work schedule is office\-based initially, with opportunities for transitioning to hybrid remote. Some travel to jobsites throughout the United States and Canada may be required, primarily between May and October, but is expected to be 10% or less of work time during those months. **Key Responsibilities** **Mechanical Engineering** * **3D Modeling \& Drafting:** Create detailed SolidWorks 3D models and assembly/fabrication drawings adhering to industry standards (drafting standards, weld symbols, tolerances, and material specifications). * **Engineering Analysis:** Perform mechanical and machine design calculations and computer models to validate designs, including finite element analysis (FEA) software. * **Component Specification:** Evaluate commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) parts (e.g., motors, bearings, gear reducers, hydraulic cylinders, belts, chains, sprockets, etc.) and create specifications for purchasing. * **Design for Manufacturing:** Collaborate with engineers and fabrication specialists to optimize parts for company manufacturing methods and tooling, focusing on sheet metal bending, laser cutting, CNC machining, and weldment stability. * **Bill of Materials (BOM) Management:** Generate and maintain accurate, structured BOMs to ensure exact project requirements are achieved. * **Shop Floor Collaboration:** Provide technical support to the fabrication and assembly teams, troubleshooting production issues and processing engineering change notices (ECNs). **CAD \& PDM Administration / Power User Support** * **Advanced Modeling Troubleshooting:** Serve as the internal expert to resolve complex SolidWorks issues, including repairing broken features, stabilizing failing/unstable assemblies, and fixing corrupted drawing files. * **PDM Vault Administration:** Handle daily administrative tasks for the PDM Vault, including managing user permissions, workflows, and folder structures. * **Connectivity \& Sync Support:** Troubleshoot and resolve daily user issues regarding server connectivity, check\-in/out errors, revision control conflicts, and metadata/variable synchronization between SolidWorks and the PDM Vault. * **Best Practices \& Standards:** Establish, document, and enforce company\-wide CAD modeling standards, templates, and PDM workflows to optimize vault performance and minimize file corruption. **Experience and Qualifications** * **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field. * **Experience:** 5\+ years of experience in mechanical engineering, with a proven track record of managing engineering data. * **SolidWorks Expertise:** Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks (CSWP or CSWPA certifications are highly desirable). Deep understanding of design, including parametric modeling practices and large assembly management. (Note: Expertise with other platforms e.g. Inventor, NX, Creo, may be considered). * **PDM/PLM Administration:** Hands\-on experience administering SolidWorks PDM (Standard or Professional) or an equivalent PLM vault environment. * **Technical Troubleshooting:** Strong analytical mindset with the ability to systematically diagnose and resolve software, hardware, and network\-related CAD/PDM data sync issues. * **Communication:** Excellent interpersonal skills with the patience and clarity required to provide technical support and training to fellow engineers. **Benefits\-** Health, Dental and Vision Insurance 401K Matching Paid time off Life Insurance Employee Assistance Program

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: ##### **Job Summary** **Job Description** Senior AI Engineer (Contract) – Applied GenAI / Full Stack High\-Level Summary / Team Need I’m looking for a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI Platform Team to help build secure, scalable, and reusable enterprise AI capabilities. This team enables safe, fast AI adoption across the enterprise by delivering governed platform capabilities, reusable patterns, and enterprise AI solutions such as RAG\-based search, chat assistants, and agent/chatbot services aligned to enterprise business domains. This is a high\-output, highly collaborative, hands\-on engineering role focused on building and shipping production\-ready AI solutions — not a research role and not a purely architectural role. This role should skew toward backend/platform engineering, and the engineer needs to be able to operate across the full solution lifecycle — including infrastructure as code, APIs/services, cloud deployment, data storage, and production\-ready delivery. Our team builds reusable AI platform components and domain\-aligned AI solutions while working within guardrails related to privacy, security, compliance, observability, and engineering standards. We are not building frontend/UI applications on this team today; this role is centered on backend services, platform capabilities, and cloud\-native delivery. **Required** * 6–8 years of software engineering experience with strong hands\-on development experience in modern application engineering. * Strong experience with Node.js / TypeScript; this is the non\-negotiable primary language requirement for the role. * Strong experience building backend/platform\-oriented full\-stack solutions, including APIs, services, databases, cloud deployment, and operational support. * Strong AWS experience is required. * Candidates should have hands\-on experience with services such as API Gateway, Lambda, Bedrock, S3, EventBridge, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, CloudWatch, CDK, and Fargate. jobs.title: Display Engineer :: Spring, TX
jobs.description: **MUST HAVE:** Practical troubleshooting. Hands\-on work with enterprise PCs, displays, docking, hardware validation, or related AV systems; able to explain a real issue investigated beyond replacing hardware or rebooting. * MUST HAVE: Independent problem solving. Defines the symptom, attempts reproduction, compares working versus failing setups, changes one variable at a time, and distinguishes evidence from a guess. * MUST HAVE: Curiosity and learning agility. Researches unfamiliar technology, asks productive questions, and can grow into specialized display engineering without needing step\-by\-step direction. Secondary Skills \- Nice to Haves * graphics drivers * Firmware * BIOS Job Description The Display Engineer is a hands\-on technical role focused on reproducing, isolating, validating, and resolving display and docking issues in enterprise endpoint environments. Work spans monitors, notebooks, workstations, docks, cables, graphics drivers, firmware, operating systems, and integrated peripherals. The engineer builds representative test setups, compares known\-good and failing conditions, changes variables systematically, and documents findings that engineering teams can act on. We welcome candidates from enterprise endpoint troubleshooting, display or AV integration, docking support, hardware validation, and technical escalation backgrounds. Deep knowledge of every display standard is not a prerequisite. What matters is a demonstrated ability to investigate unfamiliar problems independently, learn quickly, reproduce symptoms, isolate causes, and verify results rather than relying on part swaps or routine update/reboot steps. * Lead complex display investigations. Own end\-to\-end troubleshooting of issues such as intermittent black screens, signal loss or cutouts, delayed display detection, wake/resume failures, resolution or scaling problems, refresh\-rate limitations, multi\-monitor instability, input switching, and dock\-to\-display behavior. * Reproduce enterprise environments. Build representative test configurations that mirror the reported endpoint, monitor, dock, cable/adapter path, operating system, firmware, graphics driver, display settings, and connected peripherals so that testing reflects the actual environment rather than a simplified lab scenario. * Use disciplined root\-cause isolation. Perform controlled A/B testing, known\-good versus known\-bad comparisons, and structured test matrices. Change one variable at a time and distinguish correlation, common denominators, hypotheses, and confirmed root cause. * Troubleshoot the complete display path. Investigate DisplayPort, HDMI, USB\-C video, Thunderbolt/USB4, cables, docks, bandwidth constraints, and display detection. Build deeper expertise in link training, EDID, MST/SST, DSC, and related protocols as needed. * Validate multi\-display and high\-demand topologies. Test single\- and multi\-monitor configurations, daisy chains, docking paths, high\-resolution or high\-refresh configurations, scaling behavior, GPU\-to\-display workloads, and combinations that place greater demand on link bandwidth or topology management. * Separate video from integrated peripheral paths. Troubleshoot monitors that also function as hubs or conferencing devices by independently validating display, USB, webcam, microphone, speaker/audio, Ethernet, hub enumeration, and power\-delivery paths rather than treating a one\-cable monitor as a single subsystem. * Perform firmware, driver, BIOS, and OS regression validation. Compare behavior before and after monitor or dock firmware, graphics\-driver, BIOS, and operating\-system changes. Determine whether an update introduces, resolves, or exposes an interoperability issue and confirm results through repeatable testing. * Develop repeatable validation plans. Create test cases for cold boot, restart, sleep/wake, reconnect, input changes, firmware updates, topology changes, and repeated cycles. Record reproduction rate and expected\-versus\-actual behavior so results can be compared over time. * Collect engineering\-quality evidence. Capture exact hardware topology, firmware and driver versions, OS build, reproduction steps and rate, logs, screenshots/video, timing data, and known\-good/known\-bad combinations. Produce concise evidence packages that another engineering team can act on without repeating basic troubleshooting. * Partner with product and R\&D engineering. Escalate well\-isolated issues with a clear technical question, supporting evidence, and a working hypothesis. Collaborate with firmware, graphics, docking, platform, and display teams to verify fixes or practical workarounds. * Support deployment and readiness decisions. Validate proposed fixes, firmware and driver releases, configuration changes, and new display combinations before broader deployment. Identify residual risk and provide clear pass/fail findings and rollout considerations. * Communicate technical findings clearly. Translate complex troubleshooting results into concise updates for technical and non\-technical stakeholders. State what is confirmed, what has been ruled out, what remains under investigation, and what should happen next without overstating the evidence. * Improve the engineering method. Document reusable test procedures, troubleshooting patterns, evidence templates, and opportunities for automation so recurring display investigations become faster, more consistent, and easier to scale.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About Spectro Cloud** Spectro Cloud, a recognized leader in enterprise Kubernetes management with its flagship Palette platform, is seeking an execution\-focused, hands\-on Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to help advance mission\-critical platform resilience and operational excellence. This role contributes directly to the continuous stability, performance, security, and reliability of our US\- and EU\-based global platform. As an SRE, you will operate and improve Palette production systems end to end, contributing to Service Level Objectives (SLOs), incident response, production readiness, observability, automation, disaster recovery, and performance optimization across commercial and federal deployments. You will work closely with Platform Engineering, DevOps, and product engineering teams to build reliable, scalable, and highly automated systems, with a strong emphasis on reducing operational toil, improving recovery speed, and preventing repeat incidents. **The Role** Your core mandate is to engineer, operate, and continuously improve a declarative, self\-healing, cloud\-native, Kubernetes\-native, highly observable, enterprise\-grade platform. You will contribute hands\-on to the systems and processes that ensure production health, including: * Go\-based microservices, focusing on throughput, resilience, reliability, and operational simplicity. * Production\-readiness improvements for CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, enabling safe and reliable deployments. * Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) automation using Terraform and Ansible to deliver consistent, secure, and repeatable environments, with strong Disaster Recovery (DR) and business continuity practices. * Unified observability across metrics, logs, traces, and intelligent alerting to provide actionable visibility into platform health. * MongoDB and distributed\-systems operations to support 24/7 availability, performance, durability, and efficiency. Success in this role requires a proactive builder\-and\-operator mindset. You should be comfortable troubleshooting complex distributed systems, automating repetitive work, participating in incident response, and improving reliability through disciplined engineering. You will also use AI responsibly as an accelerator for repeatable SRE tasks while maintaining strong human validation, security, and engineering accountability. In this role, you will help make Palette more reliable, observable, resilient, and easier to operate. You will improve the mechanisms by which Spectro Cloud detects failures, responds to incidents, measures reliability, deploys safely, and prevents recurrence—while using automation and responsible AI adoption to increase operational leverage. **What You'll Do** **Production Reliability Engineering (SRE \& Resilience)** * Implement and improve enterprise\-grade practices for stability, performance, scalability, observability, and Disaster Recovery (DR). * Define, instrument, monitor, and continuously improve Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets in partnership with service owners. * Participate in the incident\-response lifecycle, including on\-call, mitigation, blameless Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and preventative long\-term remediation. * Identify recurring reliability risks and drive engineering changes that improve production resilience. **Observability \& Performance Management (Proactive Operations)** * Build, operate, and improve the unified observability stack using technologies such as Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/Loki, and distributed tracing. * Create dashboards, alerts, and runbooks that provide real\-time visibility into system health and user experience. * Perform performance tuning, capacity planning, and load testing to ensure the platform can meet current and future demand while adhering to SLOs. * Reduce alert noise and improve signal quality so incidents can be detected and resolved quickly. **Production Safety \& Deployment Engineering (Minimizing Toil)** * Implement and continuously improve safe deployment strategies such as canary releases, rolling updates, blue/green deployments, and feature flags in partnership with DevOps and engineering teams. * Build robust, fast, automated rollback and recovery mechanisms to minimize Mean Time To Recovery (MTTR). * Automate repetitive operational work and eliminate toil through tooling, standardization, and self\-service capabilities. * Promote a 'you build it, you run it' mindset through strong production\-readiness practices and clear service ownership. **AI\-Accelerated Reliability (Responsible Innovation)** * Apply generative AI tools responsibly to accelerate repeatable SRE tasks such as RCA summarization, runbook generation, operational analysis, and incident pattern identification. * Use effective prompt\-engineering practices to improve the quality and consistency of AI\-assisted workflows. * Validate all AI\-generated operational artifacts before use. Increased velocity must never compromise engineering correctness, security, or compliance. **Platform Architecture \& Optimization (Scalability \& Performance)** * Contribute to the continuous evolution of the scalable, resilient Kubernetes control plane with a focus on reducing failure domains and operational complexity. * Design and improve resilient Go microservices and REST APIs with reliability, security, and performance principles built in. * Troubleshoot and optimize MongoDB performance, indexing, and distributed\-systems behavior to support high availability and data integrity. * Partner with engineering teams on production\-readiness reviews and reliability improvements before and after service launches. **About the Team** The Spectro Cloud Engineering organization operates under a discipline philosophy guided by Clarity, Precision, Documentation\-Driven Engineering (DDE), validation\-first execution, and a culture of Absolute Ownership. * Create and maintain clear, Markdown\-based design specifications, operational documentation, and runbooks so architectural and operational intent is documented before implementation. * Own services and reliability outcomes end to end, including operational readiness, on\-call participation, and follow\-through on remediation work. * Drive continuous operational excellence and measurable reduction of toil. * Use reliability KPIs such as MTBF, MTTR, deployment success rates, SLO attainment, and error\-budget consumption to guide improvements. * Collaborate effectively across SRE, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Security, and product engineering teams. **Required qualifications** * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, or operating high\-scale distributed systems. * Strong hands\-on experience operating, scaling, and troubleshooting Kubernetes in complex production environments. * Programming proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or a comparable language, with a strong focus on automation and operational tooling. * Hands\-on experience with observability systems spanning metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards, and incident response/on\-call operations. * Strong Infrastructure\-as\-Code experience with Terraform and/or Ansible. * Operational experience with at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networked services, and production performance issues using data\-driven methods. * Working knowledge of MongoDB operations, query/index performance, and high\-availability concepts in production environments. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with Go\-based microservices and REST APIs. * Experience designing or operating production systems for enterprise SaaS, regulated, or federal environments. * Experience implementing disaster\-recovery, capacity\-planning, or load\-testing programs. * Experience using AI\-assisted engineering or operations workflows with strong validation and governance controls. 2026\-274

jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. Success in this role requires strong technical ownership and effective teamwork. You will collaborate with business partners, data analysts, data engineers, infrastructure engineers, and software engineers to translate business needs into scalable, production\-ready graph solutions. Some Responsibilities May Include * **Graph architecture and data modeling:** Lead architectural decisions and design and maintain labeled property graph models, including entities, relationships, properties, and constraints, aligned with claims investigation use cases. * **Data integration:** Build and maintain scalable pipelines to ingest, transform, validate, and load data from relational databases and other structured and unstructured sources into graph databases. * **Graph database engineering and deployment:** Lead the implementation, configuration, and production deployment of graph database solutions, such as Neo4j or Amazon Neptune, in collaboration with infrastructure teams. * **Performance optimization:** Optimize graph queries, indexes, data models, and ingestion processes to improve performance, scalability, and resource utilization. * **Graph analytics:** Apply algorithms such as community detection, centrality, and pathfinding to identify relationships, patterns, and investigative insights. * **Production reliability:** Implement automated testing, monitoring, data quality controls, and operational documentation to support reliable graph solutions. * **Security and governance:** Apply organizational standards for data access, privacy, security, and governance. * **Cross\-functional collaboration:** Translate business requirements into technical designs and communicate findings, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical and business audiences. Qualifications: **We Are Seeking Candidates With:*** At least five years of professional data engineering experience. * Hands\-on experience developing and supporting graph database solutions using Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or a comparable platform. * Demonstrated ability to work independently and lead graph architecture and production deployment. * Experience designing labeled property graph models and writing and optimizing graph queries using a language appropriate to the platform, such as Cypher or Gremlin. * Proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, or Scala. * Experience building ETL or ELT pipelines, including integrating relational data into graph databases. * Understanding of graph algorithms and their application to analytical or investigative use cases. * Experience with data quality validation, automated testing, version control, and production troubleshooting. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and teamwork skills. Core Competencies* Technical ownership and leadership * Cross\-functional collaboration * Clear technical and business communication * Analytical thinking and problem\-solving * Business and insurance domain understanding * Commitment to data quality, security, and operational reliability Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $97,000 \- $177,000 + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + **High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience** * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!** * **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. jobs.description: **All job postings will expire at 11:59 PM Eastern Time on the application deadline.** **Organization:** Rehabilitation \& Correction \- Chillicothe Correctional Institution **Agency Contact Name and Information:** Personnel Director 740/774\-0033/DRC.CCIRecruit@drc.ohio.gov **Work Location:** 15802 State Route 104 Chillicothe, Ohio, 45601 United States **Compensation:** $25\.61 **Schedule:** Permanent \- Full Time **Work Hours:** Not Specified **Classified Indicator:** Classified **Union:** OCSEA **Primary Job Skill:** Trades **Who We Are** Guided by a single mission “To reduce recidivism among those we touch,” the Ohio Department of Rehabilitation and Correction believes that everyone is capable of positive change. Our staff embrace these core values and serves as role models for pro\-social behavior conveying an attitude of dignity and respect in the treatment of others. The Ohio Department of Rehabilitation and Correction has been tasked with front line crime reduction through rehabilitative treatment and programming efforts provided in a safe, secure and humane correctional environment and effective community supervision. Our goal is to protect the public through helping individuals turn away from crime and become productive, contributing members of our communities, ensuring a safer Ohio for all Ohioans now and in the future. To learn more about our agency, please visit our website at www.drc.ohio.gov. **What You'll Do** **This is a reposting. If you applied previously, you must apply again to be considered.** **Pay ranges from approximately $54,000 to $72,000\. Starting pay will be based on qualifications, education, experience, and location.** * Serve as lead worker (e.g., provides work direction and training) over lower\-level powerhouse workers and /or inmates in installation, repair, maintenance and operation of powerhouse equipment (e.g., boilers, furnaces, stokers, other fuel burning equipment, turbines, blowers, flow meters, pumps, generators, fans, pollution control equipment) * Makes rounds of powerhouse reading gauges, adjusting equipment and observing operation of equipment * Starts, stops and changes over\-generating equipment as needed * Keeps powerhouse logs, recording gauge readings, fuel consumed, power generated * Maintains work performed, timecard and related records * Maintains security of inmates. * Maintains inventory of parts and supplies and orders parts * Oversees and /or performs maintenance on area around powerhouse * Performs annual boiler inspection and maintenance * Serves on institutional committees * Attends training, seminars and /or meetings as required * Performs security functions as required (e.g., man\-down, shakedown, inmate movement) * Performs other duties as assigned **Additional Information** **Application Procedures:** In order to be considered for this position, you must apply on\-line through this posting website. (We no longer accept paper applications.) * When completing your on\-line Ohio Civil Service Application, be sure to clearly describe how you meet the minimum qualifications outlined on this job posting. * We cannot give you credit for your qualifications, experience, education and training in the job selection process if you do not provide it in your on\-line application. * We will communicate with you through the email you provided in your profile and job application. Be sure to check your email often. If you require a reasonable accommodation for the application process, please contact the Human Resources Office so proper arrangements can be made. Otherwise, you will be given specific instructions on requesting an accommodation if you are invited to an assessment and/or interview. **The Ohio Department of Rehabilitation and Correction is a tobacco\-free workplace.** **Pre\-Employment Drug Testing:** All final applicants tentatively selected for this position will be required to submit to urinalysis to test for illegal drug use prior to appointments. Testing will also be performed for the presence of marijuana. An applicant with a positive test shall not be offered employment unless the applicant submits medical documentation of legally prescribed medications or a recommendation for medical marijuana. **Pre\-Employment Background Investigation:** The final applicant selected for the position will be required to undergo a criminal background check. An individual assessment of an applicant’s prior criminal convictions will be made before excluding an applicant from consideration. The Ohio Department of Rehabilitation and Correction is prohibited from hiring: * Individuals under a federal or state weapons disability if the position requires firearms certification/recertification and use; * Individuals who have engaged in sexual abuse in a prison or other confinement facility; have been civilly or administratively adjudicated, or convicted of engaging or attempting to engage in sexual activity in the community facilitated by force, implied threats of force, or if the victim did not or was unable to consent; * Individuals convicted of soliciting or providing support for an act of terrorism, terrorism, or money laundering to support terrorism; * Individuals who have been convicted of or pled guilty to a felony where a direct correlation exists between the position and prior criminal behavior (example: individuals convicted of a felony involving fraud, deceit, or theft from holding a position that has substantial management or control over the property of a state agency.) **Why Work for the State of Ohio:** At the State of Ohio, we take care of the team that cares for Ohioans. We provide a variety of quality, competitive benefits to eligible full\-time and part\-time employees\*. For a list of all the State of Ohio Benefits, visit our Total Rewards website! Our benefits package includes: * Medical Coverage * Free Dental, Vision and Basic Life Insurance premiums after completion of eligibility period * Paid time off, including vacation, personal, sick leave and 11 paid holidays per year * Childbirth, Adoption, and Foster Care leave * Education and Development Opportunities (Employee Development Funds, Public Service Loan Forgiveness, and more) * Public Retirement Systems (such as OPERS, STRS, SERS, and HPRS) \& Optional Deferred Compensation (Ohio Deferred Compensation) * Benefits eligibility is dependent on a number of factors. The Agency Contact listed above will be able to provide specific benefits information for this position. **Qualifications:** Stationary Steam Engineer License pursuant to Section 4104\.19, Revised Code 6 mos. exp. as licensed stationary engineer. **Job Skills:** Trades, Engineering, HVACTrade, Regulatory Compliance, General Maintenance, Attention to Detail, Problem Solving, Flexibility, Time Management. **ADA Statement:** Ohio is a Disability Inclusion State and strives to be a model employer of individuals with disabilities. The State of Ohio is committed to providing access and inclusion and reasonable accommodation in its services, activities, programs and employment opportunities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and other applicable laws. **Drug\-Free Workplace:** The State of Ohio is a drug\-free workplace which prohibits the use of marijuana (recreational marijuana/non\-medical cannabis). Please note, this position may be subject to additional restrictions pursuant to the State of Ohio Drug\-Free Workplace Policy (HR\-39\), and as outlined in the posting.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer I
jobs.description: **Job Responsibilities** ------------------------ **The South Carolina Law Enforcement Division (SLED) is seeking a highly skilled Systems Engineer to provide advanced\-level design, implementation, and support of the agency’s enterprise IT infrastructure.** **About SLED** The South Carolina Law Enforcement Division (SLED) is a premier statewide law enforcement agency dedicated to serving and protecting the citizens of South Carolina. With a proud history rooted in integrity, professionalism, and public service, SLED is committed to providing high\-quality investigative, intelligence, and forensic services to support law enforcement agencies across the state. At SLED, we value dedication, ethical conduct, accountability, and a strong commitment to justice. Our agency plays a vital role in maintaining public safety and supporting criminal justice efforts at the local, state, and federal levels. From advanced forensic science to homeland security, criminal investigations, and criminal justice information systems, SLED's diverse responsibilities make it one of the most dynamic law enforcement agencies in the state. We foster a professional work environment where teamwork, respect, and continuous improvement are fundamental. Our employees are held to the highest standards and are given opportunities to grow within a mission\-driven organization that makes a meaningful difference in South Carolina communities. Learn more about why you should join our team at www.sled.sc.gov. **General Responsibilities** Recommend, develop, configure, and support the patching of the agency's server and desktop environments. Maintain server images with up\-to\-date patches and drivers and provide third\-party software patching. Deliver monthly and on\-demand patching reports to IT leadership. Perform systems engineering functions, including system design, implementation, and optimization, and serve as a technical lead by providing high\-level support and troubleshooting expertise. **Specific Duties** * Oversee the installation, configuration, and deployment of hardware and software systems. Monitor system performance, analyze metrics, and implement optimizations to enhance efficiency and reliability. Provide high\-level support for system issues, diagnose problems, and implement solutions to minimize downtime. * Execute the SLED server vulnerability management program. Facilitate monthly, on\-demand, and third\-party patching of Windows and Linux servers using enterprise patching tools. * Design and implement disaster recovery plans to ensure business continuity in the event of system failures or data loss. Maintain the backup environment to ensure data integrity and availability. * Create and maintain documentation related to system configurations, processes, and procedures for reference and compliance. Provide training and support to end users and other IT staff on system operations and best practices. **Minimum and Additional Requirements** --------------------------------------- * A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field and experience in computer system development and modification in an on\-premises, cloud\-based, or hybrid environment. Relevant experience may be substituted for the bachelor's degree on a year\-for\-year basis. * Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server environments. * Experience with server patch and vulnerability management using enterprise patching tools, including third\-party patching. * Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions. * Experience with automation and scripting (e.g., PowerShell) and with security best practices. * Ability to manage projects, solve complex technical issues, and communicate effectively both verbally and in writing. * Must have a strong understanding of IT security best practices, including patching, hardening, compliance, disaster recovery, and data protection. * Must be able to lift 50 pounds. * Must successfully complete a fingerprint background check. * Position requires participation in a rotating 24/7 on\-call schedule and may involve occasional overnight travel. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Professional certifications such as CompTIA, VMware VCP, Azure Administrator/Architect, other Microsoft certificates, or equivalent. * Experience with PowerShell, Terraform, or Ansible for automation and infrastructure\-as\-code. * Experience in a law enforcement or public safety IT environment. **Additional Comments** ----------------------- South Carolina Law Enforcement Division (SLED) is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, including, but not limited, to lactation), national origin, age (40 or older), disability or genetic information. **SLED offers an exceptional benefits package for FTE positions that includes:** * Health, Dental, Vision, Long Term Disability, and Life Insurance for Employee, Spouse, and Children * 15 days annual (vacation) leave per year * 15 days sick leave per year * 13 paid holidays * Paid Parental Leave * State Retirement Plan and Deferred Compensation Programs Supplemental questions are considered part of the official application. Any misrepresentation of yourself may be grounds for disqualification. Conditional selection based on candidate education, training, experience, oral interviews and clearance of background investigation.

We welcome applications from all people without regard to sex, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any characteristic protected by law. We believe that diverse teams reflect our identity as a global company, enabling us to better address the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future. Our benefits reflects the STELLANTIS commitment to helping you reach your personal and professional goals. In addition to an environment that promotes career development, we offer benefits for a healthy lifestyle and a rewarding future, designed to take care of you and your family, in various stages of life. As a global company, our employee packages will vary by country, customary norms and the legal entity into which you are hired. We care about your privacy. For more information on how your personal data is processed, please read the specific Privacy Statement provided by the respective entities whose job offer you have selected.

jobs.description: Job Description Strategic ACI is seeking a Senior AI Platform Engineer to design, build, deploy, and operate production AI capabilities for NGA on a new Digital Ecosystem program. The role combines architecture with direct implementation, including writing code, integrating models and tools, building deployment pipelines, evaluating AI performance, and troubleshooting production systems. Experience implementing LLMOps or MLOps practices, including model and prompt versioning, automated evaluation, deployment gates, monitoring, and rollback. Through company all\-hands, team events, Slack communities, learning sessions, and in\-person gatherings, we create intentional opportunities for our global team to collaborate, build relationships, and celebrate successes together. **All positions are open to remote work unless otherwise specified in the requirements below.** **The opportunity** ------------------- We're seeking a **Product Engineer** with a builder's mindset: someone who naturally spots problems, gets excited about finding solutions, and enjoys turning ideas into working products. You might have founded a startup, launched your own product, built side projects, automated something that frustrated you, or simply be the person who is always looking for a better way to do things. At TechnologyAdvice, engineers don't just implement requirements or wait for work to be assigned. They work directly with business stakeholders, Product, and other engineers to discover problems worth solving, determine what solutions make sense, and take ownership of delivering measurable results. You'll work across the full problem\-solving lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and understanding business needs to evaluating solutions, implementation, deployment, measurement, and iteration. Sometimes the right solution is a new application. Other times it's improving an existing process, automating manual work, or recognizing that something isn't worth building at all. We value engineers who are just as interested in figuring out what to build and why as they are in actually building it. AI is a core part of how we work. We expect engineers to use AI throughout their workflows to accelerate research, discovery, prototyping, development, testing, and delivery. We believe AI enables resourceful engineers to experiment faster, tackle more ambitious problems, and create impact well beyond what would traditionally be possible for a small team. Strong engineering fundamentals and sound judgment remain essential to ensuring those solutions are reliable, secure, and maintainable. You won't be expected to independently navigate every complex opportunity from day one. You'll collaborate with Product, Engineering leadership, and experienced engineers as you develop the judgment to assess opportunities, make tradeoffs, and own increasingly ambiguous problems. What matters is that you take initiative, seek out context, and drive problems forward rather than waiting for detailed instructions. Success in this role is measured by the business impact you create, your ability to identify and solve meaningful problems, the speed and quality of your execution, and how effectively you use AI and technology to increase your leverage. We care more about whether your solutions create value than how much code you write. The best candidates are curious, resourceful, action\-oriented builders who enjoy experimenting, challenging assumptions, and turning ideas into reality. Whether your experience comes from building products at work, launching your own ventures, or pursuing projects simply because you wanted to see if something could be done, we're looking for people who take pride in solving problems and want to have a direct hand in making a business better. **Location:** United States **What you'll do** ------------------ * Use AI\-assisted development practices to rapidly prototype, validate, and ship production\-ready solutions. * Work directly with business stakeholders and Product to understand business problems, user needs, constraints, and desired outcomes. * Proactively identify opportunities to improve business outcomes by engaging stakeholders, examining data, questioning existing processes, and investigating problems, not just responding to assigned work. * Take ownership of problems from solution definition through implementation, deployment, measurement, and iteration. * Build and maintain full\-stack applications, backend services, automations, data workflows, and internal tools that create business value. * Understand how your work connects to measurable outcomes such as revenue, cost, speed, quality, capacity, risk, or customer experience. * Use data, feedback, and product analy learn quickly. * **We embrace AI** — AI\-powered tools such as Cursor, Claude, and ChatGPT are expected parts of the engineering workflow. * **We understand the problem** — Engineers don't just receive requirements; they seek out the context necessary to make good decisions. * **We own outcomes** — Shipping code isn't the finish line. We care whether what we built actually solved the problem. * **We use judgment** — Not every decision needs a process, framework, or escalation. We expect engineers to develop the judgment to make good decisions at the appropriate level. * **We stay curious** — Engineers are encouraged to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, experiment, and learn. * **We increase our leverage** — We continually look for ways technology and AI can allow a small team to create disproportionate business impact. **Growth to Senior Product Engineer** ------------------------------------- Product Engineers are expected to develop increasing autonomy, judgment, scope, and business ownership over time. A Senior Product Engineer consistently demonstrates the ability to independently identify high\-value opportunities, turn ambiguous business problems into solutions, make sound architectural and build\-vs\-buy decisions, and own complex work from discovery through measurable business impact with minimal oversight. Progression to Senior is based on demonstrated scope, autonomy, judgment, leverage, and impact—not tenure. **What we offer you** --------------------- * **Career Growth:** Advance with mentorship programs, leadership academies, and opportunities to shape company culture and DEI initiatives. * **Flex Fridays:** Adjust your 40\-hour week to enjoy a full or half day off on Fridays. * **Remote\-First Culture:** Work from the comfort of your home. * **Flexible PTO:** Take the time you need, when you need it. * **Health Coverage:** Medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family. * **Insurance Protection:** Life, AD\&D, Short\-Term, and Long\-Term Disability coverage. * **401K with Match:** Secure your future with our company\-matched retirement savings. * **Paid Parental Leave:** Support for new parents during life's special moments. * **Wellness Perks:** Access Headspace and enjoy monthly fitness reimbursements. * **Pet Insurance:** Care for your furry family members. * **Speaker Series Bonus:** Present in our monthly speaker series and earn a bonus. * **Book Reimbursement:** Get up to 12 books reimbursed per year to fuel your learning. * **Bucket List Benefit:** Celebrate milestones with annual contributions toward your dream adventures after 3 years. * **In\-Office Perks:** Enjoy catered lunches for our in\-office team. \#LI\-Remote **Work authorization** Employer work visa sponsorship and support are not provided for this role. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States at hire in an employer approved US state and must maintain authorization to work in the United States throughout their employment with our company. **EOE statement** We believe that our differences make us stronger, and thus foster a diverse and inclusive culture where people feel safe being themselves. jobs.title: Sr. Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Passionate about precision medicine and advancing the healthcare industry?** Recent advancements in underlying technology have finally made it possible for AI to impact clinical care in a meaningful way. The Senior Software Quality Engineer will apply scalable, risk\-based approaches to evolve Tempus’ QMS for novel digital health, AI, and machine\-learning technologies, while ensuring alignment with FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, and other applicable regulatory requirements. This position will report to the Director, Software Quality Engineering. **Responsibilities** * Support Tempus’ SDLC activities for medical device software by ensuring required documentation and Design and Development file (aka DHF) deliverables are generated and maintained throughout lifecycle of medical device software/SaMD, including: + SRS, SAD, SDS, V\&V + Traceability + Risk management/FMEA + Cybersecurity * Own project compliance to various QMS procedures and activities including: + Change control + CAPAs and NCRs + internal and external audits + management reviews + training * Apply innovative, scalable and risk\-based approaches to optimize the QMS, including integrating eQMS systems, while meeting compliance for novel technologies. * Maintain knowledge of the evolving regulatory landscape for Digital Health, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning technologies, and incorporate best practices in Tempus’ SDLC processes and QMS. * Work cross functionally with project teams, including Product, Engineering, and Regulatory Affairs * Performs other Quality Assurance related duties and responsibilities as assigned. **Required Qualifications** * BA/B.S. or higher preferred in Biomedical, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or relevant engineering disciplines. * 5\+ years in a software quality role within the FDA regulated medical device/IVD (or EU MDR/IVDR) industry. * Experience and working knowledge of applicable regulations and standards: FDA QMSR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 14971 **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with various QMS approaches and consolidating multiple QMS * Experience with FDA Class I and II AI/ML\-enabled software, including LLM\-based agents * ASQ CSQE or comparable quality/regulatory certification Chicago/National: $110,000\-$155,000 NY/SF: $120,000\-$165,000 The expected salary range above is applicable if the role is performed from California and may vary for other locations (Colorado, Illinois, New York). Ryan and Eric began assembling a world class team, focused on building the first version of a platform capable of ingesting real time healthcare data in an effort to personalize diagnostics. We built the platform for oncology and have expanded it to neuropsychiatry, cardiology, infectious disease (through COVID), and radiology. You will work hands\-on with Databricks, Azure data services, and modern data engineering practices to deliver reliable, scalable, and high\-performing data products. In this role, you'll partner with stakeholders across multiple business functions while helping drive platform modernization, engineering excellence, and technical innovation. **What You'll Brew:*** Design, build, and support scalable Databricks Lakehouse data pipelines using Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Structured Query Language (SQL), and Python. * Lead technical design and delivery for complex data initiatives that span multiple systems, platforms, and business functions. * Diagnose production issues, perform root cause analysis, evaluate technical alternatives, and implement solutions that improve reliability, scalability, and maintainability. * Develop reusable frameworks and engineering practices for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, testing, monitoring, data quality, and production support. * Administer and support Databricks platform capabilities, including workspace configuration, Unity Catalog, permissions management, and data governance. * Design and manage production workflows, including scheduling, dependency management, monitoring, alerting, and failure recovery. * Implement continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes using Azure DevOps, Git\-based development workflows, and Databricks Asset Bundles. * Collaborate with business stakeholders, analytics teams, and technology partners to define requirements and deliver impactful data solutions. * Optimize data pipelines, compute resources, and storage for performance, observability, reliability, and cost efficiency while supporting modernization of legacy SQL Server solutions. * Mentor engineers, conduct code and design reviews, and contribute to continuous improvements in engineering standards and practices. * Work in a standard office environment with occasional travel as needed to support business objectives and team collaboration. **Minimum Qualifications:*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a closely related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, data integration, analytics engineering, or related technology roles. * 3\+ years of hands\-on Databricks development experience supporting production environments. * Strong expertise with Databricks Lakehouse, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks Workflows, Unity Catalog, and distributed data processing. * Experience working with Microsoft Azure data services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure Key Vault. * Advanced SQL and Python skills with experience building, operating, and optimizing complex ETL/ELT pipelines and analytical data models. * Experience with modern DevOps and data engineering practices, including Git\-based development, automated testing, CI/CD, orchestration, monitoring, security, governance, and production support. * Demonstrated ability to lead technical solution design, evaluate technical trade\-offs, and independently deliver complex data initiatives. * Strong communication and collaboration skills with experience providing technical guidance to engineering teams. **Preferred Qualifications:*** Experience with advanced Databricks capabilities, including Databricks Asset Bundles, workspace administration, platform configuration, and governance. * Experience with Power BI semantic modeling, reporting enablement, and analytics consumption patterns. * Experience modernizing legacy SQL Server data solutions to cloud\-based platforms. * Familiarity with artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), feature engineering, or model\-ready data products. * Knowledge of SAP, Salesforce, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, or consumer packaged goods business processes. Level: L6 At the Boston Beer Company and in accordance with pay transparency laws, we are open about our salary ranges. For this role, the salary range is between $120,000 and $187,000\. jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer
jobs.description: **Location:** Tyler, TX (In Office) **Firm:** The Legacy Lawyers, P.C. **Schedule:** Full Time, Monday through Friday **Compensation:** $130,000\.00 **Why The Legacy Lawyers?** At The Legacy Lawyers, technology is part of how we deliver excellent service to clients facing difficult probate, trust, estate, and conservatorship matters. We are looking for a Full Stack Web Developer who can optimize and enhance our existing systems, support our team's technical needs, and drive innovative solutions as the firm continues to grow. This is a hands\-on role with firmwide impact. You will be the person our team turns to when technology gets in the way of their work, and the person who looks ahead to prevent those problems, improve workflows, and make sure our tools are worth the investment. **Who Are We?** The Legacy Lawyers, P.C. is one of California's fastest\-growing litigation firms focused exclusively on probate, trust, estate, and conservatorship disputes.Our work protects families, preserves legacies, and resolves high\-stakes conflicts that often shape generations to come. We value service, integrity, building relationships, accountability, and believe strong systems should make it easier for our associates to provide excellent service to our clients. **Everything We Do Is Guided By Our Core Values:** ● Integrity – Always doing the right thing, especially when no one is watching. ● Relationships – Build relationships, and all else will follow. ● Service – Do what you do so well that people can't help telling others about you. ● Illuminate – Brighten every space you enter. ● Getting Stuff Done – Start now. Keep it fun, fast, and focused. **Compensation \& Benefits:** ● Starting salary: $130,000\.00 ● 3 weeks of paid vacation ● 7 paid holidays ● 5 paid sick days ● Gold\-level medical, dental, and vision insurance ● First\-time homebuyer benefit ● Life insurance ● 3\.5% firm\-matched retirement plan ● Leadership and advancement opportunities within a rapidly growing firm **What You'll Do:** ● Build internal web applications and dashboards that give attorneys and staff a clear view of matters, deadlines, tasks, and firm performance. ● Connect the firm’s existing platforms, including practice management, document management, Google Workspace, billing, intake, and electronic signature, through their APIs and data exports so information moves between systems without manual re\-entry. ● Design and maintain the databases behind these tools, including how matters, parties, roles, and deadlines are structured. ● Build secure logins and access controls so each user sees only the matters and information they are permitted to see. ● Automate repetitive workflows such as intake, document generation, calendaring, and reporting. ● Recommend when an existing product or low\-code tool is a better choice than custom software. ● Deploy, host, monitor, and back up the applications you build, and resolve problems quickly when they arise. ● Use AI tools where they help, and evaluate proposed AI automations for accuracy and confidentiality risk. ● Document what you build so the firm can understand, maintain, and keep using it. ● Train attorneys and staff on new tools and gather their feedback to improve them. ● Assist with everyday technology support, including setting up and removing employee accounts and troubleshooting system issues. **What We're Looking For:** ● 3\+ years building and shipping web applications used by real people, with work you can show us. ● Experience across the full stack: a modern front\-end framework (such as React or Vue), a back\-end language (such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, or Python), and a relational database (such as PostgreSQL or MySQL). ● Experience integrating third\-party platforms through REST APIs. ● Experience deploying and maintaining applications on a cloud platform such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure. ● Solid understanding of authentication, permissions, and protecting confidential data. ● Experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and the judgment to review what they produce. ● Ability to gather requirements from non\-technical users, set priorities, and ship independently without a large team. ● Clear communication and the ability to explain technical decisions to attorneys and staff. ● Experience with Google Apps Script, Google Workspace APIs, or legal practice management software is a plus. ● Law firm or professional services experience is a plus, not required. **Why Join Our Team?** You will have the opportunity to shape how technology works across the firm, rather than simply respond when something breaks. Your work will help attorneys and staff spend less time navigating systems and more time serving clients.If you enjoy helping people, strengthening systems, and taking ownership of technology from idea through implementation, we would like to hear from you. **Apply today and be part of The Legacy Lawyers, P.C.!** ***FIRST ROUND OF CANDIDATE REVIEW BEGINS 11/2/2026*** Pay: $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Vision Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Work Schedule** First Shift (Days)**Environmental Conditions** Office**Job Description** As part of the Network Advanced Manufacturing Engineering team, the Vision Systems Engineer III will help develop and scale next generation vision inspection capabilities across the manufacturing network. This role will serve as a technical leader for offline vision inspection, initially focused on the Matroid platform, translating emerging technology into practical, scalable manufacturing solutions. This is not a traditional sustaining engineering role. The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of manufacturing, automation, software, and data, developing new technical capabilities and establishing approaches that can be deployed across multiple sites. The role requires curiosity, technical versatility, and the ability to move from an undefined problem to a robust solution while building the knowledge and standards that allow others to succeed. **Location:** On\-site in Logan, UT. Relocation assistance is NOT provided. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship. * Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening. **A Day in the Life** * Develop, test, optimize, and maintain Matroid vision detectors and the image datasets used to train and evaluate them. * Connect vision configurations to SKUs, Bills of Material, and manufacturing data to enable product specific inspection. * Design and integrate vision hardware, software, databases, networks, controls, and manufacturing system interfaces. * Troubleshoot detector and system performance, identify root causes, and develop scalable solutions. * Support testing, validation, deployment, startup, and continuous improvement across multiple manufacturing sites. * Establish technical standards and coach site engineering teams to independently support and expand deployed systems. * Coordinate Engineering, Operations, Quality, IT, OT, software resources, vendors, and other functions to close technical gaps and advance the program. **Education** Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Automation, or a related technical discipline. **Experience** 3 to 5 years of relevant technical engineering experience. Strong candidates may come from machine vision, automation, manufacturing systems, controls, systems integration, software development, or similar technical disciplines. Experience in several of the following areas is beneficial, but candidates are not expected to have experience in all of them: * Machine vision or computer vision * Python or software development * PLC programming, Ignition, or industrial controls * SQL, databases, networking, APIs, or system integration * Agile software development workflows * Software testing, validation, configuration management, or software lifecycle management * Integrated manufacturing or multi\-site technology deployments * Prior Matroid experience is beneficial but not required. **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities** This role requires a strong systems thinker who enjoys solving problems that cross traditional engineering boundaries. The successful candidate must be able to learn unfamiliar technologies quickly, recognize where additional capability is needed, and draw from previous experience to develop solutions when an established playbook does not yet exist. The engineer must be comfortable with ambiguity, hands on technical work, and evolving responsibilities. Success will require strong cross functional collaboration, technical ownership, and the ability to influence and coordinate work across sites and disciplines without relying on formal authority. We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus scheme, healthcare, company 401k, and a range of employee benefits! Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward\-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation. Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform critical job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer III
jobs.description: **Location:** Onsite in Duquesne, PA or Mansfield, TX **Employment Status:** Full\-Time **Compensation:** $99,000 – $120,000 Annually \+ Bonus **Travel:** Up to 50% \| Voluntary temporary relocation opportunities may be available based on project needs. **Who We Are** Thermo Systems is a global, full\-service control systems integration partner delivering premier class automation solutions across the **Energy, Life Sciences, and Mission Critical** markets. Guided by ***The Thermo Way***, we are unified, dynamic, and committed to delivering excellence. Our culture is grounded in three core principles: * **Employee Success** – investing in our people and their growth * **Customer Success** – delivering reliable, high\-quality solutions * **Financial Strength** – operating with discipline and long\-term focus We believe strong teams, trusted partnerships, and technical excellence drive sustainable success. **The Opportunity** The Controls Engineer III develops and delivers automation and control\-system solutions and takes responsibility for complete projects or significant portions of broader engineering efforts. Engineers at this level are expected to determine the work necessary to achieve assigned outcomes, coordinate that work with others, and carry it through design, development, integration, testing, and implementation. Controls Engineers III work with substantial independence, solving technical and execution problems while recognizing risks or decisions that require broader involvement. The role provides opportunities to deepen technical capability, exercise project\-level judgment, and provide technical direction or guidance to others. **What You’ll Do** **Core Responsibilities:** * Take responsibility for the engineering execution of complete projects or significant portions of broader engineering efforts, determining the deliverables and individual tasks necessary to achieve the required outcome. * Develop and implement automation and control\-system solutions through design, development, integration, testing, implementation, and issue resolution. * Coordinate technical work and interfaces with other engineers, disciplines, project teams, customers, and partners as required for successful delivery. * Identify and resolve technical and execution problems, evaluate potential solutions, and escalate issues or decisions requiring broader involvement. * Monitor engineering progress, quality, risks, and dependencies and take action to keep assigned work on track. * Complete assigned engineering responsibilities with limited direction while keeping appropriate stakeholders informed of significant decisions, risks, and changes. * This position may require up to 50% overnight travel based on project and business needs. Travel may vary throughout the year from little or no travel during local assignments to extended travel while supporting projects outside the employee's home market. **Collaboration \& Communication:** * Coordinate technical activities and interfaces across engineering, project teams, customers, partners, and other disciplines as required for successful delivery. * Serve as a primary technical point of contact for assigned projects or engineering efforts, communicating status, decisions, technical needs, and risks to appropriate stakeholders. * Identify communication or coordination gaps that could affect delivery and take action to resolve them. * Communicate problems requiring broader involvement with sufficient context, potential solutions, and expected impacts to support timely decisions. * Adapt technical communication to the needs and knowledge of customers, project teams, and technical contributors. **Quality, Safety \& Process:** * Apply company policies, quality requirements, engineering practices, and established processes throughout assigned engineering work. * Follow all safety requirements, identify and communicate unsafe conditions, and stop or escalate work when necessary to protect people, equipment, or operations. * Plan and perform appropriate technical reviews, checks, and testing to ensure engineering deliverables and integrated systems meet applicable requirements. * Identify quality, safety, or process risks affecting assigned work and take appropriate action to resolve them, including engaging others when broader involvement is required. * Identify and recommend practical improvements to engineering practices and processes based on project experience and lessons learned. **Leadership \& Organizational Influence:** * Promote a professional, collaborative, and respectful work environment through consistent actions, communication, and interactions with others. * Provide technical guidance, feedback, and informal mentoring to less experienced team members as opportunities arise. * Share technical knowledge and lessons learned and help others understand engineering practices, project requirements, and effective approaches to completing their work. * Provide technical direction to others when coordinating engineering work for assigned projects or systems. **People Leadership:** * This role does not normally have formal responsibility for managing employees. Employees may provide technical direction, mentoring, and feedback to others. * Employees preparing to transition to the people\-management career track may also be assigned supervisory responsibilities as part of a documented development plan. **What We’re Looking For** **Education \& Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or another pertinent technical discipline. * Typically 4 or more years of relevant experience, with demonstrated capability consistent with the expectations of the role. **Skills \& Qualifications:** * Strong working knowledge of engineering, automation, and control\-system concepts, with the ability to apply that knowledge across complete projects or significant engineering efforts. * Ability to interpret, apply, and reconcile project requirements, drawings, specifications, procedures, standards, and other technical information. * Ability to learn and work effectively with new engineering tools, software, platforms, equipment, and customer technologies as assignments require. * Sound technical judgment, including evaluating problems and risks, developing potential solutions, and recognizing when additional expertise or broader involvement is needed. * Effective written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to organize and prioritize engineering work, manage competing needs, follow through on commitments, and communicate risks that could affect successful delivery. * Commitment to quality, safety, professional conduct, and continuous improvement. **What You’ll Get** * Competitive compensation with annual bonus opportunity * 401(k) with company match * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with low\-cost options * Paid time off and sick leave * Tuition reimbursement and professional credential support * In\-house and external technical training opportunities * Exposure to complex, high\-impact automation projects * A collaborative culture built on integrity, accountability, and teamwork * Learn more at www.thermosystems.com ***Work Environment \& Physical Requirements*** *The physical and environmental demands described here are representative of those required to perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.* ***Equal Employment Opportunity*** *Thermo Systems provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other protected status.* ***Disclaimer*** *This job description outlines the general nature and level of work expected. Responsibilities may evolve based on business needs.*
