jobs.title: (Senior/Junior AI Inference Reliability Engineer, Compute Infra
jobs.description: ### **About this role** We're looking for a software engineer, reliability\-minded but still a builder, to own what happens in production to the Kubernetes\-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. The platform team builds the manifest\-driven API and controllers that let the inference team declare what they need, a cluster, a model deployment, a capacity change, and get it reconciled underneath. Your job is to keep that promise true in the real world: triaging InfiniBand issues when prefill and decode nodes stall exchanging KV cache over RDMA, diagnosing hero\-model and LoRA\-serving faults that don't show up in generic health checks, and extending the automated self\-healing system so each new failure mode becomes a permanent fix instead of a recurring page. The core value we're after is keeping the decoupling real even when things break, and keeping the fleet efficient without that efficiency becoming a new source of instability. You'll own SLOs and error budgets for inference serving, lead incident response, and turn what postmortems teach you into actual changes in the controllers and automation, not just updated runbooks. You'll also work the reliability side of capacity efficiency, since a mistuned defragmentation or bin\-packing pass is itself a production risk. Strong candidates have hands\-on production\-reliability experience on large\-scale distributed or GPU\-serving systems, are comfortable troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA and Kubernetes controller/CRD\-based platforms, and think about GPU infrastructure, and the tools that keep it reliable, as software to be engineered. A product mindset applies: the on\-call experience, the clarity of an alert, and the judgment built into an automated remediation are things you ship and iterate on. ### **Responsibilities** * Operate the provisioning state machine in production: own the health of the host lifecycle pipeline, discovery, inference bring\-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA, triaging stuck or failed state transitions at fleet scale and feeding real failure patterns back into how the states and transitions are designed. * Triage and extend automated self\-healing: when the node\-scanning and remediation platform misses something, a new failure mode, an InfiniBand issue in disaggregated prefill/decode serving, a GPU Xid variant, a hero\-model or LoRA\-specific fault, diagnose it live, drive the fix to production, and turn it into a new detection/remediation plugin so it's automatic the next time. * Own end\-to\-end reliability of the pipeline: hold the SLOs and error budgets for provisioning and fleet health, lead incident response when idempotency, retry, rollback, or drift assumptions break down in practice, and drive the systemic fix, not just the hotfix. * Partner with the inference/ML platform team from the production side: be the one who knows how real cluster topologies, interconnects, and scheduling constraints actually fail in the field, and feed those failure modes back as first\-class requirements into the platform's abstractions. * Work alongside machine learning researchers, engineers, and product managers to bring our latest technologies into production, enabling advanced research through awesome engineering. * Introduce new techniques, tools, and architecture that improve the performance, latency, throughput, and efficiency of our model inference stack. * Build tools to give us visibility into our bottlenecks and sources of instability, then design and implement solutions to address the highest\-priority issues. * Lead reliability cross\-functionally: build coalition across infra, ML platform, and product teams around shared reliability priorities, manage stakeholders through incidents and roadmap trade\-offs, and represent the reliability point of view in planning so it shapes decisions before they ship, not after an outage. ### **Requirements** * Experience operating a provisioning or host\-lifecycle pipeline in production, comfortable troubleshooting stuck or failed state transitions (discovery, bring\-up, GPU driver/CUDA validation, health checks, decommission/RMA) at fleet scale, and translating real failure patterns back into improvements to the state machine’s design. * Deep experience owning production reliability for large\-scale distributed systems; GPU/ML\-serving infrastructure experience is a strong plus. * Hands\-on experience troubleshooting InfiniBand/RDMA networking issues, ideally in a multi\-node training or disaggregated\-inference context — comfortable reading IB port counters and subnet manager logs, not just application metrics. * Familiarity with the operational realities of multi\-tenant model serving (LoRA/adapter\-based serving) and with running differentiated SLOs across model pools of different priority. * A demonstrated track record of eliminating operational toil through automation and tooling you built yourself, not just process or documentation. * Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, reconciliation loops, and node\-level health/remediation systems. * Comfort with event\-driven architectures, backpressure/circuit\-breaking design, and treating observability (metrics, logs, traces) as something built into a system, not added after an incident. * A software\-engineering mindset first: you write and ship production code, and you think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered, not a fleet to be manually operated. ### **About Together AI** Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose\-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high\-performance inference that scales reliably, fine\-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier\-level specialized models, and pre\-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400\+ trillion tokens a month. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance and other competitive benefits. The US base salary range for this full\-time position is: $160,000 \- $280,000 \+ equity \+ benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Equal Opportunity** Together AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. Please see our privacy policy at https://www.together.ai/privacy.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Platform Integration
jobs.description: **Job Description:** ==================== **Shape the Future of AI in Capital Markets and Legal Disclosure** At Toppan Merrill, we’re building Quinn, a cloud\-based platform that helps law firms, investment banks, and public companies draft, review, and file SEC documents, including IPO registration statements, prospectuses, proxy statements, and annual and quarterly reports. We’re applying AI to one of the most consequential document workflows in the world, where precision, trust, and accountability matter most. You’ll join a small, highly visible team, work directly with senior engineering leadership, and engage with some of the world’s largest law firms. In this role, you’ll be the founding engineer for how outside AI tools such as Harvey and ChatGPT Enterprise securely connect to Quinn. That means production\-ready OAuth 2\.1 with token exchange, deny\-by\-default authorization, and a complete audit trail, built on the emerging Model Context Protocol standard and held to the security bar of the most demanding enterprise clients there are. The first thing Quinn will pilot with clients is this integration. A working prototype already exists; turning it into a service a law firm’s security team will approve is the core of this role. You’ll build it and own it after launch. **What you will do** * Productionize the integration service (an MCP server) that outside AI tools connect to, over the Streamable HTTP transport * Implement sign\-in with OAuth 2\.1 using our identity provider (Okta), including token exchange so the service calls Quinn on behalf of the attorney and never passes an outside tool’s token through * Enforce what each outside tool may do: which actions its permissions allow, and which documents are on each client firm’s approved list, denying everything else by default * Keep an immutable, exportable audit trail of every action an outside tool takes, including reads, that client firms can review * Design controls for AI\-specific risks, including tool misuse driven by content in documents and abnormal bulk access to documents * Test with at least two external AI tools, and support client firms’ security reviews * Build an internal command\-line tool for our operations teams on the same service **How you’ll work** You’ll own the integration service end to end and partner closely with our Identity and Security teams on the authorization design and client security reviews. You’ll also work with a backend engineer building the matching controls inside the Quinn platform, and with the IT and innovation teams at our design partner law firms. **First 90 days** * Stand up the service with production sign\-in in a test environment * Implement the approved\-document list and the audit log * Connect a first external AI tool end to end **Required** * 6\+ years of backend or platform engineering * Deep, hands\-on OAuth 2\.0 or 2\.1 and OIDC experience: authorization servers, scopes, audience, PKCE, token exchange * Experience building services that external customers or partners integrate with, including security reviews * Security\-first engineering habits: deny by default, least privilege, audit logging * Strong in TypeScript (Node.js) or Python, and comfortable working in the other; our services use both * Experience integrating with customers’ identity providers (OIDC or SAML federation, multi\-tenant SSO) **Preferred** * Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or AI tool and agent integrations * Okta administration or custom authorization servers * Experience integrating with enterprise legal software (document management systems, Harvey, or similar) **Success at 12 months** * Pilot running with design partner firms, having passed Toppan Merrill’s security review and each firm’s own * Service passed an external penetration test with no open critical or high findings * At least two different AI platforms connected Learn more at https://www.toppanmerrill.com/careers/. About Toppan Merrill *We understand that your skills deserve recognition. That’s why we offer a competitive pay scale ranging from* $135K–$175K ***annually,*** *based on experience and expertise. We believe in compensating our dedicated team members fairly for their hard work and commitment. Please note that actual salaries may vary within, above, or below this range based on factors such as education, training, experience, professional achievement, business needs, and location.* *Toppan Merrill strives to provide our employees and loved ones with competitive benefits including:* * *Enhanced Medical, Dental, Vision and, Life insurance for employees and dependents* * *Employer Contribution to* 401(k) * *Paid time off including vacation, sick, community involvement, bereavement, jury duty, and holidays* * *Paid parental leave* * *Paid community* *involvement/volunteer* *days* * *Wellness Resources and Employee Assistance Programming* Toppan Merrill is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified individuals, including qualified women, minorities, individuals with disabilities and veterans, are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Intermediate Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Family** IT \- Development**About Us** At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests. Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there. **Who We Are** We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life. Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them. We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms. **What We Do** Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1\) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2\) Protection Solutions and Savings \& Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3\) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs. Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23\.9 million customers worldwide.\* For more information, visit transamerica.com. **Job Description Summary** The Intermediate Software Engineer designs, develops, implements, and supports enterprise application solutions that meet business and customer needs. This role works closely with other developers, QA, and leads to delivering scalable, secure, and high\-quality software solutions.**Job Description** **Responsibilities** * Work collaboratively with other development staff, including contract and offshore software engineers, and business product owners in an agile environment. * Refine stories, write code and test cases, test code, work closely with QA, deploy code to various environments, and document solutions. * Evaluate solution options considering business requirements, scalability, security, performance, and cost. * Partner with internal and external resources, including vendors and offshore teams, to deliver project objectives. * Utilize third\-party software development frameworks, open\-source libraries, and APIs to rapidly develop application solutions. * Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement. * Support production applications, troubleshoot issues, and participate in problem resolution efforts. * Present technical concepts and project updates to technical and non\-technical audiences. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or information systems. * One year of experience in software development using Java, Python, and AWS. * One year of cloud\-based application development, deployment, and support. * One year of with application integration, microservices, and REST\-based service development. * Proficiency in database design techniques and philosophies. * Knowledge in Agile development, its tools and, and best practices. * Knowledge of distributed computing and scalable application architecture concepts. * Knowledge of software development and research tools. * Attention to detail and results\-oriented with a strong customer focus. * Ability to work as part of a team and independently. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and technical communication skills. * Ability to prioritize workload to meet tight deadlines. **Technical Environment** * Primary Development Platform: Java, Spring Framework (Boot), Python, JPA, SQL and NoSQL * Cloud Environment: AWS – ECS, Lambda, IAM, S3, ALB, TG, Terraform, Route 53, SQS, SNS, RDS, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, Storage Gateway, EventBridge and ElastiCache * Database Technologies: RDS, Oracle and DynamoDB * Frontend Technologies: Angular * Integration \& API Technologies: REST APIs, Micro Services, SNS, SQS,  omes for clients, while keeping their information safe and secure. With more than 1,000 employees across the UK, US, Netherlands, Hungary, Spain, and Hong Kong, Enterprise Technology is a diverse, global team. Our experts work across areas such as application development, information security, infrastructure, data \& analytics, risk \& controls, program management, and architecture. We offer a wide range of career opportunities and are committed to supporting employee development. Curiosity is the quality we value most. Much of our work involves solving complex problems, applying knowledge in new ways, and continuously improving how we operate. As technology evolves rapidly, we look for inquisitive people who are confident challenging the status quo and helping us drive change. **What We Offer** For eligible employees, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support both the personal and financial well\-being of our employees. Compensation Benefits * Competitive Pay * Bonus for Eligible Employees Benefits Package * Pension Plan * 401k Match * Employee Stock Purchase Plan * Tuition Reimbursement * Disability Insurance * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Employee Discounts * Career Training \& Development Opportunities Health and Work/Life Balance Benefits * Paid Time Off starting at 160 hours annually for employees in their first year of service. * Ten (10\) paid holidays per year (typically mirroring the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) holidays). * Be Well Company holistic wellness program, which includes Wellness Coaching and Reward Dollars * Parental Leave – fifteen (15\) days of paid parental leave per calendar year to eligible employees with at least one year of service at the time of birth, placement of an adopted child, or placement of a foster care child. * Adoption Assistance * Employee Assistance Program * Back\-Up Care Program * PTO for Volunteer Hours * Employee Matching Gifts Program * Employee Resource Groups * Inclusion and Diversity Programs * Employee Recognition Program * Referral Bonus Programs **Inclusion \& Diversity** We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women. To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company\-sponsored, employee\-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all. **Giving Back** We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994\. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work. **Transamerica’s Parent Company** Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999\. Since its start in 1844, Aegon has grown into an international company serving more than 23\.9 million people across the globe.\* It offers investment, protection, and retirement solutions, always with a clear purpose: **Helping people live their best lives.** As a leading global investor and employer, the company seeks to have a positive impact by addressing critical environmental and societal issues, with a focus on climate change and inclusion and diversity. * As of December 31, 2023

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer

Our dedicated associates help the company achieve its mission to put the world on vacation. Innovation and growth keep our work interesting and fun. Every day is a chance to learn something new and turn vacation inspiration into exceptional experiences for millions of travelers worldwide. The **Senior Software Engineer** is responsible for the analysis, design, development, testing and implementation of API proxies and integration services on the **Google Apigee** platform within the enterprise portfolio. The Engineer will provide the technical expertise on the design and construction of new and existing modules as well as the use ofappropriate development tools and data flows across the API and Middleware Integrations stack. Will provide direction to lower\-level developers and interact with technical leads, business analysts, solution architects and other development teams. Provide SME knowledge, technical planning expertise in the areas of application design, software development, performance, testing, implementation, and infrastructure. The senior developer is also responsible for the quality of the application code and adheres to the relevant coding standards and established patterns. The Software Engineer III reports to the Manager of Applications Delivery \& Services to deliver robust applications based on best practice software engineering that is well aligned with the SDLC process. **How You'll Shine:** * Performs complex analysis, design, development and implementation of IT strategic applications and data services. Help with solution design efforts and impact analysis for varying sizes of critical applications and ensures standard operating procedures are being followed * Analyzes highly complex business and systems requirements, and designs solutions for applications, data, processes, interfaces, controls, outputs, environment, and infrastructure tools/utilities. * Ensures that disruption to applications is minimized through analysis, planning and testing of proposed software fixes and updates and adherence to strict change management processes. Conduct deep dive analysis of application issues across the full stack (UI, middleware, microservices, data) and recommend solutions. * Assist application services teams with technical support when required between Applications and other IT technical engineering groups, including operational, maintenance and modification of interfaces and reports, as well as general technical modifications. * Anticipates and identifies potential problems before they occur and implements solutions and schedules and prioritizes work, minimizing impact on projects and users. * Instruments and monitors API performance and availability using APM tooling (AppDynamics, Dynatrace or similar) alongside Apigee analytics, establishing dashboards, alert thresholds and SLO measurement, and using that telemetry to drive proactive tuning and faster incident resolution **Travel Requirements:** * Less than 10%. including 3\+ years hands\-on designing, building and operating API proxies on Google Apigee (Edge, X or hybrid)etc. * Working knowledge of Apigee API productization and consumer management, including multi\-proxy estate. * Awareness of Apigee platform constraints and how to design around them. * Leads development activities with agile methodologies (Scrum, XP, Kanban) * Expert in formal software development methodologies * Expert experience with highly integrated application systems/platforms, data flows, and business processes * Proven ability to think analytically, logical reasoning and problem\-solving skills * Proven ability to work on a Team and good interpersonal skills * Self\-starter and completes assignments with moderate supervision * Proven delivery results with Services (micro\-services, SOA, API) * Deep understanding of API design patterns, SOA principles and its implementation methodologies (Oracle Fusion Middleware experience, a plus) * Data modeling/design experience * N\-Tier Application design, UX/UI experience * Experience with XML and enterprise integration technologies including Web Services (SOAP/WSDL) * Experience in one or more of the following technologies SOAP, XML, RESTful, JSON, Swagger, OpenAPI, etc. * Experience with CI/CD software such as GitHub, BitBucket, Jenkins, TFS, Maven, etc. * Experience with code quality software such as SonarQube * Experience with AWS or Google Cloud integration * Experience with APM and observability platforms such as AppDynamics or Dynatrace, including instrumenting and monitoring API traffic, building dashboards and alerts. * Ability to correlate Apigee analytics and trace data with APM telemetry to establish end\-to\-end transaction visibility across the API and its downstream services * Experience in developing applications for Hospitality Industry preferred. * Experience in business process improvement and systems convergence initiatives. * Experience working with offshore development teams. **How You'll Be Rewarded:** We offer a diverse range of comprehensive health and welfare benefits to associates who work 30 or more hours per week to meet your needs and support you throughout your career with us. Travel \+ Leisure Co. benefits include: ***Note: Temporary and/or seasonal associates are ineligible for Paid Time Off.*** * Medical * Dental * Vision * Flexible spending accounts * Life and accident coverage * Disability * Depending on position, paid time off, parental leave and holidays (speak to your recruiter for additional information) * Wish day paid time to volunteer at an approved organization of your choice * 401k with employer match (subject to eligibility requirements, including tenure \- speak to your recruiter for additional information) * Legal and identify theft plan * Voluntary income protection benefits * Wellness program (subject to provider availability) * Employee Assistance Program **Where Memories Start with You** Hospitality is at the heart of all we do at Travel \+ Leisure Co. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: ### **About Treeswift:** In the face of rising threats, increasing pressure on affordability, and unprecedented demand for power, Treeswift empowers energy companies to modernize their field work to meet the growth and challenges ahead. We build physical AI for the field worker: whether on foot or in a vehicle, our technology is an ironman suit for engineers, linemen, and vegetation crews: same worker, same boots on the ground, now operating at 10x productivity. Our platform is powered by cutting edge hardware, sensors (LiDAR, camera, etc…), AI and software designed to revolutionize work in the toughest environments. Our technology has enabled our customers to reduce wildfire risk, regulatory and outage risk from vegetation, avoid delays and cost overruns in new construction, and accelerate recovery from severe storms. To tackle this challenge, we are bringing together a team of mission\-driven experts with deep industry experience in robotics (Penn, Caltech, CMU) and enterprise software development (Palantir, Stripe, Oracle, MongoDB). We have raised funding from leading investors including Penny Pritzker’s Inspired Capital. We are headquartered in midtown Manhattan, with additional offices in San Francisco and Philadelphia. Our growth is only accelerating. We’re looking for deeply curious and highly ambitious people who want to have a real world impact. Come build the future of (field) work with us. **About the role** ML sits at the heart of Treeswift’s product translating complex sensor data into meaningful insights that drive critical decision\-making for our customers. As our business grows the importance of this work only grows with it. You will join at a critical inflection point and will lead the charge on the following priorities (amongst others): * **Technical Leadership.** You will be responsible for continuing to improve the quality and consistency of our models across a growing breadth of operating conditions. As the breadth of models and datasets grows you will thoughtfully introduce feedback loops and ML Ops that accelerate model improvement. You have excellent judgement on what problems require fast experimentation/validation, and where we should be focused on sustainable scalable improvement over a longer period of time. * **Edge model development.** Working closely with our robotics and embedded teams, you will support growing exploration of model deployment on devices for real\-time use cases. * **Lead and grow our team (as needed)**. We have an incredibly talented ML team distributed across our NYC, Philly and SF offices. You will lead the current team, identify gaps and grow the team as needed. * **Collaborate closely** with our Software, Robotics, Hardware and Product teams to deliver on Treeswift’s vision and business objectives. You will report to our Head of Software Engineering. This is a full\-time, hybrid role based out of our Lower Manhattan, NYC office (2\-3 days per week in person, currently pinned to Tuesdays and Wednesdays). ### **About Machine Learning At Treeswift** Machine Learning at Treeswift is the layer that translates sensor data into meaning for our end\-users. At a high\-level we develop three categories of model that power downstream business decisions. * **Classifying** a point cloud \- distinguishing ground from vegetation from structures etc. * **Identifying** individual objects within 3D space — poles, equipment, wires, trees, etc. * **Describing** characteristics of individual objects. This includes everything from tree species and health, detailed wire types, pole information (height, attachments, etc.) etc. Together this information informs critical decision\-making for our customers such as: * What vegetation is a risk to utility infrastructure and how severe is that risk? What action is recommended as a result (trim, removal, etc…)? * Is ongoing asset construction deviating from the expected design and if so how? If so, is this an approved deviation or a quality issue that needs to be addressed before a downstream customer or financial impact? ### **Required skills and experience** * Early\-stage or fast\-moving environments where scope and ownership evolve quickly. * Strong familiarity with models built on images, video, lidar, pointclouds, speech, or geospatial data sources. * Building and using cloud\-based training and inference pipelines (including orchestration, deployment, and the operational realities of running models at scale). * Willingness to drive architecture and approach across both, bring innovative ideas and rapid execution to new and existing models, and be accountable for the quality and consistency of our models across a growing breadth of operating conditions. * Leading development of our training and inference pipelines. You will lead how we build and evolve these pipelines as well as move us towards on\-device inference for time\-sensitive use cases. * 3\+ years experience in leadership: setting clear direction for a team, driving architecture and design decisions, reviewing others' work, and mentoring individual engineers. * Experience creating, curating, and cleaning training datasets, and building the evaluation and feedback loops that drive model improvement. * Strong programming skills and expertise in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, scikit\-learn, and TensorFlow. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills. You have the ability to keep a team distributed across three offices (NY, Philly, SF) well\-aligned. You will be a strong partner to the product team on how to balance technical trade\-offs and product objectives. ### **Nice\-to\-haves** * Experience developing models for and deploying models to run on edge\-devices. * Experience with deep learning training frameworks such as MLflow, Lightning, Weights and Biases, or similar. * Experience with semantic mapping, image processing techniques and/or computer vision fundamentals. * Experience with Apache Airflow (especially 3\.x) and/or Astronomer. * Experience with one or more of: Sensor Fusion, SLAM, Visual Odometry. * 8\+ years of professional experience **Benefits** * Competitive salary and equity package * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your eligible dependents * Life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to support all new parents * Flexible, unlimited paid time off * 401(k) retirement savings plan * Free OneMedical membership * Commuter benefits * Snacks, goodies, and team lunches provided twice a week to keep you fueled and connected with your colleagues. The estimated salary range for this position is $225,000 \- $265,000 USD. Total compensation for this position is determined by skills, qualifications, relevant work experience, location, and other factors. This salary estimate excludes the value of any potential bonuses; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long\-term incentives. This information is provided per the New York City Human Rights Law. Please note that the range provided is applicable only to New York City\-based applicants. Base compensation may vary if the work location is outside of New York City. Treeswift is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, whether it be alternate forms of material, accessible meeting rooms, etc., please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer III
jobs.description: Description: *Design the industrial tools and machinery our customers rely on for pipe and tube machining and welding.* **THE JOB** With limited supervision, the Mechanical Engineer III is responsible for mechanical design and drafting of industrial tools and machinery for pipe and tube machining and welding applications. The successful candidate will be self\-motivated with a drive for learning and professional growth. This is a full\-time position within the engineering department and is based at Tri Tool's headquarters in Rancho Cordova, California. **WHAT YOU’LL OWN** * **Collaboration.** Collaborate and strategize with colleagues in engineering, production/manufacturing, product management, service, and repair departments to solve problems and develop innovative world\-class products. * Support products through their full lifecycle, from quoting and design to manuals and customer support. * **Drawings and documentation.** Complete manufacturing and assembly mechanical drawings, tolerance analysis/stack\-ups, and other documentation per ASME Y14\.5M standards using SolidWorks CAD software. * **Design and drafting.** Design and drafting of mechanical tools, fixtures, and machine components and subassemblies. * **Project scope.** Assigned projects involve the following key areas: bill of materials structure, materials selection, strength of materials, static thermodynamic conditions and environments, metal plating and coatings, assembly and joining hardware, various manufacturing processes, and specification of required tolerances with manufacturing cost in mind. * **Electromechanical systems.** Electromechanical system design and specification (AC and DC motors, servo motors, solenoids, actuators). * **Pneumatic and hydraulic systems.** Pneumatic and hydraulic system design and specification with cylinders, actuators, valves, regulators, hoses, and fittings. * **ERP records.** Maintain accurate component information, revisions, and manufacturing bills of materials within Tri Tool’s ERP system (NetSuite). * **Project management.** Manage medium and large sized projects with little direction and execute engineering tasks and projects to completion with a high level of independence. * **Proposals.** Assist and/or lead proposal and business development deliverables, including equipment and risk analysis. * **Prototyping.** Hands\-on problem solving and assembly and testing of prototypes within an R\&D shop environment. * Other duties as assigned. Requirements: * Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical or Industrial Engineering from an ABET\-accredited college or university. * Strong command of machine design fundamentals, including bearing types and selection, press fits and tolerances, gear selection, and torque calculations. * Minimum seven (7\) years of applicable professional experience in mechanical design, drafting, fabrication, assembly, and testing of mechanical tools or systems. Master’s level engineering degree completion and five (5\) or more years of applicable professional experience may be considered. * Ability to present specific examples of machine designs you have executed. * Experience integrating pneumatic, hydraulic, and electromechanical components (motors, actuators, valves) into tooling. * Prior experience using SolidWorks or other 3D CAD and drafting tools is required. * Knowledgeable of GD\&T tolerancing methods and their appropriate application. * High level of attention to detail and completeness of work. * A tenacious attitude and drive to deliver results within schedule. **NICE TO HAVE** * Master’s Degree preferred. * Hands\-on shop experience, such as running mills or lathes, or sustained mechanical build work.” * Machine and tool design for portable and/or in situ industrial tool industries * CNC machine and mechanism design * Design of custom industrial equipment and tools * Design of consumable metal cutting tools, such as endmills, indexable inserts and holders, turning tools, etc. * Part design for Additive Manufacturing * Manufacturing process development for Additive Manufacturing **WHY TRI TOOL** It’s a new era of industry. Technology is evolving. Demand for customization is increasing. Lead times are decreasing. Tolerances are tightening. To stay ahead of competition, industry leaders must innovate faster, drive efficiencies, and streamline operations. At Tri Tool, we cut through complexity and provide industry leading custom solutions, off\-the\-shelf pipe beveling and flange facing tools, and expert field services for piping and tubing. For more than 50 years, we have partnered with companies in major industrial markets—aerospace, government and defense, life sciences, power generation, oil and gas, and semiconductor—to design, develop, and manufacture precision machining and custom engineered tools that increase productivity, optimize costs, and accelerate delivery. Combining proven expertise with unrivalled experience and extraordinary ingenuity, we go above and beyond expectations to deliver solutions that propel our customers forward... THAT’S OUR THING At Tri Tool Technologies, we insist on the highest standards of performance, precision, and durability — and we look for team members who share that same commitment. You’ll have extensive access to our in\-house machine shop to build, test, and refine your designs This is an excellent opportunity for a detail\-oriented professional who takes pride in ensuring smooth production processes and upholding the highest quality standards in a dynamic and fast\-paced manufacturing environment. If you are ready to bring your expertise to a team that has been trusted by industry leaders for over five decades, we invite you to apply today. We look forward to welcoming you to the Tri Tool family. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Must be able to lift/move up to 50 pounds without assistance; Lifting/Moving anything over 50 pounds must be assisted. Must be able to wear safety equipment as required for personal protection. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and/or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit; stand; stoop; squat; walk; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Must be able to safely use hand tools, power tools, and engineering products. Must be able to use office equipment such as computers, multi\-line phones, scanners, copiers, and paper cutters. **DISCLAIMER** The above information on this description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees to this job. Employees are expected to follow their supervisor’s instructions and to perform the tasks requested by their supervisors. *Tri Tool Technologies is an equal opportunity employer.*

jobs.title: AI Engineer I, II, III or Senior

The Senior AI Engineer sets the technical direction and engineering standards for AI solutions across cloud and secure on\-premises environments, and mentors engineers across teams to build depth and capability. Success in this role requires deep expertise in AI and data science, strong business acumen, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to build trust and alignment with stakeholders at every level of the organization. **Note** : There is one position available, and this position will be filled at one of four job grade levels: AI Engineer I; job grade 8; AI Engineer II, job grade 9; AI Engineer III; job grade 10 or Senior AI Engineer, job grade 11\. This decision will be based on the qualifications and experience of the selected candidate and Tri\-State business needs at the time of hire. **Tri\-State recognizes the value of a highly engaged and committed workforce and provides an excellent benefits program that includes** : Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Flexible Work Schedules including compressed work week and telecommuting opportunities to work remotely up to 40%, Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Tuition Reimbursement, Life Insurance, Retirement Option, Long Term Disability (LTD), Short Term Disability (STD), Employee Assistant Program (EAP) and Paid Leave Benefits. **Senior AI Engineer** Hiring Salary Range: $125,000\-$161,000 **AI Engineer III** Hiring Salary Range: $113,000\-$143,000 **AI Engineer II** Hiring Salary Range: $101,000\-$128,000 **AI Engineer I** Hiring Salary Range: $91,000\-$114,000 Actual compensation offer to candidate may vary outside of the posted hiring salary range based upon work experience, education and/or skill level. * Build and maintain strong relationships with business leaders and stakeholders across Tri\-State, acting as the primary technical partner for AI initiatives. * Lead discovery with business units to identify problems and opportunities where AI, machine learning, and data science can create measurable value. * Frame business problems into well\-defined AI solutions with clear success criteria, expected value, feasibility, and risk. * Build business cases and prioritization recommendations for AI opportunities, including value, effort, data readiness, and risk. * Set stakeholder expectations, communicate progress and results, and make sure delivered solutions are adopted and achieve their intended outcomes. * Lead end\-to\-end delivery of AI solutions across multiple teams and projects, from discovery and design through build, deployment, adoption, and ongoing operation. * Lead the design of advanced AI and analytical solutions for high\-value utility use cases, such as load and renewable forecasting, asset health and predictive maintenance, wildfire and outage risk, and grid operations support. * Coordinate engineering work across teams and with data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and business partners to deliver solutions on time and as designed. * Measure and report We’re people\-first, team\-oriented, and looking for someone excited to contribute to meaningful, high\-impact work. **What****You’ll****Do*** Develop and support new and existing web applications and site features * Work across the SDLC: planning, estimation, development, testing, deployment * Collaborate with the development team, product, UX \& QA to clarify requirements and deliver solutions * Take ownership of assigned work from start to finish * Be a mentor or provide guidance to teammates when appropriate **What****We’re****Looking For** We value strong fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to grow. We prioritize work\-life balance, clear communication, and helping each other succeed. **Why****You’ll****Love Working Here** We offer: * Hybrid schedule: * Local (within 50 miles of our HQ in Paoli, PA): typically 2 days onsite per month (yes, month!) * Remote: 2 weeks onsite per year * Competitive compensation in\-line with experience \& impact, plus a quarterly bonus program * Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision plus immediate vesting on your 401k match * A people\-first culture where curiosity, ownership, and collaboration are valued * Opportunities to grow your technical skillset and contribute to impactful, high\-visibility products **About Turn5** Turn5 is one of the largest and fastest growing eCommerce retailers in the Greater Philadelphia area. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer 2
jobs.description: **See yourself at Twilio** Join the team as Twilio’s next Machine Learning Engineer, Customer Memory. **About the job** This position is needed to build and scale the pipelines that turn raw conversation data into structured, searchable customer memory, and the evaluation systems that keep that memory accurate as the product evolves. You'll join the Conversation Memory team, which builds the memory layer behind Twilio's Conversational AI platform: the systems that extract what matters from millions of conversations, resolve it to the right customer, and retrieve it in milliseconds when an agent needs it. Memory that is wrong, stale, or crossed between customers is worse than no memory at all, so quality measurement is a first\-class part of the work. **Responsibilities** In this role, you’ll: * Build the extraction pipeline that turns raw data into structured memory, tuning the LLM prompts and schemas that decide what an AI agent remembers about a customer and what it forgets. * Own the retrieval path that answers "what do we know about this person?" in milliseconds, working with embeddings, vector search, and ranking * Contribute to the eval systems that tell us whether memory is actually getting better, turning a fuzzy question of quality into benchmarks and regression gates that run before every change ships. * Diagnose production issues across the ingestion, extraction, and indexing path using logs, metrics, and traces. * Partner with Product and ML teams to translate customer problems into system changes and evaluation criteria. **Qualifications** Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! **Required:** * Experience building backend services, and a demonstrated ability to pick up new languages, frameworks, and tools as the problem demands. * A curious approach to service management: ability to investigate how systems actually behave in production, and desire to continuously learn how to operate them with rigor and accountability. * Experience building or working with evaluation/quality\-measurement systems, such as regression detection or quality metrics, or the desire to learn. * Solid grounding in observability practices: structured logging, metrics, and using them to debug distributed systems in production. * Fluency with AI\-assisted dev tools (e.g. agents for code generation, review, debugging), applied with deliberate direction and critical thinking. **Desired:** * Experience with Go and/or Python. * Experience with event\-streaming systems (e.g. Kafka). * Experience building LLM\-backed products. * Practical experience applying ML, e.g. building, evaluating, or productionizing models. **Location** * This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in San Francisco, CA, Oakland, CA, San Jose, CA, or the surrounding areas. **Travel** We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in\-person meetings. **What We Offer** Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. **Compensation** * *Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements. Compensation for candidates in other locations will be discussed during the hiring process. Please note that hiring for this role is not restricted to the locations listed above.* The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: * Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $128,560 \- $160,700 * Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $136,000 \- $170,000\. * This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. **Application deadline information** Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 13, but may change based on business needs.

jobs.description: **Senior Staff Security Engineer — Supply Chain, Offensive \& AI Security** **About this role and team** As a Senior Staff Security Engineer, you will define and build security platforms, developer tooling, and AI\-powered automation that protect Uber’s software ecosystem at scale. Securing the software supply chain will be a core focus, alongside continuous offensive testing and security assessments of AI applications and autonomous agents. This is a deeply technical, hands\-on role. You will write production\-quality code to protect source code, dependencies, build infrastructure, artifacts, and deployment pipelines. You will also build systems that automate penetration testing, vulnerability discovery and validation, adversarial AI testing, and remediation. Your work will advance both the use of AI to improve security and the security of AI itself, including first\-party and third\-party agents, LLM integrations, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and autonomous workflows. Working across Security, Developer Infrastructure, and Engineering, you will establish technical strategy and lead complex initiatives from concept through deployment and long\-term operation. You will embed controls into developer workflows, turn manual assessments into continuous capabilities, and eliminate systemic weaknesses through secure defaults and platform improvements. Successful candidates combine expert software engineering with deep expertise in securing software delivery and offensive security. They build scalable systems that reduce real\-world risk while improving developer productivity. **What you’ll do** * **Build software supply chain protections.** Implement source code integrity, commit signing, code, artifact, and container signing, provenance verification, dependency integrity, and cryptographic verification. Establish standards and automated enforcement for secure builds, artifact repositories, container registries, and deployment pipelines that prevent untrusted code, unsigned artifacts, vulnerable dependencies, and noncompliant software from advancing. * **Engineer dependency security and remediation systems.** Build capabilities to inventory and assess open\-source components, manage SBOMs, detect vulnerable or malicious packages and transitive dependency risks, and mitigate supply chain compromise. Automate dependency upgrades, secure patches, code fixes, and verification of remediation effectiveness. * **Deliver scalable application security platforms.** Integrate SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection, and AI\-powered analysis into code generation, development, pull requests, and CI/CD. Analyze source code, build configurations, infrastructure definitions, containers, and artifacts at scale, and provide actionable feedback with minimal developer friction. * **Turn threat models into engineering controls.** Model threats across applications, APIs, identity systems, build infrastructure, cloud environments, and AI workflows. Identify trust boundaries, abuse cases, and attack paths, then implement secure defaults, reusable libraries, architectural improvements, and regression tests that eliminate recurring vulnerability classes. * **Build continuous offensive security capabilities.** Develop automated penetration testing, DAST, attack orchestration, and exploit validation systems for applications, APIs, mobile services, infrastructure, and externally accessible endpoints. Identify authorization weaknesses, business logic flaws, privilege escalation, and chained attacks, using isolated execution environments, attack sandboxes, and controls appropriate for production testing. * **Build AI\-powered security tools and test AI systems.** Apply frontier models, security\-specific models, and autonomous agents to discovery, attack planning, validation, secure coding, and remediation. Assess first\-party and third\-party agents, LLM integrations, MCP servers, and agent tools for prompt injection, tool poisoning, unauthorized execution, data exposure, and trust boundary violations. * **Make findings accurate and actionable.** Correlate and deduplicate findings, combine deterministic analysis with AI reasoning, dynamic testing, exploit verification, and human review, and prioritize validated risk. Continuously reassess applications and agents as code, configurations, models, tools, and integrations change. * **Own production engineering and technical direction.** Write maintainable, tested code; define architectures, APIs, interfaces, safety controls, and engineering standards; and operate reliable distributed services. Evaluate emerging technologies, prototype quickly, and lead initiatives across teams with clear milestones and measurable outcomes. * **Raise engineering quality and adoption.** Mentor senior engineers, lead design and code reviews, and partner with infrastructure and product teams to embed security into existing workflows. Communicate investment priorities and measure improvements in coverage, accuracy, ency updates, patch generation, and verification. * **Threat modeling and secure architecture:** Experience leading threat modeling for software delivery systems, applications, APIs, and AI agents, and implementing the resulting mitigations. Deep knowledge of service\-to\-service authentication, identity, messaging, data stores, containers, Kubernetes, and multi\-cloud architectures. * **Offensive automation:** Experience building penetration testing frameworks, exploitation engines, attack orchestration, scalable DAST, and systems that generate, execute, and validate exploits in authorized environments. Expertise in web, API, mobile, cloud, and distributed systems testing, attack\-path analysis, privilege escalation, and lateral movement; familiarity with Burp Suite, Nuclei, OWASP ZAP, Metasploit, Invicti, or comparable tools. * **AI\-powered security engineering:** Experience building with LLMs, frontier or cybersecurity\-focused models, autonomous agents, or multi\-agent architectures for source analysis, reconnaissance, attack planning, vulnerability discovery, exploitability assessment, secure code generation, and remediation. Experience combining deterministic analysis, multi\-model reasoning, runtime verification, and human review. * **AI security testing:** Experience assessing agents, LLM applications, MCP servers, tools, and third\-party integrations for direct and indirect prompt injection, tool poisoning, insecure invocation, privilege escalation, data exfiltration, and cross\-agent trust violations. Experience building red teaming frameworks with live endpoint testing, multi\-turn adversarial interactions, dynamic validation, and isolated execution infrastructure. * **Developer experience and measurable outcomes:** Experience integrating continuous testing and enforcement into development and production workflows while minimizing friction. Ability to measure discovery and exploit validation rates, precision, recall, false positives, remediation, enforcement and attack coverage, automation, adoption, and risk reduction. * **Sustained technical leadership:** Experience turning research and prototypes into maintainable production services, setting multi\-year technical direction, mentoring senior engineers, and raising standards through architecture guidance and code review. For Seattle, WA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $267,000 per year \- USD $297,000 per year. For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $267,000 per year \- USD $297,000 per year. For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Our client runs the compliant system of record you build on to move, store, and grow money. Launch financial products your customers love. We provide the financial primitives, licenses, and compliance, and our forward deployed team gets you live in two weeks. Under the hood, fiat and blockchain run as one system. Their customers never see any of it. Money comes in, money goes out, and it just gets there. **The Role** Our customers don't just call our APIs. They build their products on us. Their balances, their payment operations, their compliance state. Which means our business succeeds exactly as far as theirs do. Forward Deployed Engineering is the team that makes that true, one customer at a time. You'll report to our CTO and embed with one strategic customer at a time, the enterprises building their products where we're investing deepest. You'll understand their business, their constraints, and their pain points better than anyone, and then you'll build what their launch needs. Here's a concrete example. A global payouts customer is expanding into a new market where we don't yet have local account infrastructure. You scope the requirements with their engineering team, then build the virtual account infrastructure, in our core codebase, that their launch depends on. When it ships, it's not a one\-off. It becomes a core product that we sell to the next ten customers. That's the defining property of this role. This is not a services role, and it's not technical support. You're a product engineer whose roadmap comes from a live customer instead of a planning doc. Everything you build lands in the core platform, and the best of it becomes product the whole company resells. Engagements are scoped at contract time. You're delivering what we've committed to, not absorbing unbounded requests. But within that scope, the what, the why, and the how are yours to figure out with the customer. **What You'll Do** * **Deploy into customer contexts.** Iterate daily with your customer's engineering and operations teams, mostly over Zoom and Slack, with some travel to spend real time on site. * **Scope the build with the customer.** You're not handed a spec. You work out what to build and why with the customer directly, paired with a deployment strategist who owns the commercial side. * **Build across the full stack.** TypeScript and React, NestJS with Postgres and Prisma, and AWS (SQS, SNS, Lambda). New account infrastructure, blockchain integrations, API endpoints, compliance workflows, whatever the launch requires. * **Generalize the bespoke.** Identify patterns across implementations and work with product to turn engagement output into first\-class platform features. * **Prototype fast, ship carefully.** Rapid iteration against live customer workflows, accepting some throwaway work and making sure what isn't throwaway gets productized properly, all while debugging production issues in real time, sometimes with the customer watching. * **Design for correctness and auditability.** This is money\-movement infrastructure. Edge cases have real consequences, and you think about failure modes before they happen. * **Communicate crisply** with customer engineers, operators, founders, and finance leaders, and with our own product leads, whose pods your work must generalize into. **Who You Are** * **You're a builder first.** We're flexible on tenure. We'll hire a scrappy engineer straight out of school or a seasoned customer\-facing engineer. We're not flexible on the bar. You ship production\-grade, full\-stack work, and you have something you've built to prove it. * **You're AI\-native.** Agentic tools are how you already build, and we'll ask you to show us. * **You're energized by customers, not shielded from them.** You're comfortable operating directly with an enterprise engineering team, under ambiguity, where the requirements are yours to discover. * **You're obsessed with correctness and resilience.** You love a good state machine. You think carefully about what happens when things go wrong, because with money they can't. * **Strong pluses.** Payments and fintech infrastructure experience, blockchain and stablecoin integration work, and a forward\-deployed or solutions architect background where you *built* rather than just configured. **What Success Looks Like** * Your customer launches on time, on our rails, and their volume ramps because what you built works. * The infrastructure you shipped for one customer is now core product being sold to the next ten. * Your customer's engineering team treats you as one of their own, and our team trusts what you merge. * You've defined, alongside our CTO, what "forward deployed" means. * You're an early member of a function we're building the company around. **How We Work** We run on three principles: * **2% better, every day.** One percent for yourself, one percent for the people around you. * **Telos.** From the Greek word telos, meaning not just done but fulfilled. Everyone here is focused on one mission and knows each other's Telos. * **Build.** Embody the builder's mindset. Make things, solve problems, and have fun doing it. Location: NYC or Denver About Us: We're a recruiting, staffing, and placement company for Startups. Please submit your resume. If you're a good fit, we will connect you directly with our client who is hiring for this role. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Technical Support I
jobs.description: **Position Overview** ===================== United Health Services (UHS) is seeking a Technical Support I professional to provide frontline technical support for end users across the organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the installation, configuration, and maintenance of PC workstations and related hardware and software. The successful candidate will perform troubleshooting and diagnostic assessments, resolve technical issues efficiently, and ensure the timely completion of work order requests. This position requires strong problem\-solving abilities, excellent customer service skills, and a commitment to delivering reliable technology support in a fast\-paced healthcare environment. The ideal candidate is a customer\-focused technology professional with strong troubleshooting skills, the ability to prioritize multiple requests, and a commitment to providing timely and effective technical support to ensure seamless operations across the organization.**Primary Department, Division, or Unit:** Desktop Support, UHS Information Systems Operations**Primary Work Shift:** Day**Regular Scheduled Weekly Hours:** 40**Compensation Range:** $22\.97 \- $34\.46 per hour, depending on experience \- **Job Responsibilities** * Provides support and maintenance of technical hardware and software: Day to day PC workstation operation. * Installation and maintenance PC workstations. * Ensures timely resolution of Help Desk and Work Order requests. * Performs or coordinates problem analysis, diagnostics, maintenance, repair, isolation and resolution. * Performs customer interviews and inquires, situation assessment, and implements corrective actions. * A record, documents, verifies, and validates help desk contacts. * Records, tracks, and reports on issues from onset to resolution. * Troubleshooting and diagnostic review of issues. * Assists with PC imaging and programming as needed. * Assists with configuration of PC workstation software. * Supports internal and external networks and systems * Provides documentation and proper inventory of equipment. * Assists with technical development and testing for new services and server applications. * Trains users to operate and perform basic computing functions. * Coordinates with other departments and outside organizations to include but not limited to the following: equipment receipt and transportation, hardware and software installations/upgrades, and maintenance of equipment. * Responsible for Help Desk Level 2/3 and On\-Call support. **Position Qualifications** **Minimum Required:** * Associate degree or completion of a technical training program in Information Technology, Computer Systems, or a related field; **or** * Two (2\) years of technical support experience in a networked environment. **Preferred:** * + CompTIA A\+ + Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) + Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE) \- **Why You’ll Love Working at UHS** ================================== At United Health Services (UHS), we believe every connection—to patients, to purpose, to each other—makes a difference. That’s why we’re intentional about supporting our team in ways that go beyond the job. Whether through meaningful benefits, personal growth, or fun along the way, we’re here to help you thrive in work and life. **A Culture of Connection** – We support each other like family and create space for every voice to be heard. Engagement Councils, peer recognition, and initiatives like Walk in my Shoes for senior leaders are just a few ways we foster belonging and collaboration. Outside of work, we stay connected through team events like trivia, trunk\-or\-treat, volunteer days, our staff choir, or seasonal celebrations. **Comprehensive Benefits for Life \& Family** – We offer medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first of the month after hire for employees working 24\+ hours/week. With flexible plan options and coverage tiers, you can choose what fits your life best. Additional perks include discounted childcare through Bright Horizons and voluntary benefits like pet insurance, legal services, and identity theft protection. **Well\-Being \& Financial Security** – From day one, PTO starts accruing so you can take time to recharge. We support your long\-term wellness with a 403(b) retirement plan and company match, flexible spending accounts, access to financial advisors, and up to $400/year in wellness rewards. When life gets tough, we’re here with 24/7 EAP counseling, virtual mental health support, a food pantry, PTO donation program, and professional attire through the Classy Closet. **Growth That Moves with You** – With access to 100,000\+ online courses, leadership programs, tuition reimbursement, clinical ladders, and internal mobility, we help you grow wherever your passion leads. We also continuously review compensation to ensure market competitiveness and internal equity, so you can feel confident your work is valued and rewarded fairly. **A Place to Call Home** – Located in New York’s Southern Tier, UHS offers more than a career—we offer a lifestyle. Enjoy four\-season recreation, affordable living, top\-rated schools, minor league sports, craft brews, a close\-knit community, and more, all within reach of the Finger Lakes, the Catskills, and major Northeast cities. \- **About United Health Services** ================================ United Health Services (UHS) is a locally owned, not\-for\-profit healthcare system in New York’s Southern Tier comprising four hospitals, long\-term care and home care services, and physician practices in Broome and surrounding counties. UHS provides healthcare and medical services for two\-thirds of the region’s population, produces $1\.3 billion a year in total economic impact, and boasts a workforce of more than 6,300 employees and providers. At UHS, our work is guided by our Values of Compassion, Trust, Respect, Teamwork, and Innovation. Whether you provide direct patient care or support behind the scenes, you are part of a shared purpose: to improve the health and well\-being of the communities we serve. Every employee plays a meaningful role in fulfilling our mission—we’d love for you to consider joining us! United Health Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer. \- *United Health Services, Inc. and the members of the UHS System neither are affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed nor approved by, nor otherwise associated with, Universal Health Services, Inc. (NYSE: UHS), UHS of Delaware, Inc. nor their affiliates, which can be found at www.uhsinc.com.*

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, AI & Business Platforms
jobs.description: Do you want to build the system a whole company runs on, not one more feature in someone else’s product? Do you use AI coding tools every day, and still read every line before it ships? Would you rather spend an hour watching how a warehouse actually works than a week guessing from a requirements document? United Material Handling (UMH) is looking for a Principal Software Engineer, AI \& Business Platforms to take technical ownership of UMH\-os, our internal operating system, and UMH Connect, our distributor partner portal. The foundation is already in place: Azure infrastructure, single sign\-on, CI/CD, a design system, an approved catalog of applications across ten departments, and a written blueprint. Our CEO has been building much of it himself with Claude Code. Now we need a professional engineer to own it, build it out, and run it. You will work directly with the CEO, ship to production in your first two weeks, and build AI agents that produce real proposals for real distributors. **KEEP READING IF:** **YOU ARE A BUILDER WHO SHIPS.** You measure progress in working software that people use, not in plans. You like small, frequent releases, and you can take a feature from a conversation on the warehouse floor to production in days. When you inherit code, you assess before you rewrite, fix what is fragile, and leave alone what works. **YOU ARE SERIOUS ABOUT AI IN PRODUCTION.** You have put LLM agents into production, not just demos, and you know the hard part is evaluation, logging and guardrails, especially when an agent is putting prices on a proposal. You treat AI coding tools as power tools, not authors, and you can explain every line in production no matter who or what wrote it. **YOU ARE THE ENGINEER THE BUSINESS TRUSTS.** You can sit with a buyer, a warehouse lead or the CFO, figure out what they actually do, write it down in plain English and get their sign\-off before you build. You push back with a reason and an alternative, and once a decision is made, you commit. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES MAY INCLUDE:** **In the first 30 to 60 days and ongoing:** * Learns the business: tours our Corona headquarters and Moreno Valley distribution center and sits with Sales Operations, Supply Chain, Operations and Finance to see how work gets done. * Reads the UMH\-os codebase, standards and blueprint end to end, and delivers a written assessment of what to strengthen first. * Ships a first production change within two weeks and takes ownership of the deployment pipeline. * Agrees a clear working split with our IT Administrator, who owns accounts, devices and user support. **By the third month and ongoing:** * Reviews and approves every change to UMH\-os and UMH Connect before production, including work from AI tools and outside partners. * Takes a major new application, starting with Order Management, from specification to daily use. * Tightens the engineering standards so AI\-written code comes out consistent the first time. * Becomes the technical owner of our outside development partners. **By the sixth month and ongoing:** * Runs one shared agent runtime for both platforms, with evaluation, logging and guardrails. * Launches UMH Connect with pilot distributors, including a proposal agent and a proposal check agent. * Connects Fellow, Dialpad and Microsoft 365 activity to Salesforce so customer records stay current automatically. * Recruits and leads a small nearshore engineering team if the work calls for it. **By the twelfth month and ongoing:** * Brings order management into UMH\-os, with job costing, WIP and field time capture under way. * Documents the platform well enough that a new engineer ships within two weeks of joining. * Plans the next stage of our ERP roadmap with the CEO. **EDUCATION, SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE:** * 8\+ years of professional software engineering, including 3\+ years leading or architecting production business applications, required * Expert TypeScript, React and Node.js, required * Microsoft Azure (App Service, Azure SQL, Entra ID) and GitHub Actions CI/CD, required * Relational data modeling and SQL for operational workflows, required * LLM agents or tool\-calling features shipped to production (Claude, Azure OpenAI or AI Foundry; MCP or similar), required * Integrations with Salesforce, Microsoft Graph and an ERP, required * Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, required * Application security fundamentals, including securing an external portal, required * Experience as one of a small number of engineers owning a platform end to end, required * Microsoft Dynamics NAV or Business Central experience, preferred * Salesforce platform development, preferred * Manufacturing, distribution or logistics experience, preferred * Experience leading remote or nearshore engineers, a plus * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience **WHO WE ARE:** United Material Handling is a pallet rack manufacturer, distributor and warehouse automation integrator headquartered in Corona, California, with a distribution center in Moreno Valley. We serve customers through three channels: direct storage solutions, resellers and distributors, and automation integrators. We are growing fast, and we are building our own systems to scale with us. **THIS OPPORTUNITY WILL OFFER THE RIGHT INDIVIDUAL:** * The chance to architect the operating system of a growing company: orders, projects, supply chain, finance approvals, hiring, budgeting and a partner portal, all on one platform. * Real AI work on a modern stack, connected to a live CRM, ERP and CPQ, with leadership that uses these tools daily and invests in them. * A direct line to the CEO, decisions in days rather than quarters, and work the whole company sees. * A growth path to leading a small team and the platform as it scales. This is a full\-time, hybrid position based in Corona, California, with two to three days per week on site and the rest remote. Occasional visits to our Moreno Valley distribution center are part of the job. Travel beyond that is limited, at up to 10 percent. **OUR HIRING PROCESS:** We use a structured process: a screen with Employee Experience, an interview with the hiring manager, a hands\-on work sample using our real codebase and AI tools, and a final conversation with leadership. The work sample takes about three hours and needs no preparation.
