jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **L'opportunité** Nous recherchons un(e) développeur(se) logiciel sénior, établi(e) à Montréal, au Canada, ou travaillant à distance dans le fuseau horaire de la côte Est des États\-Unis, pour se joindre à une nouvelle équipe de développement chargée d’assurer la prise en charge de la plateforme Unity pour un écosystème Android englobant les appareils mobiles, les ordinateurs portables et les appareils hybrides. L’objectif principal de cette équipe est de permettre aux développeur(se)s Unity de déployer leurs titres de façon fluide sur ces appareils, tout en tirant pleinement parti de leurs capacités matérielles et logicielles uniques, notamment l’utilisation optimisée de l’affichage, l’intégration native des périphériques d’entrée et les services propres à chaque plateforme. L’équipe sera également chargée de rechercher et de mettre en œuvre des optimisations de l’environnement d’exécution afin d’améliorer les performances de démarrage et l’efficacité d’exécution sur les appareils d’entrée de gamme comme sur les appareils haute performance. Pour ce faire, elle établira des points de référence en matière de performance, collaborera avec des expert(e)s internes et externes du domaine afin de mener des analyses rigoureuses des performances du moteur Unity sur la plateforme, et travaillera avec les principales parties prenantes à la mise en œuvre d’améliorations validées. Les candidat(e)s doivent posséder une expertise en C\+\+, en C\# et en programmation de systèmes Android, ainsi qu’une expérience démontrée dans la création de logiciels de grande qualité à grande échelle. **Ce que vous ferez** * Travailler au sein d’une équipe agile afin de concevoir et de développer des fonctionnalités et des Workflow dans l’éditeur Unity qui prennent en charge ces configurations de plateforme particulières. * Évaluer, analyser et repérer les possibilités d’optimisation dans l’ensemble de la pile technologique, puis collaborer avec plusieurs équipes afin de développer des solutions. * Rédiger une documentation technique complète et participer activement aux processus de révision de la conception. * Assurer la stabilité de la plateforme en examinant et en résolvant les signalements de bogues. * Renforcer la qualité et la livraison grâce aux tests automatisés et à des révisions de code rigoureuses, tout en favorisant une culture d’innovation, de collaboration et d’excellence technique. **Ce que nous recherchons** * Une solide expérience de la programmation de systèmes Android, appuyée par une maîtrise avancée de C\+\+, de C\# et de Java ou Kotlin. * Une expérience de la création et de la maintenance de systèmes de plateforme ou d’environnements d’exécution. * Une solide compréhension de la façon dont les applications de grande envergure utilisent plusieurs langages, notamment de l’exécution des appels synchrones et asynchrones, ainsi que de la gestion, de la propriété et du transfert de la mémoire entre ces langages. * Une expérience de la conception et de la mise en œuvre d’ensembles de fonctionnalités évolutifs dans une base de code multithread de grande envergure. * Des compétences en diagnostic, en débogage et en profilage des performances. **Vous avez peut\-être également** * Une compréhension approfondie de C\# et des environnements d’exécution gérés. * Une connaissance des méthodes de rendu 3D en temps réel et des API graphiques modernes, y compris Vulkan. * Une approche méthodique de la recherche et du développement de solutions d’optimisation novatrices. * Une passion pour l’avenir des jeux vidéo ou des expériences 3D en temps réel dans divers contextes. * Une connaissance des meilleurs moments et des meilleures façons d’utiliser l’intelligence artificielle dans le processus de développement logiciel. Échelle salariale de base: Nous déterminons l’échelle salariale de base pour ce poste en fonction de votre lieu de travail principal : Zone A : de 125,300 $ CA à 175,300 $ CA brut Zone B : de 135,400 $ CA à 203,000 $ CA brut Zone A : de 135,800 $ US à 203,600 $ US brut Zone B : de 153,400 $ US à 230,200 $ US brut Zone C : de 172,400 $ US à 258,600 $ US brut **The opportunity** We are seeking a Senior Software Developer, based either in Montreal, Canada or working remotely within the US East Coast time zone, to join a newly established development team responsible for delivering Unity platform support for an Android\-based ecosystem encompassing mobile, laptop, and hybrid form factors. jobs.description: University Staff**Description** --------------- **Join Our Team and Make a Difference in Higher Education!** At the System Administration office at the University of Colorado, we are dedicated to building a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and empowered to thrive. Our office is committed to fostering a culture where employees find community, a sense of belonging, and the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to our mission and purpose. By joining our team, you’ll have a direct impact on shaping the future of higher education. In addition to the Office of the Board of Regents, the University of Colorado’s system administration includes 19 units that provide essential services to CU’s campuses in Aurora, Boulder, Colorado Springs, and Denver, as well as the Office of the President. While not a part of any one campus, we are proud to serve in the centralized office for the University system. Together, we ensure CU continues to deliver outstanding education, groundbreaking research, and valuable service to our communities. We believe in creating an environment where the unique experiences and perspectives of everyone are embraced, enriching the work we do and the strategic outcomes we pursue. If you’re passionate about making a difference, contributing to a dynamic team, and supporting a mission that matters, we encourage you to apply and be part of our journey. Learn more about CU System Administration. **Position Summary:** University Information Services (UIS) provides technical services and enterprise applications to the University of Colorado campuses and the Office of the President. UIS is committed to excellence in customer service and technical expertise. Through the development of enterprise applications, UIS supports the University systems used by students, faculty, human resources employees, finance employees, and others. The Senior DevOps Engineer applies an automation mindset leveraging DevOps tools with the application of technical skills and leadership to the areas of application and infrastructure deployment, patching, and support. This position will serve as a senior technical expert within the UIS Enterprise Cloud Services group. As a part of the ECS CrossApps Middleware team, the Sr. DevOps Engineer performs installation, configuration, upgrade, and day\-to\-day operational support of a variety of applications and middleware technologies. This position designs, builds, and maintains technical environments, supports system rollouts, responds to and troubleshoots escalated operational issues while managing internal and external customer relationships. This position informs and advises project managers and stakeholders about project plans and implementation, conducts technical analysis, and produces recommendations. This position is also charged with supporting daily operations of these applications, and must also work with the team to automate processes and procedures, create efficiencies, and provide quality business services to our clients and customers. This position reports to the Assistant Director of Enterprise Cloud Services and is exempt from the State of Colorado Classified Staff system. **Where You Will Work:** **Applicants must be Colorado residents or able to relocate to Colorado within a month of starting employment with University of Colorado System Administration.** This role is eligible to work remotely within Colorado. **Please note, leadership may adjust in\-office work requirements with a minimum of three months' notice before any change can be implemented.** **Equal Opportunity Statement:** CU is an Equal Opportunity Employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. We are committed to creating a workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity, and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, including protected veterans and integrator for large complex systems and applications, including monitoring, orchestration, and automation. * Communicate and collaborate with application owners/managers, initiative leaders, and project leadership to clarify requirements, develop work plans, document, and lead technical architecture. * Apply DevOps methodologies for building and operating highly available, scalable applications and services. * Evaluate, build and modify automation for deploying applications and services based on DevOps and GitOps principles internally and for external teams * Serve as a domain architect providing advice and guidance on new technical solutions and/or architectural changes to existing design, particularly as it pertains to the CrossApps Middleware areas of discipline and support. * Maintain, upgrade, and extend a library of Ansible playbooks, Bash, and m administration, web servers, application servers, database servers, SSL/TLS, logging, clustering, monitoring, RESTful APIs, and container/orchestration. * Ability to apply best practices, design patterns, and DevOps / GitOps principles. * Envision automating everything such that all the organization’s systems could be re\-created from a git repo. * Ability to troubleshoot, resolve, and explain complex problems and discuss trade\-offs of potential solutions. * Skilled in finding, fixing, repairing, and preventing issues. * Ability to learn and use new applications and computer languages, including the use of source control * Ability to work in a twenty\-four\-seven (24x7\) operational environment with on\-call and production support responsibilities * Ability to work remotely while remaining attentive, engaged, responsive, and productive * Knowledgeable in supporting Enterprise Java applications. * Strong attention to detail. * Excellent oral and written communication skills. **How to Apply:** For full consideration, please attach the following as separate documents to your If an application requires additional materials, such as a transcript or certification, you may redact identifying information relating to your date or birth, dates of school attendance, or dates of graduation. **When to Apply:** For full consideration completed applications must be submitted by **November 4, 2026**. Background investigations include a criminal history record check, and when appropriate, a financial and/or motor vehicle history. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Fully onsite in Austin TX AI Engineer — Agentic Systems Mid\-Level Individual Contributor \| 3–5 Years Experience Role **Summary** We are hiring an AI Engineer to design, build, and operate agentic AI systems — LLM\-powered agents that reason over enterprise data, call tools, and execute multi\-step workflows end to end. This is a hands\-on engineering role at the center of how we automate complex technical and operational work. You will take ambiguous problems, decompose them into agent workflows, and ship production services that engineering teams depend on daily. This is an ideal role for an engineer with a strong Python and ML foundation who has already shipped LLM or RAG applications and now wants to go deeper into orchestration, tool\-calling, and autonomous multi\-agent architectures. You will work within an established platform and architecture, with senior engineers available for design review — but you will own your components from prototype through production. **Key Responsibilities** Agent Design \& Orchestration Build and ship LLM\-powered agents that plan, call tools, and complete multi\-step tasks using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent orchestration libraries. Implement multi\-agent workflows — planner, executor, reviewer, and specialist roles — including state handling, hand\-off logic, retries, and graceful failure paths. Design and expose tools to agents via function\-calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, wrapping internal APIs, databases, and enterprise systems as safe, well\-scoped agent capabilities. Retrieval \& Knowledge Systems Build and operationalize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines**:** chunking, embedding, vector and hybrid search, re\-ranking, and context assembly. Integrate structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured sources — SharePoint, Confluence, Jira, REST APIs, Excel, and SQL warehouses — into retrieval and agent context layers. Continuously improve answer grounding and reduce hallucination through better retrieval, prompt design, and context management. Engineering \& Deployment Develop production Python services and APIs for agent and model inference using FastAPI, containerized with Docker and deployed through standard CI/CD pipelines. Instrument agents with tracing, token and cost accounting, latency monitoring, and structured logging so that behavior is observable and debuggable in production. Apply MLOps and LLMOps practices including version control for prompts and configs, automated regression testing, and safe rollout of model or prompt changes. Evaluation \& Quality Build evaluation harnesses for agent workflows — golden datasets, task\-level success metrics, LLM\-as\-judge scoring, and regression suites that gate releases. Measure and tune for accuracy, latency, and cost, and make explicit trade\-offs between them based on the use case. Collaboration Partner with domain experts, data engineers, and product stakeholders to turn manual workflows into reliable automated agents. Deliver results through interfaces users actually adopt — Streamlit apps, chat interfaces, dashboards, and embedded integrations. Write clear design notes and runbooks, and participate actively in code and design reviews. **Required Qualifications** 3–5 years of professional software, ML, or data engineering experience, including at least 1 year building LLM\-based or GenAI applications. Strong Python engineering skills — not just notebooks. Production code, testing, packaging, async patterns, and API development with FastAPI or similar. Hands\-on experience with at least one LLM orchestration framework (LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or an equivalent) in a shipped application. Demonstrated experience building RAG systems**:** embeddings, vector stores (e.g., FAISS, pgvector, Pinecone, Chroma), and retrieval quality tuning. Practical command of prompt engineering, structured output, function/tool calling, and context\-window management. Working knowledge of SQL and cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, or equivalent), and comfort writing queries against enterprise schemas. Experience containerizing and deploying services with Docker and shipping through CI/CD on a major cloud (Azure, AWS, or GCP). Solid grounding in ML fundamentals and familiarity with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or HuggingFace Transformers. Clear written and verbal communication, and the judgment to escalate when a problem is under\-specified rather than guessing. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience building or consuming Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, or comparable agent tool\-integration layers. Production experience with multi\-agent or agentic workflow systems, including human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints and approval gates. Familiarity with LLM observability and evaluation tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Weights \& Biases, or MLflow. Experience with workflow orchestration tools — Airflow, Dagster, Prefect — or analytics engineering with DBT. Exposure to model fine\-tuning or parameter\-efficient adaptation (LoRA/PEFT) and knowing when it is — and is not — the right answer. Background in a technical engineering domain (semiconductor, hardware validation, manufacturing, or similar) where agents operate over specialized data. Experience with AI governance, responsible\-AI review, or enterprise security requirements for LLM deployments. Building AI Tools and flows for Server Validation Must Have**:** Optimizing Token utilization Python Scripting Database \- Azure VIVA is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants have an equal opportunity for placement, and all employees have an equal opportunity to develop on the job. This means that VIVA will not discriminate against any employee or qualified applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status

jobs.title: Sr Security Platform Engineer, AI and Automation
jobs.description: Global Enterprise Security (GES) partners with the lines of business across Vanguard to protect crew and client information and assets. Our sub\-department, Attack Surface Reduction, provides a cohesive view into Vanguard's technical attack surface, focused on identifying, prioritizing, and managing vulnerabilities and configuration issues across the organization. DevSecOps, part of Attack Surface Reduction, enhances the security posture of Vanguard's software applications through security automation that helps developers find and fix vulnerabilities earlier in the SDLC. This role sits on the team responsible for orchestration and enforcement of our security scanning capabilities, including SAST, SCA, container scanning, and API security scanning. jobs.title: SDK Developer
jobs.description: **About VectorWave** VectorWave is building the Analog Processing Unit (APU), the world’s first programmable neuromorphic processor that runs AI inference on raw radio\-frequency waveforms pre\-digitization. Conventional RF systems must digitize the signal before any AI inference can occur, fundamentally limiting the latency, power consumption, and performance of wireless edge compute. The APU bypasses these bottlenecks by performing the AI signal processing fully in analog. We are a venture\-backed MIT spinout translating award\-winning research into new wireless products with fundamentally new capabilities. With applications spanning defense (electronic warfare, spectrum awareness, anti\-jam) and commercial wireless (Wi\-Fi and 5G/6G spectrum sharing, interference management), we are building a team of engineers who are excited to transform the future of wireless communications! **The role** The SDK developer role focuses on building the interface for users to control, program, and operate the APU. You will work closely with the APU development engineers to integrate the functionalities into software packages that ship with the APU. Your work here will create SDKs that seamlessly connect the user to the programmable APU AI signal processing \& inferencing. **Location:** This is an in\-person, full\-time role at our office in the Greater Boston area. There may occasionally be some travel to conferences. **What you'll do** * Design \& deliver SDKs for VectorWave’s partners and APU developers * Integrate automated controls, calibrations, etc. as necessary into the software interface for the APU * Distill which physical parameters are user\-controllable, visible, or automated within the SDK * Work with the RF, machine learning, and system engineers to ensure inter\-system compatibility * Help build a new developer community around APU edge AI inferencing * Provide SDK support for early partners and developers to ensure successful APU integration **What you bring** * Experience creating SDKs for electronic or radio systems * Experience in system lifecycle management (i.e. updates, feature integration) * Experience creating detailed system and user guide documentation * Expertise in UX and UI for controlling complex systems * Expertise in bug testing and/or software robustness * Familiarity with the basics of deep neural networks **Nice to have** * Explicit SDK design for SDRs, RFSoCs, or other similar systems * UX and UI for manipulating deep neural networks * Software security and application shielding * Remote/web cyber security * Familiarity with PyTorch **How we work** * **Always be curious.** Sometimes the most profound outcomes come from paying attention to the smallest details. * **Truth guides us.** Honesty and candor are foundational. Don't delay hard conversations, start them. * **Think out loud.** Voicing anything both technical and non\-technical helps us solve problems together. * **Mistakes are expected.** Perfection is impossible when you're building something new. We want to navigate challenges thoughtfully so we can learn and improve. * **Adaptability is essential.** Make the best decision with the information at hand, then be ready to adjust. * **Lean on each other.** As we scale, we aim to maintain our scrappy, small team camaraderie. **Compensation and benefits** Competitive salary and meaningful equity, plus: **The basics** * Medical: UnitedHealthcare Choice Plus, platinum tier. $10 primary care visit. $10 therapy visits. * Dental: Blue Cross Blue Shield Dental Blue. Child orthodontia included. * Vision: Guardian. * Unlimited PTO. **Family matters** * We offer 95% dependent premium coverage. * Plus, we have uncapped IVF support for fertility and family planning. * Coming soon: Twenty\-six weeks of parental leave at 100% of pay for every parent: birthing, non\-birthing, adoptive, and foster. **For life beyond work** * 401(k): we match 100% of the first 6% of pay, dollar for dollar. * Take care of yourself with a $2,000 annual wellness benefit. **Equal opportunity** VectorWave is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. VectorWave participates in E\-Verify. See the E\-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters in English and Spanish.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: AI Solutions Engineers are the hands of the AI program. You embed beside a business team, understand their work deeply, and rewire it with AI — then hand the result over and measure the win. This is not a help desk and not a build queue: you're an elite generalist deployed to the highest\-value friction in the company, owning problems end\-to\-end, from discovery sessions to the working solution to the story of what it saved. Primary Job Duties 1\.Discover \& record. Embed with a team, shadow and record how the work actually gets done, and find the high\-volume, high\-friction, rules\-heavy workflows worth rewiring. 2\.Define the SOP before AI. Make the current process explicit — you can't improve what you haven't written down. 3\.Engineer the AI\-driven SOP — human\-in\-the\-loop. Redesign the workflow around AI, keeping review and approval checkpoints wherever judgment, risk, or client trust require them. AI drafts; humans own. 4\.Build the assets. Turn the redesign into reusable capability — prompts, playbooks, harness workflows, automations (n8n / ChatGPT / Claude / agentic tooling), and small bespoke apps or integrations. You'll be able to work with developers as complex scenarios arise. 5\.Capture the win. Help employees log board\-grade wins in the AI Wins Tracker, convert their hurdles into wins, and package repeatable patterns into the shared playbook / prompt library for other teams. 6\.Clear the path. Partner with IT, security, and infrastructure on access, connectors, and permissions; escalate recurring blockers into infrastructure and policy asks. 7\.Create the moments people remember. Notice the task someone dreads and build the thing that makes it disappear — the tailored touch that produces trust and success. 8\.Business \& Customer workflows — operations across TFS, Class Action, Restructuring, and customer\-facing teams: document and case work, claims, proposals, correspondence, support. 9\.Internal \& Technical workflows — automation, reporting, data plumbing, and agentic development /QA enablement for the technical teams. Ø Hands\-on fluency with modern AI assistants — ChatGPT and Claude (Desktop / Code / agentic modes) — used daily to get real work done, not just demoed. Ø Prompt engineering — you can design, test, and iterate prompts and reusable prompt libraries that hold up in production, and you understand context, tools, and where models fail. Ø Workflow automation fluency (n8n / Zapier / similar) — you can build working automations end\-to\-end, including multi\-step flows, triggers, and API calls. Ø Working with APIs and integrations — you can read API docs, wire systems together with Ø REST/webhooks/auth, and move data between tools without hand\-holding. Ø Light scripting / building — comfortable enough in C\#, SQL \& JavaScript (or a low\-code equivalent) to build small apps, scripts, and glue, and to read code others wrote. Ø Process mapping — you can sit with a team, extract how the work really happens, and write a clear SOP before you touch AI. Ø Data literacy — spreadsheets, structured data, and basic SQL; you can quantify a before/after and defend the number.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: **About Versapay \\uD83D\\uDE80** Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage. Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward. Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M\+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually. Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!! **About the role** Versapay is hiring its first GTM Engineer to remove manual work from the revenue engine, speed up response to inbound demand, and run automated outbound plays for Sales and Marketing. You will design, build and maintain the workflows, integrations and AI agents that connect our GTM systems, with Salesforce as the system of record. This is a builder role inside Revenue Operations and reports to VP of Revenue Operations. You will own problems end to end: find where reps and marketers lose time, design the fix, ship it, and measure the result. We care about hours given back to the field and faster pipeline, not about how many tools/workflows you deploy. ### **What you'll do** **Speed to lead and inbound orchestration** * Own the inbound path from form fill or meeting request to first rep touch, and cut response time to minutes. * Build lead\-to\-account matching, qualification and routing logic, with clear SLAs and alerts when they are missed. * Design and automate instant follow\-up: rep notifications, meeting booking, and context\-rich handoffs so reps know who they are talking to before they call. **Automated plays for Sales and Marketing** * In partnership with marketing design signal\-based plays, for example website visits from target accounts, product or event engagement, job changes of known champions, and renewal or expansion triggers. * Turn each signal into an action: a task, an alert, a sequence enrollment or an account brief for the right owner. * Partner with Marketing on campaign follow\-up, event lead processing and nurture handoffs so no lead sits untouched. **Eliminating manual work** * Map where reps, SDRs, marketers and CSMs spend time on low\-value tasks, and rank fixes by hours saved. * Automate CRM hygiene: field completion, duplicate prevention, activity capture and stage\-change requirements. * Build AI\-assisted workflows such as pre\-call account research, call summaries written back to Salesforce, follow\-up email drafts and deal\-risk flags. **Data and enrichment** * Improve coverage and accuracy of account and contact data using our current data sources. * Support the evaluation if we choose a dedicated enrichment and orchestration platform (for example Clay), and lead its rollout if approved. **Systems, integrations and governance** * Support integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, sales engagement, conversation intelligence and other GTM tools, using APIs, webhooks and workflow platforms. * Work within Salesforce data\-model and change\-control standards set with the Salesforce admin team. * Document every workflow: what it does, what it writes, who owns it and how to turn it off. ### **What you'll bring** **Required** * 4\+ years in a technical GTM role such as GTM engineering, RevOps systems, marketing ops engineering or sales ops automation at a B2B SaaS company. * Deep working knowledge of Salesforce: objects, fields, flows, validation rules, and how lead, contact, account and opportunity data relate. * Hands\-on experience building production workflows in at least one automation platform, such as n8n, Workato, Make, Zapier or Tray. * Comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication; able to read API docs and connect two systems without vendor help. * Working scripting skills in Python or JavaScript, and basic SQL. * Practical experience using LLMs in workflows: prompt design, structured outputs, testing for accuracy, and knowing when not to use AI. * A track record of shipping automations that measurably saved time or improved conversion, with numbers to show it. * Clear written documentation habits and the judgment to build things others can maintain. **Nice to have** * Experience with Clay or similar enrichment and orchestration tools (Apollo, ZoomInfo workflows, Common Room). * Experience with lead routing and scheduling tools such as LeanData or Chili Piper. * Experience with intent platforms, such as 6sense or Demandbase * Familiarity with marketing automation (ex., HubSpot) and sales engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft, Gong Engage). * Exposure to a data warehouse and reverse ETL (ex., Snowflake). * Experience in a PE\-backed or fast\-scaling SaaS company, or in fintech, payments or AR/AP software. ### **How we'll measure success** Success means faster pipeline and fewer manual hours, measured against a baseline set in your first 30 days. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: **About WCG** ------------- WCG delivers transformational solutions that accelerate clinical research and advance human health. We serve the experts, innovators, and pathfinders on the frontlines of science and medicine—empowering them to develop breakthrough therapies while ensuring the risks of progress never outweigh the value of human life. Together, we stimulate growth, maximize efficiency, and shape the future of clinical trials. **Why WCG** ----------- At WCG, we invest in our people because you are the driving force behind our mission. The salary range for this position reflects our commitment to fair, competitive pay based on your qualifications, experience, skills, education, and location. Together, we'll find the right fit for your expertise and our shared mission. **Job Summary** --------------- The Software Test Engineer is a member of the Quality Engineering team, responsible for supporting the testing, validation and delivery of WCG namedproducts and systems. The role applies established testing and validation practices across the software development life cycle (SDLC), executes manual and automated test activities, prepares validation documentation, and collaborates closely with Software Engineering, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to support product quality and compliance. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required. * Review requirements and design documentation to help ensure requirements are clear, testable, and consistent with the clinical trial protocol and system design specifications before test design begins. * Develop and execute test and validation activities using established risk\-based testing methodologies; prepare and maintain CSV documentation i test scripts, test summary reports, and requirements\-to\-test traceability matrices. * Contribute to the execution and maintenance of automated test suites using Playwright across UI, API, and real\-time (Socket.io) application components. * Maintain test cases , execution cycles, and traceability records in Zephyr and JIRA, or equivalent test management tools for assigned products and projects. * Conduct and build upon comprehensive manual regression testing cases and scripts to ensure release product quality. * Prepare data sets to test logic, error handling, and system workflows; perform load, performance, and user\-simulation testing. * Report and track defects in the official bug tracking system (e.g., JIRA); ensure reported defects are remediated and re\-validated in a timely manner. * Support ongoing enhancement of manual and automated tests into existing regression and CI/CD test suites, actively working to increase reliability and improve release confidence. * Analyze test results, identify defects or performance concerns, and collaborate with Software Engineering to investigate and resolve issues. * Support change\-control and validation activities by preparing and maintaining required documentation. * Participate in the evaluation and use of approved AI\-augmented testing tools (e.g., AI\-assisted test case generation, self\-healing automation, LLM\-based output evaluation) in accordance with established validation and compliance requirements. * Communicate testing status, findings, and issues to project stakeholders and support customer testing activities as needed. * Periodically conduct training for other team members on testing/validation tools, standards, and best practices. * Follow established testing and validation methodologies and provide feedback on process improvements when appropriate.. * Other duties as assigned by supervisor. These may, on occasion, be unrelated to the position described here. * Attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the position. **EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, skills, and related experience. * **CERTIFICATIONS/LICENSE/REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS:** * None r ement tools such as Zephyr (or equivalent Xray/TestRail) or Helix ALM (Test Track). * Experience executing and contributing to automated regression suites with Playwright preferred * Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, risk\-based testing, and software/validation testing life cycles. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; exceptional attention to detail. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple simultaneous projects in a dynamic environment. * Ability to work in multi\-disciplinary teams (Developers, Business Analysts, QA, Validation Compliance) to meet aggressive goals and deliver quality results. * Ability to translate product and protocol requirements into test cases, validation deliverables, and automated test scripts. * Ability to analyze and troubleshoot product defects and provide creative solutions for optimizing system performance. Preferred: * Proficiency in one or more scripting/programming languages, preferably Typescript * SQL scripting and API testing experience (e.g., Postman, Newman, REST Assured). * Experience with JIRA and Scrum or Kanban/Agile methodologies. * Exposure to AI\-augmented/agentic testing tools or workflows (e.g., AI\-assisted test authoring, prompt engineering for test\-case generation, self\-healing automation). * Modern Tooling \& Technical Ecosystem Skills: Given WCG's technology ecosystem spans PHP, Socket.io (real\-time/WebSocket communication), React, Valkey (Redis\-compatible caching/data store), MySQL, both virtually and deployed in local meetings, the following modern tools and skills are especially valuable for a test engineer supporting this stack: + Enterprise Test Management: Zephyr Scale/Squad (Jira), Xray, or TestRail for test case authoring, traceability matrices, and release/validation cycle reporting. + Automated Regression \& E2E Testing: Playwright (cross\-browser, API, and component testing) with parallelized CI execution. + API Testing \& Contract Validation: Postman/Newman or REST Assured for validating PHP backend endpoints and service contracts. + Real\-Time/WebSocket Testing: Experience testing Socket.io event\-driven flows (socket.io\-client test harnesses, Artillery's socket.io engine) to validate real\-time messaging, reconnection logic, and race conditions. + Database Testing: MySQL query validation, data integrity checks, and performance tuning (EXPLAIN plans, indexing); tools like MySQL Workbench or DBeaver. + Performance \& Load Testing: Artillery is preferred for modern, scriptable load testing of APIs and WebSocket connections + Observability: experience with tools like New Relic to correlate test failures with backend/service health. + Visual Regression: Playwright's built\-in screenshot comparison for catching unintended React UI regressions. + AI\-Augmented QA (emerging): AI\-assisted test case generation and self\-healing automation, applied with appropriate validation rigor and documentation given the regulated environment. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:** May coordinate testing activities for assigned projects and provide informal guidance to team members. **TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:** 0\-5% **Pay Range** ------------- USD $52,470\.00 \- USD $95,000\.00 /Yr. **EEOC Statement** ------------------ WCG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer – Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to race, color, national origin or ancestry, religion or creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, age, marital status, family or parental status, disability, genetic information, citizenship, veteran status, or any other legally recognized basis or status protected by federal, state, or local law. WCG complies with the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Act and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. We promote a "One WCG" culture where all are welcome, respected, valued, and empowered to make a difference every day to advance clinical research.

We are responsible for the end\-to\-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology \& digital\-led initiatives across the Attractions \& Entertainment, Food \& Beverage, Resorts \& Transportation and Merchandise lines of business. As a Data Engineer at Disney Experiences, you will assist in designing, building, and overseeing the deployment of technology architecture, solutions, and software aimed at capturing, managing, and utilizing structured and unstructured data from various sources. This role is designed for professionals who are passionate about data engineering and can work effectively within a collaborative team environment. The Data Engineer will create data ingestion pipelines including workloads and applications inside AWS. Implements, troubleshoots, and optimizes distributed solutions based on big data technologies like SQL, S3, Glue, MSK, Snowflake and Redshift to solve large scale processing problems in a Cloud DW environment. Designs syndicated and curated data views that will be used for reporting, analytics, and advanced applications. Apply technical expertise and mathematical concepts to challenging programming problems. Strong communication, interpersonal, and collaboration skills, including the ability to work effectively in an agile / scrum environment. Responsibilities Design and develop data pipelines in AWS \& Snowflake Design and develop data views, assist with architecture decisions, deployment, and feedback. Develop and support data solutions using AWS services including CDK, CloudFormation, Kinesis, Lambda, SQS, SNS, S3, and EC2\. Ability to debug and troubleshoot across a broad technical stack. Product ownership and strong business support in enterprise level theme park related environment. Working with a variety of business partner groups across Disney Parks and Resorts to implement optimal technical solutions. Provide data and system analysis needed for feature engineering. Develop and maintain data quality checks and validation processes to ensure reliable and accurate data assets. Required Qualifications: 3\+ years of Data Engineering or similar experience required, supporting SQL in a Data warehouse environment. Strong knowledge of Python and object\-oriented programming concepts. Solid working experience with Snowflake native objects like SnowPipe, external/internal stages, external tables, integration objects, stored procedures (Snowflake Scripting), stream \& task, data masking, time travel and cloning. Design scalable dimensional and analytical data models that support enterprise reporting, self\-service analytics, and data product consumption. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions and curated datasets. Experience building data pipelines and complex data transformations. Experience with AWS S3, Glue, MSK, Redshift, Spark, or related ETL/Deployment tools. Working knowledge of Data Build Tool (DBT). Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment. Strong conceptual understanding of security at rest and in transit for big data pipelines. Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyze and resolve data and system issues. Hands\-on experience implementing data pipelines and data models within established architectural frameworks. Strong systems and data analysis skills, and experience with testing in data space. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and source control tools such as GitHub. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Airflow or other workflow orchestration tools. Experience supporting real\-time data processing workloads. Familiarity with data governance, metadata management, and data lineage concepts. Exposure to machine learning or analytics use cases. Experience working with large\-scale cloud\-based data platforms. Required Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience \#TECHATDISNEY **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in Orlando, FL is $103,400 to $138,600 per year. jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: ***About Safari Circuits*** At Safari Circuits, we believe a supportive, family\-like culture is the foundation of our team's success and the exceptional quality of our products. We manufacture mission\-critical Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs) for global medical, military, and defense markets. Since 1985, we have paired industry\-leading stability with continuous business growth. As we build a stronger future, we are dedicated to fostering your professional growth and investing in your long\-term success. ***Job Summary*** We are seeking a **Senior Electrical Engineer** to lead the end\-to\-end development of custom test equipment for the electronics manufacturing industry. In this role, you will design, build, validate, and document high\-performance testing systems while directly collaborating on custom engineering projects for our global clients. ***Primary Responsibilities Include:*** * **Formulate comprehensive engineering plans** to outline project milestones, design development phases, and resource requirements. * **Architect and specify hardware components**, evaluating both off\-the\-shelf parts and custom Printed Circuit Board Assemblies (PCBAs) to maximize performance and cost\-efficiency. * **Execute full\-lifecycle hardware development**, driving custom electronic designs from initial concept through schematic capture and layout. * **Develop, debug, and optimize software systems** across embedded microcontrollers and PC platforms utilizing C, C\#, LabVIEW, and Python. * **Lead the physical assembly, prototyping, and testing** of newly designed products to validate functionality against rigorous engineering benchmarks. ***Requirements:*** * BSEE or combination of formal training (College and/or Military) and experience designing electronic circuits or test equipment * Experience with one or more PCB CAD layout packages (Altium preferred) * Experience in writing software in C, C\#, LabVIEW, and Python * Authorization to work in US ***Benefits*** * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement * Promotion opportunities * Climate\-controlled facility ***EEO Statement*** *Safari Circuits, LLC. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.* *Native American \& Veteran Hiring Preferences will be applied in accordance with Waséyabek Development Company policy. We are committed to making merit\-based hiring decisions. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, citizenship, marital status, height or weight, veteran status, or any other legally protected category.*

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer- Industrial Control Panels
jobs.description: Working at Watlow Watlow is a global technology and manufacturing leader who provides world class engineering expertise through innovative thermal products and systems, enabling our customers to thrive. We are making a positive impact every day as our solutions enrich the lives of people everywhere. We have been providing breakthrough thermal solutions for over 100 years! Our corporate values guide us uncompromisingly to always do the right thing, continually learn and improve, respect everyone, and lead with service and humility. Senior Electrical Engineer Overview of Role The Senior Electrical Engineer serves as a technical expert responsible for advanced electrical system design of control panels and integrated thermal systems. This role leads complex projects, ensures regulatory compliance, drives platform development and standardization activities, and supports customer engagement and mentors junior engineers. Key Responsibilities * Lead electrical design of complex control panels and integrated thermal systems. * Lead projects to drive product extension and/or standardization activities. * Author and validate P\&IDs, schematics, panel layouts, wiring diagrams, test documentation, manuals, and manufacturing documentation. * Interpret customer specifications and develop compliant system solutions. * Specify components and instrumentation in accordance with customer requirements, applicable codes, and cost requirements. * Ensure compliance with UL508A, NEC, CE, IEC, ATEX, and hazardous area requirements. * Generate cost estimates and support internal and external quotation activities. * Review supplier quotations for technical adequacy and compliance. * Support manufacturing supplier escalations, troubleshooting and validation testing. * Collaborate with heater designers, product specialists and account managers to develop optimized system solutions. * Lead design reviews and ensure design for manufacturability principles are applied. * Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance across projects. Qualifications **Must Have:** * Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering with 6–8\+ years of industrial electrical design experience. * Strong experience designing and supporting power and control panels. * Advanced knowledge of electrical codes and hazardous area classifications as they pertain to control panel design and integration. * Experience with customer\-facing technical discussions. * Proficiency in Solidworks Electrical, Eplan, or equivalent design tools. **Additional Success Factors:** * Experience with medium voltage equipment. * HMI programming experience. * PLC programming experience. * Bench testing experience. * Project leadership experience. * Knowledge of change control and configuration management. * Lean or Six Sigma training. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. * Strong organizational and prioritization skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. * Thorough attention to detail and documentation. * Able to communicate and interact with suppliers, customers, account managers, and internal teams. **Benefits:** The Watlow Total Compensation Plan The health, well\-being and financial stability of you and your family is a high priority to us.The Watlow Total Rewards Plan includes competitive compensation and a full range of life and career enhancing benefits: * Annual Incentive Program * 401(k) plan that includes a company match on your contribution and an annual company contribution that is tied to company performance * Wellness incentives * Employee Personal Assistance Program * Dental, medical, vision and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance * Paid holidays, personal time, and vacation * Parental leave * Tuition reimbursement Diversity \& Inclusion We proactively embrace diversity in all its dimensions across our company and cultivate a culture of inclusion and forward thinking that respects and reflects each team member’s individual strengths, views, and experiences. Watlow takes pride in being an inclusive equal opportunity employer and considers for employment qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Please let us know confidentially if you need or require any special accommodations to participate in our recruiting process by emailing us at accommodations@Watlow.com.

jobs.title: Product Associate II
jobs.description: **About Waymark** Waymark is a mission\-driven team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders working to transform care for people with Medicaid benefits. We partner with communities to deliver technology\-enabled, human\-centered support that helps patients stay healthy and thrive. We're designing tools and systems that bring care directly to those who need it most—removing barriers and reimagining what's possible in Medicaid healthcare delivery. Our Values At Waymark, our values are the foundation of how we work, grow, and support one another: * Bold Builders: We tackle the toughest challenges in care delivery by harnessing the power of community and technology. * Humble Learners: We seek feedback, embrace diverse perspectives, and welcome challenges to our assumptions. * Experiment to Improve: We use data to inform decisions and continuously assess our performance. * Focused Urgency: Our mission drives us to act swiftly and relentlessly in pursuit of meaningful results. If this resonates with you, we invite you to bring your creativity, energy, and curiosity to Waymark. **About This Role** Your primary product to manage will be Lighthouse, the platform our care teams use every day to find, reach, and care for Medicaid members. Today Lighthouse records care after it happens. Over the next eighteen months you will help it become a place where care is delivered: a member texts a symptom, agentic models draft a structured history and assessment, a licensed clinician reviews the treatment plan and approves pended orders, and Lighthouse executes the resulting prescription, laboratory order, or referral — then documents the encounter, submits the claim, and updates the health information exchange. Alongside that build, you'll keep shipping the improvements care teams depend on right now — panel management nudges, clinical history context, task and goal automation from outreach and preventative care campaigns, and the steady stream of feature work that keeps a growing patient\-facing care team maximally effective. That is a large surface, and you will need to develop specifications for it. You will spend real time with operations leaders directing the care team; you will decide how their needs will translate into building; and you will write the specifications, acceptance criteria, and measurement plans that let a growing engineering team move quickly without guessing. You'll collaborate closely with a cross\-functional team spanning product design, engineering, and data science. You'll partner with design on user research, shaping user flows, and reviewing prototypes; with engineering on technical feasibility, implementation, and QA; and with data scientists to turn powerful predictive models into useful, actionable experiences for care team members. Waymark is a small, fast\-moving team, so you should expect to be a self\-starter and get hands\-on rather than wait for a fully\-formed brief. You will report to the VP of Product and work as part of a small Product and Design organization and larger Clinical Product Development department. In eighteen months, success looks like this: Lighthouse supports safe clinical triage with human\-in\-the\-loop approvals, our predictive models reach care teams as pre\-drafted work rather than notifications, and our engineers ship against a backlog they trust. **Responsibilities** * Own the Lighthouse product backlog end to end — problem framing, written specifications, acceptance criteria, sequencing, QA, and release readiness — spanning both new clinical/agentic capabilities and the ongoing feature enhancements care teams rely on day to day. * Partner daily with the Lighthouse engineering and design pod — run project kickoffs, scope refinement, sprint planning, and delivery plan; keep a refined backlog at least two sprints deep; hold the definition of ready and definition of done. * Partner with cross\-product PMs to specify how predictive model outputs and drafted agentic actions surface inside Lighthouse — which decision each score informs, how work is ordered and rate\-limited, and where a human reviews and confirms before any action is taken. * Maintain a continuous discovery practice: a weekly cadence of structured contact with product, design, engineering and operations team members, an opportunity map for Lighthouse, and prioritized, testable bets rather than a feature request queue. * Define and instrument outcome metrics before each launch, weighted toward completed clinical actions and reduced care\-team workload rather than volume of suggestions produced, and run the post\-launch read\-out. * Coordinate clinical safety review, compliance, and partner readiness across Compliance, Security and Legal teams for each major feature release. **Minimum Qualifications** * Two or more years in a product management role shipping software used by non\-technical operational or clinical staff, with at least one product you owned from discovery through launch and out ance criteria, and decision documents are clear enough that engineers and designers design, build, and validate the right thing without a meeting. * Practical fluency with agile delivery — refinement, estimation, sprint cadence, flow and cycle\-time metrics — and the judgment to know which ceremonies are earning their cost. * Comfort with quantitative evaluation: you define success metrics before launch, read an instrumented result honestly, and change course when the data says so. * A humble learner who seeks out the perspectives of care team members and welcomes challenges to your own conclusions, and who thrives in a fast\-paced environment where scope is set rather than received. * An excellent cross\-functional collaborator — you build trusted working relationships with product design, engineering, and data science, and move comfortably between writing a spec, reviewing a Figma file, and triaging a bug. * Operate with a self\-starter, scrappy mentality — pick up ambiguous problems and move work forward without waiting for a heavy process or a fully\-staffed team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience as the first or only product manager on a product surface, establishing the practice rather than inheriting it. * Experience shipping products built on machine learning or LLM\-based systems, including human\-in\-the\-loop review patterns and their evaluation. * Experience working with Medicaid populations, community health workers, or safety\-net care delivery. * Experience in healthcare delivery, digital health, or health\-tech — particularly with electronic health records, clinical ordering, e\-prescribing, laboratory integrations, claims (837P), or health information exchange. * Experience using AI tools to make data\-informed decisions, analyze complex datasets, and understand code well enough to investigate and triage bugs effectively. **Hiring Range** The expected hiring range for this role is $111,000 – $130,000, depending on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications. *This is a remote role, however, candidates living in certain high\-cost of living cities such as San Francisco, New York City, and Seattle, may be eligible for an additional market premium.* **In addition to salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Here's what you can expect:** * Stock Options: Opportunity to invest in the company's growth. * Work\-from\-Home Stipend: A dedicated stipend for your first year to help set up your home office. * Medical, Vision, and Dental Coverage: Comprehensive plans to keep you and your family healthy. * Life Insurance: Basic life insurance to give you peace of mind. * Paid Time Off: 20 vacation days, accrued over the year, plus 11 paid holidays. * Parental Leave: 16 weeks of paid leave for birthing parents after six months of employment, and 8 weeks of bonding leave for non\-birthing parents. * Retirement Savings: Access to a 401(k) plan with a company contribution, subject to a vesting schedule. * Commuter Benefits: Convenient options to support your commute needs. * Professional Development Stipend: A dedicated stipend supports professional development and growth. Offer of employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Employment history and advanced degree/professional license verification (when applicable) are included as part of the standard background check process. *Don't check off every box in the requirements listed above? Please apply anyway! Studies have shown that some of us may be less likely to apply to jobs unless we meet every single qualification. Waymark is dedicated to building a supportive, equal opportunity, and accessible workplace that fosters a sense of belonging – so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every preferred qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still consider submitting an application. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings!*

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **About Company:** At Web Industries, we’re not your typical company—we’re 100% employee\-owned (ESOP), which means this isn’t just a job… it’s *your* company. That’s right—you’re not just showing up to work every day, you’re helping build something with a purpose. Our founder, Bob Fulton, believed that the people who create the value should share in the success—and we’ve been proving that true ever since. We thrive on the energy that comes from people being open, honest, and working together toward shared goals. It’s what makes us successful—and it’s what makes work here different. **How We Show Up Every Day** We don’t just talk about values—we live them:* Heart of an Owner – We take pride, show accountability, and treat the business like it’s ours… because it is. * Stronger Together – Great things happen when we collaborate, support each other, and win as a team. * Find a Way – We bring grit, creativity, and determination to every challenge—and we don’t stop until we figure it out. **What You Can Expect** Working at Web means being part of something bigger. You’ll experience a mix of people, cultures, industries, and technologies that keep things fresh, interesting, and always evolving. We believe your experience matters—because when our people thrive, our business thrives. That’s why we’re committed to helping you build a career that’s both rewarding and meaningful. **Perks That Matter (Because You Matter)** We’ve got your health, wealth, and well\-being covered:* Health \& Wellness * + Comprehensive Medical, Dental \& Vision coverage starting on your first day + Company\-paid Short\- and Long\-Term Disability; Life and AD\&D insurance (with optional add\-ons) and other voluntary insurances + Access to a robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental health support + Award\-winning Wellness Program with discounts and incentives * Wealth \& Future * + 401(k) retirement plan + Employee Stock Ownership Program (ESOP) – yes, ownership! * Time \& Flexibility * + Generous Paid Time Off, Sick Time, and Holidays * Growth \& Development * Tuition Reimbursement * Ongoing training and career development opportunities **Bottom Line?** At Web Industries, you’re not just building a career, you’re part of an employee ownership community with opportunities and a future you can be proud of. About the Role: **Location: Marlborough, MA** **POSITION SUMMARY** The IT Software Engineer / Developer to be responsible for analysis, design, development and testing of .NET solutions which support enterprise business applications (ERP, MES, QMS, CRM, HRIS, Manufacturing, and Reporting) to meet the needs of the diverse markets we serve. The role requires a strong aptitude for understanding and analyzing business processes and the ability to design and develop simple yet optimal solutions. The individual must have a solid understanding of integration/replication techniques between on premise, hosted, and cloud applications in order to facilitate enterprise data flow between these applications. **PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** * Develop and maintain high\-quality software solutions while supporting the organization’s standards and infrastructure using Microsoft .NET Framework * Visual Studio C\#, X\+\+ languages along with a solid understanding of Microsoft DevOps, SQL Server * Collaborates with end\-user teams to define software requirements and acts as an internal technical advisor in the design and development of systems management tools. * MS Dynamics 365 and data modeling * Responsible for analysis of current programs including performance, diagnosis and troubleshooting of problem programs, and designing solutions to problematic programming. Makes recommendations for software purchases and/or enhancements. * Performs any other function or responsibility as assigned. **Additional REQUIRED Qualifications/Skills:** Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or related field * Solid Understanding of MS Visual Studio, .NET framework, WinForms development * SQL Server Transact\-SQL and relational modeling * Good communication skills and ability to work within a Team and independently ***Additional PREFERRED Qualifications/Skills:*** * Dynamics 365 X\+\+ familiarity * LLBLGen Pro familiarity **Must be eligible to work on government contracts.**

jobs.title: Data Platform Architect
jobs.description: **General Summary** Provides technical leadership for enterprise data platform design, operational architecture, platform standards, environment strategy, and platform modernization. Translates enterprise architecture direction into secure, reliable, scalable, and operationally viable platform designs that support data engineering, analytics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, business intelligence, and reusable enterprise data products across business domains. **Duties and Responsibilities** **Essential Functions:** * Defines target architecture, reference patterns, standards, and technical roadmaps for enterprise data platforms, including lake, lakehouse, warehouse, streaming, integration, and analytics capabilities. * Designs platform operating models, environment and workspace strategies, provisioning approaches, and reusable platform services that support multiple business domains. * Establishes security, identity, access, privacy, network, data protection, and information lifecycle patterns with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data governance, and infrastructure teams. * Translates enterprise architecture standards and business requirements into operationally viable platform designs, architecture decisions, implementation guidance, and modernization plans. * Guides the architecture of Databricks, cloud data services, orchestration, metadata, catalog, observability, and data movement capabilities that support governed enterprise data products. * Defines engineering patterns for continuous integration and delivery, source control, automated testing, infrastructure and configuration practices, deployment, monitoring, and operational recovery. * Leads architecture reviews and quality assurance for platform and data engineering solutions, identifying risks, dependencies, technical debt, and opportunities for reuse and simplification. * Evaluates emerging platform technologies and recommends adoption, integration, or retirement decisions based on strategic fit, security, reliability, scalability, interoperability, and cost. * Partners with Data Engineering, Platform Operations, Data Architecture, Cogito, analytics, and business\-aligned delivery teams to support enterprise platform onboarding and adoption. * Guides platform modernization and operational improvement initiatives, including workspace improvements, migration patterns, performance optimization, monitoring, and support readiness. * Documents platform architecture, standards, reference implementations, decision records, service boundaries, dependencies, and operational requirements. * Provides technical leadership, mentoring, and consultation while promoting common standards across the federated data and analytics operating model. **Common Expectations:** * Demonstrates commitment to WellSpan values, service excellence, security, privacy, responsible data use, and stewardship of enterprise information assets. * Participates in architecture governance, planning, incident and problem reviews, roadmap development, and continuous improvement. * Maintains current knowledge of cloud data platforms, platform engineering, healthcare data practices, security, governance, and emerging data and AI technologies. **Qualifications** **Minimum Education:** * High School Diploma or GED Required **Work Experience:** * 10\+ years Required **Courses and Training:** * Databricks Data Engineer Associate/Professional or equivalent cloud data certification Upon Hire Preferred * Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst Associate or equivalent BI certification Upon Hire Preferred **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Advanced knowledge of enterprise data platform architecture, data lakes, lakehouse and warehouse designs, distributed computing, real\-time data distribution, integration, metadata, and platform operating models * Proficiency designing modern cloud data architectures using Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud and platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Apache Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Oracle, relational databases, and NoSQL technologies * Strong understanding of security and access architecture, privacy, networking, identity, encryption, secrets management, data protection, governance, catalog capabilities, and enterprise risk controls * Knowledge of platform engineering practices including environment and workspace strategy, continuous integration and delivery, source control, automated testing, observability, monitoring, reliability, and disaster recovery * Ability to create architecture roadmaps, standards, reference patterns, decision records, technical designs, and reusable services that simplify the technology landscape and align platform capabilities with business needs * Ability to evaluate traditional and emerging data and AI technologies, identify architectural tradeoffs, and recommend solutions based on strategic fit, interoperability, scalability, reliability, security, readiness, and cost **Benefits Offered:** * Comprehensive health benefits * Flexible spending and health savings accounts * Retirement savings plan * Paid time off (PTO) * Short\-term disability * Education assistance * Financial education and support, including DailyPay * Wellness and Wellbeing programs * Caregiver support via Wellthy * Childcare referral service via Wellthy

jobs.title: Principal AI Engineer – Enterprise Generative AI
jobs.description: Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal AI Engineer to serve as a senior technical leader driving the design, scale, and operationalize of enterprise Generative AI solutions across the firm. This role sits at the intersection of AI platform engineering, business use‑case delivery, and risk‑aware execution, and is critical to accelerating initiatives such as DASH (Employee Virtual Assistant), intent routing, and LOB‑embedded GenAI use cases. As a Principal Engineer, you will own end‑to‑end technical strategy, influence architecture across multiple teams, and act as a force multiplier for GenAI adoption through a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) model—embedding deeply with business partners while staying aligned with central AI platforms and governance. **Key Responsibilities** * Own and define enterprise‑grade GenAI architectures, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, prompt orchestration, and multi‑model routing strategies. * Drive production readiness for GenAI solutions, ensuring scalability, resilience, observability, and cost efficiency. * Lead complex architectural decisions spanning data ingestion, vector databases, model selection, guardrails, latency optimization, and API scalability. * Establish reference architectures and reusable patterns to accelerate GenAI adoption across Lines of Business. * Enterprise Use‑Case Delivery (FDE Model) * Act as a Forward Deployed Principal Engineer, partnering directly with business and product teams to deliver high‑impact GenAI use cases from ideation to production. * Translate business problems into well‑defined AI system designs and NFRs, ensuring measurable outcomes. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex production issues across non‑prod and prod environments. * Influence platform roadmap by feeding real‑world use‑case requirements back into central AI services (e.g., Tachyon). * Governance, Risk \& Compliance * Ensure all AI solutions align with Wells Fargo risk, cyber, and model governance standards, including AIRR, data protection, and guardrails. * Partner with Cyber, MRM, Legal, and Risk teams to design compliant AI patterns without slowing delivery. * Embed security, privacy, and ethical AI principles into solution design by default. * Organizational Influence \& Mentorship * Serve as a recognized GenAI expert across the enterprise—regularly consulted by engineering, architecture, and leadership teams. * Mentor senior and staff‑level engineers; raise the technical bar across teams. * Contribute to internal communities of practice, architecture reviews, and executive‑level technical discussions. * Represent Wells Fargo GenAI capabilities in internal innovation forums and knowledge‑sharing sessions **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of software engineering experience, with significant depth in AI/ML or data‑intensive systems. * 2\+ Years of experience in Python programming language. * 2\+ Proven experience designing and delivering production‑scale Generative AI systems in an enterprise environment. * 2\+ years of experience in: + LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG architecture + Vector databases and semantic search + API‑driven, cloud‑native architectures + Distributed systems and performance optimization **Desired Qualifications** * Strong understanding of non‑functional requirements: security, scalability, resiliency, observability, and cost management. * Demonstrated Principal‑level impact: influence across multiple teams, platforms, or business units. * Experience operating in highly regulated environments (financial services strongly preferred). * Hands‑on experience with agentic AI frameworks and multi‑model orchestration. * Prior experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer or embedded engineering model. * Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to senior executives and non‑technical stakeholders. **Job Expectations** * **Must be based in one of the above locations or willing to relocate at your own expense.** * Relocation assistance is not available for this position. * This position currently offers a hybrid work schedule. * This position is not eligible for Visa sponsorship. **Posting End Date:** 2 Nov 2026* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.*** **We Value Equal Opportunity** Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance\-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements. Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process. **Applicants with Disabilities** To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo. **Drug and Alcohol Policy** Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more. **Wells Fargo Recruitment and Hiring Requirements:** a. Third\-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo. b. Wells Fargo requires you to directly represent your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: The Challenge Within3 is building the next generation of its platform, and we’re looking for a Frontend Engineer to help shape it from the ground up. You will work closely with product, design and backend engineers to build a fast, accessible and polished experience used by clinicians and researchers around the world. What you can expect from the opportunity * Build new product experiences: Turn Figma designs and product specs into new features using React and TypeScript. * Shape the frontend architecture: Help define the architecture, patterns and reusable component library for the new platform. * Integrate with our APIs: Work with GraphQL APIs using Apollo Client, and manage client\-side state and caching. * Test and ship with confidence: Write reliable tests with React Testing Library and Cypress, and help keep our CI/CD pipeline (CircleCI) healthy. * Own frontend quality: Take responsibility for performance, accessibility, observability (logging and session replay) and cross\-browser support. * Raise the bar: Collaborate in an agile team, review code and help lift frontend standards across engineering. **Requirements** What you need to grow and succeed * React and TypeScript: 3\+ years of experience building single\-page applications (SPAs) with React and TypeScript. * CSS and UX: Strong CSS skills and a good eye for detail and UX. * State and data\-fetching: Experience with client\-side state management and data\-fetching using Apollo Client and GraphQL. * Testing: Experience with testing frameworks, preferably React Testing Library and Cypress. * Async and performance: A solid grasp of asynchronous patterns and frontend performance. * Build tooling: Experience with modern build tools, including Webpack, Babel, ESLint and Docker containers. * Observability: Experience integrating frontend logging and session replay tools. * Collaboration tools: Experience with engineering collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence. * Live and have the right to work within the US. Nice to have * Industry experience: Experience in healthcare, life sciences or other regulated industries. * Scrum: Experience working in a Scrum environment. * Design libraries: An understanding of common design libraries, preferably MUI. * AI\-assisted development: Hands\-on experience with Claude Code and agentic programming workflows, using AI coding agents to plan, build, test and review code, with sound judgement on the quality of what they produce. Technical skills are important, but so are attitude, curiosity, ownership and the ability to work well with others. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Work From Home Don't meet every single requirement?
