At Within3 we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. Within3 is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We invite you to consider opportunities at Within3 regardless of gender; gender identity; gender reassignment; age; religious or similar philosophical belief; race; national origin; political opinion; sexual orientation; disability; marital or civil partnership status or other non\-merit factor.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Identity
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** Workday is strategically expanding into the identity management space to govern access for both employees and AI agents across the enterprise. As enterprise adoption of autonomous agents accelerates, CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs are facing a critical governance challenge: how to manage identity, access, provisioning, lifecycle automation, and least\-privilege controls across a combined workforce of people and AI agents. Workday is establishing a specialized Identity sales team focused on helping enterprise customers modernize identity governance and access management for this new era of work. This team will partner with customers to articulate how Workday's identity governance capabilities, expected to become part of Workday's Agent System of Record, can help reduce access risk, strengthen compliance, automate identity lifecycle processes, and unlock trusted AI adoption at scale. The Revenue organization at Workday is grounded in integrity, innovation, accountability, and collaboration. We are looking for experienced enterprise sellers who can build trusted executive relationships, lead complex security and identity focused sales cycles, and help accelerate market adoption in a strategic growth area for Workday. **About the Role** You are an experienced enterprise seller who combines identity and security fluency, executive presence, and disciplined sales execution. You are comfortable engaging CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, senior technology leaders, security executives, and ecosystem partners while navigating complex, multi\-stakeholder sales cycles. You know how to build trusted customer relationships, uncover operational and compliance risk, shape executive level value propositions, orchestrate internal resources, and connect identity governance capabilities to measurable business outcomes. You bring credibility in conversations about identity governance, access management, provisioning, access reviews, least\-privilege enforcement, lifecycle automation, compliance, AI governance, cloud architecture, and enterprise transformation. This is an overlay sales role. You will partner closely with Core Account Executives and cross\-functional teams to develop opportunities, advance executive engagement, and help position Workday's identity governance capabilities as a strategic part of Workday's broader platform, AI, and agent governance vision. **Key Focus \& Responsibilities:** * **Own complex enterprise identity sales cycles.** Lead identity governance opportunities from discovery through negotiation and close. Build account strategies, qualify opportunities, shape executive\-level value propositions, and progress opportunities with discipline across large, matrixed enterprise accounts. * **Build trusted executive relationships.** Engage CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and senior technology leaders to position Workday as a strategic enterprise software partner for identity governance, agentic AI governance, access modernization, and enterprise risk reduction. * **Connect identity and security priorities to business value.** Translate customer needs across identity governance, provisioning, access reviews, least\-privilege enforcement, lifecycle automation, security, compliance, AI governance, and enterprise transformation into clear value\-based sales strategies. * **Orchestrate cross functional teams.** Partner with Core Account Executives, Solution Consultants, Forward Deployed Engineers, Value Managers, product, customer success, partner teams, and sales support to deliver compelling customer outcomes and support complex deal execution. * **Develop pipeline and identify timely opportunities.** Build pipeline across assigned accounts by identifying business events, security priorities, identity modernization initiatives, AI governance needs, compliance requirements, and keholders. * **Cross\-ecosystem interoperability.** Ability to position identity governance capabilities as an interoperable component of a customer’s broader IT, security, cloud, data, application, and AI ecosystem. * **Enterprise sales discipline.** Strong command of account planning, qualification, pipeline generation, stakeholder mapping, executive engagement, mutual action planning, negotiation, and complex deal execution. **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role\-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . Primary Location: USA.IL.Chicago Primary Location Base Pay Range: $130,000 USD \- $195,000 USD Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $130,000 USD \- $195,000 USD **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law. Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible. **Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!** At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers. Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not. In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

The role begins with the operating model, runbooks, automation, monitoring, logging, identity\-integration design, escalation paths, and readiness processes required before platform deployment. As the platform is deployed, Sustainment Engineers will support incident response, configuration and baseline maintenance, patch coordination, capacity and performance monitoring, change management, and knowledge transfer. The role requires disciplined production operations and a strong focus on enabling VA personnel to assume operational responsibility by the end of the period of performance. **KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** · Contribute to the sustainment operating model, support procedures, escalation paths, operational readiness plans, runbooks, and service\-support workflows. · Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 operational support, incident triage, troubleshooting, and service restoration for platform\-attributable incidents within the agreed severity and response framework. · Maintain platform configurations, approved baselines, inventory, configuration backups, operational records, and change history. · Coordinate patch management with the applicable OEM lifecycle and approved maintenance procedures. · Monitor capacity and performance against discovery baselines and the capacity\-sizing model; identify trends, risks, and recommended corrective actions. · Support monitoring, logging, identity integration, alert tuning, service health checks, and operational reporting. · Coordinate all changes through Department\-designated change\-management tooling and respect change freezes and dependencies involving enterprise programs and application owners. · Prepare for production\-impacting events through documented escalation, recovery, validation, and communications procedures; exercises. · Work with platform engineers, architects, security personnel, automation engineers, and the Training Lead to ensure operational procedures reflect the implemented environment. · Provide shadowing and reverse\-shadowing opportunities and coach VA subject matter experts through routine and complex operating procedures. · Prepare monthly operations information, incident records, change records, capacity observations, problem analyses, and lessons learned as required by the reporting model. **CORE RESPONSIBILITY AREAS** · Operations readiness, runbooks, and operational model development · Tier 2/Tier 3 support, incident response, and troubleshooting · Configuration baseline, patch, backup, and change management · Capacity/performance monitoring and operational reporting · Shadow/reverse\-shadow knowledge transfer to VA staff **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** · Prior experience supporting a federal agency as a contractor is required, including familiarity with Government operations experience**. \- **REQUIRED** \* Experience with Tier 2/Tier 3 support, on\-call escalation, HA failover, upgrades, performance monitoring, and certificate management. \* Experience in federal or FISMA High environments. \* Experience with automation, configuration backup/recovery, centralized logging, monitoring, and identity integrations. **EDUCATION** · Associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, networking, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent directly relevant experience. · Relevant platform or operations certifications are preferred. jobs.title: Software Developer 2
jobs.description: **Software Developer 2** *Location:* Centennial, CO (In\-Office) *Company:* RefiJet *Reports to:* Director of Software Development **The Opportunity** RefiJet processes a high volume of auto refinance applications every month across a network of 30\+ lending partners. The software running that operation spans borrower\-facing applications, lender integrations, and internal tools used by our operations teams. The quality, reliability, and usability of that software directly affects real financial outcomes for real people. Software Developer 2 is the level where you stop needing the work handed to you fully defined. You already know how to ship. This role is about widening what you can be trusted with: features that touch more than one system, requirements that arrive incomplete, and problems where the right answer is not obvious from the ticket. You will work across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, lender integrations, and internal operations tools. This level carries in both directions. You are still learning, and you still have people invested in your development: structured code review, a manager whose job includes your growth, and senior engineers who will make you better when you use them. You are also now someone other people learn from. You will mentor Software Developer 1 engineers, review their code with care rather than speed, and answer the questions that are still hard when you are new to a codebase. Carrying someone else is part of the job at this level, not an extra. We are deliberately stack and platform agnostic. We care that you can think clearly, learn a codebase quickly, and write code other engineers can build on. We do not care which language or framework you learned first. The specific technologies you will work in are covered in the interview process, and they will change over the course of your career here. The fundamentals will not. **Location and schedule.** Plan on five days per week on site in Centennial, Colorado. We say that plainly instead of calling the role hybrid, because the mentoring and cross\-team work this level depends on happens faster in person and because we would rather be clear now than surprise you at offer stage. One or two remote days per week may become available once you are established and performing well. You earn it, the Director of Software Development decides it, and no date is attached to it. **What You'll Do \- Key Responsibilities** **Strategy \& Leadership** At this level, leadership means owning outcomes rather than tasks, and starting to make the engineers around you better. * Own the features and components assigned to you end to end, including design decisions within an agreed approach, testing, release, and support after release * Mentor Software Developer 1 engineers through pairing, code review, and onboarding, and treat their questions as part of your workload rather than an interruption * Review code as a contributor of useful feedback, not a rubber stamp. Catch the design problem, not only the style problem. * Push back on work that does not hold together, and propose the alternative rather than only naming the objection * Estimate your own work with enough accuracy that others can plan around it, and communicate a slipping estimate before the date, not after * Improve how the team works by strengthening documentation, tightening standards, and reducing recurring toil * Represent engineering credibly in conversations with product, operations, and other internal partners, including explaining technical constraints in terms a non\-engineer can act on **Discovery \& Execution** * Deliver features across frontend applications, backend services, APIs, and internal tools, including work that spans more than one service or team boundary * Take a requirement that is incomplete or ambiguous, ask the questions that make it concrete, and turn it into a workable plan before writing code * Author specifications for your own work and review specifications written by others, under our spec\-driven development practice in which a feature is specified in writing and agreed before it is built * Design and build API integrations, including work with external lending partner systems, with attention to error handling, retries, idempotency, and failure modes * Model and query data correctly, and understand the performance and integrity consequences of the schema and queries you write * Write and maintain automated tests that give the team real confidence, and recognize when a test is protecting behavior rather than only raising coverage * Debug production issues methodically, identify the actual cause, verify the fix, and record what you learned so the next person does not repeat it * Participate in release, deployment, monitoring, and production support for the systems you build * Use AI\-assisted development tools as part of normal daily work, and remain fully accountable for every line you ship, whether you or a tool wrote it first **Growth \& O er data responsibly and follow all internal security, privacy, and data handling requirements. We operate in a regulated industry. Careful data handling is a condition of the role, not a preference. * Never move production data into a non\-production environment, share credentials, or work around a security control to save time. If a control is blocking legitimate work, escalate it and help fix the control. * Contribute to a collaborative engineering culture by being dependable, communicative, and open to feedback **Required Skills \& Experience** This list is short and every item on it is real. If you meet these, apply. * Professional experience building and maintaining production web applications across both frontend and backend, with a track record of features you delivered end to end * Working proficiency in a modern backend language and a modern frontend framework, with enough depth to debug problems in both * Practical experience with REST APIs or service\-to\-service integration, including handling failures rather than only the happy path * Practical experience with relational databases, including writing queries you can reason about and schema changes you can defend * Experience writing automated tests and using them to ship with confidence * Experience debugging issues in a running production system * Comfortable working from written specifications, and able to identify when a specification is wrong or incomplete * Version control fluency with Git and collaborative development workflows * Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a technical tradeoff to someone who is not an engineer * Demonstrated ability to give and receive feedback constructively * Legally authorized to work in the United States, and able to work on site in Centennial, CO five days per week **Education:** No specific degree is required. A computer science or related degree, a bootcamp, self\-directed learning, or equivalent practical experience are all acceptable paths. We evaluate demonstrated ability. **On experience level:** This role is scoped for roughly 2 to 5 years of professional experience. Range is a proxy, not the bar. If you are outside it in either direction and the rest of this description fits, apply anyway and let us make the call. **Nice to Have** None of the following is required, and their absence will not remove you from consideration. * Experience owning a feature area or service that other engineers depended on * Experience mentoring or onboarding a more junior engineer * Experience integrating with third\-party or partner APIs where you did not control the other side * Experience with containerized or cloud\-hosted environments and the deployment pipeline that reaches them * Experience with observability tooling, including tracing a real incident through logs and metrics * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools with good judgment about when to trust them * Interest in fintech, lending platforms, or transaction\-heavy software products * Experience with auto lending, auto refinancing, or consumer credit products. * Familiarity with loan origination systems (LOS), credit decisioning, or lending infrastructure. * Experience working with external partners or B2B clients in a product\-led organization. **Compensation \& Benefits** **Base Salary:** $108,000 \- $137,000 annually, commensurate with experience **Bonus:** Eligible for an annual performance\-based bonus with a defined target percentage of base salary, tied to company and individual goals. **Benefits:** Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k), PTO, career development opportunities, and the chance to join Denver's Best Place to Work (2024 \& 2025\) with a dynamic culture focused on internal promotion and employee growth. **Equal Opportunity Statement** Yield Solutions Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants.

jobs.title: Onsite Network Engineer
jobs.description: Company Description Yoda Tech Pte. Ltd., based in Singapore, focuses on dividing aspects of digitalization into small logical micro\-initiatives using ready\-to\-use Micro\-bots, instead of large transformational initiatives. This approach aims to reduce IT Operations spending. Our core areas include Automate \+ Robotize, Power Application Development, Infrastructure, Maintenance, and Support. Summary We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented Intermediate Onsite Network Engineer to join our IT infrastructure team. In this role, you will provide hands\-on support for local area networks, manage core networking hardware, and ensure seamless connectivity and secure office communications. The ideal candidate will have solid experience with enterprise routing, switching, wireless environments, and firewall administration. This position requires strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced office setting. Key Responsibilities * Provide tier\-2 technical support for office networking infrastructure, including troubleshooting routers, switches, access points, and firewalls. * Manage network provisioning and configuration processes for new office expansions, hardware deployments, and port activations. * Configure and maintain enterprise Wi\-Fi networks in office and conference spaces, ensuring seamless roaming, high bandwidth availability, and guest network security. * Perform basic network administration tasks, such as VLAN configuration, subnetting, DHCP/DNS management, and access control list (ACL) implementation. * Deploy and maintain firmware updates, patches, and configurations across network switches and firewalls for compliance and security reporting. * Support network monitoring and security tools, tracking bandwidth utilization, identifying bottlenecks, and troubleshooting connectivity issues. * Collaborate with remote IT and security teams to escalate complex network incidents and contribute to network architecture documentation and knowledge base updates. * Conduct routine hardware audits, structured cabling, rack management, and basic physical troubleshooting in the office telecommunications room. * Ensure data security and compliance by following corporate network security policies and industry best practices. Required Skills and Experience Technical Expertise: * Proficient in enterprise networking hardware administration (e.g., Cisco, Aruba, or Juniper switches, routers, and firewalls), including installation, configuration, and maintenance. * Strong experience with LAN/WAN routing protocols (e.g., OSPF, BGP) and VLAN segmentation. * Hands\-on experience with wireless network controllers and guest portal provisioning workflows. * Skilled in setting up and troubleshooting site\-to\-site VPNs, remote access solutions, and network security protocols. * Basic knowledge of core network services including Active Directory\-integrated DNS and DHCP. * Familiarity with network monitoring and management tools (e.g., SNMP, PRTG, or SolarWinds) for performance tracking and inventory management. * Working knowledge of structured cabling standards (Cat6/Fiber optics), rack layouts, and patch panel management. Soft Skills: * Excellent customer service and communication skills to interact with non\-technical users and coordinate with vendors. * Ability to prioritize tasks in a dynamic environment and document network resolutions clearly. * Strong analytical mindset for diagnosing and resolving complex network routing or latency issues efficiently. Experience: * 5 plus years of network engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on enterprise network environments and infrastructure administration. * Proven track record in on\-site support roles, including hardware rack\-and\-stack, structured cabling, and network device deployment. Pay: $4,000\.00 \- $6,000\.00 per month Application Question(s): * How many years of hands\-on experience do you have in enterprise network engineering and administration? * How many years of hands\-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise routers, switches, VLANs, wireless access points, and firewalls, including routing protocols such as OSPF or BGP? * Are you legally authorized to work in the United States? * How soon are you available to start? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Policy Manager, YouTube Trust and Safety
jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Bruno, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 7 years of experience in data analytics, trust and safety, policy, cybersecurity, business strategy, or related fields. * 1 year of experience in people management, leading a team. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience as a thought leader and team lead or people manager in an investigative, anti\-abuse environment (e.g., content abuse, spam, or other behavioral abuse). * Ability to work in a rapidly\-changing industry and manage ambiguity while minimizing uncertainty through quantitative insights. * Ability to lead a team to frame problems, structure analyses, and drive impact. * Ability to build effective relationships with cross\-functional partners across geographies. * Excellent strategic and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent business judgment, influencing, and communication skills. **About the job** ----------------- Trust \& Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know\-how, excellent problem\-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big\-picture thinker and strategic team\-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross\-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed \- with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety. As a Trust and Safety Policy Manager, you’re a skilled and experienced people manager. You are adept at context switching and multi\-tasking, and someone who naturally rallies colleagues around shared goals. You will manage a team of skilled Policy Leads working on content moderation challenges facing YouTube today. Your team will focus on Adversarial Abuse Policy Development, operating on the front lines of platform defense. Bad actors do not play by traditional rules—they rapidly adapt and weaponize cutting\-edge technologies to execute coordinated spam campaigns, synthetic media impersonations, and sophisticated scams. In this role, you will act as the critical bridge between behavioral threat analysis, machine learning engineering, operations, and product strategy. This role will sometimes involve reviewing graphic, controversial, or offensive video content in line with YouTube’s Community Guidelines and our policies for the YouTube Partner Program. At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, LLM Inference Platform
jobs.description: **About Zenlayer** Zenlayer is the first massively distributed edge cloud provider, operating 290\+ Points of Presence across 70\+ countries. For models ranging from hundreds of billions to trillions of parameters (including MoE), you will continuously reduce **cost per million tokens** and increase **per\-GPU Goodput** while meeting TTFT/TPOT SLOs, and prove the gain from every optimization with reproducible data. **What You Will Work On** **1\. End\-to\-End Performance Attribution and Benchmarking** * Establish a unified Token Performance metrics framework (TTFT, TPOT, Goodput, GPU utilization, per\-token cost), and build load\-testing benchmarks that reflect real production traffic (high concurrency, long context, multi\-turn Agent workloads) * Perform bottleneck attribution for models such as DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen, and MiniMax across compute, memory bandwidth, communication, scheduling, and queuing, and let the data determine which layer is the dominant constraint **2\. Kernel\-Level Inference Engine Optimization** * Dive deep into the source code of vLLM / SGLang / TensorRT\-LLM, customizing and contributing upstream on critical paths such as the scheduler, Continuous Batching, Chunked Prefill, CUDA Graph, and KV block management * Clearly define the responsibility boundary between the inference engine and orchestration layers such as Dynamo / llm\-d, and reduce tail latency through request routing and load balancing **3\. PD Disaggregation and KV Cache Transfer** * Lead the core design of Prefill\-Decode disaggregation: the KV transfer path (NIXL/RDMA/UCX), transfer\-compute overlap, and phase\-aware autoscaling * Define the failure domains and recovery semantics of cross\-instance KV transfer, and answer the key question: under which workloads does PD disaggregation deliver gains, and under which does it make things slower **4\.** **MoE** **Parallelism and Wide\-EP** * Design hybrid TP/PP/DP/EP parallelism strategies and quantify the trade\-offs between EP and TP * Tackle expert load imbalance and All\-to\-All communication overhead, and drive Wide\-EP into production **5\. Kernels and Quantization** * Write and tune critical CUDA (and ROCm/HIP) operators: memory access optimization, kernel fusion, and Attention / MoE / communication\-related kernels * Build a closed\-loop "quantization – accuracy – throughput" evaluation: the real\-world gains and accuracy regressions of FP8/FP4/INT4/AWQ/GPTQ across different engines and hardware **Requirements** * First\-principles understanding of Transformer inference: the compute vs. memory\-bound nature of Prefill and Decode, the KV Cache memory model, the differences among MHA/GQA/MLA, and how MoE routing constrains parallelism * Source\-level, in\-depth experience with at least one mainstream inference engine, with real cases of identifying and fixing bottlenecks in scheduling, kernel selection, or KV management * CUDA kernel tuning skills (Nsight profiling, memory optimization, fusion, CUDA Graph) with hands\-on practical experience * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field (HPC systems, ML Systems). * Minimum 6 years in systems/Performance Engineering, with at least 2\-3 years directly on LLM or GPU performance work **Preferred, but not** **required****:** * Experience with Merged PRs in vLLM * Experience operating at cluster sale (hundreds to thousands of GPUs)

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.description: Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. We are looking for proactive, results\-driven individuals to join our dynamic team. The Senior Product Engineer owns technically complex product initiatives from problem definition through release. You'll have the accountability of a product owner (you own the outcome, the scope decisions, and getting it across the finish line to customer success and marketing) along with the engineering depth to design and build much of the solution yourself. This is not a traditional product owner role and not a traditional engineering role. A product owner defines what should be built and hands it off. Our engineering team owns the platform: the frameworks, components, security, performance, and delivery standards that keep our application consistent. A Product Engineer builds on that foundation to deliver usable features quickly. You'll take an ambiguous problem, understand the domain and the users, make sound decisions about application logic and data flow, and carry it from early prototype to beta to full release. This role sits on the product team and reports to the CTO. Today, the CTO sets priorities and assigns initiatives across this role and our product owner. You'll be assigned initiatives where a handoff between a product owner and an engineer would lose too much in translation: complex workflow\-driven features, rapid prototyping, AI integrations, and UI overhauls that require deep knowledge of how the application works underneath. **Requirements**### **Responsibilities:** Deliver product initiatives * Take high\-ambiguity projects from discovery through release, including scoping, technical design, implementation, QA coordination, rollout, handoff to customer success and marketing, and post\-launch iteration. * Turn early ideas into working prototypes quickly, test them with real users, and carry the strongest ones through beta to full release. * Set clear acceptance criteria and success metrics, instrument features with product analytics, and use the data to decide what to improve next. Build complex, user\-facing features * Design and deliver workflow\-driven, multi\-step features with state, rules, and edge cases, such as lien intake, case status progression, negotiation tracking, and approval flows, where the logic matters as much as the interface. * Identify where AI can meaningfully reduce manual work (document processing, intake automation, data extraction, summarization) and turn those ideas into reliable, production\-grade features with appropriate human review and fallbacks. * Rework confusing or outdated screens into clear, consistent experiences, partnering with product design and using the established design system and component framework rather than reinventing them. * Build features hands\-on within the engineering team's frameworks and standards. Bring in engineers for larger pieces of work, such as significant backend changes, and take part in architectural decisions. Partner across the business and team * Work directly with lien negotiators, customer success, support, and law firm users to understand the real problem, then make informed tradeoffs on scope, complexity, and timeline. * Bring user data and findings into roadmap and prioritization discussions. * Raise the bar on how we build. Model a fast, pragmatic, user\-centered approach to delivery, and share what you learn with the product and engineering teams. ### **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, with meaningful time spent building user\-facing applications (frontend, full\-stack, or UI engineering backgrounds are a strong fit) * Demonstrated ownership of features or projects from concept to production, beyond executing predefined tickets * Experience working directly with users or business stakeholders to define requirements, and keeping those relationships strong through notice when a requirement doesn't match the user's actual problem, and are comfortable cutting scope to ship something valuable * Ability to work through ambiguity and make decisions with incomplete information * Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, including explaining engineering complexity in plain terms to stakeholders * Hands\-on experience with processing) * Familiarity with product analytics tools (e.g., PostHog), project tracking tools like Jira/Confluence, and cloud platforms like AWS * Ability to work on\-site at least three days per week (60%) in our Franklin, TN office Nice to Have * Experience in a product owner, product manager, or technical lead capacity * Background in workflow\-heavy B2B software, legal tech, healthcare, insurance, or claims processing * Experience integrating with third\-party platforms such as Salesforce or legal case management systems like Filevine **Benefits** * Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Disability, Life, AD\&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options * 401(k) Plan with Company Match * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time \& 10 paid Holidays) * Parental Leave Pay Disclosure: The total base jobs.title: Senior Software Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Zipliens is a leading lien resolution company that specializes in streamlining the lien process for personal injury law firms. Our work helps law firms operate more efficiently and helps the injured people they serve access settlement funds more quickly and accurately. We are looking for a senior quality engineer who is passionate about setting the quality standards for a growing engineering team and building the testing and evaluation that keeps complex, data\-heavy products working correctly at scale. Zipliens is looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join our team and lead quality for the applications we build for the legal industry. After several years of high growth, Zipliens has become a leader in lien resolution, a process required in most personal injury settlements. The software we build supports that work, so the quality of what we ship has a clear, real\-world impact on law firms and the people they represent. We're scaling engineering significantly this year, and quality engineering is growing along with it. QA at Zipliens is embedded in the engineering teams and combines exploratory testing with automation. As the senior on the team, you'd set the standards the rest of the team works to: what sufficient coverage looks like, what gates a merge and a deploy, which frameworks and tools we standardize on, and how the quality engineers we add this year learn to think about risk. You'll have context available rather than a blank slate, and your judgment will shape the team's standards rather than just inheriting them. We also build with AI as a first\-class part of the workflow, and that applies to testing as much as to development. Our product uses LLMs to extract structure from medical records and lien correspondence, so deciding how non\-deterministic output gets validated before release is a core part of this role. We also use agentic coding tools and internal skills and harnesses we've written ourselves to build and maintain automation, and you'd be expected to use them well, set the standard for how their output gets reviewed, and evaluate new tools as they come along. **Requirements**### **Responsibilities:** * Lead quality for medium to large features, including ones that cross team boundaries. You'll own the risk analysis, the test strategy, the release criteria, and the final sign\-off. * Set, follow, and advocate for the team's test standards and frameworks, including what sufficient coverage means for the team and what a passing build is expected to guarantee. * Own the automation and CI/CD gating strategy: which suites run at which stage, what gates a merge versus a deploy, and how we keep suite runtime and flakiness under control so engineers trust the results. * Own the evaluation methodology for our LLM features, including sampling and significance, rubric design, regression gates on prompt and model changes, production quality monitoring and drift alerts, and re\-running golden sets when a vendor updates a model. * Set the team's standards for validating AI\-generated output, both in the product and in the tests and tooling we generate with AI. * Collaborate with the Product Owner to define Acceptance Criteria and release criteria, and serve as the primary QA point of contact for cross\-functional planning. * Evaluate and introduce new tools and AI capabilities for the team. * Mentor the quality engineers on the team and coach engineers on exploratory technique and risk\-based testing. We're adding people quickly this year; the seniors we hire now establish what good looks like for everyone who follows. * Weigh in on the testability of application designs early, while changes are still cheap to make. ### **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years on a QA or software development team, with experience across a range of products and test approaches. * Expert\-level skills in at least one of exploratory testing and test design, test automation and infrastructure, or AI/LLM evaluation, and solid proficiency in the other two. At this level we expect you to have set the methodology for a team, not only followed one. * Experience setting test standards and choosing frameworks for a team, and getting the team to adopt them. * Significant experience building and owning automation in a modern framework (Playwright, Cypress, pytest, or similar), including designing the CI/CD gating strategy around it. * Comfortable in code. Our backend is Python/Django and our frontend is React, and you'll be reviewing test code, reading changes for risk, and contributing to shared test infrastructure. * Strong SQL and PostgreSQL. Verifying a workflow here usually means verifying the data it produced as well as what the UI shows. * Hands\-on experience evaluating LLM or ML features in production: golden datasets, acceptance thresholds, calibrating LLM judges against human labels, and monitoring quality after release. * Experience using agentic coding tools for test work, and a clear view of where their output needs human review. * Experience mentoring quality engineers or developers and raising standards on a growing team. * Excellent written and verbal communication \- you'll be defining release criteria with product, explaining risk to non\-technical stakeholders, and making the case for quality investment to engineering leadership. ### **Nice to Have:** * Experience testing document processing or extraction from unstructured data, including defining acceptance thresholds for it. * Experience building or owning test infrastructure shared across multiple teams. * Experience testing third\-party integrations, especially where the counterparty's documentation isn't solid and you need contract tests, sandboxes, or recorded fixtures to work around it. * Familiarity with AWS and Kubernetes. We have an SRE who owns the cluster \- you won't be running it, but you'll be working with them on test environments and tracking down where a failure happened. * Experience handling sensitive data such as PHI, or working under HIPAA\-style requirements. **Benefits** * Private Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Company HSA contributions for HDHP participants * Flexible Spending Accounts (Health \& Dependent Care) * Company\-Paid Short\-Term Disability Coverage * Voluntary Long\-Term Disability, Life, AD\&D, and Supplemental Coverage Options * 401(k) Plan with Company Match * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick Time \& 10 paid Holidays) * Parental Leave Pay Disclosure: The total base salary range for this role is $98,000 \- $132,000 annually with an opportunity to earn a discretionary quarterly bonus. Final compensation will be determined based on skills and experience. jobs.title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Zuora** At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage\-based pricing to AI\-driven and outcome\-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue. We've led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we're evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI\-ready foundation. ### **The Opportunity** Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) is Zuora's newest technical go\-to\-market motion, pairing a Forward Deployed Product Manager (internally, an Echo) with one or two Forward Deployed Engineers inside fixed\-time customer engagements. This is a full\-time role: you'll run a portfolio of engagements deployed in weeks to months, building the playbook as you go. Our focus: building the future of agentic quote\-to\-cash, which means helping enterprises monetize AI\-native and usage\-based products, and taking Zuora's new AI agents into their first customer deployments. The job is to own the customer problem end to end and build the answer with the customer: turn a messy field signal into a working prototype, a clear specification and measurable success criteria, take the engagement from idea to production in weeks, not quarters, and leave behind a documented, reusable asset with a commercial next step. You'll work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Services and Support to keep every engagement tied to a real customer outcome. ### **What you'll do \& achieve** **Discover and design** * Run technical discovery with the customer's engineering, product and finance leaders. Map quote\-to\-cash workflows, exceptions, handoffs and control points, and define the prototype that proves the ideal end\-state integration and the success criteria it must meet. * Identify and prioritize agent use cases by value, data readiness and risk. Recommend what to automate, what to assist and what to leave to people. * Be the customer's primary day\-to\-day contact, and decide what is in and out of scope. **Specification \& signoff** * Draft the specification with your Forward Deployed Engineer: customer need, gap, build and maintainer of record, plus the agent spec (success metrics, acceptance criteria, level of autonomy, escalation paths and approval rules for any action in a system of record). Drive it through customer sponsor, FDE leadership and Product \& Engineering signoff. No unsigned builds. * Build golden datasets and eval plans with customer experts, and review results with your engineer at every gate. * Design human\-in\-the\-loop controls with the customer's Controllers and Internal Audit, including approvals, segregation of duties and audit evidence. **Co\-build with the customer** * Embed with the customer's engineering, product and finance teams and build alongside them and your Forward Deployed Engineer. You own the outcome, not a status report. * Ship to a fixed clock. Scope to what the customer's team can run after we leave, not the wishlist. * Start only with a named customer sponsor and a real resourcing commitment. The customer, not FDE, is usually the long pole on speed. * Build first: prototype agents, workflows and pricing models yourself with AI tools, and prove the idea on the customer's real data before engineering commits. * Pull in whatever the outcome needs: Zuora engineers, product, Services, partners, the customer's own people, or agents. Point them at the work; a great engagement puts far more hands on the problem than the pod alone. * Drive adoption through rollout, and report business impact (hours saved, errors reduced, faster close, cash collected) in terms an executive acts on. **Deploy agents and AI monetization** * Lead first customer deployments of Zuora's new AI agents, from deal desk and quoting to billing and revenue, and identify the use cases and customer segments they open up. * Lead AI\-monetization engagements: model usage, credit and hybrid pricing with the customer, and define how metering, entitlements, billing and revenue recognition fit together. **Reuse \& readout** * Own the engagement Brief (our standard exit write\-up of what was built, what broke, what's reusable and where it should live next) and the reuse case. Present at the monthly readout and quarterly portfolio review, and turn repeatable patterns into playbooks, product requirements and filed product gaps. **Commercial partnership** * Dual\-thread with the account team: the AE owns commercials, you own the technical buyer. Every engagement names its commercial next step before kickoff. **Enablement** * Mentor new teammates as the team grows, and act as the motion's evangelist across the field. ### **What we look for** * Builder. Show us what you've built: a product, workflow, agent or tool you shipped that real general controls experience, or a CPA or accounting background. * Founder or early\-team experience, ideally in AI monetization, agentic product development and deployment, or the quote\-to\-cash lifecycle: CPQ, contracts and orders, usage metering and rating, billing, payments, collections and AR, and revenue recognition. * Experience with subscription billing, usage\-based pricing, or monetization platforms. * Exposure to agentic or usage\-based AI pricing models, AI agents, or to a prior customer\-facing or forward\-deployed engineering role. **How we'll evaluate** Expect a deep\-dive walkthrough of something you've built, including how you used AI tools to build it, and a conversation about a time you pushed something through when it stalled. We look at judgment (what you delegated, what you checked, when you stopped trusting the output), curiosity and ownership, not just speed. **What success looks like** * Customers adopt Zuora's agents and AI\-monetization capabilities in production and keep using them, with business impact their executives recognize: hours saved, errors reduced, faster close, cash collected. * Each engagement opens the next: an expansion, a renewal, a reference customer, and a pattern the product team can pave. * The customer's team owns what we built, and the Brief makes the next engagement faster. ### **About the Team** As an industry pioneer, our work is constantly evolving and challenging us in new ways that require us to think differently, iterate often and learn constantly. It's exciting. Our people, whom we refer to as "ZEOs," are empowered to take on a mindset of ownership and make a bigger impact here. Our teams collaborate deeply, exchange different ideas openly and together we're making what's next possible for our customers, community and the world. ### ### **Benefits** Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs' wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide: * Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance\-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company\-wide year\-end break * Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy) * Learning \& development stipend to support ongoing growth * Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available * Mental wellbeing resources and support * *Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process* \#ZEOLife at Zuora ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We: * Collaborate deeply across teams and regions * Learn constantly and iterate often * Build an inclusive, high\-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued #### **Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace** Think, be and do you. At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts. Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to **assistance@zuora.com** (or local equivalent, where applicable).

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer, Agent Management Platform
jobs.description: ### **About CrewAI** CrewAI is the leading framework and enterprise platform for building and orchestrating multi\-agent AI systems, powering 300M\+ agent executions per month across thousands of companies. The Agent Management Platform is our control plane for deploying, monitoring, governing, and scaling agents in production. ### **The Role** You'll build the CrewAI Agent Management Platform, where teams create, deploy, monitor, and govern AI agents in production. You'll make complex AI infrastructure feel understandable and usable, helping customers diagnose failures, review decisions, and stay in control of their automations. This is a senior full\-stack product engineering role with a strong frontend emphasis. You'll spend most of your time building rich, intuitive interfaces, while owning the backend changes needed to deliver complete features. Our stack combines React and TypeScript with Rails, Hotwire, and PostgreSQL. You'll lead work from problem definition through launch, partnering closely with design, product, and runtime engineers. ### **What You'll Do** * Build complete product workflows across Studio's visual editor, deployments, traces, and human review, as well as onboarding, integrations, permissions, and settings. * Work with design and product to clarify customer problems, prototype solutions, and iterate using real usage and feedback. * Shape frontend architecture: component APIs, state management, data fetching, navigation, and rendering performance. Balance maintainability with shipping speed. * Make asynchronous workflows reliable and understandable: live updates, editing and saving, validation, errors, retries, and recovery. * Extend our shared design system across React and Rails, improving consistency, accessibility, and theming. * Build the Rails models, services, APIs, and background jobs your features need. Partner with runtime and infrastructure engineers on deeper platform capabilities. * Ship with meaningful frontend and Rails tests, browser verification, and instrumentation; diagnose and resolve production issues. * Help the team ship better work through technical decisions, code reviews, mentoring, and reusable patterns. ### **What We're Looking For** * A track record of independently delivering substantial full\-stack product features, with particular depth in frontend engineering. * Deep proficiency in React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, including component design, complex state, asynchronous behavior, and performance. * Experience shipping rich, interactive products such as editors, workflow builders, developer tools, or applications with complex data. * Strong product and interaction judgment. You can simplify technical workflows and make thoughtful decisions without needing every interaction specified. * Practical accessibility knowledge: semantic interfaces, keyboard navigation, focus management, and accessible component behavior. * Demonstrated ability to independently ship backend changes supporting your features, including data models, APIs, services, and background jobs. Experience with Rails or a comparable framework; Rails experience is preferred. * Pragmatic judgment about improving an existing codebase: when to reuse, refactor, or introduce a new abstraction. * Clear communication and the ability to align engineering, product, and design around a solution. * Ownership of production outcomes and curiosity about AI agents, execution traces, and human review workflows. ### **Bonus** * Experience with visual canvases, graph interfaces, observability products, or live event streams. * Ruby on Rails, Hotwire/Stimulus, ViewComponent, or shared design\-system experience. * Experience building AI products, human review workflows, or enterprise permission and integration experiences. * Experience improving frontend developer tooling, testing infrastructure, or component documentation.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Senior Data Scientist** **About Us** At Gifthealth, we're revolutionizing the way people experience healthcare by simplifying the process of managing prescriptions and health services. Our mission is to provide a seamless, personalized, and efficient healthcare experience for all our customers. We're a dynamic, innovative, and customer\-centric company dedicated to making a positive impact on people's lives. **Position Summary** We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to own traditional machine learning models that answer operational and patient\-outcome questions, and support the evaluation of agentic AI workflows as our team begins to field generative workflows that act on model scores and real\-time signals. This position plays a key role in supporting theAI/ML Engineering team and reports to the Sr. Manager, AI/ML Engineering, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, operational excellence, and compliance standards. This is an individual\-contributor role with no direct reports today, though you will mentor newer teammates as the team grows. You'll join a small but growing cross\-functional team with high autonomy and minimal ceremony. We are building new services and practices from the ground up, we write things down, and we invest in education, upskilling, and career growth. We deliver quickly and iterate. Data is PHI. HIPAA, BAAs, masking, and role\-based access are daily working realities here, not a compliance module you click through once. **Key Responsibilities** * Models against operational decisions: own traditional machine learning models that answer questions such as which patients are likely to miss their next refill, switch pharmacies, or stall before checkout; which new prescriptions will stall in prior authorization; and how to optimize call volume, staffing demand, or distribution center throughput, driving both patient outcomes and operational improvements. * Agentic AI evaluation: own the evaluation mechanisms that prove agentic AI workflows are reliable, and infuse data\-driven rigor into generative workflow development decisions such as foundation model selection and parameter optimization. * Training data sourcing and preparation: partner with data engineers on the pipelines your features depend on, drive sourcing of new data inputs, and own modeling data end\-to\-end, within a data platform built on Snowflake, a few hundred dbt models, Terraform, and Looker. * The data science practice: define how the team evaluates and validates a model, how it's documented, what's monitored, and what gets retired. Document best practices and mentor new data scientists as the team grows. **Qualifications** * **Education**: A degree is optional; we evaluate demonstrated capability, not credentials. * **Licensure/Certification**: Not applicable. * **Experience**: Typically 4 to 7 years of experience, as a guide rather than a requirement. * **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**: + You have built predictive models and shipped them into a business process, and you can name the decision each one served. + You have owned at least part of how your models run after launch: deployment, batch or real\-time scoring, monitoring or retraining. Ideally on a cloud ML platform such as Snowflake ML or Amazon SageMaker. + Strong SQL and strong Python. Comfortable in a cloud warehouse and in dbt, or clearly able to get there fast. + Real statistical judgment: you know the difference between a model that validates well and a model that will hold up, and you can explain leakage, drift, and a badly chosen target to a non\-technical stakeholder. + You have worked with LLMs seriously enough to be skeptical: you build evaluations, you know where hallucination bites, and you do not confuse a good demo with a working capability. + Demonstrated application of the above Qualification + You are comfortable being the first: no playbook, no platform, an incomplete warehouse underneath you, and a need to pick the right first problem anyway. + You can say "this should not be a model" and mean it. Some of what looks like a data science problem here is a broken process or a missing field. + You exercise strong independent judgment and you mentor newer teammates. Both are level expectations in this role, and you will be the person others bring modeling questions to. + You use AI tools effectively, but your foundational coding and data science skills are sharp enough that you can read, audit, and debug every line yourself. If an agent writes it, you still own it and can defend it. + Nice to have: Snowflake, and especially Snowflake ML (Feature Store, Model Registry, Snowpark). This is a strong plus, as it's where our models are built and served today. + Nice to have: healthcare, pharmacy, payer, or life\-sciences data, such as claims, prior authorization, benefit investigation, or adherence measurement. + Nice to have: generative AI platforms such as Snowflake Cortex AI or Amazon Bedrock. + Nice to have: working with PHI under HIPAA and BAAs, and the instincts that come with it. + Nice to have: time series and forecasting at operational cadence, for staffing or volume. + Nice to have: survival analysis or any honest treatment of censored data. + Nice to have: probabilistic record linkage or master data management. + Nice to have: experience introducing data science into a company that did not have it. **Work Environment** * **Location**: Columbus, OH or remote (US). * **Schedule**: Full\-time; standard business hours. * May require flexibility to support model monitoring, retraining, or evaluation work tied to operational decisions. * Regular collaboration with data engineers and the AI/ML Engineering team to ensure alignment. **Key Essential Functions** * Must be able to work at a computer for extended periods * Must be able to communicate effectively, verbally and in writing, with data engineers and non\-technical stakeholders * Must be able to handle and access PHI in compliance with HIPAA, BAA, masking, and role\-based access requirements * Must be able to read, audit, and debug code and models, including output produced with AI tools **Employment Classification** **Status:** Full\-time **FLSA:** Exempt **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement** Gifthealth is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, transgender status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you do not meet every requirement but still feel you would be a great fit for this role, we encourage you to apply! **Disclaimer** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required of personnel. Gifthealth reserves the right to modify job duties or descriptions at any time.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Service Delivery Manager
jobs.description: **Service Delivery Manager – SDM** **Purpose:** Accountable for delivery, quality, safety and people across a site cluster of roughly 90–100 field staff running 24x7\. The primary point of contact for the client's site and programme leads in that cluster. **What you will do** * Lead the cluster's Tech Leads, Senior Auditors, Auditors and Lead Network Engineers across day, swing and night shifts. * Deliver the audit plan for each site: coverage, throughput and evidence quality to the client's audit specification. * Hold quality: QA re\-audit pass rate of at least 98%; act fast on rework, method gaps and weak shifts. * Run the site rhythm: shift handovers, daily huddles, discrepancy triage with the client's design and DCIM owners, weekly reviews. * Plan and execute site rotations with PMO, Travel and Admin, so crews move without idle time. * Own people: rosters, overtime approval, attrition, performance, coaching and career paths to Tech Lead. * Work with the EHS lead and site safety officers; stop work when it is not safe. * Report cluster KPIs, risks and staffing to the Senior SDM and PMO; escalate per the defined escalation path. **What you bring** * 10\+ years in data center, network or field operations; 5\+ years managing field teams of 50\+ across shifts. * Hands\-on experience in hyperscaler data center build\-outs or operations: structured cabling, fiber, rack and network turn\-up, QA / QC. * Has run 24x7 operations and handled client escalations on live sites. * Data\-driven: runs a site on KPIs, dashboards and logs. * Willing to be based at, and move between, client data center sites in the US. * Preferred: PMP, ITIL or Lean; OSHA 30; BICSI or fiber certifications. **How we will measure success (first 6 months)** * Cluster audit KPIs at target: QA re\-audit pass rate at least 98%; evidence and log completeness at least 99%. * Zero recordable safety incidents; zero client\-raised SEVs from our work. * Shift coverage at plan; 30\-day attrition below plan. * Site moves completed with no unplanned idle crew days. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Datastores
jobs.description: Office Engineering Hybrid Full\-time ### **About Rootly** At Rootly, we are on a mission to be the go\-to way companies respond when things go wrong, helping every organization be more reliable. We do this by building an industry\-leading incident management platform that allows companies around the world to consistently and quickly resolve incidents. We are not simply transforming an industry, we are carving out a new multi\-billion\-dollar category ourselves and need incredible talent to achieve this ambitious goal together. Customers love Rootly. Some of the fastest\-growing companies around the world such as NVIDIA, DoorDash, Uber, Canva, Tripadvisor, Squarespace and more rely on Rootly to power their critical incident management process. They obsess over our delightful enterprise\-ready platform and unique partnership model. Investors love Rootly. We are backed by some of the most respected funds in the world from Y Combinator to operators like the CTO of Dropbox and GitHub. We'd be happy to disclose our entire funding and profitability picture live during the interview. As a culture we relentlessly put transparency first. We conduct monthly financial reviews as a team so everyone has a pulse on the health of the business and publish what we are building in our weekly changelog. ### **About the Role** As a Senior Platform Engineer focused on datastores, you'll be the team's expert on PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Kafka, and Redis. You'll find and fix the locking, pooling, and query problems that can slow Rootly down under load, and you'll raise the whole engineering team's depth through pairing, reviews, and runbooks rather than owning the datastores alone. Like everyone on Platform, you'll also share responsibility for the platform as a whole and take your turn on call. You'll work closely with our platform engineering leader, and with product engineers to shape how their features store and query data. ### **What You'll Do** * Own the performance and reliability of PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, and Redis in production. * Find and fix lock contention, connection pooling limits, slow queries, and job fan\-out that degrade under load. * Lead capacity planning and load testing so we know our limits before a customer's worst day finds them. * Set standards for schema changes, migrations, indexing, and query patterns, and build checks that catch problems before they ship. * Review data\-heavy changes from product teams and teach the patterns behind your feedback. * Build the dashboards, runbooks, and alerts that let any engineer debug a datastore incident. * Partner on multi\-region data replication and recovery with the Infrastructure side of Platform. ### **What You'll Need** We care about impact, ownership, and technical judgement. Degrees and big\-name logos are not required. What matters is your ability to execute, influence, and teach. ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years building and running production systems, with significant time on datastore performance and reliability. * Experience supporting multi\-tenant systems at scale, including tenant isolation, noisy\-neighbour protection, and keeping one customer's traffic spike from degrading service for everyone else. * Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL internals: locking, MVCC, query plans, indexing, vacuum, and connection pooling. * Experience running OpenSearch or Elasticsearch at scale. * Experience with capacity planning and load testing for web services. * You fix the class of problem, not the instance, and leave behind tools and docs others use. * You write production\-grade software, and you're comfortable working in an application codebase, not only in the database. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Rails, ActiveRecord, and Sidekiq at scale. * Experience with Redis as a queue and cache under heavy load. * Experience with cross\-region replication and database failover. * Experience with Kafka or DynamoDB. ### **What Success Looks Like** By 6 to 12 months you will have: * Fixed the top locking, pooling, and slow\-query issues behind our historical SEV0 incidents. * Established a load testing baseline and capacity plan, so we know our limits before customers find them. * Put schema change and migration standards in place, backed by automated checks. * Built dashboards, runbooks, and alerts that let any engineer on call debug a datastore incident. * Spread datastore depth across the team, so reliability doesn't depend on any one person. ### **Our Tech Stack** * Backend: Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Redis, Sidekiq, AWS Lambda, ECS, Kafka, DynamoDB * Frontend: Turbo, Stimulus, ViewComponents * Infrastructure: AWS, OpenTofu/Terraform (IaC), Datadog ### **Why Rootly?** We're not just another startup. We're building something category\-defining and want teammates who crave ownership, love solving hard problems, and thrive in a high\-bar, high\-impact environment. Here's what you can expect when you join Rootly: * Competitive compensation and early equity in a fast\-growing, venture\-backed company. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. * 3 weeks of vacation, plus unlimited sick and mental health days, and a company\-wide end\-of\-year shutdown to recharge. * $500 stipend for home office setup. * Unlimited token usage and access to AI tools. * A fast\-moving, high\-impact environment where your leadership and ideas directly shape the future of the company. This is a newly created vacancy, and we may hire more than one person to fill it. As we build out the team, we may use AI to support parts of our interview process, like reviewing assessments, but it's a tool that helps our people, not a substitute for their judgement. If this sounds like the kind of challenge and opportunity you're looking for, apply now and let's build something great together. *Accommodations are available on request at any stage of our recruitment process. Contact recruitment@rootly.com and we will work with you to meet your needs confidentially.* *Rootly is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, record of offences, marital status, family status, disability, or any other ground protected by the Ontario Human Rights Code or applicable law.*
